The beginning of an end for Chinese counter-revolution

Over two years of the reign of counter revolution have passed in China and now this country is again immersed into starvation, disorder and economic crisis. It is also aflame with fresh "generals'" wars.
The Imperialistic Powers, in spite of the contradictions of their interests in China, have unanimously refused to give up extraterritoriality. America, which at first exhibited such great anxiety over Nanking's welfare, was the first to announce refusal. By doing so the imperialistic Powers have pointed out his place to the hangman Chiang Kai Shek with all his treacherous programme of China's unification and prosperity.
The Municipal Council of the International Settlement has erected iron gates on the border of the Chinese territory and the Settlement. This is a symbol of the iron foot of imperialism in China and its strengthening.
None but the victorious labourers' and peasants' revolution will be able to free the country from the yoke of imperialism. This revolution is coming on with every succeeding day. The labour class of China is recovering from serious defeat. The strike movement, which has increased, testifies to that. In January 1929 alone 77 conflicts took place between the labourers and their employers in Shanghai, having involved 21.000 workers. This Summer 15.000 silk mills labourers went on strike there. Labour disturbances also occured in Peipin, Tientsin and Canton. The most important factor in all this is that the economic struggle is turning into a political one. On May 30 and August 1 revolutionary demonstrations by labourers were held once more on the streets of Shanghai after a considerable break.
There is also the development of rural revolution. Revolutionary partisan detachments have been formed and have extended. At present there are in China nine Soviet centres. The peasants in uprising are spreading their influence from the South to Central China. The support of the Soviet and dictatorship of labourers and peasants are advocated. This mass wave, representing the growing revolutionary movement, is the direct outcome of Chiang-Kai-Shek's reactionary programme. The wave of labourers' and peasants' revolution will wipe off the remainder of the regime of Kuomintang hangmen.

Message from Comrade Stalin.

Comradely greetings to the men and commanders of the Special Far Eastern Army, which is defending the rights and interests of the October Revolution against the encroachments of Chinese land owners and capitalists. Watch closely every movement of Chinese counter-revolutionaries. Deal a blow for a blow and help thereby our brethren in China, the labourers and peasants, to destroy the yoke of oppression.
Remember that on this great day, November 7, millions of labourers of the U.S.S.R. are thinking of you whilst celebrating the anniversary of Revolution and are also rejoicing at the success attained by the Special Far Eastern Army.
Long live the October Revolution! Long live the Special Far Eastern Army! Long live labourers and peasants of China'.

（批：Action / usual authorities / 6/12 / dec.）

中国反革命的终结之始

在中国，反革命统治已过去两年有余，如今这个国家再次陷入饥荒、混乱和经济危机之中。新的“军阀”战争也在此刻烽火重燃。
尽管帝国主义列强在华利益存在矛盾，但它们一致拒绝放弃治外法权。起初对南京政府福祉表现出极大关切的美国，率先宣布拒绝放弃。通过此举，帝国主义列强向刽子手蒋介石及其欺骗性的中国统一与繁荣计划指明了其地位。
公共租界工部局已在中国领土与租界的边界上竖起了铁门。这是帝国主义在华铁蹄及其强化势力的象征。
唯有胜利的工农革命才能将国家从帝国主义的枷锁中解放出来。这场革命正日益临近。中国工人阶级正从严重的失败中恢复过来。罢工运动的增加证明了这一点。仅在1929年1月，上海就发生了77起劳资冲突，涉及21,000名工人。今年夏天，那里有15,000名丝厂工人举行罢工。北平、天津和广州也发生了劳工骚乱。所有这一切中最重要的因素是，经济斗争正在转变为政治斗争。在经历了相当长一段时间的沉寂后，5月30日和8月1日，工人们再次在上海街头举行了革命示威游行。
农村革命也在发展。革命游击队已经组建并得到扩展。目前中国有九个苏维埃中心。起义农民的影响力正从华南向华中蔓延。人们主张支持苏维埃以及工农专政。这股代表日益增长的革命运动的群众浪潮，是蒋介石反动计划的直接后果。工农革命的浪潮将扫除国民党刽子手政权的残余。

斯大林同志的贺电。

向保卫十月革命的权利和利益、抵御中国地主和资本家侵犯的特别远东军的官兵们致以同志般的问候。密切监视中国反革命分子的一举一动。以牙还牙，以此帮助我们的中国兄弟——工农群众——摧毁压迫的枷锁。
请记住，在这个伟大的日子——11月7日，当苏联数百万劳动者庆祝革命周年纪念日时，他们正思念着你们，并为特别远东军取得的成就感到欢欣鼓舞。
十月革命万岁！特别远东军万岁！中国工农万岁！

（批：行动 / 常规主管部门 / 6/12 / 十二月。）

friends with the Chinese and tried to explain things to them
to the best of their ability. An artist painted a fat,
wealthy merchant riding in a ricsha pulled by a miserable
looking coolie. In this way the Soviet military men made
friends with the Chinese prisoners of the Mukden army. This
caused the Chinese prisoners to change their attitude. They
lost their timidity and showed signs of being conscious
regarding what was happening. It was necessary to find out
which of the men were officers. After much hesitation one
man came forward and pointed them out, having previously
indicated their ranks. A publication was invited to which
several of the men contributed. One was to the following
effect, written by a sailor of the Sungari fleet. "The life
of a peasant and a city poor man is very difficult amongst
Chinese. The rich have taken possession of everything and
are exploiting us by buying off our lives, as if we were
dogs. The masters in our country and in the Red country have
different purposes. There are a great many labourers in
China who would be willing to frustrate the plans of the
Generals. When they do so we shall be victorious. Life will
become brighter and we will then help our Russian comrades".
The camp of the Soviet is more like a political school
and cannot compare with that of the Sumbei. New ideas enter
the minds of the Chinese prisoners as to Soviet Republic
and October Revolution.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

中国工农致苏联的电文。

中国工人阶级和农民群众
向苏联致以问候，支持其社会主义
建设。值此十月革命12周年之际，并与世界
无产阶级联合，中国人将加强反对
国际帝国主义及其在华代理人——
国民党——的斗争，同时也反对试图
发动对苏战争的蒋介石、张学良、
汪精卫和张发奎。
中国工人阶级联盟与
苏联联盟万岁！
打倒国际帝国主义和中国
国民党！
全世界无产者，联合起来！
让我们保卫全世界劳动者
唯一的祖国——苏联！
共产国际万岁！

两个阵营。

在列举了哈尔滨针对苏联公民的集中营孙贝伊（Sumbei，音译）所犯下的可怕暴行后，作者接着描述了苏联军队对待俘虏的舒适环境和良好待遇。几名中国人被俘并被带到苏联营地。看到他们的长官如何对待敌方俘虏，这些人对自己即将面临的遭遇充满了焦虑。他们被带进一个明亮的大厅，感到非常惊讶。他们不敢相信每个人都会配备一张舒适的床，并对大厅装饰着旗帜等物品感到惊奇。看到这一切，俘虏们的脸色变得开朗起来。不久之后，“列宁”号轮船的一些水手带着乐器进来，开始跳舞并提供普遍的娱乐活动。他们还唱了歌。红色舰队的水手们与中国人交上了朋友，并尽力向他们解释事情。一位艺术家画了一幅画：一个肥胖富有的商人坐在一辆由看起来凄惨的苦力拉着的黄包车上。通过这种方式，苏联军人与奉天军队的中国俘虏建立了友谊。这使中国俘虏改变了态度。他们失去了胆怯，表现出对正在发生的事情有了意识。有必要查明哪些人是军官。经过多次犹豫，一个人站了出来，指出了他们，并事先标明了他们的军衔。大家受邀参与一份出版物，其中几人 contributed（投稿）。其中一篇由松花江舰队的一名水手撰写，大意如下：“在中国，农民和城市贫民的生活非常艰难。富人占据了一切，并通过收买我们的生命来剥削我们，仿佛我们是狗一样。我们国家和红色国家的主人们有着不同的目的。中国有很多劳动者愿意挫败将军们的计划。当他们这样做时，我们将取得胜利。生活将变得更加光明，届时我们将帮助我们的俄罗斯同志”。
苏联的营地更像是一所政治学校，无法与孙贝伊（Sumbei，音译）相比。关于苏维埃共和国和十月革命的新思想进入了中国俘虏的脑海。

pages.en:
- 3 -

Blueher re his Special Army.

Blueher said that the question as to why he will not
take on Volunteers to serve in the Special Army is of great
interest at present to the labourers of Vladivostock and the
whole of Soviet Russia.. Inquiries are being received from
all parts of the country to that effect. He added that if
he were to accept all applicants he could form five such armies
as the Special, but there is no need for such a step just yet.
The Special Army although not very numerous as compared
to the Chinese Army, stationed on the border, is strong enough
to defend Soviet borders and is in a position to deal successfully
with every problem and task.

Dutch reign of terror in Indonesia(Dutch Indies).

Inspite of the continuous reign of terror perpetrated
by the Dutch Authorities in Dutch Indies, the movement for
freedom and independence is progressing under the guidance
and leadership of the labour unions.
The Dutch Authorities consequently are endeavouring
to obtain the support of the leaders by appointing them to
various Government posts. In this their policy..the the Dutch
Authorities are being unanimously supported by the social-
democrats of Holland. It is not a mere coincidence that
the first act of the reign of terror against revolutionary
unions took place immediately after the appointment of
a certain social-democrat named Kulenfeld to the post connected
with the Ministry for Home Affairs. Another social democrat
named Stokwis, who is always advising the authorities to
execute communists without any mercy, continues to act against
the extremists. All the arrested persons are sent to the
"New Guinea" Island.

Comrade Rykoff's speech at a Conference in Moscow.

In making a detailed speech on the subject of the Sino-
Soviet C.E.R. conflict, relations with China and other
matters affecting the interests of U.S.S.R. Comrade Rykoff
made the following statement.
The International Concession or the Settlement of Shanghai
occupies a special place in China representing in itself
"a country in a country", almost entirely governed by the
British. Millions of Chinese reside in the Settlement
and but several tens of thousands of foreigners. The
Chinese have no say in the management of the Settlement.
In addition Chinese residing in the Settlement are subject
to a special Provisional Court and not the Chinese Court,
foreign influence being uppermost in the former.
The Government of Nanking is reactionary and hence
against the Soviet. However the wide masses of labourers
have a different opinion about U.S.S.R.
The policy of U.S.S.R. towards China was made clear
in the declaration of July 25, 1919 when the Boxer indemnity
and the extraterritorial rights were relinquished in favour
of China.

"Izvestia" of September 28,
1929.

（印：POLITICAL BRANCH (FOREIGN SECTION) DATE 5 / 12 / 29）
pages.zh:
- 3 -

布柳赫尔（Blueher，音译）谈其特别军。

布柳赫尔（Blueher，音译）表示，关于他为何不招募志愿者在特别军中服役的问题，目前引起了符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）及全苏联劳动者的极大兴趣。全国各地都在就此问题进行询问。他补充说，如果他接受所有申请人，他可以组建五支像特别军这样的军队，但目前没有必要采取这一步骤。
特别军虽然与驻扎在边境的中国军队相比人数不多，但足以保卫苏联边境，并有能力成功处理每一个问题和任务。

荷兰在印度尼西亚（荷属东印度）的恐怖统治。

尽管荷兰当局在荷属东印度持续实施恐怖统治，但在工会的指导和领导下，争取自由和独立的运动仍在进展。
因此，荷兰当局正努力通过任命各种政府职位来获得领导人的支持。在这一政策中，荷兰当局得到了荷兰社会民主党人的一致支持。并非巧合的是，针对革命工会的恐怖统治的第一次行动，恰恰发生在一名名为库伦费尔德（Kulenfeld，音译）的社会民主党人被任命为与内政部有关的职位之后立即发生。另一位名为斯托克维斯（Stokwis，音译）的社会民主党人，一直建议当局毫不留情地处决共产党人，继续对极端分子采取行动。所有被捕人员都被送往“新几内亚”岛。

雷科夫（Rykoff，音译）同志在莫斯科会议上的讲话。

在就中苏中东铁路冲突、对华关系及其他影响苏联利益的事项发表详细讲话时，雷科夫（Rykoff，音译）同志作了如下陈述。
上海的国际租界或公共租界在中国占据特殊地位，其本身代表着“国中之国”，几乎完全由英国人治理。数百万中国人居住在租界内，而外国人仅有数万人。中国人在租界的管理中没有发言权。此外，居住在租界的中国人受特别临时法院管辖，而非中国法院管辖，前者的外国影响力占主导地位。
南京政府是反动的，因此反对苏联。然而，广大劳动群众对苏联持有不同看法。
苏联对华政策在1919年7月25日的宣言中已明确，当时苏联放弃了庚子赔款和治外法权，将其让予中国。

1929年9月28日的《消息报》（Izvestia）。

（印：政治处（外事科）日期 5 / 12 / 29）

The "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) of May 31,
Civil war in China.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL C.I.D No. I. G... 2199 writes:- Date... 26.6.29.）

Before the war between Nanking and Kwangse had ceased Feng Yu Hsiang in the North declared war on Nanking. The political significance of these wars between the various parties is proof of the united frontier of counterrevolutionary camp, formed after the Canton Soviet uprising, having fallen through.

China, however, is to such an extent a colonial country and subject to so many contraries of the imperialistic camp that the civil war of different political Chinese groups remains to be a mystery if no consideration is given to the policy of imperialistic powers. Nanking is at present a weapon in the hands of the U.S.A. imperialism, which is aiming to turn China from a semi-colony of three Imperialistic countries into one fully that of America. The Kwangse group represents British interests and the British are trying to secure a sphere of influence in South China.

American advisers in Nanking, American concessions on radio stations in China, American concession for aerial service, American control over the railways in China all these are but a preliminary step of the greedy American imperialism in China. So far American banks are bound with the British, Japanese and French by an agreement on "International Consortium" concluded on October 15, 1920 and expiring on October 15, 1930. According to that agreement industrial Government loans intended for China should be divided in an equal measure between the banks of England, France, Japan and U.S.A. However the agreement is expiring in 1930 and everything goes to show that American Financial capital intends to exploit China on the principle of monopoly. This explains the opposition set up by the British, Japanese and French Imperialism to America.

The "Washington Post" writes:-
"Americans should understand that China in a considerable measure depends on foreign capital for railway improvements and constructions as well as of other branches in business; if our advisers will work successfully, China must get financial assistance in our country and in order to get that the Nanking Government has to show that it is capable of governing the country in a wise manner".

Chiang Kai Shek is obeying these instructions of American Imperialism, whilst England and Japan are endeavouring to undermine the policy of U.S.A. in Nanking by instigating wars between the Generals and supporting intrigues. The Kwangse group and Feng are but instruments in this tremendous sanguinary game of the imperialists.

Happenings in China are dependent on extensive clash of contraries between imperialists and between those of the Chinese groups.

At the same time there is a reign of disorder in the Chinese peasant districts.

Imperialism and counter-revolution have been making efforts during the past two years to "solve" the problem of China, but instead of that things are going more and more apart.

(Pravda).

25:6:29.

5月31日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya），
中国的内战。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处政治部 编号 I. G... 2199 写道：- 日期... 1929年6月26日。）

在南京与广西派系的战争尚未停止之前，北方的冯玉祥向南京宣战。各派系之间这些战争的政治意义证明，在广州苏维埃起义后形成的反革命阵营的统一战线已经破裂。

然而，中国是一个殖民地国家，受制于帝国主义阵营的诸多矛盾，如果不考虑帝国主义列强的政策，中国不同政治集团之间的内战仍然是一个谜。南京目前是美国帝国主义手中的武器，其目标是将中国从三个帝国主义国家的半殖民地转变为完全由美国控制的殖民地。广西派系代表英国利益，英国人正试图确保其在华南的势力范围。

南京的美国顾问、美国在中国广播电台获得的特许权、美国获得的航空服务特许权、美国对中国铁路的控制，所有这些都只是贪婪的美国帝国主义在中国的初步步骤。到目前为止，美国银行受1920年10月15日签订、1930年10月15日到期的“国际财团”协议的约束，与英国、日本和法国绑定在一起。根据该协议，旨在提供给中国的工业政府贷款应在英国、法国、日本和美国的银行之间平均分配。然而，该协议将于1930年到期，一切迹象表明，美国金融资本打算按照垄断原则剥削中国。这就解释了英国、日本和法国帝国主义对美国的反对。

《华盛顿邮报》写道：-
“美国人应该明白，中国在很大程度上依赖外国资本来改善和建设铁路以及其他商业部门；如果我们的顾问工作成功，中国必须从我国获得财政援助，为了获得这种援助，南京政府必须证明它有能力以明智的方式治理国家”。

蒋介石服从美国帝国主义的这些指示，而英国和日本则通过煽动将领之间的战争和支持阴谋活动，努力破坏美国在南京的政策。广西派系和冯玉祥只是帝国主义这场巨大的血腥游戏中的工具。

中国的事态发展取决于帝国主义列强之间以及中国各集团之间广泛的矛盾冲突。

与此同时，中国农村地区处于混乱状态。

在过去两年中，帝国主义和反革命势力一直努力“解决”中国问题，但事与愿违，局势越来越分裂。

（《真理报》）。

1929年6月25日。

The "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) of June 4, writes;-
London and Tokio inspire activities in Nanking and Harbin.
England is endeavouring with the help of her agents
to take advantage of the Generals' cliques in China being
at war in order to create dissension between China and
U.S.S.R.
The Nanking Government in its declaration against
Feng Wu Hsiang dares to accuse Soviet Russia of co-operation
with Feng Yu Hsiang and the supplying of the latter with
funds, ammunition, advice and even having a secret agreement
with him.
On April 2I in the Japanese newspapers published
in Peking there appeared information to the effect that
the Nanking Government was in possession of "secret
instructions of the Department of Eastern Political Committee
in Moscow" sent out to all Soviet Consuls in China. These
instructions allege to give away Moscow and Feng's plans
of co-operation, etc. and are said to emanate from
Soviet Consuls in Tientsin and Harbin.
The Nanking Government up to very latest time denied
the truth of these documents and only one month later
referred to them because it was necessary once more to
emphasize its fidelity to the imperialists, who are great
enemies of China and U.S.S.R.
All this is a proof of the pressure from London and
Tokio causing the dark forces to "act" in Nanking and Harbin.
However, the regular provocation of imperialists and their
hirelings is doomed to utter failure this time. The Chinese
masses know that Soviet Russia is their only true friend
and the defender of China's freedom and independence and is
opposed to all militarists, who ill-treat labourers and
peasants and bow down before imperialists.

A timely warning.

With reference to the attack on the Soviet Consulate
in Harbin contrary to all international rights, it is as
well for the Chinese Authorities concerned to note that
a similar attitude will be taken towards their official
representatives in Soviet territory. Moreover the Soviet
people and Government can make a distinction between Chinese
labouring masses, with which they wish to live on friendly
terms and in peace, in view of the labourers of both the
countries having common economic interests and in close
neighbourhood. They all wish to fight the common enemy -
imperialism and their irresponsible politicians.
Friendship between U.S.S.R. and China will remain
unchanged in spite of all incidents and provocations caused
by the imperialists through their direct or indirect agents.
However a stop must be put to Chinese provocation and this
was diplomatically conveyed as a warning to the Government
of Nanking. Let us hope for the benefit of China and
Russia that this warning will be heeded.

（印：POLITICAL BRANCH (FOREIGN SECTION) DATE 25.6.29）

（批：No!）

H.B.M.C.G.,
Col. Holland,
Capt. Goldsmid &
Lieut. Carlson.
G. Y. [签名]）

6月4日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）写道：-
伦敦和东京策动南京和哈尔滨的活动。
英国正企图利用其代理人，
趁中国军阀派系交战之机，
制造中国与苏联之间的不和。
南京政府在其反对冯玉祥的宣言中，
竟指责苏联俄国与冯玉祥合作，
并向后者提供资金、弹药和建议，
甚至与其签有秘密协定。
4月21日，在北京出版的日本报纸上
刊登消息称，南京政府掌握了“莫斯科
东方政治委员会发给所有驻华商
领事的‘秘密指令’”。这些指令据称
泄露了莫斯科与冯玉祥的合作计划等，
并声称源自天津和哈尔滨的苏联领事。
直到最近，南京政府一直否认这些文件
的真实性，仅在一个月后才提及它们，
因为有必要再次强调其对帝国主义的
忠诚，而帝国主义是中国和苏联的大敌。
所有这些都证明了来自伦敦和
东京的压力，导致黑暗势力在南京和哈尔滨“行动”。
然而，帝国主义及其走狗的常规挑衅
这次注定要彻底失败。中国民众知道，
苏联俄国是他们唯一真正的朋友，
是中国自由和独立的捍卫者，
反对所有虐待劳工和农民、
向帝国主义低头的军阀。

及时的警告。

鉴于违反所有国际法准则袭击哈尔滨苏联领事馆一事，
有关中国当局最好注意，
对其在苏联领土上的官方代表
也将采取类似态度。此外，苏联人民和政府能够区分
中国劳动大众——鉴于两国劳动者拥有共同的经济利益
且毗邻而居，苏联希望与他们和平友好相处。
他们都希望打击共同的敌人——
帝国主义及其不负责任的政客。
尽管帝国主义通过其直接或间接代理人
制造了所有事件和挑衅，
苏联与中国之间的友谊将保持不变。
然而，必须制止中国的挑衅行为，
这一警告已通过外交途径传达给南京政府。
让我们希望为了中国和俄罗斯的利益，
这一警告能得到重视。

（印：政治部（外事科） 日期 1929年6月25日）

（批：不！）

（批：抄送：
英国驻华公使，
霍兰德上校，
戈尔德斯米德上尉 &
卡尔森中尉。
G. Y. [签名]）

(published in Izvestia)
The "Izvestia", of April 14 writes:-

Slogans for May Day.

I. Long Live May I - the day of review for revolutionary
forces of the international proletariat.
2. Long live the Com.intern - the organizer and leader of
proletarian revolution, Lenin's headquarters of world's
proletariat.
3. On May I the proletarians of U.S.S.R. demonstrate
their solidarity with the international proletariat
and the oppressed colonies. Long live the international
proletarian revolution.
4. Millions of India's labourers are rising up for the
struggle against British imperialism, against landowners
and national bourgeoisie. Long Live Soviet India!
5. Proletarian greetings to the oppressed nations of the
East, struggling against imperialistic yoke.
6. On May I our revolutionary greetings to the prisoners
of capitalism, the victims of bloody fascism, the
warriors for world-wide October.
7. Bourgeoisie is preparing an imperialistic war. The
labour Class under the banner of Komintern will turn
it into a civil war for the dictatorship of the proletariat.
8. Long live International Red Day of struggle against
the imperialistic war in defence of U.S.S.R.
9. Social-democrats are the main support of imperialists
in the preparation for new wars and the attack on U.S.S.R.
Down with social imperialists. Long live the international
communism.
10. In the face of new great battles those of faint heart
are leaving the ranks of the International. Merciless
opposition to the "right" and Trotsky's adherents. Long
live Lenin's Com intern, which advocates the will of Marx
and Lenin.
11. The pact of Kellogg in the hands of the bourgeois
governments is but a mask of hypocrisy for the preparation
of new wars. Proletarians of all countries, unite, pull
down that mask, build up new ranks for the overthrow of
the bourgeoisie.
12. Only international proletarian revolution can put an
end to the growth of armaments and wars. Long live the
Soviet rule in the whole world.
13. Every new success of U.S.S.R. is a blow to the
international bourgeoisie. Long live the Soviet Union - the
motherland of international proletariat.
14. May Day greetings to the Red Army and the Red Fleet,
the untiring watchmen of Soviet borders, the armed
body of the world revolution.
15. On May Day young army men in the face of the labourers
of the whole world swear to defend U.S.S.R. strongly - this
support of the world revolution.
16. The Red Army is the guard of the world, she will
defend the victories of the October revolution.
17. Industrialization is the foundation of defence of the
country. Industrialization must go on.
18. The Red Army is preparing conscious warriors and builders
of socialism in city and village.
19. U.S.S.R. is the banner of freedom for the oppressed
nationalities of the whole world. Long live the fraternal
union of nationalities.

（印：C.I.D. REC. No 1 (4) 2199... Date ..12.6.29..）
pages.zh:
（发表于《消息报》）
4月14日的《消息报》（Izvestia）写道：-

五一节口号。

1. 五一万岁——国际无产阶级革命力量检阅之日。
2. 共产国际万岁——无产阶级革命的组织者和领导者，世界无产阶级的列宁总部。
3. 5月1日，苏联无产阶级展示其与国际无产阶级及被压迫殖民地的团结。国际无产阶级革命万岁。
4. 印度数百万劳动者奋起斗争，反对英国帝国主义、反对地主和民族资产阶级。苏维埃印度万岁！
5. 向正在反抗帝国主义枷锁的东方被压迫民族致以无产阶级的问候。
6. 5月1日，向资本主义的囚徒、血腥法西斯主义的受害者、全球十月革命的战士致以革命的问候。
7. 资产阶级正在准备帝国主义战争。劳动阶级将在共产国际的旗帜下，将其转化为争取无产阶级专政的内战。
8. 国际红色斗争日万岁，反对帝国主义战争，保卫苏联。
9. 社会民主党人是帝国主义者在准备新战争和攻击苏联时的主要支柱。打倒社会帝国主义者。国际共产主义万岁。
10. 面对新的重大战役，那些意志薄弱者正离开国际的队伍。无情反对“右派”和托洛茨基分子。拥护马克思和列宁意志的列宁共产国际万岁。
11. 凯洛格公约在资产阶级政府手中不过是准备新战争的虚伪面具。各国无产者，联合起来，撕下那层面具，建立推翻资产阶级的新队伍。
12. 只有国际无产阶级革命才能终结军备扩张和战争。全世界苏维埃政权万岁。
13. 苏联的每一个新胜利都是对国际资产阶级的打击。苏联万岁——国际无产阶级的祖国。
14. 五一节向红军和红海军致敬，他们是苏联边境不知疲倦的守望者，是世界革命的武装力量。
15. 5月1日，年轻军人在全世界劳动者面前宣誓坚决保卫苏联——这个世界革命的支柱。
16. 红军是世界的卫士，她将捍卫十月革命的胜利成果。
17. 工业化是国家防御的基础。工业化必须继续推进。
18. 红军正在培养城市和乡村中自觉的社会主义战士和建设者。
19. 苏联是全世界被压迫民族的自由旗帜。各民族兄弟联盟万岁。

（印：政治部 收件编号 1 (4) 2199... 日期 ..1929年6月12日..）

20. For the industrialization, support and collectiveness
of the agricultural economy. Let us develop socialistic
attacks in city and village.
21. We want more metal, cast iron, steel and machinery in
the village.
22. Let us not be afraid of difficulties. Let us shake off
the hesitancy of unbelievers. Let us develop the victorious
socialistic reform.
23. In the bourgeois countries the plunderous exploitation
of labourers is developing. In U.S.S.R. the labourers have
the 7 hour labour day. Long live the 7 hour labour day
the origin of which is October.
24. Competition between factories and mills, coal mines and
workshops is a strong weapon of socialistic education
of masses and the inclusion of millions of workers in
participating in economics.
25. Soviet organization, changing from the formal democracy
of bourgeoisie of the republic to the actual participation
of labourers in the administration, makes a step towards
competition with good prospects (Lenin).
26. We shall raise the labour class through the means of
socialistic competition to oppose the revelry, matrimony
and drunkenness.
27. The productiveness of labour is most important and primary
in the gaining of victory over the new public social order
of things. (Lenin).
28. Socialistic rationalization of produce and the
fixing of lower prices or self-cost, is the business of
the labour class of every description, including labourers
of every factory, mill, coal mine, etc., in Soviet Russia.
29. Long live socialistic rationalization - the foundation
of material and cultural success of the labour class in
the country of proletarian dictatorship.
30. Let us put on the black list factories which tolerate
matrimony and revelry, also idleness and disorder.
31. Voluntary brigades are an example to communistic
attitude towards labour, and a blow to carelessness, etc.
in the manufacturing.
32. Let us boycott an idler and reveller. First May greetings
to the ranks of socialistic competition in the fore!
33. Through the labour unions, which are like a school of
communism, we shall include millions of proletarians in
the building up of socialism. Let us develop and extend
self-criticism in labour unions, connection with the masses
and let us make secure the leadership of the party.
34. Through labour unions let us mobilise the labour class
for a decisive attack on the frontier of labour discipline.
Let us open fire on revelry, drunkenness and hooliganism
in industrial circles.
35. Let us develop socialistic industry. Let us establish
a technical foundation for the improvement of economics.
Let us increase the produce both in city and village.
36. Let us increase bread cultivation. Let peasants unite
in collectives. Let us labour jointly on joint land!
37. Promote science and technics to oppose poverty and
backwardness of the village. Let us increase the land
cultivation in peasant fields. Let us reconstruct the
village on a socialistic basis.
38. A member of the Communist youth is to cultivate not
only the fields of U.S.S.R. but to change the total conditions
of life in the village by introducing the rule of collective-
ness in labour.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

20. 为了工业化，支持和发展农业经济的集体化。让我们在城市和乡村发展社会主义攻势。
21. 我们需要在农村有更多的金属、生铁、钢铁和机械。
22. 不要害怕困难。让我们摆脱怀疑者的犹豫。让我们发展胜利的社会主义改革。
23. 在资产阶级国家，对劳动者的掠夺性剥削正在发展。在苏联，劳动者实行七小时工作制。七小时工作制万岁，其起源在于十月革命。
24. 工厂、矿井和车间之间的竞赛是对群众进行社会主义教育以及让数百万工人参与经济管理的有力武器。
25. 苏维埃组织从共和国资产阶级的形式民主转变为劳动者实际参与管理，迈出了具有良好前景的竞争步伐（列宁）。
26. 我们将通过社会主义竞争手段提升劳动阶级，以反对放纵、婚姻陋习（注：此处原文matrimony可能指代某种旧式家庭束缚或翻译偏差，依原文直译）和酗酒。
27. 劳动生产率在战胜新的公共社会秩序方面是最重要和首要的。（列宁）。
28. 生产的社会主义合理化以及降低价格或成本，是苏联各类劳动阶级的任务，包括每个工厂、矿井等的劳动者。
29. 社会主义合理化万岁——这是无产阶级专政国家中劳动阶级物质和文化成功的基础。
30. 让我们将容忍放纵、婚姻陋习（同上）、怠惰和混乱的工厂列入黑名单。
31. 志愿突击队是共产主义劳动态度的榜样，也是对生产中粗心大意等现象的打击。
32. 让我们抵制懒汉和放纵者。五一节向前沿的社会主义竞争队伍致敬！
33. 通过像共产主义学校一样的工会，我们将数百万无产者纳入社会主义建设。让我们在工会中发展和扩大自我批评，加强与群众的联系，并确保党的领导地位。
34. 通过工会，动员劳动阶级对劳动纪律防线发起决定性攻击。向工业圈子里的放纵、酗酒和流氓行为开火。
35. 让我们发展社会主义工业。让我们为改善经济建立技术基础。让我们增加城市和乡村的产量。
36. 让我们增加粮食种植。让农民加入集体。让我们在共同的土地上共同劳动！
37. 促进科学和技术，以对抗农村的贫困和落后。让我们增加农民田地的耕种面积。让我们在社会主义基础上重建农村。
38. 共青团员不仅要耕种苏联的田地，还要通过在劳动中引入集体主义规则，改变农村的整体生活条件。

39. A Communist in the village is an Organizer of the
Collective Form of economy.
40. Members of the Communist Youth advocate good crops and
collectiveness.
41. The productiveness of labour would have increased in a
double and triple measure and human labour would be minimized
if only economics would be made general in lieu of the
individual peasant method of procedure (Lenin).
42. Let us organize competition between districts and provinces,
villages etc., with a view to co-operation in the matter of
extending wheat sowing fields and the increase in crops.
43. The institution of collective and other groups is the
best method to improve the state of the poor and the freeing
of the village from speculation agents.
44. Let us improve our organizations of economics and arrange
for the construction of new socialistic factories of agriculture.
45. Through the medium of these organizations let us support
the produce of peasants and labourers.
46. In organizing the poor class and in getting them and the
middle class people together under the guidance of the
labour class, we will suppress the speculating element.
47. Our motto is: Support the poor and fight the speculating
crowd.
48. We have a splendid method to improve our State management
tenfold by inducing the working class and the poor to co-operate
in the State work.
49. Bureaucratism is an obstacle to reconstruction of the
Soviet country. New squads should be recruited from the masses
and we shall then be assured of sure means to combat bureaucratism.
50. Labourers apply to yourselves the methods of self-criticism
with a view to clearing the Soviet country of bureaucrats
and useless people.
51. The flame of labour self-criticism must turn against
the infection of bureaucratism in the State work.
52. When attacked by the class enemy let us retaliate. Let us
form groups of Red specialists from amongst the labour class.
53. Put women of labour and peasant class to the fore as
leaders. Let us help these women who form the new ranks of
the builders of socialism.
54. Let us mobilize the proletarian public to oppose ignorance.
55. Strengthen the ties of science, technics and production
under the leadership of the labour class. All learning when
applied means socialistic industrialization of the country.
56. Oppose antisemitism. Educate the masses in an international
spirit.
57. Priests and ministers, clergymen of the Catholic faith
and Rabbis are all allies of the speculant and of Nepman
theory (The new Economic Policy). Let us offer strong
opposition to clergymen in general.
58. Let us fight opportunism, and show no mercy towards
the tactics of conciliation. Long live Lenin's unity of
the ranks of All Russian Communist Party.
59. Followers of Trotzky have joined the camp of counter-revolu-
tion. Show no mercy to the traitors of the proletarian cause.
60. Let us clear the ranks of the Party from outsiders. Improve
the condition of the military advance troops, who are Communists.
61. The unity of the revolutionary battalions of the proletariat
is guarantee of our success. Long live the Russian Communist
Party. Long live the Communist International.
62. Hold up the banner of the Communist Party. Labourers
join its ranks. It is the leader of socialistic construction.
The Central Committee of the
Allied Communist Party(Bolsheviks).

(FOREIGN SECTION)
DATE 15. 6. 29

39. 村中的共产党员是集体经济形式的组织者。
40. 共青团员提倡丰收和集体化。
41. 如果以普遍的经济模式取代个体农民的生产方式，劳动生产率将成倍乃至三倍地提高，人力劳动将减至最低限度（列宁）。
42. 让我们在地区、省份、村庄等之间组织竞赛，以期在扩大小麦种植面积和增加作物产量方面进行合作。
43. 建立集体组织及其他团体是改善穷人状况、使乡村摆脱投机商人的最佳方法。
44. 让我们改进我们的经济组织，并安排建设新的社会主义农业工厂。
45. 通过这些组织，让我们支持农民和劳动者的产品。
46. 在工人阶级的指导下组织贫苦阶级，并将他们与中产阶级人士团结在一起，我们将压制投机分子。
47. 我们的口号是：支持穷人，打击投机人群。
48. 我们有一个极好的方法，通过促使工人阶级和穷人参与国家工作，使我们的国家管理水平提高十倍。
49. 官僚主义是苏维埃国家重建的障碍。应从群众中招募新队伍，这样我们就有了打击官僚主义的可靠手段。
50. 劳动者们，请运用自我批评的方法，以清除苏维埃国家中的官僚和无用之人。
51. 劳动自我批评的火焰必须转向针对国家工作中的官僚主义毒瘤。
52. 当受到阶级敌人攻击时，让我们予以反击。让我们从工人阶级中组建红色专家小组。
53. 让工农妇女担任领导职务走在前列。让我们帮助这些组成社会主义建设新队伍的妇女。
54. 让我们动员无产阶级公众反对无知。
55. 在工人阶级的领导下，加强科学、技术与生产之间的联系。所有学问一旦应用，即意味着国家的社会主义工业化。
56. 反对反犹主义。以国际主义精神教育群众。
57. 神父、牧师、天主教神职人员以及拉比都是投机者和“耐普曼”理论（新经济政策）的盟友。让我们对神职人员总体予以强烈反对。
58. 让我们反对机会主义，对调和策略毫不留情。全俄共产党队伍的统一万岁。
59. 托洛茨基的追随者已加入反革命阵营。对无产阶级事业的叛徒毫不留情。
60. 让我们清除党内的异己分子。改善作为共产党员的军事先锋队的状况。
61. 无产阶级革命营垒的团结是我们成功的保证。俄罗斯共产党万岁。共产国际万岁。
62. 高举共产党的旗帜。劳动者们加入其行列。它是社会主义建设的领导者。
全联盟共产党（布尔什维克）中央委员会。

"........................................" of May 1, 1929 writes:- 91.99.
31.5.29.

In addition to a series of articles on the
occasion of Labour Day, wherein comment was made on
the war preparations by Foreign Powers against U.S.S.R.
the opposition of the international world to demonstrations
by the revolutionary masses, etc., several caricatures
were included depicting the following incidents:-
Prince of Wales and a group of miners to whom he is said
to have very generously distributed flowers and smiles
whilst they were starving.
Methods of treating colonial natives by the imperialists,
showing a group of black natives, etc. marching along the
street in a revolt.
England, France, America and Japan killing natives (?)
A planter administering corporal punishment to an African
native.
Also several other pictures on labour, capitalism
and imperialism.

"The Izvestia" of April 28, 1929 writes.

Revolution in India inevitable.

A German Journalist of note who has returned from
a tour of India writes that the situation there is very
acute at present. The new party of independence has
one Pandit Lal Meru at the head and is advocating a
regular revolutionary programme. Communism is very
much in favour. National leaders do not exercise much
influence on the population and in spite of all the
British will do to suppress the movement the revolution
in India is inevitable and is not likely to abate.

The "Izvestia" of April 17, 1929 writes:

Great Britain and U.S.S.R.

In the pursuit of anti-Soviet campaign the Conservative
Press of Great Britain is accusing the Soviet Government,
of a great deal of happenings. It has been discovered
in London that some important documents disappeared from
Scotland Yard. "Soviet spies" were accused at once.
As regards India the "Times" in London writes:- The
telegrams of Curson have not yet been forgotten wherein
the hostile activities of the Bolsheviks in India and
other Asiatic countries were described. It is a well known
fact that the Government which is endeavouring to secure
British trade and recognition, continues to do everything
in its power to disseminate treachery and discontent in
India with a view to counteracting British policy in
all countries of the world." Other newspapers again
attribute almost the principal part of guilt to the
Soviet in India's disturbances. There is nothing new
in these accusations. Nevertheless during the whole
time of Anglo-Soviet relations there has not been a case
proved where Soviet Government or Soviet State institutions
participated in anti-British propaganda and less so
in disseminating treachery and discontent in India or
any other parts of the British Empire. Other Press
organs of different countries write a great many articles
about the policy of Great Britain in the Far East and
in the Colonies, yet it never affected government relations
with those countries yet, whilst Russia is considered
highly in the wrong for doing the same thing.

《消息报》(Izvestia)
“........................................” 1929年5月1日写道：- 91.99.
1929年5月31日。

除了系列五一劳动节文章——其中评论了外国列强针对苏联的战争准备、国际社会对革命群众示威的反对等——还刊登了几幅漫画，描绘了以下事件：-
威尔士亲王向一群矿工分发鲜花和微笑，据说他非常慷慨，而这些矿工当时正忍饥挨饿。
帝国主义者对待殖民地土著的方法，展示了一群黑人土著等在街头起义行进。
英国、法国、美国和日本杀害土著 (?)
一名种植园主对一名非洲土著施以体罚。
还有几幅关于劳工、资本主义和帝国主义的其他图片。

1929年4月28日的《消息报》写道。

印度革命不可避免。

一位刚从印度巡回访问归来的著名德国记者写道，那里的局势目前非常严峻。新的独立党由潘迪特·拉尔·梅鲁 (Pandit Lal Meru) 领导，正在倡导一项正规的革命纲领。共产主义非常受欢迎。民族领袖对民众的影响力不大，尽管英国会竭尽全力镇压该运动，但印度的革命是不可避免的，且不太可能平息。

1929年4月17日的《消息报》写道：

英国与苏联。

在反苏运动中，英国保守派报刊指责苏联政府制造了许多事件。伦敦发现苏格兰场的一些重要文件失踪。“苏联间谍”随即受到指控。关于印度，伦敦《泰晤士报》写道：- 寇松 (Curson) 的电报尚未被遗忘，其中描述了布尔什维克在印度和其他亚洲国家的敌对活动。众所周知，那个力求确保英国贸易和承认的政府，继续尽其所能在印度散布背叛和不满，以抵消英国在世界各国的政策。”其他报纸又将印度动乱的主要罪责几乎全部归咎于苏联。这些指控并无新意。然而，在整个英苏关系期间，从未有过确凿案例证明苏联政府或苏联国家机构参与了反英宣传，更不用说在印度或大英帝国的任何其他部分散布背叛和不满。其他国家的新闻机构撰写了大量关于英国在远东和殖民地政策的文章，但这并未影响政府与那些国家的关系，而俄罗斯做同样的事却被认为大错特错。

- 2 -

For example a newspaper called "Kolnische Zeitung"
of April 10, published in Germany, where the press
so far has been very reserved with regard to the Soviet
Unions' politics now writes:-
"There is nothing astonishing that the London press
is attributing the incident of the bomb-shell thrown
into the Government meeting centre in India, to communists
and Moscow as the offender. London press can support
its statements by the fact that Soviet press is giving
of late a lot of space to the penetration of communistic
influences into the masses of India".
Thus the campaign of clearly hostile attitude towards
the Soviet with a view to preventing the establishing
of normal Anglo-Soviet relations, is finding an echo
in the press of many other countries. This goes to show
that the sources of information and inspiration are
the same in every respective instance.

8/2

例如，4月10日在德国出版的名为《科隆日报》(Kolnische Zeitung) 的报纸，此前德国媒体对苏联政治一直持非常保留的态度，现在却写道：-
“伦敦报刊将向印度政府会议中心投掷炸弹的事件归咎于共产党人和莫斯科这一肇事者，这并不令人惊讶。伦敦报刊可以依据以下事实支持其说法：苏联报刊最近大量报道了共产主义影响渗入印度民众的情况”。
因此，这种旨在阻止建立正常英苏关系的、明显对苏联持敌对态度的运动，在许多其他国家的报刊中引起了反响。这表明，在各相应情况下，信息来源和灵感来源是相同的。

"Krasnoe"Znamya" (Red Banner) of May 1, 1929.

East rising up.
A review on China, Indonesia, Philippines and Japan.

In the history of revolutionary movement in the East
and South of Asia this year may be looked upon as the
tenth anniversary of the beginning of such movements for
several countries.
Take China for instance; up to 1919 there was hardly
any strike movement known there yet, whilst in the years of
1925 to 1927 China had lived through a civil war of classes,
several general strikes and armed uprisings were short lived
but nevertheless real Soviet power in numerous places.
Chinese revolution has been defeated, but the seeds
have been sown and this is proved by the following:-
In 1927 the Shanghai proletarians suffered a defeat in
their first uprising, but a few weeks later they rose up
again and practically took possession of the city then, which
shows what tremendous opportunities are hidden in the people
of China.
Undoubtedly Shanghai and Canton labourers will not
be able to parade the streets as we do on May 1, but this
only means that sooner or later they will do so and the
"Paris of the Far East" will see the Chinese Red Army
march through the city even though it may take years before
this happens.
From China we turn our attention to Indonesia. This is
another country which did not require tens of years to
arouse revolutionary masses. For three hundred years the
people of that country have been under the yoke of Dutch
East Indies authorities, this uprising also suffered a
defeat, but nevertheless it has scored a victory for
the revolution in gaining experience. Indonesia is a
country to-day for which rivalry to a great extent exists
between America, England and Japan, but which has
communists only for its national leaders.
Next to Indonesia comes the Philippines, but here
labour movement is very little developed; the same applies
to other countries of Indo-China.
Now India is very active at present and yet how quiet
this country seemed but a short time ago. The rulers of
India have a reason to urge the introduction of bye-laws
against communists. The laurels won by Premier Tanaka of
Japan, the hero of three interventions: Siberian from 1918
to 1922, Manchurian in 1920 and later and two Shantung ones,
apparently do not give peace to the Anglo-Indian law
promoters. It is proved to-day that the revolutionary
movement is strong in India as compared to previous times
when there was no necessity to institute bye-laws against
the communists. The rulers of India have every reason
to feel anxious about India, as the revolutionary progress
of this country is too apparent to everyone who has been
observing the heroic struggle put up by the natives of India
in 1928 and 1929.
And what about Japan? The rulers of that country
cannot blame themselves of lack of vigilance and severe
measures against the development of revolutionary spirit
and communism, yet we know that at present, beginning with
1925, revolutionary movement has made a progress in that
country and is being continuously repressed.
One thing is certain and that is that the spirit
of uprising is becoming stronger and stronger in the East
and the forthcoming Congress of Pan Pacific Labour Unions
will have to start preparing labourers of the East to
real struggle.

1929年5月1日的《红旗报》(Krasnoe Znamya)。

东方崛起。
关于中国、印度尼西亚、菲律宾和日本的综述。

在东亚和南亚革命运动的历史上，今年可被视为几个此类运动开始十周年。
以中国为例；直到1919年，那里几乎没有任何罢工运动为人所知，而在1925年至1927年间，中国经历了一场阶级内战，几次总罢工和武装起义虽然短暂，但在许多地方确实建立了苏维埃政权。
中国革命虽遭失败，但种子已经播下，这由以下事实证明：-
1927年，上海无产阶级在第一次起义中遭受失败，但几周后他们再次起义，并实际上占领了城市，这表明中国人民蕴藏着巨大的潜力。
毫无疑问，上海和广州的工人无法像我们在五一节那样上街游行，但这只意味着他们迟早会这样做，“远东巴黎”将看到中国红军穿过城市行进，即使这需要数年时间才能实现。
从中国我们将注意力转向印度尼西亚。这是另一个不需要数十年就能唤醒革命群众的国家。三百年来，该国人民一直受荷属东印度当局的压迫，这次起义也遭受了失败，但它通过积累经验为革命赢得了胜利。今天的印度尼西亚是一个美国、英国和日本在很大程度上存在竞争的国家，但其民族领袖只有共产党人。
仅次于印度尼西亚的是菲律宾，但这里的劳工运动发展甚微；印度支那的其他国家也是如此。
现在印度非常活跃，然而就在不久前，这个国家看起来还多么平静。印度的统治者有理由敦促制定针对共产党的附例。日本首相田中获得的荣誉——他是三次干预的英雄：1918年至1922年的西伯利亚干预、1920年及之后的满洲干预，以及两次山东干预——显然没有让英印法律制定者感到安宁。今天证实，与以前无需制定针对共产党附例的时期相比，印度的革命运动更为强劲。印度的统治者完全有理由对印度感到焦虑，因为任何观察过1928年和1929年印度土著英勇斗争的人都能明显看出该国的革命进展。
那么日本呢？该国统治者不能指责自己缺乏警惕或对革命精神和共产主义的发展措施不严，但我们知道，目前从1925年开始，革命运动在该国取得了进展，并持续受到镇压。
有一点是肯定的，那就是东方的起义精神正变得越来越强烈，即将到来的泛太平洋工会代表大会将不得不开始准备东方劳动者投入真正的斗争。

Dear Brethren:- On behalf of the labourers of Holland, the
crew of the Dutch steamer "Gemma" send you their greetings
on the 1st of May. We wish you success against and in the
struggle with the blood-thirsty capitalists of the world."
Seamen of the Dutch s.s. "Gemma".

"Krasnoe Znamya" of May 7 writes as follows:-

Five ships on their way from America.

The KCO (Kamchatka Co., Ltd.) is awaiting the arrival
from America of five ships, purchased in the country. The
names of the steamers are: Eskimos (formerly Eastern Bell),
Yakut (ex Lake Elmsford), Lunut (Lake Elpuelbo) Tungus
( Lake Elwa) and Ukagir (Lake Elmwood). Some are carrying
goods whilst others are empty.

"Krasnoe Znamya" of May 9th writes as follows:-

Soviet Russia labourers promise assistance
to the proletarians of other countries.

Moscow 7 (Rosta) The treatment of labourers and
the methods employed in capitalistic countries on the
occasion of Labour Day celebrations has excited the labour
proletariat. Resolutions of protest in large numbers
are being received from various cities of Soviet Russia.
At meetings held in Kazan and Chita protests were also made.
The labourers said "Our assistance is always ready. Fight
bravely and establish Soviet rule over the world".
Special issue of the newspaper "Rabochi Krai" (The
Labourers' Territory" has been issued on the subject
of the disturbances in Germany on May 1.

Supplementary Translation.

Date 22. 4. 29.

The "Slovo" of April 19 and 20 writes as follows:-

Political.

Preparations for an uprising in Barga.
last
A long time prior to year's disturbances in Barga
the situation appeared very disquieting both along the border
of Barga and in Halha, where activities and preparations
indicated that an uprising would occur. When this happened
last August it did not come as a surprise. It was pointed
out then that the movement of Barga citizens was not their
own doing altogether, but connected with international
combinations of different sources, one of which is Soviet
Russia.
Everything goes to show now that this Summer we may
expect a new uprising of Barga citizens and Mongolians as
the outstanding political factor in North Manchuria. The
following data supports the above fears.
Routes of preparation are:-
1. In the territory of Halha.
2. In the C.E.R.Zone.
3. North of the C.E.R. Zone.
Since the time of the Barga uprising last September
persons who came from there reported that there was a great
movement along the routes between Urga and Khiachta and Urga
and Sambeis, which were said to be extensively used for the
transportation of arms, ammunition, equipment, and small
military detachments, particularly cavalry and A certain
amount of big guns and a large quantity of motor cars of
every description. Russians instructors were said to be
with the military detachments. The above was first infor-
mation of the movement of troops in Mongolia. Then there was
a political centre organized in Urga for activities in Barga.
Then there was established a revolutionary committee composed
of young mongolians of Barga and Halha who started a partisan
war on a large scale in the province of Barga. Agitators
were also sent to Barga in favour of the latter joining Halha.
At the same time information was received from Verkhne-
Udinsk to the effect that 9 persons composed of Buriats,
Kalmiks, and Kirgisi, proceeded through that city from
Leningrad en route for Urga and these men were Red commanders
who were appointed to organize peoples revolutionary troops.
A later period again 65 agitators were reported to have
arrived there, these being Mongolians and Buriats, who
graduated propaganda schools in Novo-Sibirsk. News was
received then also that Mongolia's young men were being
taught artillery and machine gun art as well as the use of
poisonous gas.
The concentration of troops, the laying of stock of
arms and ammunition and various supplies from U.S.S.R. as
well as the organization of a revolutionary centre and the
preparation of agitators are the primary steps towards an
uprising or a campaign.
When these forces were collected in Urga they began to
proceed to the borders of Barga. In January information was
to hand that there were Guards placed along the line composed
of 10 to 12 men. In the district of Lake Buinor a battery
of 100 men of Infantry arrived from Sambeis with motor cars
at their disposal. At about the same time near the border of
Barga on the River Kerulen strong cavalry detachments of armed
Halha men, strength about 200, appeared in the district.
Besides these were detachments of 50 to 100 met in South
Hingan.

4月19日和20日的《言论报》（Slovo）写道：——

政治。

巴尔嘎地区的起义准备工作。
去年巴尔嘎地区发生骚乱之前很久，无论是在巴尔嘎边境还是在外蒙古（Halha），局势都显得非常令人不安，那里的活动和准备工作表明即将发生起义。当去年八月起义发生时，这并不令人意外。当时有人指出，巴尔嘎公民的运动并非完全由他们自己发起，而是与来自不同方面的国际联合有关，其中之一便是苏俄。
目前的一切迹象表明，今年夏天我们可能会看到巴尔嘎公民和蒙古人的新一次起义，这将成为北满突出的政治因素。以下数据支持上述担忧。
准备路线如下：
1. 在外蒙古领土内。
2. 在中东铁路区域内。
3. 在中东铁路区域以北。
自去年九月巴尔嘎起义以来，从那里回来的人报告说，在库伦（Urga）至恰克图（Khiachta）以及库伦至三贝子（Sambeis）之间的路线上有很大的活动，据说这些路线被广泛用于运输武器、弹药、装备和小型军事分队，特别是骑兵，以及一定数量的大炮和各种类型的汽车。据说俄罗斯教官随同这些军事分队行动。以上是关于蒙古军队调动的第一批情报。随后，在库伦组织了一个政治中心，旨在巴尔嘎地区开展活动。接着成立了一个由巴尔嘎和外蒙古的年轻蒙古人组成的革命委员会，他们在巴尔嘎省发动了大规模的游击战。煽动者也被派往巴尔嘎，鼓动其加入外蒙古。与此同时，从上乌丁斯克（Verkhne-Udinsk）收到消息，称有9名由布里亚特人、卡尔梅克人和吉尔吉斯人组成的人员从列宁格勒经该市前往库伦，这些人是被任命去组织人民革命军的红军指挥官。后来又有消息说，65名煽动者抵达那里，他们是蒙古人和布里亚特人，毕业于新西伯利亚的宣传学校。当时还收到消息说，蒙古青年正在接受火炮和机枪技术以及毒气使用的训练。
军队的集结、来自苏联的武器弹药和各种物资的储备，以及革命中心的组织和煽动者的准备，都是起义或战役的首要步骤。
当这些力量在库伦集结后，他们开始向巴尔嘎边境进发。一月份有消息称，沿线部署了由10至12人组成的警卫队。在布伊诺尔湖（Lake Buinor）地区，一个由100名步兵组成的炮兵连从三贝子抵达，并配有供其使用的汽车。大约在同一时间，在巴尔嘎边境附近的克鲁伦河（River Kerulen）地区，出现了强大的武装外蒙古人骑兵分队，兵力约200人。此外，在南兴安岭地区还发现了50至100人的分队。

pages.en:
- 2 -

At about the middle of March further information
received was to the effect that small Soviet troops
detachments were seen in Sambeis, for the most part
cavalry men. These were numbering from 100 to 150 men.
In the vicinity of Lake Buinor Soviet troops were seen also.
It is reported that in the vicinity of Sambeis some
constructions are being carried out, appearing to be
barracks. Bridges are also being constructed across the
River Kerulen in the district of Sambeis.
The above information gives an idea of the movement
in preparation by Mongolians in Barga. Among the less
intensive activity is to be observed along the Chinese
Railway Zone.
Here we witness the Soviet Administration being
engaged in clearing the personnel along the whole of
the Western line of the railway. Changes have been
effected through dismissal, transfers, etc, of employees
of Chinese citizenship, holders of double citizenship
passports and Soviet citizens. Communists alone are
retained or appointed. In the district between Chalungtun
and Fulerdi Soviet Communists have been placed in power
mostly. A few non party employees who still remained
at the time of changes effected, have been replaced since
the arrival in Chalamgtun of Kuznetsoff, the Soviet
Consul of Mukden.
The Railway Administration did every thing in their
power to effect the changes. Consulates have been assisting
them and are now endeavouring to find fault with the
local Police, who are still keeping their eye on the
Soviet railway personnel.
There are routes of transportation in the districts
of Fulerdi and Turchiha, as well as Arshan.
Russian refugees last year pointed out that the
River Yal was a great obstacle to travelling with ease.
This year the C.E.R. did away with that obstacle by
constructing two bridges across the River which were
completed about a fortnight ago. The C.E.R. Administration
asserts that these bridges are necessary for the transporta-
tion of goods south of C.E.R. but this statement
is very doubtful. Merchants declare that there is not
a sufficient quantity of goods for transportation that way
to ensure the construction of special bridges across the
Yal River. These bridges may prove very useful to Mongolian
troops if they proceed to Fulerdi. Thus, so to speak
"economic" measures of the C.E.R. by strange coincidence
render an assistance to the strategical plans of the
Mongolian movement.
Another interesting little detail. Communist organizations
took a great interest in the construction of the bridges
in question. At the opening of the bridges there were
present, in addition to Suchatzky, an official of the Railway,
President of the Tsitsihar Local Committee and several
prominent communists, who later proceeded to Chalangtun
where Soviet Consul Kuznetsoff was at the time.
The impression naturally is that something big is
being in preparation along the Western line of the C.E.R.
of a political nature, under cover of economic improvements.
If these preparations are compared with those at Halha,
it may be easily understood what the reason for them is.
"R. S."

- 2 -

大约在三月中旬，收到的进一步消息称，在三贝子看到了小股苏军分队，大部分是骑兵。人数在100至150人之间。在布伊诺尔湖附近也看到了苏军。据报道，在三贝子附近正在进行一些建设，看起来像是兵营。在三贝子地区的克鲁伦河上也在修建桥梁。
上述信息让人了解了蒙古人在巴尔嘎地区的准备活动。在中东铁路沿线，可以观察到强度较低的活动。
在这里，我们看到苏联当局正在清理整个铁路西线的人员。通过解雇、调动等方式，对中国籍员工、持有双重国籍护照者和苏联公民进行了变更。仅保留或任命共产党员。在查干屯（Chalungtun）和富拉尔基（Fulerdi）之间的地区，主要由苏联共产党员掌权。在变更发生时仍留任的一些非党员工，自从苏联驻沈阳领事库兹涅佐夫（Kuznetsoff）抵达查兰屯（Chalamgtun，注：原文此处拼写与前文Chalungtun略有不同，依音译处理）后，已被替换。
铁路管理局竭尽全力实施这些变更。领事馆一直在协助他们，现在正试图找当地警察的茬，因为当地警察仍在监视苏联铁路人员。
在富拉尔基、突泉（Turchiha）以及阿尔山（Arshan）地区都有运输路线。
俄国难民去年指出，雅尔河（River Yal）是轻松旅行的巨大障碍。今年，中东铁路通过在该河上建造两座桥梁消除了这一障碍，这两座桥大约在两周前完工。中东铁路管理局声称，这些桥梁对于中东铁路以南的货物运输是必要的，但这一说法非常值得怀疑。商人宣称，没有足够数量的货物需要通过那条路线运输，以确保在雅尔河上建造专用桥梁。如果蒙古军队进军富拉尔基，这些桥梁可能会证明非常有用。因此，可以说，中东铁路的“经济”措施出于奇怪的巧合，为蒙古运动的战略计划提供了援助。
另一个有趣的小细节。共产党组织对所谓桥梁的建设表现出极大的兴趣。在桥梁开通仪式上，除了铁路官员苏哈茨基（Suchatzky）、齐齐哈尔地方委员会主席以及几位著名的共产党员外，还有其他人出席，他们随后前往查兰屯，当时苏联领事库兹涅佐夫就在那里。
自然的印象是，在中东铁路西线，借着经济改善的掩护，正在筹备某种重大的政治性质事件。如果将这些准备工作与外蒙古的准备工作进行比较，就很容易理解其原因。
“R. S.”

The "Slovo" of April 22nd writes as follows:-

Soviet.

Melnikoff and Mukden.

In connection with negotiations on the subject of the
Chinese Eastern Railway between Mr. Melnikoff, Soviet Consul
in Harbin and the Mukden Authorities, Mr. Melnikoff absented
himself for a few days in Harbin and has now returned to Mukden.
In spite of the tempting offers made by the latter to Marshal
Chang Hsueh Liang, Sino-Soviet negotiations re C.E.R. are at a
standstill.
Negotiations which still take place are of a secondary
importance and are being carried on by persons who have not
authority to sign or enter into any agreement whatsoever.
Mr. Melnikoff is not making any attempts at meeting Marshal
Chang again or even his right hand, Mr. Wang, Chief of the
Department for Foreign Affairs. Melnikoff is, however,
endeavouring to obtain some results in the favour of Soviet
through outside influence, but is not likely to succeed.
Moreover, there is little doubt that the Far East is
about to live through exciting happenings of political nature
affecting the Asiatic Continent.
D. Uraloff.

Soviet agents.

Marshal Chang Hsueh Liang has sent a telegram to Nanking
reporting that he has received information of the expected
arrival shortly in the Province of 3 Eastern States from
Primorie of two thousand Russians, alleged to be military
refugees escaped from Soviet Russia. In reality, however,
this is Soviet provocation and the above people will be Soviet
agents for propaganda purposes in China. Marshal Chang has
issued instructions to closely watch and guard the borders
and persons crossing these.

Budenny's alleged arrest.

Budenny, on having returned to Moscow, is said to have
been arrested by the Authorities for insubordination on
having received a new appointment. In addition to that in
his absence whilst touring the Far East, several of his
relatives and collaborators have been sent out to Siberia
for participation in the Opposition Movement and he was
demanding their freedom.

Russian.

Concert and Lotto for the benefit
of Anatole Bronin.

On Wednesday, April 24, a grand concert and Lotto will
be held at the Russian Merchants' Club for the benefit of
Anatole Bronin, a prisoner in Dairen. There will be several
valuable prizes for the Lotto and increased payments in cash.
Entrance fee to the Concert one dollar and to Lotto free.

Russian peddlars in Nanking.

Six Russian peddlars are reported to be trading in
Nanking and succeed in earning from 40 to 60 dollars. They
are all ex soldiers.

4月22日的《言论报》写道：——

苏维埃。

梅利尼科夫与沈阳。

鉴于苏联驻哈尔滨领事梅利尼科夫先生与沈阳当局之间关于中东铁路的谈判，梅利尼科夫先生在哈尔滨缺席数日，现已返回沈阳。尽管后者向张学良元帅提出了诱人的提议，但关于中东铁路的中苏谈判仍处于停滞状态。
目前仍在进行的谈判属于次要性质，由无权签署或达成任何协议的人员进行。梅利尼科夫先生并未尝试再次会见张元帅，甚至也未会见其得力助手、外交处处长王先生。然而，梅利尼科夫正试图通过外部影响为苏联争取一些成果，但不太可能成功。
此外，毫无疑问，远东地区即将经历影响亚洲大陆的政治性质的激动人心的事件。
D. 乌拉洛夫（Uraloff）。

苏维埃特工。

张学良元帅已向南京发电报，报告称他收到情报，预计不久将有两千名俄罗斯人从滨海省抵达东三省，据称这些人是从苏俄逃出的军事难民。然而，实际上这是苏维埃的挑衅，上述人员将是用于在中国进行宣传的苏维埃特工。张元帅已发出指令，严密监视和守卫边境及过境人员。

据传布琼尼被捕。

据说布琼尼返回莫斯科后，因不服从新的任命而被当局逮捕。此外，在他巡视远东期间，他的几名亲属和合作者因参与反对派运动而被流放到西伯利亚，而他一直要求释放他们。

俄国。

为阿纳托尔·布罗宁举办的音乐会和彩票抽奖。

4月24日星期三，将在俄国商人俱乐部为囚禁在大连的阿纳托尔·布罗宁（Anatole Bronin）举办一场大型音乐会和彩票抽奖活动。彩票将设有若干贵重奖品，并增加现金支付。音乐会入场费为一美元，彩票抽奖免费。

南京的俄国小贩。

据报道，有六名俄国小贩在南京做生意，成功赚取了40至60美元。他们均为前士兵。

The "Shanghai Zarya" of March 30th writes as follows:-
Political.

Hopes in Vain.

At present, as is usual the case when China has
domestic trouble, the foreign press gives more space
to disputes on the subject of concessions which the
Powers are gradually and inevitably giving China.
Lately general attention has been centred chiefly
on the fate of the Provisional Court.
The Chinese public opinion, the ruling party and
the Government are insisting on the complete rendition
of the Court in the Settlement, the use of the Chinese
language in proceedings, charge of local prisons and
a say in the Police matters where jurisdiction is concerned.
Foreign diplomats as is customary with them are
following the tactics of delay and postponement, but the
question of the Court is on the agenda firstly because
the period of the present "provisional" court is about
to expire and secondly because there have been conflicts
in the Court which have not yet been solved between the
representatives of Consular Body and the Chinese lawyers,
which incidents practically led to a declaration of strike
by members of the Magistrate.
Yesterday one of the local newspapers published
plans for the institution in Shanghai of a Special
Municipal Court, organized by foreigners and supported
by funds of the Municipal Council, which would be
independent of Nanking and subject to the authority
of the Consular Body.
The general political situation at present, when
the Central Government is surrounded by groups hostile
to it in the South, West and even North, in Shantung,
appears to encourage promoters of the above plans
in respect of it being possible to get back that which
had been given up at the time the Mixed Court was abolished.
No complications of government nature, no events
of any kind in China can influence the process of history
which is inclined to abolish old rights and privileges.
The institute of foreign privileges in China has
become destroyed as a result of serious world wide
disturbances and changes and quite apart from the
circumstances depending on where the Central Government
may be i.e. in Peking or Nanking, or who is at the head
of it and who are the rulers, that which has been given
away cannot be taken back.
Temperamental politicians forget that concessions are
made not to this or that personnel of the Chinese
Government or to a Party that rules at the moment. The
retreat is an outcome of the growing consciousness of
the Chinese masses under the pressure of the modern
tendencies, which cannot reconcile themselves to the fact
that a country as big as China is is not on the level
with the period of progress with which humanity has been
endowed in this century where heights of technical power
have been reached and these have bound nations together
better than all prophets of socialism or of the International
put together.

（批：As much
as I think
m d
Jca）

3月30日的《上海曙光报》（Shanghai Zarya）写道：-
政治。

徒劳的希望。

目前，正如中国发生内乱时的惯常情况那样，外国报刊更多地篇幅用于讨论列强正逐渐且不可避免地交还给中国的租界问题。最近，公众的注意力主要集中在临时法院的命运上。
中国舆论、执政党和政府坚持要求完全收回租界内的法院，要求在诉讼中使用中文，要求掌管地方监狱，并在涉及管辖权的警务事务中拥有发言权。
外国外交官们照例采取拖延和推迟的策略，但法院问题已提上日程，首先是因为现有“临时”法院的期限即将届满，其次是因为领事团代表与中国律师之间在法院内部发生了尚未解决的冲突，这些事件实际上导致了推事成员的罢工声明。
昨天，当地一家报纸刊登了在上海设立特别市法院的计划，该法院由外国人组建，由工部局资金支持，独立于南京政府，并受领事团管辖。
目前的总体政治局势是，中央政府在南方、西部甚至北部的山东都被敌对势力所包围，这似乎鼓励了上述计划的推动者，使他们认为有可能收回在会审公廨废除时所放弃的权利。
无论中国政府性质如何复杂，也无论中国发生何种事件，都无法影响历史的进程，而历史倾向于废除旧有的权利和特权。
在华外国特权制度已因世界范围内的严重动荡和变革而遭到破坏，这与中央政府所在地（即北京或南京）、由谁领导以及统治者是谁等情况无关，已经交出的东西是无法收回的。
性情急躁的政治家们忘记了，让步并非针对中国政府的某班人马或当前执政的政党。这种退让是中国民众在现代趋势压力下日益增长的觉悟的结果，现代趋势无法容忍像中国这样庞大的国家未能与人类在本世纪所取得的进步同步，在这个世纪里，技术力量达到了高峰，它将各国紧密地联系在一起，其效果胜过所有社会主义先知或共产国际加在一起的总和。

（批：尽管我认为

Shanghai Conservatives and persistent adherents
of special privileges are mistaken to think that they
are more far-seeing and courageous than the Governments
which in the year 1921 in Washington laid the foundation
at the world conference of new relations with China.
Persons who entertain hopes that in the midst of
the new disturbances they may succeed in getting back
not only the Mixed Court but perhaps even the lost
Concessions, fail to see examples such as the settlement
by Japan of the Tsinan incident, the agreement with Italy
and the consent of America to do away with Consular
jurisdiction and many other things.
Those who regret the things lost may still hope
that in the event of trouble developing, the decision finally
of ████████ matters in question will be delayed for
some time.
However sooner or later foreigners will be placed
under conditions similar to Chinese i.e. equal and
Russians will only gain by it.

（印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER OF POLICE · SHANGHAI · APR 7 1929）

上海的保守派和特殊特权的顽固拥护者错误地认为，他们比那些在1921年华盛顿会议上为对华新关系奠定基础各国政府更具远见和勇气。
那些希望在新的动荡中不仅收回会审公廨，甚至可能收回失去的租界的人，没有看到诸如日本解决济南惨案、与意大利达成协议以及美国同意废除领事裁判权等例子。
那些对失去的东西感到遗憾的人可能仍希望，如果事态发展恶化，关于████████争议事项的最终决定会推迟一段时间。
然而，迟早外国人将被置于与中国人相似的条件下，即平等的条件，而俄国人只会从中受益。

（印：警务处处长办公室 · 上海 · 1929年4月7日）

THE SHANGHAI ZARIA 30-th March 1929

V A I N   P L A N S.

As is always the case during internal disturbances in China,the
foreign Press is again the centre of intensified discussion of the
concessions,that the Powers are slowly,but inevitably making in China.
Lately attention is centered around the fate of the Provisional
Court.
Chinese public opinion,the ruling party and the Government insist
on the complete surrender of the Settlement Court,demand the introduction
of Chinese as the only language,desire to have charge of places of
detention and the police,as a function of the Court.
The foreign diplomats,as usual,follow the tactics of waiting and
delay,but the problem of the Court has become the order of the day,-
firstly because the term of existence of the present Court is soon ex-
piring,-secondly because certain conflicts,still unsettled, have arisen
between the Consular representatives and the Chinese Bar,which gave even
cause to speak of a strike of Judges.
Finally,on the pages of one of the local papers there appeared yester-
day a plan of establishing in Shanghai a Special Municipal Court,created
by foreigners,financed by Municipal funds,entirely independent of Nanking
and subordinate to the Consular Body.
The general political situation at present,when the Central govern-
ment seems surrounded by hostile groups in the south,west and even north
in Shantung,gives the authors the assurance of regaining what was lost
with the abolition of the Mixed Court.
Neither governmental complications,nor even external events in China
can stop the inexorable march of History,that is heading for the abolition
of old rights and privileges.
The institution of foreigners' privileges in China crashed as a
result of complex international perturbations and,quite independently of
whether the central government is in Peking or Nanking,who comprises it
or who is at the head of it,what has been given up,can not be regained.
Temperamental politicians forget that these concessions had to be
given not to a certain group of persons in the government and not even
before the encroachments of the ruling party.
The retreat proceeds under the pressure of the growing self-consci-
ousness of the Chinese masses,under the pressure of modernity,which
cannot put up with the fact of a huge country,like China not keeping pace
with the age,that has given Humanity marvellous discoveries and thus
joined the nations into one family tighter,than all prophets of Socialism
or the International put together.
Shanghai Conservatives and the obstinate partisans of special privi-
leges are mistaken in thinking themselves more far-sighted and courageous
than the Governments,who in Washington in 1921 at the World conference
laid the foundation of new relations with China and a new attitude towards
China.
The people,who dream,that under the noise of new disturbances,they
might regain not only the Mixed Court,but,even,perhaps,the lost concessi-
ons,don't want to see such striking facts,as the settlement by Japan
of the Tsinan incident,the consent of Italy and negotiations with America
concerning abolition of consular jurisdiction etc.etc.
Those,who yearn for what they had before,can only nurse a faint hope
that should the disturbances develop seriously,the decision on questions,
already decided,will be delayed for a while.
But in any case,sooner or later,foreigners will be placed in equal
conditions with the Chinese.
As for us,Russians,we will only GAIN BY THAT.
----------------------------------------
Are any comments necessary?

《上海曙光报》 1929年3月30日

徒 劳 的 计 划。

正如中国内部动荡期间的常态一样，外国报刊再次成为激烈讨论的中心，讨论列强在中国缓慢但不可避免地做出的让步。
最近，注意力集中在临时法院的命运上。
中国舆论、执政党和政府坚持要求完全移交租界法院，要求引入中文作为唯一语言，希望掌管拘留场所和警察，将其作为法院的一项职能。
外国外交官像往常一样，采取等待和拖延的策略，但法院问题已成为当务之急，——首先是因为现有法院的存在期限即将届满，——其次是因为领事代表与中国律师界之间出现了某些尚未解决的冲突，这甚至引发了关于法官罢工的议论。
最后，昨天在当地一家报纸的版面上出现了一项计划，拟在上海建立一个由外国人创建、由市政资金资助、完全独立于南京并隶属于领事团的特别市法院。
目前的总体政治局势是，中央政府似乎在南部、西部甚至北部的山东被敌对团体所包围，这给了计划起草者一种保证，即可以收回随着会审公廨废除而失去的东西。
无论是政府内部的纠纷，还是中国的外部事件，都无法阻止历史不可阻挡的前进步伐，历史正走向废除旧权利和特权。
在华外国特权制度因复杂的国际动荡而崩溃，而且，无论中央政府是在北京还是南京，由其组成人员是谁或由谁领导，已经放弃的东西是无法收回的。
性情急躁的政治家们忘记了，这些让步不得不给予，并非针对政府中的特定人群，甚至也不是为了应对执政党的侵蚀。
这种退让是在中国民众日益增长的自我意识压力下进行的，是在现代性的压力下进行的，现代性无法容忍像中国这样一个巨大的国家跟不上时代的步伐，这个时代赋予了人类奇妙的发现，从而将各国结合成一个大家庭，其紧密程度超过了所有社会主义先知或共产国际加在一起的总和。
上海保守派和特殊特权的顽固支持者错误地认为自己比那些在1921年华盛顿世界会议上奠定对华新关系和新态度基础的各国政府更具远见和勇气。
那些梦想在新的动荡喧嚣中不仅收回会审公廨，甚至可能收回失去的租界的人，不愿看到诸如日本解决济南惨案、意大利的同意以及与美国就废除领事裁判权进行谈判等引人注目的事实等等。
那些渴望恢复昔日所得的人，只能抱有一丝微弱的希望，即如果动荡严重发展，对已经决定的问题的裁决会暂时推迟。
但无论如何，迟早外国人将被置于与中国人平等的条件下。
至于我们俄国人，我们将只从中获 益。
----------------------------------------
有必要发表评论吗？

The "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) of March 7,6,I writes:-
（印：SPECIAL REPORT... C.I.D REG... I.G. 9199 Date ...5.4.29）

IOth Anniversary of Kommintern.

At the celebrations in honour of the IOth anniversary of
the Kommintern Comrade Katayama, who is a member of the
Kommintern, was presented with a medal.
--------

British Military Aviation.

British Military Aviation consists of 73 detachments. Last
year the number of detachments in India was increased by two.
In 1929 it is intended to increase British Aviation strength
by seven new detachments.
--------

Arrival of Col. Lawrence in London.

On the day of Col. Lawrence's arrival in London, he being
accused of organizing the partisan movement in Afghanistan against
Amanullah, the British Section of the Anti-Imperialistic League
held a demonstration during which the effigy of Lawrence was
burnt.
Saklatwala, the Indian Communist and member of the British
Parliament, was present at the demonstration.
--------

Nationalist Government and Soviet Russia.

The opinion of Soviet Authorities in the Far East is that
the Nationalist Government is anxious to resume normal diplomatic
relations with Soviet Russia. This opinion is supported by
alleged declarations made by representatives of the said Government
who recently travelled to Moscow and Vladivostock via Harbin.
On the other hand the Chinese Authorities in Harbin are
very unfriendly towards the Soviet people in the Zone and are
creating numerous obstacles in the way of the latter such as
suspending their publications, making arrests, etc.
--------

Anniversary of Korean uprising in 1919.

Ten years ago the first uprising took place in Korea
and to-day a great many changes are to be observed in the
country. The future of Korea depends on the proletariat.
Once the revolution in Korea is effected it will hit not only
imperialism but also land-owners. As a result of that revolution
the peasants will get land. Japanese and Korean Communist Parties
have an important task before them and they should recruit the
support of all classes for a final attack.
--------

The "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) of February 23rd writes:-

Moscow-Vladivostock-Japan Aerial Communication.

The following aerial lines of communications are already
in existence:- Moscow-Irkutsk (in Summer), Irkutsk-Yakutsk
(in Summer) with branches on to Bodaibo and Verkhne-Udinsk -Ulan-
Bator (all-year round). In the course of the next five years it
is proposed to construct lines along Yenisei and Obi, Irkutsk-China
and Irkutsk-Vladivostock-Japan. The latter is expected to begin
functioning in the years 1931-1932 and will be connected with
the aerial service of Japan. Communication with Nikolaevsk on
the Amur, Sakhalin, Kamchatka and other Northern points will be
greatly improved by means of aviation. The main line Irkutsk-
Vladivostock will pass through the regions of Amur.
pages.zh:
3月6、7日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）写道：-
（印：特别报告... 刑事侦缉处登记室... I.G. 9199 日期 ...1929年4月5日）

共产国际十周年。

在庆祝共产国际十周年的庆典上，共产国际成员片山潜同志被授予一枚勋章。
--------

英国军事航空。

英国军事航空由73个分队组成。去年，印度的分队数量增加了两个。1929年，计划通过增加七个新分队来增强英国航空力量。
--------

劳伦斯上校抵达伦敦。

在劳伦斯上校抵达伦敦当天，由于他被指控组织阿富汗反对阿曼努拉汗的游击运动，反帝国主义联盟英国分部举行了一次示威活动，期间焚烧了劳伦斯的模拟像。
印度共产党员、英国议会议员萨克拉特瓦拉出席了此次示威活动。
--------

国民政府与苏维埃俄国。

苏联远东当局认为，国民政府急于恢复与苏维埃俄国的正常外交关系。这一观点得到了据称是该政府代表所作的声明的支持，这些代表最近经哈尔滨前往莫斯科和符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）。另一方面，哈尔滨的中国当局对该地区的苏联人民非常不友好，并为后者制造了诸多障碍，如暂停他们的出版物、实施逮捕等。
--------

1919年朝鲜起义周年纪念。

十年前，朝鲜发生了第一次起义，如今该国已观察到许多变化。朝鲜的未来取决于无产阶级。一旦朝鲜革命成功，它不仅将打击帝国主义，还将打击地主。作为那次革命的结果，农民将获得土地。日本和朝鲜共产党面前有一项重要任务，它们应当争取各阶层的支持，以发动最后的攻击。
--------

2月23日的《红旗报》（Red Banner）写道：-

莫斯科-符拉迪沃斯托克-日本空中通信。

以下空中通信线路已经存在：- 莫斯科-伊尔库茨克（夏季），伊尔库茨克-雅库茨克（夏季），并有支线通往博代博和上乌丁斯克 - 乌兰巴托（全年）。在未来五年内，计划沿叶尼塞河和鄂毕河修建线路，以及伊尔库茨克-中国和伊尔库茨克-符拉迪沃斯托克-日本线路。后者预计将在1931-1932年间开始运营，并将与日本的航空服务连接。通过航空手段，与阿穆尔河畔尼古拉耶夫斯克、萨哈林岛、堪察加半岛和其他北方地点的通信将得到极大改善。伊尔库茨克-符拉迪沃斯托克主线将穿过阿穆尔地区。

pages.en:
- 2 -

With regard to the Vladivostock-Japan line, the latter
country has the same plan in view and intends to establish
communication in addition to Korea and Japan between Seoul-
Vladivostock and Osaka-Harbin-Vladivostock.
The Russian aerial route will be connected in future
with those of other countries in the Far East.
The route through European and Asiatic territory of
U.S.S.R. will extend 7.000 kilometres of which 4.500
kilometres apart from the Berlin-Moscow line are already
being in operation. The aerial route from Europe to the
Far East overland will be the shortest and safest through
Russia. The service will be passenger, postal and cargo,
which will prove of great benefit between Europe, China
and Japan. The Russian Far East will also derive great
advantage from the aerial route when newspapers will be
received in Vladivostock from Moscow within three-four days.

The "Krasnoe Znamya" of March 5th writes:-

Red Army Men of Germany to Soviet
Red Army, Labourers and Peasants.

On the IIth anniversary of the Red Army we send our
greetings to the soldiers of the first labourers' and
peasants' Government, promising most faithful support and
sympathy on our part.
At present when the imperialists of the whole world
are very keen on organizing intervention against U.S.S.R.,
when the social-democratic Ministers are constructing
warships against U.S.S.R. and when there is a movement
in social democratic leading circles to increase armament
and to organize an anti-Soviet frontier, also in the face
of negotiations by the present Government in Germany
with a view to an alliance with the French and German
anti-Soviet Military Group, we, soldiers of the Red
revolutionary army, swear to our readiness to assist the
soldiers of the Soviet Red Army in defending the international
proletarian country - the institution of Great Lenin - against
all enemies of proletarian revolution.
The Council of the Red Army Men.

POLITICAL BRANCH
(FOREIGN SECTION)
DATE 4. 4. 29.

（批：Mch 4:4:29.）
（批：Recd 5/4）

- 2 -

关于符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）至日本航线，后者（指日本）也有同样的计划，并打算除了现有的朝鲜和日本之间的联络外，建立首尔—符拉迪沃斯托克以及大阪—哈尔滨—符拉迪沃斯托克的通信联络。
俄罗斯的航空路线将来会与远东其他国家的路线相连接。
穿越苏联欧洲和亚洲领土的路线全长7,000公里，其中除柏林—莫斯科线外，已有4,500公里投入运营。从欧洲经陆路到远东的航空路线，经由俄罗斯将是最短且最安全的。该服务将包括客运、邮政和货运，这将证明对欧洲、中国和日本之间大有裨益。当报纸能在三至四天内从莫斯科送达符拉迪沃斯托克时，俄罗斯远东地区也将从这条航空路线中获得巨大利益。

3月5日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）写道：-

德国红军致苏联
红军、工人和农民。

在红军成立十一周年之际，我们向第一个工农政府的士兵致以问候，承诺给予我们最忠心的支持和同情。
目前，全世界的帝国主义列强正热衷于组织对苏联的干涉，社会民主党部长们正在建造针对苏联的军舰，社会民主党领导层中有一股增加军备和组织反苏边境的运动，此外，鉴于德国现政府正与法国及德国反苏军事集团进行结盟谈判，我们，红色革命军队的士兵，宣誓准备协助苏联红军的士兵，保卫国际无产阶级国家——伟大的列宁的机构——免受所有无产阶级革命敌人的侵害。
红军士兵委员会。

政治处
（外事科）
日期 1929年4月4日

（批注：1929年4月4日。）

Translation from the "Krasnoe"Znamya" of February 3,5,7,1929.

Caravan perishes in the snows of Pamir.

A caravan of 100 camels is reported to have perished en route from Western China to Pamir together with its guides. There have been several other disasters on the Pamir as a result of snow avalanches. Communication, however, is still being maintained with Western China.

Parade following District Conference.

At the close of the District Conference in Vladivostock a grand parade was held, which was witnessed by a group of foreign seamen, who cheered the army as it paraded in the streets. These seamen were exceedingly surprised to see how simple the delegates of the Conference were dressed as they wore no top hats or formal dress.

Adviser to Soviet Representative in Tokio arrives in Vladivostock.

Comrade Maysky, adviser to the Soviet Government Representative in Tokio, arrived on board the s.s. "Kagi Maru" on February 6 at Vladivostock. He was met by comrade I.M. Heitzman, representatives of various official institutions and Mr. Watanabe, Japanese Consul General in Vladivostock. Comrade Maysky will shortly proceed to Moscow. He stated in an interview with the Press correspondent that Soviet-Japanese relations were improving all the time although the Japanese Fascisti were very much opposed to the Soviet Government. Mr. Maysky also said that negotiations were carried on at present with a theatrical company from Moscow intending to visit Japan for a few representations.

Foreign seamen at the Conference.

Karl Zimmerman speaks to the President of the Conference on behalf of foreign seamen including German, Dutch and Japanese ships in port addressing the Conference with a few words of welcome and some suggestions. "We have understood what the Soviet rule is, in the short space of time we have been here, and we now know that the bourgeois newspapers are full of misleading information. Having attended the parade we are certain that the Soviet Russia will not perish with such an army. The army is united, its officers being from amongst peasants and labourers. "It would be well to free Vladivostock from dens of different evil influences and make it a real sea port"and"long live Soviet Russia"were the concluding words. A resolution to the effect was passed by the President to be presented before the Conference.

Translation from "Krasnoe Znamya" of February 8, 1929.

Chinese Eastern Railway happenings.

Comrade I.M. Geitzman, agent of the People's Commissariat for Foreign Affairs, at the District Conference made the following statement:-
"Soviet citizens now placed in custody by the Chinese authorities in connection with C.E.Ry repressions are innocent of guilt. This is not only our opinion but is also that of the Chinese people. Our sympathies are with those prisoners.
pages.zh:
译自1929年2月3日、5日、7日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

商队在帕米尔高原的风雪中覆灭。

据报道，一支由100峰骆驼组成的商队及其向导在从中国西部前往帕米尔高原的途中覆灭。由于雪崩，帕米尔高原还发生了其他几起灾难。然而，与中国西部的通信联络仍然保持畅通。

地区会议后的阅兵式。

在符拉迪沃斯托克地区会议闭幕时，举行了一次盛大的阅兵式，一群外国海员观看了阅兵，并在军队沿街行进时欢呼。这些海员对会议代表们的着装如此简朴感到非常惊讶，因为他们不戴高顶礼帽，也不穿正式礼服。

苏联驻东京代表顾问抵达符拉迪沃斯托克。

苏联政府驻东京代表顾问迈斯基（Maysky）同志于2月6日乘坐“加吉丸”号（Kagi Maru）轮船抵达符拉迪沃斯托克。伊·姆·海茨曼（I.M. Heitzman）同志、各官方机构代表以及日本驻符拉迪沃斯托克总领事渡边（Watanabe）先生前往迎接。迈斯基同志不久将前往莫斯科。他在接受报社记者采访时称，尽管日本法西斯分子非常反对苏联政府，但苏日关系正在不断改善。迈斯基先生还表示，目前正与一家打算访问日本进行几场演出的莫斯科剧团进行谈判。

参加会议的外国海员。

卡尔·齐默尔曼（Karl Zimmerman）代表停泊在港口的德国、荷兰和日本船只上的外国海员向会议主席发言，向会议致以简短的欢迎辞并提出一些建议。“我们在短短的时间内了解了什么是苏维埃政权，我们现在知道资产阶级报纸充满了误导性信息。参加了阅兵式后，我们确信拥有这样一支军队的苏维埃俄罗斯不会灭亡。军队是团结的，其军官来自农民和工人。”“最好清除符拉迪沃斯托克各种邪恶影响的巢穴，使其成为一个真正的海港”以及“苏维埃俄罗斯万岁”是结束语。主席通过了一项以此为宗旨的决议，提交会议审议。

译自1929年2月8日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

中东铁路事件。

外交人民委员部代理伊·姆·盖茨曼（I.M. Geitzman）同志在地区会议上作了如下声明：-
“因中东铁路镇压行动而被中国当局拘留的苏联公民是无辜的。这不仅是我们的看法，也是中国人民的看法。我们同情那些囚犯。

pages.en:
- 2 -

Now as to happenings in China recently. Politicians
of China have been passing through Vladivostock. From
unofficial interviews with them I have become convinced
that there are a great many people in China who view
the situation in their country in a light similar to
that we do particularly with reference to China's
unification. However, though we are told that the
ideals of Sun Yat Sen are penetrating the minds of the
people more and more and that the views of the freedom
movement as portrayed by Sun are being more frequently
supported by different circles, we cannot understand
how recent happenings in C.E.R could be tolerated and
these speak of enmity towards us. At the same time
the new situation in China should not mean, and in fact
does not, a hostile attitude towards U.S.S.R. How then
should we understand events in C.E.R. Zone? The answer
to the above mentioned happenings is therefore not
to be found in China, her conditions or the feelings
of her people. It is as well to add that it is neither
in the interests of the Chinese Government to bring
about complications with Russia as a result of the
activities of their common enemies. The answer therefore
lies in the interference of some third party. How long
is provocation going to last? The history of China
cannot be made by third persons. The situation in the
country cannot be formed through the medium of 30 silver
coins. The history of China depends on the people's
masses. Leaders pass out, the people remain. The
way of the people lies alongside with our people!"

a/o . e . J.
Copies for usual authorities
attached
H. Robertson p.1.
M
26.2.29
Wm. Lemuel
Brig. G.H. Halland
Capt. J.P. Shelley
R.E. Sharman
W.G. Lee
pages.zh:
- 2 -

现在谈谈中国最近的事态。中国政客们途经符拉迪沃斯托克。通过与他们的非正式会谈，我深信中国有很多人看待其国内局势的角度与我们相似，特别是在中国统一方面。然而，虽然有人告诉我们孙中山的理想正日益深入人心，孙中山所描绘的自由运动观点正得到不同阶层更频繁的支持，但我们无法理解为何能容忍中东铁路最近发生的事件，这些事件表明了对我们的敌意。同时，中国的新局势并不意味着，事实上也没有意味着，对苏联采取敌对态度。那么我们该如何理解中东铁路区域内的事件呢？因此，上述事件的答案不在中国，不在其状况或其人民的情感中。值得一提的是，因共同敌人的活动而导致与俄罗斯发生纠纷，并不符合中国政府的利益。因此，答案在于某些第三方的干涉。挑衅还要持续多久？中国的历史不能由第三方人物来书写。国家的局势不能通过三十枚银币的手段来形成。中国的历史取决于人民群众。领袖们会离去，人民长存。人民的道路与我们的人民并肩同行！”

a/o . e . J.

JC 9199

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya"(Red Banner) of Feb.24,
1929.

Arrival of S.M. Budenny at Vladivostok.

Comrade Budenny, leader of Red cavalry, attended
a welcome meeting in Vladivostock upon his arrival and
made a report on the Red Army in the course of the function.
He said:"there is no other army in the world that can
endure as much as the Red Army. No matter how fierce our
enemies may be they will have a surprise to see how strong
the Red Army is." This same assurance was felt in the
speeches made by other delegates attending the meeting.
Numerous foreign seamen mounted the tribune and in turn
promised they would do all in their power to make the Red Army
a threat to her enemies and a support of the labourers of the
world.

Red Army is prepared to defend U.S.S.R.

The Red Army will have a strong enemy to encounter
and one that is well equipped. However the Red Army is also
well organized and has been improving during the past years.
In the event of war the whole nation armed will represent the
real Red Army. Red units of all arms will be up and active
then supported by millions of communists and labourers
of the world. The Red Army in strength may be smaller
than some others, but it is strong and well organized. It is
not afraid of any technical and chemical methods and
preparations such as poisonous gas, etc. The Red Army
is equal if not better in this respect to the foreign ones.
It is armed with rifles which surpass those of other
countries in perfection. For instance here is a small
comparison:- Russians can fire 4330 shots per minute, French
3730 and British 3520 with their rifles. The artillery
of the Red Army is also good and so is the cavalry.
The Red Army has the support of labourers and peasants
and in this lies its strength and power!

Pardon for Partisans in the Far East.

It is proposed to proclaim amnesty to partisans
who have been formerly active against the Soviet and
who have in consequence suffered imprisonment, by minimizing
their terms of imprisonment, with the exception of those
who have actually plotted against the Government and committed
other serious offences detrimental to the Far Eastern
district in which they particularly operated.

78
pages.zh:
JC 9199

译自1929年2月24日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）（Red Banner）。

S.M. 布琼尼抵达符拉迪沃斯托克。

红军骑兵领导人布琼尼（Budenny）同志抵达符拉迪沃斯托克后参加了一个欢迎会，并在活动期间作了关于红军的报告。他说：“世界上没有其他军队能像红军那样忍受如此多的苦难。无论我们的敌人多么凶猛，他们看到红军的强大时都会感到惊讶。”出席会议的其他代表的演讲中也流露出同样的信心。许多外国海员登上讲台，依次承诺他们将竭尽全力使红军成为其敌人的威胁和世界劳动者的支持力量。

红军准备保卫苏联。

红军将面临一个强大且装备精良的敌人。然而，红军也组织良好，并在过去几年中不断改进。一旦战争爆发，全民武装将代表真正的红军。届时，各兵种的红色部队将行动起来，得到全世界数百万共产党员和劳动者的支持。红军在兵力上可能少于其他一些军队，但它强大且组织良好。它不害怕任何技术和化学手段及准备，如毒气等。在这方面，红军不比外国军队差，甚至更好。它装备的步枪在完美程度上超过其他国家的步枪。例如，这里有一个小比较：- 俄罗斯人用步枪每分钟可射击4330发，法国人3730发，英国人3520发。红军的炮兵也很优秀，骑兵也是如此。红军拥有工人和农民的支持，这就是它的力量和权力所在！

赦免远东游击队员。

提议宣布对那些以前积极反对苏维埃并因此遭受监禁的游击队员实行大赦，缩短他们的刑期，但那些实际策划反对政府并犯有其他严重罪行、对其特别活动的远东地区造成损害的人除外。

78

A.P. 9199.
Translation from "Krasnoe Znamya" No. 30 (47) Jan. 29 and 31, 1920

arrests in Harbin.

In connection with the discovery of a plot of railway men and labour unions chiefs in Harbin, meetings of protest are being held in the interior, of several cities, against the outrages committed by the Chinese authorities. The following outcries were heard:- "The policy of the supreme head of labour organizations and oppression of the working classes is a dangerous game". "Let nobody forget that the Chinese Eastern Railway is a joint concern of the two nations". "We demand immediate release of representatives of labour unions of ... etc. etc."

At a meeting held and attended by Chinese labourers Comrade Li-Shan informed the attendance of the proceedings in Harbin in the terms as under:-

"These militarists are starting a bad business. They have already attacked the Harbin telephone station, and by armed force are arresting leaders of labour unions. Moreover they stop all traffic on the railway by armed force with a view to suppressing us, labourers. We protest against this policy of the Chinese militarists carried on on the same lines as the policy of ... Again, they will lose in the end. Their actions are unacceptable to the masses of the Chinese people. Let them cease their abuses before it is too late!"

At another meeting the following was said:- "In view of recent dates in China and on the ... we must prepare with increased energy for a decisive encounter with the plunderers- imperialists and their hirelings the Chinese militarists. We wish to assure the Chinese Labour Party that we are ever ready to follow its call and to turn our weapons against the imperialists and the Chinese Generals, who are not ashamed to accept the blood money of the foreign oppressors from the Chinese labourers, who are waiting for a signal to march under Lenin's banners and fight the battles of labour versus capital."

Patriot Soviet Conference.

At the III Soviet of Vladivostok District Conference Comrade ... speaking of the international situation stated the following:- "Revolutionary activity of the masses is growing every succeeding day and much progress is made. Also, with what the hatred of imperialistic countries against the Soviets is increasing too. A delegation from Chinese labourers, speaking in the name of one thousand two hundred men residing in Vladivostock, assured the Conference that Chinese would fight shoulder to shoulder with their Russian comrades for the socialistic construction of Vladivostock district. They added that although Chinese generals wanted to interfere with peaceful construction of life, they were ready to enter into opposition with the enemy.

译自1920年1月29日及31日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）第30期（47号）

哈尔滨的逮捕行动。

鉴于在哈尔滨发现铁路工人和工会领袖的阴谋，内地数个城市正在举行抗议集会，反对中国当局所犯下的暴行。现场听到以下呼声：“劳工组织最高领导人的政策以及对工人阶级的压迫是一种危险的游戏”。“谁也不要忘记，中东铁路是两国的合资企业”。“我们要求立即释放……等工会代表”等等。

在一次有中国工人参加的集会上，李山同志向与会者通报了哈尔滨的事态发展，内容如下：

“这些军阀正在干坏事。他们已经袭击了哈尔滨电话局，并动用武力逮捕工会领导人。此外，他们还以武力阻断铁路交通，企图镇压我们这些工人。我们抗议中国军阀的这种政策，其行径与……的政策如出一辙。他们最终必将失败。他们的行为为中国广大民众所不容。让他们在为时已晚之前停止滥用职权！”

在另一次集会上，有人发言称：“鉴于中国近期及……的局势，我们必须以更充沛的精力准备与掠夺者——帝国主义者及其走狗中国军阀进行决定性交锋。我们要向中国劳动党保证，我们随时准备响应其号召，将武器对准帝国主义者和那些中国将军，他们毫不羞耻地接受外国压迫者从中国工人身上榨取的血汗钱，而工人们正等待信号，以便在列宁的旗帜下行进，开展劳工对抗资本的斗争。”

译自《红旗报》（Red Banner）2月……

爱国苏维埃会议。

在海参崴地区苏维埃第三次代表大会上，……同志在谈到国际形势时指出：“群众的革命活动日益增长，取得了很大进展。同时，帝国主义国家对苏维埃的仇恨也在增加。我们在日常工作中没有忘记列宁关于实现世界革命的意愿。

一个由中国工人组成的代表团，代表居住在海参崴的一千二百名工人向大会保证，中国人将与他们的俄罗斯同志并肩作战，为海参崴地区的社会主义建设而奋斗。他们补充说，虽然中国将军们试图干扰和平的生活建设，但他们已准备好与敌人进行对抗。

附呈当局副本。
H.R.M Commr.
Mallam 上校
Cavan 少校
Sheehy 上尉 G.S.
H. Robertson
W.B. 1924年2月21日
