American newspaper correspondent on the Donetz trial.

William Chamberlain, correspondent of the American liberal
newspaper "Monitor" (Christian Science) who attended the court
trial until the last day of the trial, has arrived at Rostov-at-Don.
Mr.Chamberlain intends to visit several of the mines in the Donetz
district to study conditions of life of the miners on the spot.

In an interview given to press representatives, Mr.Chamberlain
stated that a large section of the American press previously reported
that the Donetz trial was staged on accusations invented by the
Soviet administration. THE COURT, HOWEVER, HAS CLEARLY EXPOSED, THAT
THE COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY PLOT OF THE ENGINEERS AND TECHNICIANS HAD
REALLY BEEN IN EXISTENCE.

The plot was organised by former mine owners, who were in close
relations with some foreign organisations. The sentences have proved
that the Soviet Courts are capable of displaying sufficient humanity
when possible.

To the Workers and Red Guards of the Far East.
Letter from the Red Soldiers of Germany.

Class comrades of the struggle !
More than 100.000 soldiers of the red revolutionary front in Germany
who congregated from all parts of Germany on July 4th to participate in the
All-German meeting in Berlin, send you their revolutionary greetings
through the medium of the Unions Committee.

More than 400.000 Berlin workers, who join in this gathering, marched
together with the Red Soldiers as also do the numerous millions of sympa-
thising working and peasant population of Germany which latter consider
the red soldiers as the revolutionary front of the proletarian homeland.

The soldiers of the revolutionary front in Germany have accomplished
considerable work during the last few weeks. Our organisation was faced
with three main problems:
1) The menace to our unions on the part of the former bourgeois-reac-
tionary Government to dissolve the unions.
2) Mobilisation of all toiling workers in towns and villages to support
the communist party during the recent elections.
3) The Forth All-German reunion of Red-Soldiers held on 8th day after
the elections, when all active workers, weary worn after the Reichstag
election campaign, was organised for the purpose of demonstrating to the
bourgeoisie and to reptile social democrats the formidable strength of
the revolutionary red front.
4) The soldiers of the Red Front carried out these three campaigns
with enthusiasm and also with great success. We are proud of having attained
such excellent results for the communist party during the recent elec-
tions. The soldiers of the red front do not think of respite. We will not
rest on our laurels. On the contrary, at present we will show renewed
energy and profit from the results of the elections by extending our in-
fluence and by further gaining the sympathy of the masses, which was shown
to us during the all-German reunion.

We knew beforehand that the offensive started against us by Keidel,
the former Fascist Minister, would not only be continued by the new coali-
tion government, but even would be increased. The new German imperialism
will result in the coalition government endeavouring to complicate rela-
tions between Germany and U.S.S.R. The Red Soldiers, conjointly with the
Communist Party, will carry on the struggle for class interests of the
proletariat against the bourgeoisie and for U.S.S.R., against the world's
reaction.

The wave of sympathy and solidarity displayed to soldiers of the Red
German Front during the days when its military organisation was threatened
with dissolution, has shown that in future they will also enjoy the confi-
dence and support of the revolutionary proletariat of U.S.S.R. and the
toilers of the capitalist countries throughout the world.

In spite of all the dangers and difficulties, we will move forward
under the red banner with increased energy and a redoubled force to new
battles against imperialist menaces, threatening the union of the U.S.S.R.
and against Fascism towards the victory of the proletarian revolution.

D. C. I.

（批：Robertson 8/1. 9/8. Copies to authorities 9/9/28 Copies sent to H.M. Consul Goldschmidt Kent Goldsmith Abst.）

致远东工人和赤卫队。
来自德国红色士兵的信。

斗争中的阶级同志们！
7月4日，来自德国各地的10多万名德国红色革命前线士兵聚集柏林，参加全德大会，并通过工会委员会向你们致以革命问候。

40多万柏林工人与红色士兵一同参加了这次集会，德国数百万同情的工农群众也是如此，后者将红色士兵视为无产阶级祖国的革命前线。

过去几周，德国革命前线的士兵完成了大量工作。我们的组织面临三个主要问题：
1) 前资产阶级反动政府威胁解散工会，对我们的工会构成威胁。
2) 动员城乡所有劳工在最近的大选中支持共产党。
3) 在大选后第8天举行的第四次全德红色士兵重聚大会，当时所有活跃分子在国会选举竞选后疲惫不堪，组织此次大会的目的是向资产阶级和如爬虫般的社会民主党人展示革命红色前线的强大力量。
4) 红色前线士兵热情高涨且非常成功地开展了这三项运动。我们为在最近的大选中为共产党取得如此优异的成绩而感到自豪。红色前线士兵不想休息。我们不会躺在功劳簿上。相反，目前我们将展现新的活力，利用选举结果扩大我们的影响力，并进一步赢得民众的同情，这在全德重聚期间已向我们显现。

我们事先知道，前法西斯部长凯德尔发起的对我们的攻势不仅会被新联合政府继续，甚至还会加剧。新的德意志帝国主义将导致联合政府努力使德国与苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟（U.S.S.R.）之间的关系复杂化。红色士兵将与共产党一起，为无产阶级的阶级利益反对资产阶级，并为苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟反对世界反动势力而斗争。

在其军事组织面临解散威胁的日子里，德国红色前线士兵所获得的同情和团结浪潮表明，未来他们也将获得苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟革命无产阶级以及全世界资本主义国家劳动者的信任和支持。

尽管存在各种危险和困难，我们将以更高的热情和加倍的力量，在红旗下前进，投入新的战斗，反对威胁苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟统一的帝国主义威胁，反对法西斯主义，迈向无产阶级革命的胜利。

D. C. I.

Return of the King of Afghan.
Cabul, 29/6/28 (Tass). Following the return of the King of Afghan a large number of representatives of Afghan tribes from independent districts are arriving in Cabul to participate in the forthcoming big girge. Already over 1000 men have arrived including 300 from Waziristan. Sirza

In India various armed fighting is in progress at present between the Swatt and Dir tribes which has been provoked by Britishers with the purpose of weakening these tribes.

New graduates of the Soviet Red Military Academy.
A solemn ceremony was held yesterday in the Soviet Red Military Academy on the occasion of the admission into the Red Army of this year's graduates.
The new graduates represent the following social categories: 40,9 % workers, 25,5 % peasants and 31,6 % employees.
83% of the graduates of the eight issue of the Military Academy are members of the Russian Communist Party.
Comrade Unschlicht, in the name of Revolutionary Military Council, delivered an address in which he outlined the work which confronts the new graduates. He said: "We are living in a period of a very complicated international aggression and simultaneously we are experiencing considerable difficulties in our own country. We are faced with the attack (in various forms) of international capital. We must give a clear and comprehensive reply to the question, why this attack is being intensified at present and why the activities of the bourgeois elements in our country are increasing.
It is not true that these activities are the result of our weakness. On the contrary, in it simply because we are becoming stronger that the offensive already launched by international capital is increasing and simultaneously the internal struggle by the bourgeois elements against our so-... is becoming more pronounced."
（左侧边注：# P.M. (Soviet Govt) 25/6/28 Internal { } ）

Churchill's hypocritical statement in the House of Commons.

Replying to the question asked by Kenworthy in the House of Commons the Chancellor of Exchequer said: "The Government holds the opinion that it cannot interfere in the matter of oil markets".

Churchill's statement is absurd. British policy, for years past, has been determined, to a great degree, by problems connected with the oil question. The British Government openly prevents soviet oil from entering England, encourages the conclusion of agreements between oil concerns at the expense of British consumers, pursues a policy favourable to the interests of the big oil plunderers, but which are contrary to the interests of independent British commercial organisations and to the British consumers. All this Mr.Churchill calls " not interference in the question of oil markets".

Indian press on King Amanullah's voyage.

The Berlin correspondent of the Indian newspaper "Forward" devotes an article entitled "A rap to Britain" in connection with King Amannullah's visit to U.S.S.R.

"Moscow, writes the correspondent, met King Amannullah as a man who fearlessly and successfully dared to combat British imperialism. The struggle for independence in Afghanistan imparted the stimulus to the anti-imperialist national revolutionary movement in the oppressed countries of Asia. The Soviet Government made a present of the tractor of Soviet manufacture to the King Mannulah. The choice of the present is characteristic for the spirit of New Russia. In U.S.S.R. tractors were presented to King Amannulah, in Italy - an armoured car, in Germany and aeroplane, whereas a military agreement and loan on good terms were offered by Britain. Amannulah however did not run after such tempting proposals so Britain endeavoured to prevent him from going to USSR."

Pointing to the British military preparations along the Afghan frontier the correspondent declares: " India should remember that the forthcoming war, which is much nearer than is generally believed, will decide the fate of India also".

丘吉尔在下议院的虚伪声明。

财政大臣在下议院回答肯沃西提出的问题时说：“政府认为，它不能干涉石油市场事务”。

丘吉尔的声明是荒谬的。多年来，英国政策在很大程度上是由与石油问题相关的问题决定的。英国政府公开阻止苏联石油进入英国，鼓励石油公司以牺牲英国消费者为代价达成协议，推行有利于大型石油掠夺者利益的政策，但这违背了独立的英国商业组织和英国消费者的利益。所有这些，丘吉尔先生都称之为“不干涉石油市场问题”。

印度报刊论阿曼努拉国王之旅。

印度报纸《前进报》的柏林通讯员发表了一篇题为《对英国的打击》的文章，谈及阿曼努拉国王访问苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟（U.S.S.R.）一事。

通讯员写道：“莫斯科接待阿曼努拉国王时，将他视为一位无畏且成功敢于对抗英国帝国主义的人。阿富汗的独立斗争激发了亚洲被压迫国家反帝国主义民族革命运动的动力。苏联政府向阿曼努拉国王赠送了一台苏联制造的拖拉机。礼物的选择体现了新俄罗斯的精神。在苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟，送给阿曼努拉国王的是拖拉机；在意大利，是一辆装甲车；在德国，是一架飞机；而英国则提供了一项军事协议和条件优惠的贷款。然而，阿曼努拉并没有追逐这些诱人的提议，因此英国试图阻止他前往苏联。”

指出英国在阿富汗边境的军事准备，通讯员宣称：“印度应该记住，即将到来的战争比普遍相信的要近得多，这场战争也将决定印度的命运”。

pages.en:
Failure of British-French intrigues.

The "Hindustan Times", an organ of the Indian nation-lists, has devoted several articles to King Amanullah's voyage and to Afghan's relations with other countries. The paper places considerable political importance of the historic voyage of King Amannullah and points out that both Britain and France made earnest attempts to gain the sympathy of the Afghan Ruler in order to instigate him against USSR. The newspaper says, inter alia: "The Anglo-French intrigues calculated to lure the Afghan King into a trap, met with failure. Incessant propaganda was conducted in both the British and French press in order to prevent the King from going to USSR".

They menaced Amannulah with fomenting revolts in Afghanistan, alluded to the preposterousness of his going to USSR, but Amannullah in spite of all these carried out the program of his voyage as previously arranged and became acquainted with the "dreadful" soviets. In spite of all the flattery, the Afghan ruler decided to have nothing in common with Britain in military matters, administrative, financial or industrial reorganisation of Afghanistan. The "Industan Times" emphasizes the fact that the King has entrusted Turkish military experts with the military reorganisation of Afghanistan and discards that of European countries. Referring to existing foreign relations of Afghanistan the newspaper declares that USSR is a very dangerous competitor to Great Britain.-

英法阴谋的失败。

印度民族主义者的机关报《印度斯坦时报》（Hindustan Times）刊登了数篇文章，报道阿曼努拉国王（King Amanullah）的行程以及阿富汗与其他国家的关系。该报认为阿曼努拉国王的历史性访问具有重大的政治意义，并指出英国和法国都曾竭力争取阿富汗统治者的同情，企图煽动他反对苏联。该报称：“旨在诱使阿富汗国王落入陷阱的英法阴谋以失败告终。英国和法国报刊不断进行宣传，试图阻止国王前往苏联”。

他们威胁阿曼努拉，声称要在阿富汗煽动叛乱，暗示他前往苏联之举荒谬绝伦，但阿曼努拉不顾这一切，按原定计划执行了他的出访行程，并与“可怕的”苏维埃建立了联系。尽管极尽奉承之能事，这位阿富汗统治者决定在军事事务以及阿富汗的行政、财政或工业重组方面不与英国发生任何关联。《印度斯坦时报》强调指出，国王已将阿富汗的军事重组工作委托给土耳其军事专家，而摒弃了欧洲国家的方案。在谈及阿富汗现有的对外关系时，该报宣称苏联是英国的一个非常危险的竞争对手。-

pages.en:
I z v i e s t i a
Moscow, June 30, 1925.

Counterfeit Soviet Chervonetz notes.

Berlin, 25/6/25. Herr Briger, coroner of the Prussian Court,
concluded his investigations into the matter of counterfeiting Soviet
Bank notes, which will be the subject of a sensational political
action in the near future. The preliminary investigations lasted
10 months. One can form an idea of the extent of the crime from the
fact that 20 hundredweight of paper having water marks was to be used
for the preparation of 200.000 bank notes of one Chervinetz denomina-
tion. The authorities have also confiscated a trunk containing 5
copper plates bearing the facsimile of the Chervonetz note which have
been subjected to expert examination and found to have already been
in use.

Abundant evidence was obtained at the preliminary investigation
against a certain Vassily Sadstierashwily. He is an emigree from
West Georgia. After the revolution he became secretary to a White-
Guard adventurer named Avaloff-Bermont. In this capacity he joined
the committee for the deliverance of of Georgia from the Bolshevist
yoke. Members of this committee are dispersed all over Europe and in
Germany they maintain close connections with the right wing circles.

For the purpose of financing this committee a certain Karutitze
made the proposal to counterfeit Chervonetz notes, which action would
simultaneously injure the Soviet authority. Sadatiershvily, who was to
become general manager of this business, has enlisted a large techni-
cal staff in Germany. He covered himself with a network of agents
throughout the whole Europe from Madrid to Constantinople. Their chief
duty was to deal in counterfeited Chervontzy notes. Some of these
agents are still under examination. They include a Munich engineer
called Bell, who was intimately connected with British circles. Consi_
derable evidence was also obtained against a certain Doctor Weber from
Munchen and against a councillor named Raketta. The counterfeit Cher-
vonetz was produced in the printing office of a Frankfurt bookprinter
named Bell.

《消息报》（Izvestia）
莫斯科，1925年6月30日。

伪造苏联切尔文涅茨纸币案。

柏林，1925年6月25日。普鲁士法院法医布里格先生（Herr Briger）结束了对伪造苏联钞票一案的调查，该案不久将成为一起轰动性的政治行动的主题。初步调查持续了10个月。从需要动用20英担（hundredweight）带有水印的纸张来印制20万张面值为一切尔文涅茨（Chervinetz）的钞票这一事实中，人们可以想见该犯罪行为的规模之大。当局还没收了一只手提箱，内装5块刻有切尔文涅茨钞票仿制图案的铜版，经专家检验，发现这些铜版此前已被使用过。

在初步调查中，获得了针对一名名为瓦西里·萨德斯捷拉什维利（Vassily Sadstierashwily，音译）的人的大量证据。他是来自格鲁吉亚西部的流亡者。革命后，他成为了一名名为阿瓦洛夫-贝尔蒙特（Avaloff-Bermont，音译）的白卫军冒险家的秘书。在此职位上，他加入了旨在将格鲁吉亚从布尔什维克枷锁下解放出来的委员会。该委员会的成员分散在欧洲各地，在德国，他们与右翼圈子保持着密切联系。

为了资助该委员会，一名名为卡鲁蒂策（Karutitze，音译）的人提出了伪造切尔文涅茨钞票的建议，此举同时也将损害苏联当局的利益。萨达捷尔什维利（Sadatiershvily，音译，原文拼写不一）本应成为这项业务的总经理，他在德国招募了大量的技术人员。他在整个欧洲建立了一个代理人网络，范围从马德里到君士坦丁堡。他们的主要职责是交易伪造的切尔文涅茨钞票。其中一些代理人仍在接受审查。其中包括一名名叫贝尔（Bell）的慕尼黑工程师，他与英国圈子关系密切。此外，还获得了针对一名来自慕尼黑的韦伯博士（Doctor Weber）和一名名为拉凯塔（Raketta，音译）的参议员的有力证据。伪造的切尔文涅茨钞票是在法兰克福一名名叫贝尔的图书印刷商的印刷厂中生产的。

Pamir expedition.
A society of excursionists is preparing an expedition into
Pamir in the first part of July. The group intends to cross the
unexplored region of the Balanda-Kinka river. Thise excursionists
propose to join their work with that of the Russo-German expedi-
tion.-

帕米尔探险队。
一个远足协会正在筹备于七月上旬前往帕米尔地区的探险活动。该小组打算穿越尚未开发的巴兰达-金卡河（Balanda-Kinka river，音译）区域。这些远足者提议将他们的工作与俄德联合探险队的工作结合起来。-

pages.en:
I z v i e s t i a
June 16, 1928.

Translation of extracts on the situation in China.

Shanghai, (Tass). PooYi, the ex-Emperor of China, who fled from
Tientsin, arrived in Dairen. "Shun Pao" reports that Russian White Guards
"advised Poo Yi to take advantage of the situation and seize Manchuria and
Mongolia". The paper reports that Poo Yi rejected the offer declaring
that "he is very glad his life has been preserved since the downfall
of the dynasty".

This information of "Shun Pao" must be compared with the article
published by the "China Critic", which says: "The rather hastened depar-
ture of Poo Yi from Tientsin to Dairen is considered in Chinese circles
as the first step towards the realisation by Japan of her design to make
Poo Yi Emperor of Manchuria. It was supposed that after Chang Tso Lin's
death (as a result of the bomb outrage) chaos would prevail in Manchuria
and the ex-Emperor would declare, in a very diplomatic manner, such as
only his Japanese teachers could inspire, his accession to the Throne.
Japan, of course, would promise to remain neutral in the same manner as
was with Korea. Bye and bye history, with regard to
realisation of her designs in Manchuria, would repeat itself, to Japan's
satisfaction".

The information regarding the arrival at Dairen of the Ex-Emperor Poo
Yi and the Japanese plans connected therewith are not devoid of interest
in spite of the doubtful source of their origin. Poo Yi, - who is young
and not over-intelligent,- is the last representative of the Manchurian
dynasty. He was dethroned in 1911. By an agreement concluded at that time
he and his Court continued to reside for several years after the revolution
of 1911 in one of the most spacious Imperial palaces in Peking. During
the winter of 1924-25 General Feng Yu Hsiang ousted these remnants of the
dynasty. Poo Yi, aided by Japanese officers, took refuge in the Japanese
Legation where he continued to live with his wives and entourage. The Japa-
nese transferred him from this place to Tientsin where he lived in the Japa-
nese concession under Japanese guard. This particular attention paid to him
by the Japanese certainly suggests some political design.

（印：No. 1 U 91919 / Date 28.7.28）
pages.zh:
《消息报》（Izvestia）
1928年6月16日。

关于中国局势的摘录译文。

上海，（塔斯社）。逃离天津的中国前皇帝溥仪（PooYi）抵达大连。《申报》报道称，俄国白卫军“建议溥仪利用当前局势，夺取满洲和蒙古”。该报报道说，溥仪拒绝了这一提议，宣称“自王朝覆灭以来，他很庆幸自己保全了性命”。

必须将《申报》的这则信息与《中国评论周报》（China Critic）发表的文章进行对比，后者称：“溥仪从天津匆忙前往大连，在中国各界看来，这是日本实现其让溥仪成为满洲皇帝计划的第一步。据推测，在张作霖死于炸弹袭击后，满洲将陷入混乱，前皇帝将以一种只有他的日本导师才能启发出的极具外交辞令的方式，宣布登基。当然，日本会像对待朝鲜那样承诺保持中立。久而久之，关于其在满洲实现野心的历史将会重演，这将令日本感到满意”。

尽管来源可疑，但关于前皇帝溥仪抵达大连以及与此相关的日本计划的信息并非毫无趣味。溥仪——年轻且智力平平——是满洲王朝的最后代表。他于1911年被废黜。根据当时达成的一项协议，在1911年革命后的几年里，他和他的朝廷继续居住在北京最宽敞的皇宫之一。1924-25年冬，冯玉祥将军驱逐了这些王朝残余势力。溥仪在日本军官的帮助下，避难于日本公使馆，并与他的妻妾及随从继续在那里生活。日本人随后将他从那里转移至天津，他在日本租界内居住，处于日本人的监护之下。日本人给予他的这种特别关注无疑暗示着某种政治图谋。

（印：No. 1 U 91919 / 日期 1928年7月28日）

I z v i e s t i a
Moscow, June 16, 1926.

（印：POLICE. REGISTRY No. 10 9199 Date 26/7/28）

Translation of extracts on the situation in China.

Dr.C.T.Wang, the Foreign Minister of the Nanking Government, in an interview with the Reuter representative, announced that the question of the transfer of the capital from Peking to Nanking had been definitely decided by the Nanking government.

This decision, if realised, will be one of no small political importance. The interests of foreign capital in the Yangtze valley are of no less importance that those in North China, yet Peking has its peculiar traditions which the Nanking Government must absolutely get rid of. The announcement of the transfer of the capital was met in the Peking foreign diplomatic circles negatively. Britain, however, may have the consolation that Nanking is near to Shanghai - this most important center of British influence in China. On the contrary the change of Peking to Nanking is decidedly contrary to the interests of Japan, whose position in Central China is weaker than in the North, near her Manchurian base, where Japanese influence has taken deep roots. In consequence of this the Japanese press in China has assumed a most negative attitude towards the transfer of the capital as also towards other similar measures of the Nanking Government namely the transfer of the General Post Office from Peking to Nanking etc.

（手写批注：Authorised

关于中国局势的摘录译文。

南京政府外交部长王正廷博士在接受路透社代表采访时宣布，南京政府已明确决定将首都从北京迁往南京。

这一决定若得以实现，将具有重大的政治意义。外国资本在长江流域的利益并不亚于在华北的利益，然而北京有着其独特的传统，南京政府必须彻底摆脱这些传统。迁都的声明在北京的外交界引起了负面反应。不过，英国或许可以得到些许安慰，因为南京靠近上海——这是英国在华最重要的影响力中心。相反，从北京迁都至南京显然不符合日本的利益，因为日本在华中的势力弱于其在靠近满洲基地的华北地区的势力，而在后者日本的影响力已根深蒂固。因此，在华的日本报刊对迁都以及南京政府的其他类似措施（例如将邮政总局从北京迁往南京等）采取了极为负面的态度。

Annual conscription for the red army.

The regular annual conscription for the Red Army begins within
two months, when recruits born in 1906 will be drafted. This will
be the fifth regular conscription drafted in accordance with the
law of compulsory military service. Conscription which is carried
out every year at fixed periods has now become an ordinary event
in Soviet life. The success however of each draft depends chiefly
on the preliminary preparations. The well-timed practice of granting
exemptions to all members of the draft of the red army, particularly
the reduction of agricultural taxes is a very important factor
in assuring the success of military conscription. These exemptions
are not only being granted to those already serving the colours
but also to those who are liable to be called up for military
service next autumn.

D. C. J.

Translation of extracts on the situation in China.
Cheap labour is one of the greatest ressources in China.
Washington, 21/7/25 (Tass). The "Tass" correspondent had an
interview with Mr. Wu Chao Chu, the unofficial representative of the
Nanking Government at Washington. Answering the question as to what
measures the Nanking Government deem it necessary to take for the
amelioration of the situation of the Chinese workers who are inhumanly
exploited by both foreign and Chinese capital, Wu Chao Chu replied:
" The programme of the Kuomintang has provided for a number of social
reforms aiming particularly at the amelioration of the situation of
the toiling masses. I must add however, that Chinese cheap labour
is one of the greatest ressources of China and with it China has made
it possible to compete with the newest machinery and implements of
the Western countries. If the Chinese wish to survive in an economic
sense, they should refrain from making sudden changes in wages and
number of working hours".
Mr.Wu is assuming an expectant attitude in Washington. The Nanking
Government for the present is not interested so much in obtaining
recognition from the U.S.A. as in assuring the support of Washington
to the demands, presented by the Nanking Government to the Japanese
with regard to Manchuria.

Translation from the "Shanghai Zarya" of July 13 continued.
(Afternoon).

Russian.

Unification problem.

A correspondent of the "Shanghai Zarya" interviewed
a person closely connected with the Russian Emigrants' Committee
on the subject of unification and learnt that the Committee
will have nothing further to add to the resolutions passed
at the recent meeting of the Russian Organizations representatives
these on the whole having contained more offence against
Mr. V.V. Grosse. Whilst accusing Mr. Grosse for desiring a
non-political unification the meeting decided unanimously
in favour of a governing body for the emigrants in Shanghai
founded on principle of defence of Russian economic and
judicial rights. The Committee of Mr. Grosse is accused of
wanting to submit other organizations and at the same time
the party in opposition insists on Mr. Grosse recognizing
their leadership viz: the Grand Duke Nicholas Nicholaevitch
whilst there are other political groups in Shanghai not any
less patriotic. There is no doubt that Mr. Grosse is an
important connection for the emigrants if they wish to maintain
unity and his resignation of position would only enhance
disagreements in the community.

Harbin, June 18, 1925 (Tass).

Anti-soviet propaganda of the Japanese press.

During the last week the Japanese newspaper "Harbin Nichi Nichi" published several fallacious articles about the alleged preparations by the soviet government for military occupation of the Hulunbuir district of Mongolia adjoining the Chinese Eastern Railway.zone.

This paper in its false reports mentioned following names: Aboltin, Soviet Consula General at Harbin, Lashevitch, Vice-president of Board of Directors of the Chinese Eastern Railway and Boriskin, Chairman of Board of Directors of the Dalbank, all of whom recently visited Arshan summer ressort and were victims ■ in a motor car accident. The paper asserts that this trip was undertaken for the purpose of meeting General Feng Yu Hsiang's agents to whom they were to deliver three million dollars."

On June 16 the newspaper refferred■ to published a lengthy article in which it said: " After the defeat of southerners and wrecking of Chang Tso Ling's train the situation in the Three Eastern Provinces became critical and movement of troops began in U.S.S.R. Red Russia planned the seizure of Hulunbuir by means of subordinating this district to the influence of Urga. The soviet members of the C.E.R. administration, recognizing the necessity of forming a base in this district to carry out the plot, selected the Arshan summer ressort for this purpose. Under the pretext of putting this summer resso.t into order a huge sum of money was allotted by the C.E.R. This trip to the summer ressort was undertaken with the object of finding if the roads were sufficiently serviceable for military purposes."

Following up this campaign of falsehoods launched by the "Harbin Nichi Nicni" Comrade Aboltin, Soviet Consul General at Harbin, drew the attention of the Japanese Consul General at Harbin to the anti-soviet campaign which has been conducted for some time past by the Japanese press in Manchuria.

The Harbin soviet newspaper "Molva" in drawing attention to the false statements circulated by the Japanese press in Mandchuria writes: " One can hardly admit that the newspaper of the Japanese colony at Harbin could dare come out unsupported and conduct a campaign against U.S.S.R. accusing it of making preparations for war with China. There is no doubt these accusations emanate from authoritative sources, who remain in the background. This campaign of lies is being carried out on elaborately devised plan and the degree of its intensity is being controlled. It is a sort of psychological smoke screen behind which the active wirepullers of Japan's aggressive policy in Manchuria are endeavouring to screen themselves and direct Chinese public opinion in a false direction".

D. C. J.

哈尔滨，1925年6月18日（塔斯社）。

日本报刊的反苏宣传。

上周，日本报纸《哈尔滨日日新闻》发表了几篇虚假文章，声称苏联政府正准备军事占领毗邻中东铁路区的蒙古呼伦贝尔地区。

该报在虚假报道中提到了以下名字：阿博尔廷，苏联驻哈尔滨总领事；拉舍维奇，中东铁路理事会副主席；以及鲍里斯金，道胜银行理事会主席，他们最近均前往阿尔山避暑胜地，并在一场汽车事故中成为受害者 ■ 。该报声称，此次出行是为了会见冯玉祥将军的特使，并向他们交付三百万美元。”

6月16日，该报引用 ■ 发表了一篇长文，其中称：“在南方军队战败和张作霖列车被毁后，东三省局势变得危急，苏联开始了军队调动。红色俄罗斯计划通过将呼伦贝尔地区置于乌兰巴托的影响之下来夺取该地区。中东铁路管理局中的苏联成员认识到有必要在该地区建立基地以实施阴谋，为此选择了阿尔山避暑胜地。借口整顿该避暑胜地，中东铁路拨出了一笔巨款。前往该避暑胜地的目的是考察道路是否足以满足军事用途。”

继《哈尔滨日日新闻》发起的这一虚假宣传运动之后，苏联驻哈尔滨总领事阿博尔廷同志提请日本驻哈尔滨总领事注意日本报刊在满洲进行了一段时间的反苏运动。

哈尔滨苏联报纸《言论报》在提请注意日本报刊在满洲散布的虚假陈述时写道：“人们很难相信，哈尔滨日本侨民的报纸竟敢在没有支持的情况下站出来，开展针对苏联的运动，指责苏联准备与中国开战。毫无疑问，这些指控来自幕后权威人士。这场谎言运动是按照精心设计的计划进行的，其强度受到控制。这是一种心理烟幕，日本在满洲侵略政策的积极操纵者正试图躲在后面，并将中国公众舆论引向错误的方向”。

The "Shanghai Arya" of July 1th writes as follows:-

Mission.

Another meeting on unification.

Last Sunday the next regular general meeting of the representatives of Russian organizations in Shanghai was held at the premises of the Committee for Defense of Russian Rights and Interests. The meeting was presided over by Mr. ...omin who read the report of the Commission on the resolutions declared by the Russian migrants' committee. The report was unanimously approved and passed for publication in the local Press. The report on the whole deals in detail with the resolutions of the migrants' committee and resulted in the following resolutions having been passed by the general meeting on Sunday:-
1) To approve the report as presented and to have it published by the local Press.
2) To ignore the attitude adopted by the migrants' committee in view of the small number of organizations supporting it and to continue the organization of unification.
Next letters from Gen. Horvath were read; one was addressed to Mr. Ivanoff, Chairman of the Committee for Defense of Russian Rights and in it encouragement was given to the latter to carry on the work of unification whilst the other merely contained a few suggestions on unification by Gen. Horvath. The General likewise wrote that in his opinion great success has already been achieved in the Far East as he has been recognized by the majority of the Russian emigrants.
Plans made by the Commission on unification were brought before the attendance of representatives and passed as follows:-
1) That it was desirable to have one organization uniting all Russian emigrants in Shanghai for the protection of their economic and judicial rights and that such an organization be headed by a representative appointed by the chief representative of migrants in the Far East and assisted by members delegated by other organizations.
2) That in order that the appointment mentioned above be acceptable to all in view of the claims for that position presented by Mr. T... from the Russian Community should be asked to name their own candidate by means of voting in accordance with a well worked-out plan of procedure.
The first resolution was proposed and adopted by all present whilst the final decision of the second was postponed to the next meeting in view of the late hour.

7月1日的《上海雅利安报》（Shanghai Arya）报道如下：-

使命。

另一次关于统一的会议。

上周日，在俄侨权益保护委员会会址举行了上海各俄罗斯组织代表的下一次例行大会。会议由……omin先生主持，他宣读了关于俄侨委员会所宣布决议的调查委员会报告。该报告获得一致批准，并获准在当地报刊上发表。该报告总体上详细阐述了俄侨委员会的决议，并导致周日的全体大会通过了以下决议：-
1) 批准所提交的报告，并由当地报刊予以发表。
2) 鉴于支持俄侨委员会的组织数量寥寥，对其所采取的态度不予理会，并继续开展统一组织的组建工作。
随后宣读了霍瓦特将军（Gen. Horvath）的来信；其中一封致俄侨权益保护委员会主席伊万诺夫（Ivanoff）先生，信中鼓励后者继续开展统一工作，而另一封仅包含霍瓦特将军关于统一工作的几点建议。这位将军还写道，他认为在远东已取得巨大成功，因为他已得到大多数俄国流亡者的认可。
统一委员会制定的计划提交给与会代表审议，并通过如下：-
1) 认为有必要建立一个联合所有在上海的俄国流亡者的组织，以保护其经济和司法权利，该组织应由远东俄侨首席代表任命的代表领导，并由其他组织委派的成员协助。
2) 为了使上述任命能为各方所接受，鉴于俄罗斯社区人士 T... 先生对该职位提出的要求，应通过按照周密制定的程序方案进行投票的方式，请其提名自己的候选人。

"Izviestia".
Moscow, June 6, 1928.

Commenting on the bomb outrage at Mukden and on the alleged
participation in it by soviet agents, the "Izviestia" says: - We would
abstain from commenting on this matter but are forced to refer to it
owing to the publication of inaccurate information of a nature intended
to be provocative alleging the participation of the USSR in this outrage.
We refer to the "Toho" and "Reuter" reports asserting that the bombs
were of "Soviet make" and that a "suspicious looking Russian was killed
on the spot". The absurdity of these insinuations is so manifest, that
in the opinion of the "Izviestia" they do not deserve consideration.
However, the fact that these reports emanate from Japanese sources
and are credited to an official military person of the Japanese army,
leads us to suspect that we are dealing with an unscrupulous piece
of provocation on the part of some of the irresponsible elements
among the Japanese reactionaries and Japanese soldiery.-

"Izviestia"
Moscow, June 3, 1928.

Translation of extract from correspondence sent by "TASS" correspon-
dent from Shanghai, June 1, 1928.

Dr.C.T.Wang, the Nationalist Foreign Minister, in an interview
with the "TASS" correspondent said : "Deficiency in the activity of
some members of the Kuomintang, to which Mr.Sokolaky has referred
in the "North China Daily News", actually exists. The northern campaign
together with the whole military period of activity of the Nationalist
Government is nearing the end and the period of reconstruction of the
State in accordance with Sun Yat Sen 's Three Principles is now
approaching. Our chief aim is to revise our relations with foreign
powers and to establish them on principle of equality. This cannot be
achieved by forcing the issue. When the opportune time arrives we
should reach an agreement with the U.S.S.R., because the two countries
possessing many thousand of miles of frontier, cannot possibly maintain
the attitude of persons "who do not speak one with other". However
the U.S.S.R. Government will have to understand that we do not want
any form of government that does not conform with our wishes and with
conditions in China. Neither do we want to have any "political missio-
naries".

Answering the question submitted by the correspondent as to the
meaning "when the opportune time arrives" Dr.C.T.Wang replied:- The
opportune time will arrive after we have convinced xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
ourselves that the Soviet Government has abandoned its practice of
sending "political missionaries" into China.

Foreign Consuls are manifesting great interest in the above
policy.

A "Society of Russian Culture" has been organised in Nanking.
At the inaugural meeting addresses were delivered by Mr.Sueh Dou
Bee, Minister of Interior, New Young Chien, President of the Kiangsi
provincial Government, representative of Marshal Feng Yu Hsiang etc.

国民政府外交部长王正廷博士在接受塔斯社记者采访时说：“索科拉基（Sokolaky）先生在《字林西报》中提到的国民党部分成员在活动中的不足，确实存在。北伐以及国民政府整个军事活动时期即将结束，现在正接近根据孙中山三民主义重建国家的时期。我们的主要目标是修订与列强的关系，并在平等原则基础上建立这些关系。这不能通过强行推动来实现。当时机成熟时，我们应该与苏联达成协议，因为这两个拥有数千英里边界的国家，不可能维持‘互不说话’的人之间的态度。然而，苏联政府必须明白，我们不想要任何不符合我们意愿和中国国情的政府形式。我们也不希望有任何‘政治传教士’。”

The "Shanghai Arya" of July 4, writes as follows:-

Russian. Tragedy on the Armoured Train.

According to information received from Chinese Head-quarters in Tientsin, the crew of the armoured train "Hupeh" murdered 5 Russian officers together with Colonel Shumakoff on June 25. This murder took place between the stations "Lu Tai" and "Tunku".
The sixth officer while covering his retreat by shooting fell between two cars and was run over.
The Russian Soldiers of the armoured train (40 men) on learning of the murder of their officers who had been accommodated in another car, opened fire and under cover of same escaped.
Their subsequent fate nor the names of the officers have not been learned so far.

Yesterday's Meeting of the
Unification Commission.

Last night in the premises of the Committee for the Defence of Russian Rights and Interests a second meeting was held by the Unification Commission, chosen at the General Meeting held on June 24.
The meeting was presided over by Mr. V. Fomin.
The Declaration of the Emigrant Committee was discussed.
In their speeches the members of the Commission pointed out the inconsistency, which in their opinion was contained in the declarations of the Emigrant Committee passed on June 21st.
Some members protested against these declarations.
The Commission has drawn up an elaborate report with reference to the Declarations, which will be read at the next general meeting of Russian Organizations, to be held on Sunday, June 8.
Furthermore the Commission decided that the motives of the Emigrant Committee were non-convincing and that the work of unification should be carried on without delay.
The Commission intends to bring before the General Meeting a firm plan for future action.
The next meeting of the Commission will take place in the same place on Friday, July 6.
The place for the next General meeting which is to take place on Sunday, July 8, at 4 p.m. has not been decided upon so far.

The "Echo" of July 3rd writes as follows:

Soviet Moscow Expects War.

U.S.S.R. is making elaborate preparations for war with the West.
Many are of the opinion that they will come out victorious in this struggle, because U.S.S.R. will play her enemies off against each other and with the aid of the Komintern working towards civil war in the various European countries will prevent a united front against herself.
However there are other Communists who openly declare that war will be the cause of internal catastrophe.

7月4日的《上海雅利安报》报道如下：-

俄罗斯。装甲列车上的悲剧。

据从天津中国总部收到的消息，“湖北”号装甲列车的乘务人员于6月25日谋杀了包括舒马科夫上校（Colonel Shumakoff）在内的5名俄国军官。这起谋杀案发生在“芦台”（Lu Tai）和“塘沽”（Tunku）两站之间。
第六名军官在开枪掩护撤退时，跌落在两节车厢之间并被碾过。
装甲列车上的俄国士兵（40人）得知安置在另一节车厢的军官被谋杀后，开火射击，并借此掩护逃脱。
他们随后的命运以及军官们的姓名迄今尚未获悉。

昨日统一委员会会议。

昨晚，在俄侨权益保护委员会会址，由6月24日全体大会选出的统一委员会举行了第二次会议。
会议由 V. Fomin 先生主持。
讨论了流亡者委员会的宣言。
委员会成员在发言中指出，他们认为6月21日通过的流亡者委员会宣言中存在不一致之处。
一些成员对这些宣言表示抗议。
委员会就该宣言起草了一份详尽的报告，将在定于6月8日星期日举行的俄罗斯组织下一次全体大会上宣读。
此外，委员会决定，流亡者委员会的动机缺乏说服力，统一工作应立即继续进行。
委员会打算向全体大会提交一份坚定的未来行动计划。
委员会的下一次会议将于7月6日星期五在同一地点举行。
定于7月8日星期日下午4时举行的下一次全体大会的地点迄今尚未确定。

苏维埃 莫斯科预期战争。

苏联正在为与西方的战争做周密准备。
许多人认为，苏联将在这场斗争中获胜，因为苏联将使敌人互相争斗，并借助共产国际在欧洲各国推动内战，从而防止形成针对苏联的统一战线。
然而，也有其他共产党人公开宣称，战争将导致内部灾难。

The "Echo" of July 2nd writes as follows:-

Russian.

Declaration of the Russian migrants in Shanghai.

The meeting held by public organizations on Saturday was convened on the initiative of Mr. E.L. Metzler, Vice President of the Migrants' Committee and was attended by 43 delegates representing 25 Russian emigrant organizations. Mr. Metzler who presided over the meeting informed the attendance that this was being held with a view to acquainting the Russian emigrants of the decisions reached by the so called 'public organisations' which declared themselves against the migrants' committee and Mr. V. F. Grosse. After reading the decisions of the migrants' Committee reached on June 21, the President invited expression of views by the attendance.

Gen. Lebedeff spoke in favour of supporting the opinion of the migrants' Committee and of expressing trust in Mr. Grosse. He added that unification should first of all be outside politics and have in view the interests of to-day. If anyone wishes to exhibit activity with regard to Bolsheviks versus Tsarism is not the place, this should be done near the borders of Russia.

Mr. Lapojnikoff suggested a declaration explaining views concerning the existing state of affairs.

Mr. Tokareff, representing the Engineers' Corps, stated that the labouring class of emigrants was tired of the continuous strife in the Russian community. He said the fault lay with always the same group of people such as Bary, Ivanoff, Afanassieff and others. He also advocated that the names of persons concerned in creating trouble amongst emigrants should be all published in the declaration, but this was opposed by Mr. Lapojnikoff, who said that the names of such persons were known to everyone.

Father Andreeff, representing Bishop Simon, was the next speaker: He said that a good foundation was laid when the Emigrants' Committee was formed and that since then strong unification took place which was at the time blessed by the Bishop, who is pastor of 10,000 Russians in Shanghai. Those who choose to remain outside this unification are free to do so and no attention should be paid to the resolutions passed at the meeting held at the Officers' Club. Those are vain attempts by a few unworthy people whose sole idea is to destroy that which has been formed over a year ago. Now there is a movement to build a Russian church and this is another proof of the right way chosen by our group of people. The others are only a minority and we should not mind what they say or do."

The following declaration was then drawn up and unanimously passed by the meeting:-

"The resolutions published in the Press passed at the so called Unification Meeting of Russians in Shanghai misrepresent the position held by the Emigrants' Committee and discredit the good name of the Emigrants' Committee and its President, Mr. V. F. Grosse. The true facts of the situation are as follows:- Russian emigrants left Russia not of their own free will and it therefore natural that their thoughts should be bent on overthrowing the Bolsheviks and returning to their own country. However with the same purpose in view Russians are divided into several political parties. At the same time the position of the Bolsheviks does not indicate their early downfall and in the meantime Russians of whatever their political views are require protection of their rights and interests which could be easier attained by unification.

7月2日的《回声报》（Echo）写道：-

俄国人。

在沪俄国移民的声明。

由各公共团体于周六举行的会议，系由移民委员会副主席E.L.梅茨勒（E.L. Metzler）先生发起召开，出席会议的有代表25个俄国移民组织的43名代表。主持会议的梅茨勒先生告知与会者，召开此次会议旨在让俄国移民了解那些自称反对移民委员会及V.F.格罗斯（V. F. Grosse）先生的所谓“公共团体”所作出的决定。在宣读了移民委员会于6月21日作出的决定后，主席请与会者发表意见。

列别杰夫将军（Gen. Lebedeff）发言支持移民委员会的意见，并表示对格罗斯先生的信任。他补充说，团结首先应超越政治，并着眼于当前的利益。如果有人希望就布尔什维克与沙皇主义的问题展开活动，这里不是合适的地方，这种活动应在俄罗斯边境附近进行。

拉波日尼科夫先生（Mr. Lapojnikoff）建议发表一份声明，阐明对当前局势的看法。

代表工程师团的托卡列夫先生（Mr. Tokareff）表示，移民中的劳动阶级已厌倦了俄国社区内无休止的争斗。他说，过错始终在于同一群人，如巴里（Bary）、伊万诺夫（Ivanoff）、阿法纳西耶夫（Afanassieff）等人。他还主张应在声明中公布所有在移民中制造麻烦的人员姓名，但这一提议遭到拉波日尼科夫先生的反对，后者称这些人的名字已为人所共知。

代表西蒙主教（Bishop Simon）的安德烈耶夫神父（Father Andreeff）是下一位发言者：他说，移民委员会成立时奠定了良好的基础，此后实现了强有力的团结，当时拥有上海一万名俄国信徒的主教对此予以祝福。那些选择置身于此种团结之外的人可以自由行事，不必理会军官俱乐部会议上通过的决议。那些只是一小撮不肖之徒的徒劳尝试，其唯一目的就是要破坏一年多前所形成的局面。现在有一股建立俄国教堂的运动，这再次证明了我们这群人所选择的道路是正确的。其他人只是少数派，我们不应在意他们的言行。”

随后起草了以下声明，并经会议一致通过：-

“报刊上刊登的、在上海所谓的俄国统一会议上通过的决议，歪曲了移民委员会的立场，损害了移民委员会及其主席V.F.格罗斯先生的良好声誉。情况的真实事实如下：- 俄国移民并非自愿离开俄罗斯，因此他们一心想要推翻布尔什维克并返回祖国，这是自然而然的。然而，出于同样的目的，俄国人分裂成了几个政党。同时，布尔什维克的地位并未显示其会早日垮台，与此同时，无论持何种政治观点的俄国人，都需要保护其权利和利益，而通过团结可以更容易地实现这一目标。

pages.en:
- 2 -

Political differences whilst weakening the united anti
communist front, appear at the same time an obstacle to unification.
The proposal by the Emigrants' Committee to divide the political
and public unification movement was not meant as an expression of
a passive attitude towards Communism. The Emigrants' Committee
recognizes the necessity of active political struggle, but considers
it should be conducted outside the sphere of emigrants who are
battling with the difficulties of life, such as means of livelihood
etc. Already for the past few years a certain group of people
making use of political mottoes and would be active struggle
against Bolshevism, has been endeavouring by all means possible
to stand at the head of Russian Community in Shanghai. The results
so far are a misunderstanding with the Church, the attempts to
"run down" the ex Imperial Consul General of Shanghai, the notorious
"secret" memorandum and the noise about the unification as suggested
by the Initiative Group. The attacks such as declarations of distrust
in Mr. Grosse are only a repetition of the policy conducted by the
above named group during recent years and Mr. Grosse being the
obstacle to their ideas gets all the blame.
Concerning Mr. Grosse the Emigrants' Committee does not
attach any significance to the loss of his title, but regards him
in the light of confidence which placed in him by the Russian
Imperial Government during many years and of which Russian
emigrants have no moral right to deprive him as although ceasing
to be a Consul General he still continues to defend Russian
interests in most worthy manner in spite of all the insults
launched upon him by his political opponents. The Emigrants'
Committee and its organizations and persons are expressing full
confidence in their Chairman and proclaim him as one whole-heartedly
protecting Russian interests and giving all his knowledge, and
experience for the benefit of maintaining good relations between
Russians, Foreigners and Chinese.
One need not be surprised that the Resolutions of the
Meeting of the Opposing Party declared a distrust in Mr. Grosse
for they did exactly the same thing in the notorious memorandum
against a person of the Imperial Russian Family. They distrust
the Bishop, the ex- Consul General, Grand Duke - can anyone trust
them after that?
The next serious obstacle to unification in Shanghai
is in the number of mythical and non-important organizations. The
real unification will be genuine only when organizations of
professions will be considered such as those of engineers, doctors,
merchants, etc. etc., A non-political unification of the above
would form the authoritative centre able to decide the fates of
the Russian Community in Shanghai. It was ideas of that kind
that were expected to be brought forward by Mr. Shunihin by the
Emigrants' Committee, but when the former declared he had no fixed
plan as to how the unification could be accomplished the refusal
of the Emigrants' Committee to send his delegates to the Meeting
is to be considered reasonable. The Emigrants' Committee does
not oblige anyone to anything and is of the opinion that unification
can be voluntary only. The proposals laid out by the Committee
meant to show that already now it is existing as a non-political
uniting centre which could be extended by the joining of other
organizations and then a reform in the administration of Russian
affairs could be carried out.
Referring to the question of unification under Gen.
Horvath, the Emigrants' Committee fully entertains the idea and
is prepared to support Gen. Horvath as the representative and
protector of Russian economic and judicial rights before the
Central Chinese Government without any political affiliation to
a certain party or parties.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

政治分歧在削弱统一的反共阵线的同时，似乎也构成了团结的障碍。移民委员会提出的将政治与公共团结运动分开的建议，并非意在表达对共产主义的被动态度。移民委员会承认积极政治斗争的必要性，但认为这种斗争应在那些正与生活困难（如生计手段等）作斗争的移民圈子之外进行。在过去几年里，已有某些人利用政治口号和所谓的反布尔什维克积极斗争，千方百计试图站在上海俄国社区的领导地位。迄今为止的结果是与教会发生误解，企图“诋毁”前驻上海帝国总领事，臭名昭著的“秘密”备忘录，以及由发起小组提出的关于团结的喧嚣。诸如对格罗斯先生表示不信任之类的攻击，不过是上述群体近年来所推行政策的重复，而格罗斯先生因成为其理念的障碍而受到所有指责。
关于格罗斯先生，移民委员会并不重视其头衔的丧失，而是鉴于俄国帝国政府多年来给予他的信任，俄国移民在道德上无权剥夺这种信任，因为尽管他不再担任总领事，但他仍以最值得尊敬的方式捍卫俄国利益，不顾其政治对手对他发动的所有侮辱。移民委员会及其所属组织和个人对其主席表示充分信任，并宣称他是一位全心全意保护俄国利益的人，为维护俄国人、外国人和中国人之间的良好关系贡献其全部知识和经验。
反对派会议的决议宣布对格罗斯先生不信任，这不足为奇，因为他们在那份针对一位俄国皇室成员的臭名昭著的备忘录中也做了完全相同的事情。他们不信任主教、前总领事、大公——在此之后，还有谁能信任他们呢？
阻碍上海团结的下一个严重障碍是存在大量虚构且不重要的组织。只有当各类职业组织（如工程师、医生、商人等组织）被纳入考量时，真正的团结才是真实的。上述群体的非政治性团结将形成一个权威中心，能够决定上海俄国社区的命运。移民委员会曾期望舒尼欣先生（Mr. Shunihin）提出此类想法，但鉴于前者声明他对于如何实现团结没有固定计划，移民委员会拒绝派遣其代表参加会议被视为合理之举。移民委员会不强迫任何人做任何事，并认为团结只能是自愿的。委员会提出的建议意在表明，它目前已作为一个非政治性的团结中心存在，可以通过其他组织的加入而扩大，进而可以对俄国事务的管理进行改革。
关于在霍尔瓦特将军（Gen. Horvath）领导下进行团结的问题，移民委员会完全赞同这一想法，并准备支持霍尔瓦特将军作为俄国经济和司法权利在中国中央政府面前的代表和保护者，而不依附于任何特定政党。

"Krasnoe Znamia"
(Red Banner)
Vladivostock, May 17 1925.

Defeat in a victory.

It is a fact of world-wide knowledge that at the entrance to the Shanghai Parks there are regulations governing the use of the public recreation places, one paragraph of which says: " Entrance prohibited to Chinese and dogs". The regulation adorns this place long ago: from the moment when Shanghai passed over to the foreign imperialists. And almost at the same time the Chinese more or less were protesting against this placing Chinese at the level with dogs. Even in Shanghai, this stronghold of imperialist power at the East, where the enslaver's will is imposed by an armed merciless force, even here such a sign-board seemed to be misplaced and out of date.

Shanghai is inhabited principally by the Chinese. 30.000 foreigners there are about two million Chinese. The largest part of the municipal taxes are paid by the Chinese , by whose capital has been created the present beautiful city. At their expenses the city lives to-day. The foreigners are immensely afraid not only of the Chinese mob, but of Chinese in general and outside business dealings they have no connections with them at all. The foreign residents are isolated from the native population by warships, aeroplanes and troops. And in their everyday dealings with the Chinese they are given to understand and to feel that they are an "inferior race" which has not yet secured the blessings of culture and civilisation. Chinese are not admitted into foreign clubs public baths, Chinese children are being taught separately from the whites. Sick Chinese are being treated in special hospitals. All municipal affairs are decided upon by the Municipal Council elected exclusively by foreigners and not one Chinese can be admitted there. Naturally all municipal offices, as well as orders and works, are being given to foreigners. It is only natural that the Municipal Council pays very little attention to the needs of the Chinese population. Numerous sumptuous hospitals were erected for the benefit of the 30.000 foreigners, while the Chinese population deteriorated from various sorts of sickness for want of the necessary medical assistance, is left to the mercy of sorcerers, enchanters and conjurers. For the benefit of a small number of foreign children there have been erected spacious school-palaces, while millions of Chinese children remain ignorant, savage, uncultured. The police, in the first instance, serves the interests of the foreigners, leaving the Chinese population to the terrorism of bands of robbers and burglars, whose ranks are increasing immensely in number. Probably there is not a single city in the whole world which could surpass Shanghai by a number and variety of crimes and probably there is not one city, where the criminal elements lead such an easy and plentiful life as in Shanghai.

The struggle for equality has been going on from long time. It has acquired an especially intensive character after the well known shooting of peaceful students demonstrating on Nanking Road in Shanghai on May 30, 1925. The boycott declared by the Chinese paralysed the whole domestic, social, commercial and industrial life. The foreigners very soon understood that the Chinese, deprived though they have been of all rights, not enjoying any privileges, paying all taxes and suffering all sorts of humiliation, are practically masters of the city holding its life in their hands.

The foreigners, not accustomed to work, dreadfully frightened, dumbfounded by the redoubtable and unanimous cry of indignation of the Chinese population, trembling for their life and property, quickly

“克拉斯诺耶·兹纳米亚”报
（《红旗》）
符拉迪沃斯托克，1925年5月17日。

胜利中的失败。

众所周知，在上海公园的入口处，张贴着管理公共娱乐场所使用的规章，其中一条写道：“华人与狗不得入内”。这条规定早在上海落入外国帝国主义者之手的那一刻起，就装饰着这个地方。几乎与此同时，中国人或多或少一直在抗议这种将华人与狗相提并论的做法。即使在上海这个东方帝国主义势力的堡垒，在那里，奴役者的意志是通过武装的无情力量强加的，即使在这里，这样的招牌似乎也显得格格不入且过时了。

上海主要居住着中国人。那里有三万外国人，而中国人约有二百万。市政税的大部分是由中国人缴纳的，正是依靠他们的资本才建立了如今这座美丽的城市。这座城市今天靠他们的费用维持生活。外国人不仅害怕中国民众，而且普遍害怕中国人，除了商业交易外，他们与中国人没有任何联系。外国居民通过军舰、飞机和军队与当地人口隔离开来。在日常与中国人打交道时，他们让中国人明白并感觉到自己是一个“劣等种族”，尚未获得文化和文明的福祉。中国人不被允许进入外国俱乐部和公共浴室，中国儿童与白人分开受教育。生病的中国人在专门的医院接受治疗。所有市政事务均由完全由外国人选举产生的工部局决定，没有一个中国人能进入其中。自然，所有的市政职位以及订单和工程都交给外国人。工部局很少关注中国人口的需求，这是很自然的。为三万外国人的利益建造了许多豪华医院，而中国人口因缺乏必要的医疗援助，受各种疾病折磨，只能听凭巫师、术士和骗子的摆布。为少数外国儿童的利益建造了宽敞的学校宫殿，而数百万中国儿童仍然无知、野蛮、未开化。警察首先服务于外国人的利益，将中国人口留给强盗和窃贼团伙的恐怖统治，这些团伙的人数急剧增加。也许全世界没有哪座城市在犯罪数量和种类上能超过上海，也许也没有哪座城市的犯罪元素能像在上海这样过着如此轻松和富足的生活。

争取平等的斗争已持续很长时间。在1925年5月30日上海南京路和平示威的学生遭到枪击这一著名事件之后，这场斗争变得尤为激烈。中国人宣布的抵制运动使整个国内、社会、商业和工业生活陷入瘫痪。外国人很快意识到，尽管被剥夺了所有权利，不享有任何特权，缴纳所有税款并遭受各种羞辱，但中国人实际上是这座城市的主人，掌握着城市的命脉。

外国人不习惯工作，被中国人民可怕而一致的愤怒呼声吓得目瞪口呆，为他们的生命和财产颤抖，迅速

began to make concessions and proposed to give Chinese three seats
at the S.M.C. However the Chinese rejected with indignation this sop,
insisting on representation proportional to population and amount
of taxes paid. Simultaneously they put forward demands that the
parks and other places of public recreation should be thrown open to
Chinese, equalisation of their rights with those of foreigners etc.

The events that followed up, the victorious march of the southern
troops from south to the north, the rise of the nationalist
and revolutionary movement, - all these facts have removed demands
of the Chinese community in Shanghai on the second round. The whole
problem was shifted into another sphere, especially after the
concession of Hankow had been seized and the famous "Chen - O'Malley"
agreement had been signed, according to which Great Britain
"gave back" the concessions in Hankow to China. The problem faced
now by foreigners was not to granting to Chinese such and such
rights, not to throwing open for them the public parks, not of pro-
portional representation, but to returning to China all settlements
and concessions, the cancellation of treaties, the abolition of
extraterritoriality.

The seizure of the British concessions at Hankow and Kiukiang,
the occupation by nationalist troops of Nanking and Shanghai, these
events of the last year created a panic among the foreign colony
and emboldened the Chinese to a new struggle. Shanghai residents
raised a wall, demanding that their governments should intervene,
the bribed scribblers filled columns of the yellow capitalistic
press with idle stories about mass violences and tortures committed
with regard to foreigners, and in unison they demanded the despatch
of troops, warships and destroyers. The municipal council, the
various foreign organisations, the Chambers of Commerce, societies
and clubs passed dozens of resolutions about the impending danger,
about the devastations created by the southern troops. Martial law
was proclaimed, streets were barred, trenches and armoured cars
appeared at the corners, the city was entangled with barbed wire
and troops of all the "Great" powers were patrolling the city.

In spite of this, however, the Chinese for some time more con-
tinued to struggle. Chiang Kai Shek's coup d'etat to national
aspirations and to the struggle for independence was a more severe
blow than all foreign warships and aeroplanes put together could
have done.** Instead of the broad slogans of struggle against
imperialism, foreign oppression, unequal treaties, restoration of
concessions, the Kuomintang put forward the slogan of a struggle
for a reduction of the municipal taxes.

The fact is that the S.M.C. backed by 40.000 strong army of
well armed and perfectly supplied soldiers, has increased the
municipal taxes without, of course, asking consent from the Chinese
ratepayers, to cover expenses incurred by the war situation and
the ██████ presence of the large number of troops. Chinese rate-
payers have started an extensive movement against the taxes. During
the campaign which followed all old-timed offences deeply hidden
in the Chinese soul have been called to mind. In proclamations, at
the meetings much has been said about the "glorious" inscription
"entrance prohibited to Chinese and dogs", about violence, savagery
and roughness of the foreign soldiers who were supposed to come
for the defence of "law and order", about the absence of Chinese
representatives at the S.M.O. etc. But Chiang Kai Shek's betrayal
cut off the wings of this movement.

Foreign residents and the S.M.C., supported, on the one side,
by the Consuls and armed forces of the imperialistic powers, and,
on the other, by the Kuomintang, who went over to the reactionaries,
put up the challenge. A war ensued which lasted more than three months
pages.zh:
-2-

开始做出让步，提议在工部局（S.M.C.）中给中国人三个席位。然而，中国人愤怒地拒绝了这种小恩小惠，坚持要求代表权应与人口数量和纳税额成比例。同时，他们提出要求，公园和其他公共娱乐场所应向中国人开放，他们的权利应与外国人平等等等。

随后发生的事件，南方军队从南向北的胜利进军，民族主义和革命运动的兴起——所有这些事实将上海华人社区的要求推向了第二轮。整个问题转移到了另一个领域，特别是在汉口租界被收回以及著名的“陈-奥马利”协定签署之后，根据该协定，英国将汉口租界“归还”给中国。外国人现在面临的问题不是给予中国人这样或那样的权利，不是向他们开放公共公园，也不是按比例代表制，而是向中国归还所有租界和租借地，废除条约，取消治外法权。

去年发生的汉口和九江英国租界被占领、民族主义军队占领南京和上海等事件，在外侨中造成了恐慌，并鼓舞中国人进行新的斗争。上海居民筑起了一道墙，要求他们的政府进行干预，被收买的文人在黄色资本主义报刊的专栏里填满了关于对外国人实施大规模暴力和酷刑的空洞故事，并异口同声地要求派遣军队、军舰和驱逐舰。工部局、各种外国组织、商会、社团和俱乐部通过了数十项关于迫在眉睫的危险以及南方军队造成的破坏的决议。宣布戒严，街道被封锁，街角出现了战壕和装甲车，城市被铁丝网缠绕，所有“大”国的军队在城市中巡逻。

尽管如此，中国人在一段时间内继续斗争。蒋介石对民族愿望和独立斗争的政变，比所有外国军舰和飞机加在一起所能造成的打击更为严重。**国民党没有提出反对帝国主义、反对外国压迫、反对不平等条约、收回租界的广泛口号，而是提出了争取减少市政税的口号。

事实是，工部局（S.M.C.）在四万名装备精良、补给充足的军队支持下，未经中国纳税人同意，当然，为了支付战争局势和 ██████ 大量军队驻扎所产生的费用，增加了市政税。中国纳税人发起了一场广泛的抗税运动。在随后的运动中，深藏在中国人灵魂中的所有旧怨都被重新提起。在宣言中和集会上，人们多次谈到那块“光荣”的牌匾“华人与狗不得入内”，谈到那些 supposedly 来维护“法律与秩序”的外国士兵的暴力、野蛮和粗暴，谈到工部局（S.M.O.，原文如此，应为S.M.C.）中没有中国代表等。但蒋介石的背叛折断了这场运动的翅膀。

外国居民和工部局，一方面得到领事馆和帝国主义列强武装力量的支持，另一方面得到转向反动派的国民党的支持，发起了挑战。随之而来的是一场持续了三个多月的战争

months and ended in a Chinese defeat. The authorities did not hesit
in choosing means. Chinese banks and enterprises were left without po
ce protection; Chinese dealers in quick spoiling goods were closed;
at night time passengers were expelled from Chinese hotels; the sup-
ply of water was cut off from Chinese houses; printing offices of
Chinese newspapers were deprived of electricity. The Chinese for a
long time and in vain waited for help from the Kuomintang and the
Nanking government. By this time the Kuomintang was breaking off
last threads which tied them with the revolutionary traditions and
enticed frolic with imperialists. The Kuomintang leaders began to
fear every mass movement and revolutionary forward movement. More than
everything else they feared joining the movement by the Shanghai
workers. That is why both the government and the Kuomintang tried by
all means to frustrate the progress of the movement and when, despite
their efforts, it began to develop they prohibited it. Chinese have
suffered the severest defeat. The taxes were paid, the demands
forgotten, as for the Municipal Council they confined themselves with
promising to consider, in the future, the question of the Chinese
participation in the government of the city.

More than half a year has elapsed. The Chinese nationalists have
stepped out on the road of reaction and terrorism and in this field
they have broken all records and over-reached their teachers.
Friendly relations have been established between the Kuomintang and
imperialists, each side seeking for an opportunity to prove its
friendship and good dispositions. For this purpose mutual concessions
were made in order to consolidate the reign of foreigners in China,
who at present are consenting to share with the Chinese the authority
power and revenue and conjointly to oppress and exploit Chinese
people.

And as soon as the Kuomintang had changed its stakes, the
imperialists have adopted new tactics. From now on they are endeavour-
ing to cultivate friendship with the Chinese bourgeoisie and intelli-
gentia, to share with them the authority. Imperialists realize that
it would be more profitable to deal with China divided and devoured
by class struggle rather than to contribute, by a provocative attitude
towards the unification of China.

A few months ago at the initiative of the municipal council,
directed by British policy in Shanghai, negotiations began with the
Chinese Chambers of Commerce. They resulted in a decision to intro-
duce Chinese into the municipal government by giving them three
places at the S.M.C. and six at various committees and to throw open
the parks and other places of public recreation. The Chinese bourgeoi-
sie left out their former demands and max accepted this sop.

Some time ago the annual ratepayers meeting was held by which
these negotiations should have been approved before being put into
force. The meeting was preceded by a furious controversy in the
columns of the local press. The residents, from various points of
view, argued on the impossibility of admitting Chinese into the
public parks. "If they need them, let the M.Council make special
parks for Chinese". With great passion British residents argued that,
if the parks are open to Chinese, Shanghai morals will suffer, foreig-
ners will be infected with various contagious diseases, women will
be faced with insults by unrestrained Chinese gallants, the alleys
and roads will be besmirched and music profaned. In short life
would become impossible for a foreigner.

Nevertheless these tears were shed in vain. The word had gone
from above to make concessions to Chinese, to prove the "sincerity"
of the new course of British policy". The municipal authorities, the
British Consulate and the militant organ of the British imperialism
the "North China Daily News", all fought for Chinese admission into
the parks. Their reasoning was very primitive. The Chinese, they said,
pages.zh:

并以中国的失败告终。当局在选择手段时毫不犹豫。中国银行和企业失去了警
察保护；经营易腐商品的中国商人被勒令停业；夜间，中国旅馆的乘客被驱逐出
去；中国住户的水源被切断；中国报社的印刷厂被切断电力供应。中国人长期徒
劳地等待国民党和南京政府的帮助。此时，国民党正在切断与革命传统联系的最后
纽带，并与帝国主义者调情嬉闹。国民党领导人开始害怕任何群众运动和革命向前
发展。他们最害怕的是上海工人加入运动。这就是为什么政府和国民党试图千方百
计挫败运动的进展，当尽管他们努力阻止，运动仍开始发展时，他们便予以禁止。
中国人遭受了最严重的失败。税款照缴，要求被遗忘，至于工部局，他们仅限于承
诺将来考虑中国人参与城市管理的问题。

半年多过去了。中国民族主义者走上了反动和恐怖主义的道路，在这一领域，
他们打破了所有记录，甚至超过了他们的老师。国民党与帝国主义者之间建立了友
好关系，双方都寻求机会证明其友谊和善意。为此，双方相互做出让步，以巩固外
国人在中国的统治，目前外国人同意与中国人分享权力、权威和收入，并共同压迫
和剥削中国人民。

一旦国民党改变了赌注，帝国主义者便采取了新策略。从现在起，他们致力于
培养与中国资产阶级和知识分子（intelligentia，原文如此）的友谊，并与他们分
享权力。帝国主义者认识到，与通过挑衅态度阻碍中国统一相比，与一个因阶级斗
争而分裂和被吞噬的中国打交道更有利可图。

几个月前，在受英国在上海政策指导的工部局的倡议下，开始与中国商会进
行谈判。结果决定通过给予工部局（S.M.C.）三个席位和各委员会六个席位的方式，
让中国人进入市政府，并向中国人开放公园和其他公共娱乐场所。中国资产阶级放
弃了他们以前的要求，欣然接受了这种小恩小惠。

不久前举行了年度纳税人会议，这些谈判本应在生效前获得批准。会议之前，
当地报刊专栏展开了激烈的争论。居民们从各种角度论证了允许中国人进入公共公
园的不可能性。“如果他们需要公园，让工部局为中国人生建专门的公园”。英国居
民激情澎湃地争辩说，如果公园向中国人开放，上海的道德将受到损害，外国人将
感染各种传染病，妇女将面临放纵的中国纨绔子弟的侮辱，小巷和道路将被弄脏，
音乐将被亵渎。简而言之，外国人的生活将变得不可能。

然而，这些眼泪白流了。上层已下达指令，要向中国人做出让步，以证明英
国政策新路线的“诚意”。市政当局、英国领事馆以及英国帝国主义的战斗机关《字
林西报》，都为允许中国人进入公园而奔走。他们的推理非常原始。他们说，中国人，

pages.en:
-4-

for some time past have been behaving themselves well and in any case
better that it could have been expected from the Kuomintang. For this
they must be rewarded. Better to give them this concession rather
than wait until they fight out this right. Besides, it is necessary
to remove all those trifling things of every day life which irritate
Chinese calling to their mind their inferiority. At the meeting the
question was decided xxxx in the affirmative.

At present the Chinese are permitted to use the public parks
which are situated on Chinese soil, created by the sweat and labour
of Chinese coolies and seized by imperialists. The inscription which
has now become historic, "Entrance to Chinese and dogs prohibited"
will, probably be also removed. Chinese representatives will sit
together with the white usurpers and decide on municipal affairs.

It would seem, at a first glance, that the Chinese have scored a
victory and that the imperialists have made big concessions. However
this is not the case. We shall not deal with the reservations of three
seats for Chinese at the Municipal Council and six at the committees -
it is far away from the demand for proportional representation, or
that at the last moment the ratepayers together with the Chinese
bourgeoisie have limited admission into the parks only to those who
are "decently dressed" and who can pay an entrance fee, - all they
are trifles. Far more important is the fact that after the sop thrown
by the imperialists and so greedily taken up by the Chinese bourgeoisie
and the Kuomintang, all talk about the struggle for the restoration
of the Shanghai concession, abolition of extraterritoriality, have
been stopped. The Chinese bourgeoisie has already understood it and
timidly begins express in the press its hope thatxx "the nationalist
government will not abandon the struggle xxxxxxxxfornx against the
foreign oppressors and would carry on the fight, certainly not with
the communistic methods, but by diplomatic channels". But these are
rare voices. In a mass Chinese bourgeoisie and the Kuomintang are
very satisfied with the results of 65 years struggle for Chinese
equality in Shanghai.

Every day the Kuomintang are going astray from their original
slogans, are surrendering one position after another, and together
with the imperialists they are intensifying class divisions and
class struggle. The Chinese proletariat, especially the Shanghai one,
under the severe blows delivered by its own suppressors and the not
less severe blows from the foreign exploiters, are learning the idea
that they have nothing in common with the bourgeoisie, the struggle
with which will continue to the last drop of blood.-

在过去一段时间里表现良好，无论如何，其表现优于人们对国民党所预期的水平。对此必须给予奖励。与其等待他们通过斗争来争取这一权利，不如主动给予这项让步。此外，有必要消除日常生活中那些令中国人感到恼火、提醒他们自身地位低下的琐碎事项。在会议上，该问题被决定为肯定（xxxx 原文不清）。

目前，中国人被允许使用位于中国土地上的公共公园，这些公园是由中国苦力的血汗创建并被帝国主义者攫取的。那块如今已成为历史铭文的“华人与狗不得入内”标牌，可能也将被移除。中国代表将与白人篡权者坐在一起，共同决定市政事务。

乍看之下，似乎中国人取得了胜利，而帝国主义者做出了重大让步。然而事实并非如此。我们暂且不谈在市议会中为中国保留三个席位以及在委员会中保留六个席位的问题——这远未达到按比例代表制的要求；也不谈在最后时刻，纳税人连同中国资产阶级将进入公园的权利仅限于那些“衣着得体”且能支付入场费的人——这些都是琐事。更为重要的是，在帝国主义者抛出诱饵，而中国资产阶级和国民党贪婪地接受之后，所有关于恢复上海租界、废除治外法权的斗争言论都已停止。中国资产阶级已经明白了这一点，并开始怯懦地在报刊上表达其希望，即xx“国民政府不会放弃对抗外国压迫者的斗争xxx xxxxxfornx，并将继续战斗，当然不是采用共产主义的方法，而是通过外交渠道”。但这些声音寥寥无几。绝大多数中国资产阶级和国民党对经过65年争取在上海的中国人平等地位所取得的成果感到非常满意。

国民党每天都在背离其最初的口号，一个接一个地放弃阵地，并与帝国主义者一起加剧阶级分化和阶级斗争。中国无产阶级，尤其是上海无产阶级，在遭受本国镇压者的沉重打击以及外国剥削者同样严厉的打击下，逐渐认识到他们与资产阶级没有任何共同之处，与资产阶级的斗争将持续到流尽最后一滴血。-

pages.en:
"Krasnoe Znamia"
(Red Banner)
Vladivostock, June 19, 1928.

（印：SHANGHAI M.C.P. POLICE. C.I.D. REGISTRY No 10 9199 Date.... 28 . 6 . 28）

Meaning of the victory of Kuomintans.

The question who will win the war in China, the Ankuochun of the Kucmintang, has at last been solved. Yen Hsi Shan's troops, as the latest telegrams report, have occupied Peking. The Northern Expedition is therefore approaching its end. It is true there remains yet the Manchurian question, but according to latest advices this question also will be settled in the course of the few next days.

The Kuomintang Generals explain the situation in Manchuria as follows: The Fengtien army surrenders, therefore there is nobody to be pursued, besides it is not safe to show one's nose into it as nobody knows how it may be looked upon by some countries, so there would be no end of troubles. Therefore a simple solution of this problem presents itself to the Kuomintang leaders: Chang Tso Ling (who is already dead or dying) is removed from political life and his successor must be a partisan of the "Three Principles", the Kuomintang flag will be hoisted everywhere in Manchuria.

And that is all !

Such an issue is not a casual one. It is intimately connected with the future course to be followed by the southern■■ Government and shows what this course will be like. The principle of federalism has triumphed. China under the Kuomintang flag absolutely will not differ from the China prior to the northern expedition. There will reign in each province, as before, a General pursuing a policy of his own, his ambition, his aspirations to extend his rule over the whole of China. These independent rulers will, as before, unite themselves in a militarist group and will continue to fight one another, each claiming the right to dominant role in China.
pages.zh:
《红旗》
(Red Banner)
符拉迪沃斯托克，1928年6月19日。

（印：上海工部局警务处。刑事调查处登记号 10 9199 日期.... 28 . 6 . 28）

国民党胜利的意义。

谁将在中国的战争中获胜，是安国军还是国民党，这个问题最终得到了解决。据最新电报报道，阎锡山的部队已占领北京。因此，北伐即将结束。诚然，满洲问题尚存，但根据最新消息，这一问题也将在未来几天内得到解决。

国民党将领对满洲局势的解释如下：奉系军队投降，因此无人可追；此外，涉足其中并不安全，因为不知某些国家会如何看待此举，从而引发无尽的麻烦。因此，国民党领导人对此问题的解决方案很简单：张作霖（已死或垂死）退出政治舞台，其继任者必须是“三民主义”的支持者，满洲各地将悬挂国民党旗帜。

仅此而已！

这样的结果并非偶然。它与南方■■政府未来的走向密切相关，并显示了这一走向将是怎样的。联邦主义原则取得了胜利。在国民党旗帜下的中国与北伐前的中国绝对没有区别。各省仍将像以前一样，由一位将军统治，推行其自己的政策，怀有其野心及其将统治扩展至全中国的愿望。这些独立的统治者将像以前一样结成军阀集团，并继续相互争斗，各自声称拥有在中国占据主导地位的权利。

pages.en:
-2-

All this is quite clear and natural. Long before the souther-
ners occupied Peking, there was a story in circulation full of
meaning: A prominent political leader was once asked : "What will
happen if the scutherners are defeated and fail to occupy Peking" ?
-"Chaos will prevail" was the reply. "And what will happen if they
take Peking "? - Chaos will prevail also".

True ¶ In either case chaos is unavoidable - as unavoidable as
civil wars among Generals and separate militarist groups. So it may
be taken as definitely established fact that all present talk among
the Kuomintang leaders, who have betrayed Sun Yat Sen's will, about
the Chinese revolution, the unification of China, the struggle
against foreigners and such-like good things is an impudent lie
and deceit. As we see it, the unification of China is out of ques-
tion. As for the Kuomintang Generals, they are being openly taxed
as the loyal creatures of such a one or the other of the foreign
powers.

A similar fate has befallen the other slogans of the northern
expedition, especially the social slogans. To the question, what
has been gained by the Chinese toiling masses through Chang Tso
Ling's expulsion from Peking and the establishment of the Kuomintang
authority, there can be only one answer - absolutely nothing !

The Kuomintang at the present time is an unveiled counter-revo-
lutionary force. Their aspirations are absolutely clear: unmerciful
suppression of peasants, a decisive struggle against revolutionary
tendencies in the country and against the labour movement: a rope
or a bullet to a communist.

The substitution of the old authority by a new one will bring
about nothing new. White terrorism will continue, the counter-revo-
lutionary tendencies of the leaders will subsist. However it may be,
the destruction of Chang Tso Ling as a reactionary force will bring
to the Chinese revolution substantial help, it is the commence of
a process to increase the revolutionary forces, it will begin a gra-
dual extension of its influence from south to north.

Probability is not at all excluded that the forces disengaged
pages.zh:

这一切都非常清楚且自然。早在南方人占领北京之前，就流传着一个充满深意的故事：有人曾问一位 prominent political leader（重要政治领袖）：“如果南方人战败且未能占领北京，会发生什么？”回答是：“混乱将盛行。”“那如果他们占领了北京呢？”——“混乱仍将盛行”。

确实 ¶ 无论哪种情况，混乱都是不可避免的——正如将军们和各派军阀之间的内战不可避免一样。因此，可以将其视为既定的事实：国民党领导人所有关于中国革命、中国统一、反对外国人等美好事物的言论，都是背叛孙中山遗愿的无耻谎言和欺骗。在我们看来，中国的统一是不可能的。至于国民党将领，他们被公开指责为这样或那样外国势力的忠实走狗。

北伐的其他口号，特别是社会口号，也遭遇了类似的命运。对于中国劳苦大众通过驱逐张作霖出北京和建立国民党权威获得了什么这一问题，只有一个答案——绝对一无所获！

国民党目前是一支不加掩饰的反革命力量。他们的企图非常明确：无情镇压农民，坚决反对国内的革命倾向和劳工运动：对共产党员处以绞刑或枪决。

用新政权取代旧政权不会带来任何新事物。白色恐怖将继续，领导层的反革命倾向将持续存在。无论如何，作为反动势力的张作霖的覆灭将给中国革命带来实质性的帮助，这是革命力量增长过程的开始，其影响力将从南方向北方逐渐扩展。

完全不能排除现在北方前线脱身的部队

The Chinese "9 of January" .

On May 30, 1925, a painful drama was enacted in the main street of Shanghai (Nanking Road) the participants in which were, on the one side, workers and students who had risen against the slave-like conditions of labour, against the daily increasing insolent oppression on the part of all kinds of militarists, and on the other side, the dogs of British imperialism - the British police.

The unarmed demonstration, after a peremptory refusal to obey the order to disperse, was fired upon by the British Police. 6 men were killed on the spot, several wounded and 120 were arrested.

The date of May 30 in Shanghai was preceded by a number of events, testifying to the increase in the anti-imperialistic movement throughout China, the development of the strike movement which culminated in the seizure of the factories and mills by the workers (May 25 at Tsingtao), the revolutionary ferment among the peasant masses.

It was evident that the shooting of the peaceful demonstrators in Shanghai could not decide the issue of the struggle desired by the imperialists, because the events of May 30 had definitely turned this national-liberation movement into a real revolutionary class struggle.

The blood of those who perished on Nanking Road did not bring confusion into the ranks of the fighting proletariat of Shanghai, on the contrary it soldered the working masses who in a few days had organised a huge General strike involving about 300.000 men.

On May 30 the working class, holding the banner of class struggle, replaced the national-liberation movement. The international plunderers, masters of the political situation in China, thus came face to face with their class enemy in one of the brightest and most congested streets of Shanghai. The political barometer showed clearly to the

符拉迪沃斯托克，1928年5月30日。

（印：上海工部局警务处。刑事调查处登记号 10 9199 日期 1928年6月13日）

中国的“一月九日”。

1925年5月30日，在上海的主要街道（南京路）上演了一出悲惨的戏剧，参与者一方是反抗奴隶般劳动条件、反抗各类军阀日益猖狂压迫的工人和学生，另一方是英帝国主义的走狗——英国警察。

在断然拒绝服从解散命令后，手无寸铁的示威队伍遭到英国警察开枪射击。6人当场死亡，数人受伤，120人被捕。

上海的5月30日之前发生了一系列事件，证明了中国各地反帝国主义运动的高涨，罢工运动的发展在工人占领工厂和纱厂时达到顶峰（5月25日在青岛），以及农民群众中的革命骚动。

显然，在上海枪杀和平示威者并不能决定帝国主义者所希望的斗争结果，因为5月30日的事件已明确地将这场民族解放运动转变为真正的革命阶级斗争。

在南京路上牺牲者的鲜血并没有使上海战斗无产阶级的队伍陷入混乱，相反，它凝聚了劳工大众，他们在几天内组织了一场涉及约30万人的大规模总罢工。

5月30日，工人阶级高举阶级斗争的旗帜，取代了民族解放运动。中国的国际掠夺者、中国政治局势的主宰者，从而在上海最明亮、最拥挤的街道上之一直面他们的阶级敌人。政治气压计清晰地向

pages.en:
-2-
foreigner, who was busy with plundering, the indications of a strike
movement and the organisation of revolutionary Trade Unions. The ranks
of the new fighters were clear, the general liberation slogansxxx
were removed to the background and on the banners of the proletariat
who had risen in revolt were traced out, with the blood of the Shanghai
victims, the slogans: "Down with imperialists" and "Death to capitalists".
The Shanghai workers in participating in the nationalist-leberation
movement, put forward, in addition to the demands in the retrocession
of the concessions, the abolition of extraterritoriality and the
withdrawal of privileges to foreigners, demands to the recognition
of Trade Unions, increase in wages, betterment of the general conditions
of labour and the abolition of corporal punishment.
Faced with these demands the Chinese bourgeoisie, who had formerly
supported the nationalist movement (in the merchants and banks strike
etc.), gave up playing at revolution and entered into an agreement
with imperialists, to whom they were bound by strong ties of plunder.
With the departure of the big bourgeois class, the role of the
labour class became more clearly outlined as a leader and organiser of
the national-lineration movement in which the classes of the petty
bourgeoisie and intelligentsia were still mixed up under the Kuomintang
banner.
It was the name of Chiang Kai Shek, the treachery of Kuomintang,
the flood of blood shed by the best elements of the revolution - nu -
merous members of the Chinese communist party - that finally contributed
towards the accomplishment of a decisive separation of the class forces
the main outline of which had already been drawn up Shanghai on May 30
1925.
The only companion of the Chinese proletariat - the Chinese peasant -
in the battles with militarists, landowners and imperialists, has
acquired some idea of the revolutionary Truth,which has given him a
clear cut image of his real class enemy in the shape of the gentry,
the usurers, the landowners.

忙于掠夺的外国人显示了罢工运动和革命工会组织的迹象。新战士的队伍界限分明，一般的解放口号xxx退居次要地位，而在起义无产阶级的旗帜上，用上海受害者的鲜血写上了口号：“打倒帝国主义者”和“资本家去死”。上海工人在参与民族解放运动时，除了提出收回租界、废除治外法权和取消外国人特权的要求外，还提出了承认工会、增加工资、改善总体劳动条件和废除体罚的要求。
面对这些要求，曾经支持民族运动的中国资产阶级（在商人和银行家罢工等事件中）放弃了革命游戏，并与与他们有着牢固掠夺纽带的帝国主义者达成协议。随着大资产阶级的离去，工人阶级作为民族解放运动的领导者和组织者的角色变得更加清晰，在该运动中，小资产阶级和知识分子阶层仍然混杂在国民党旗帜下。
正是蒋介石的名字、国民党的背叛、革命优秀分子——众多中国共产党党员——所流的鲜血，最终促成了阶级力量的决定性分离，其主要轮廓已于1925年5月30日在上海勾勒出来。
中国无产阶级在与军阀、地主和帝国主义者的战斗中唯一的伙伴——中国农民——获得了一些关于革命真理的概念，这使他清晰地看到了以绅士、高利贷者、地主形式出现的真正阶级敌人形象。

"I z v i e s t i a".
Moscow, May 13, 1928.

Amannulah-Khan's visit to England.

The Royal trip of the Faghan King Amannulah has aroused keen interest in social and political circles throughout the world.

The strategical peculiarity of the geographical position of this country in the past has been more than once a topic of discussion at the moment when the question of intervention in U.S.S.R. and the possibility of utilising for this purpose its south-eastern frontier. Long before King Amannulah's voyage the world press, commenting on a war which the U.S.S.R., it is supposed, will have with the prospective opponents, has discussed the chances of both sides from the standpoint of the possibility of either side considering Afghanistan as an ally.

It was therefore a matter of course that in the long list, drawn up by the King of Afghanistan, of the countries which he had to pay a visit, Britain and U.S.S.R. held the top place. The people of Afghanistan in the past had an opportunity to demonstrate how successfully they could defend their political independence. The British official and semi-official press might well try to make the "public opinion" believe that the independence of Afghanistan is nothing but a result of the humanity displayed by the British Empire towards the Afghan people, but it is an open secret that the position which Afghanistan occupies now has been attained only by force of arms. Even such a servant of the British Imperialist policy in the Far East as the newspaper "Near East" was obliged to admit that the "success of the national liberation movement in Afghanistan was due to a political situation created in the territory of the former Tzarist Russia". As regards the other factors which have largely contributed towards the independence of Afghanistan, they are well known. The victorious war of the Afghan people
