《消息报》。
莫斯科，1928年5月13日。

阿曼努拉汗访问英国。

阿富汗国王阿曼努拉的皇家之旅引起了全世界社会和政治界的浓厚兴趣。

该国地理位置的战略特殊性在过去曾多次成为讨论的话题，尤其是在涉及干涉苏联以及利用其东南边境进行此类行动的可能性的时候。早在阿曼努拉国王出访之前，世界舆论在评论据称苏联将与潜在对手发生的战争时，就从双方是否可能将阿富汗视为盟友的角度讨论了双方的胜算。

因此，在阿富汗国王拟定的必访国家名单中，英国和苏联位居前列，这是理所当然的事。阿富汗人民在过去曾有机会展示他们如何成功地捍卫自己的政治独立。英国官方和半官方媒体或许会试图让“公众舆论”相信，阿富汗的独立不过是英帝国对阿富汗人民展现人道主义的结果，但这已是一个公开的秘密：阿富汗目前所处的地位完全是靠武力取得的。即便是像《近东》这样服务于英国远东帝国主义政策的报纸，也不得不承认，“阿富汗民族解放运动的成功是由于在前沙皇俄国领土上形成的政治局势所致”。至于其他在很大程度上促成阿富汗独立的因素，则众所周知。阿富汗人民的胜利战争

pages.en:
against Indian hirelings of the British imperialism, which ended
in the British-Afghan Treaty of 1921, has conclusively demonstrated
to the British Government the futility of any attempt to turn
Afghan territory into a "passage" for the troops of the British
Empire to pass through.

Taken conjointly with this the friendly visit paid by King
Amannulah to Britain and his almost round the world trip including
the visit to the u.s.s.r. is of a special interest.

The British press, which for a long period has been engaged in ✱
impressing upon the minds of the readers that Afghanistan is merely
an object of armed colonisation, is now confronted with a difficult
problem. The British newspapers have to prepare "public opinion"
by arguing it to believing the immensely important military, poli-
tical and economic consequences of this visit. The main difficulty
in the situation was that the head of the Afghan state had to appear
in England not as a humble vassal but as an equal sovereign, whose
decisions may greatly embarrass Britain's anti-soviet policy in
the Middle East.

Shortly before the arrival of the King of Afghan in London, a
conference to discuss Indian and Afghanistan matters was held in a
fashionable club the "East India Association". This conference which
gives a perfectly true reflection of the frame of mind of the Bri-
tish statesmen responsible for British imperialistic policy in the
Middle East, was attended by persons who, in the past, had filled
prominent administrative posts in India and were very closely
interested in the "Afghan question". The principal address was deli-
vered by General McMann, who played a leading part in several milita-
ry expeditions at the Afghan frontier, including that of 1897-1898.
The spokesman admitted that it was only a short while ago that
Britain had abandoned her previous attitude of regarding Afghanistan
as one of her strategical points. Another of his statements is also
worth mentioning namely that "until the death of the father of the
present Afghan ruler - King Habibullah, Afghanistan has remained such
as we had wished it to be". The experts on "Afghan matters" who
pages.zh:
反对英国帝国主义的印度雇佣军，这场战争以1921年英阿条约的签订而告终，向英国政府确凿地证明了任何企图将阿富汗领土变为英帝国军队通过之“通道”的做法都是徒劳的。

结合这一点来看，阿曼努拉国王对英国的友好访问以及他几乎环游世界的行程（包括访问苏联），具有特殊的意义。

长期以来一直致力于向读者灌输“阿富汗仅仅是武装殖民对象”这一观念的英国新闻界，现在面临着一个难题。英国报纸必须通过论证此次访问在军事、政治和经济方面极其重要的后果，来引导“公众舆论”。局势的主要困难在于，阿富汗国家元首出现在英国时，并非以卑微附庸的身份，而是以平等主权者的身份，其决定可能会极大地使英国在中东的反苏政策陷入困境。

在阿富汗国王抵达伦敦前不久，一场讨论印度和阿富汗事务的会议在一家名为“东印度协会”的时尚俱乐部举行。这次会议完全真实地反映了负责英国中东帝国主义政策的英国政治家们的心态，与会者包括过去曾在印度担任重要行政职务并对“阿富汗问题”非常感兴趣的人士。主旨演讲由麦克曼将军发表，他曾多次参与阿富汗边境的军事远征，包括1897-1898年的那次。这位发言人承认，英国就在不久前才放弃了此前将阿富汗视为其战略据点之一的态度。他的另一项声明也值得一提，即“在现任阿富汗统治者之父——哈比布拉国王去世之前，阿富汗一直保持着我们所希望的状态”。那些

pages.en:
also took part in the deliberations, expounded principally on the
role Afghanistan played in the world war and they made a few intere-
sting cynical revelations. Sir Lewis Dane, the head of the British
Mission in1905, which had concluded the famous treaty with Emir
Habibullah, stated:"In 1915 Habibullah could achieve a feat which
could leave far behind famous expedition into India by Alexander the
Great. Though greatly tempted the Emir remained loyal to us till
his death. We are greatly indebted to him". The British diplomat
hinted at a possibility which had existed then for the Germans to
use warlike Afghan people to make an attack on India. There is only
one incorrect point in this statement - he was silent about the cau-
ses of Habibullah's loyalty to British imperialism.
We think in unnecessary to say anything about the unceremonious
and clumsy attempts made by the British semi-official press to woo
the king during his stay in England. The attention paid by to King
Amanullah by a large part of the British bourgeois press will remain
unforgotten in the disgraceful history of the British press, as the
best evidence of the remarkable fact that the British lion knows
sometimes how to turn himself into a submissive pup.
"The respect which is now being paid by Britain to Afghanistan -
wrote the "Workers Life, the organ of the British Communist party -
is a respect felt by a bully for the person who had beaten him".
The British House of Commons, for obvious reasons, remained silent on
the subject. Only Saklatvala, the Communist representative, speaking
about the coming visit to London of King Amanullah, declared that
Britain and other countries "are cultivating friendship" with Afgha-
nistan out of common hatred towards the U.S.S.R.".
The King of Afghanistan arrived in England. At the sea shore he
was met by that expert of smart-falling-from-the-horse, heir to
the British Throne, the Prince of Wales. At the London Railway
station he was met by that dumb performer of British imperialism
King George. Here the King of Afghanistan, from the point of view
of court etiquette, was greatly "insulted". The head of the Afghan
pages.zh:
同样参与审议的“阿富汗事务”专家，主要阐述了阿富汗在世界大战中所扮演的角色，并做出了一些有趣且愤世嫉俗的披露。1905年与埃米尔哈比布拉签订著名条约的英国代表团团长刘易斯·丹恩爵士表示：“1915年，哈比布拉本可以成就一番伟业，其成就将远远超过亚历山大大帝进军印度的著名远征。尽管受到巨大诱惑，埃米尔直至去世仍对我们保持忠诚。我们对他深表感激。”这位英国外交官暗示了当时德国人有可能利用好战的阿富汗人民进攻印度。这一陈述中只有一点不正确——他对哈比布拉忠于英国帝国主义的原因缄口不言。
我们认为，无需多言英国半官方媒体在国王访英期间那种无礼且笨拙的讨好企图。英国资产阶级媒体大部分对阿曼努拉国王表现出的关注，将在英国新闻界可耻的历史中留下不可磨灭的痕迹，作为英国狮子有时懂得如何将自己变成顺从的小狗这一显著事实的最佳证据。
“英国现在对阿富汗表示的尊重——”英国共产党机关报《工人生活》写道——“是一个恶霸对被击败者所感到的尊重。”
出于显而易见的原因，英国下议院对此事保持沉默。只有共产党员代表萨克拉特瓦拉在谈到阿曼努拉国王即将访问伦敦时宣称，英国和其他国家与阿富汗“培养友谊”是出于对苏联的共同仇恨。

阿富汗国王抵达英国。在海边迎接他的是那位擅长从马上摔落的专家、英国王位继承人威尔士亲王。在伦敦火车站迎接他的是那位英国帝国主义的哑剧表演者乔治国王。在此，从宫廷礼仪的角度来看，阿富汗国王受到了极大的“侮辱”。阿富汗

pages.en:
people, who during his voyage had learned to respect "etiquette",
kissed the hand of the British Queen. In response to this the
British King limited himself to an official handshake with the
wife of the Afghan Sovereign. "The first gentleman" of Britain,
despite all his regard to the strategical importance of the Afghan
territory, did not condescend to return the courtesy to the wife
of the descendant of his former vassals. The British press, loyal
to the principle of "gentlemanship" tried to convince British
public opinion that the uncourteous action of the British King
was due to his "emotion" caused by the arrival of the "dear guest".
As to Amannullah-Khan he took some precautionary measures
before coming to England. Quite accidentally he left part of his
suite in Paris, including his foreign minister. The official
visit paid to the King by Chamberlain and the canard, let loose
by the official press, about the conclusion of a British-Afghan
military agreement has caused a smile of incredulity on the faces
of the most naive of people. The Britishers took a chance to
demonstrate all the physical force of their imperialistic policy,
the power of their industry, the great extend of their "culture".
Yet King Amannullah during his stay in Britain showed himself
a free man in a "free" country. He emphasized in his official speeches
that he was dealing with representatives of Great Britain as an
equal. As such he has departed therefrom.
The British press followed Amannullah's visit in Britain by
spreading the most absurd rumours about "revolts" in Afghanistan,
refusal of the Afghan King to pay a visit the U.S.S.R..
British hospitality was extended to King Amannulah even during
his visit to the U.S.S.R. A large part of the British press indul-
ged in concocting false reports about a number of "unpleasant inci-
dents" befalling xxxxxxxxxSovietxxxUnionx Amannullah-Khan in the Soviet
Union. The furious spitefulness displayed by the press of British
imperialism corroborates beyond any doubt the fact that from now on
the British policy has to reckon with the existence of an indepen-

Krasnoe Znamia"
(Red Banner)
Vladivostock, July 5, 1925.

Hands off from U.S.S.R.!

Letter of American mariners to Vladivostock workers.

Comrades, workers of Vladivostock !

We, a group of six American mariners, members of the American
Communist Party, have been requested to write an article for the "Krasnoe
Znamia".

After having seen all the achievements accomplished by U.S.S.R.
within the last 10 years and 9 months, we are of the opinion that the
best subject for such an article would be the question of the defense
of U.S.S.R.

We warn you at present more than we have done previously about the
new attack against U.S.S.R., which is being launched by those capitalist
countries which surround you. We clearly understand now the reason for
those formidable military preparations as also for the campaign of anti-
soviet propaganda which is being conducted in America by Morgan, Rockfel-
ler, Dawes, Coolidge and others. This anti-soviet propaganda is gradual-
ly increasing because the situation of the American workers is becoming
worse and worse every day. This is proof of the decay of capitalism
in America and of the ever increasing force of workers and peasants
in U.S.S.R. whose influence upon the poor workers and peasants of America
will undoubtedly succeed in uniting them under the red banner of the
American communist party; under the leadership of the Comintern, in
order to deal a mortal blow both to the capitalists of America and to
those of the whole world.

This explains the reason why thousands of capitalistic newspapers
in America head their articles with clamorous headlines about the
peasants' insurrections in U.S.S.R., about Stalin's move to the right-
to capitalism, about Trotsky defending Leninism, and how everybody
in U.S.S.R. is becoming mad from vodka and how millions of peasants
and workers are at the verge of death from starvation.

And at the present moment, when you are dealing out justice to the
bandits of Donetz Basin, the Wall Street press shouts through its news-
paper headlines about the murders in the land of the Soviets. They have
already forgotten that only the last year they spilt the blood of Sacco
and Vanzetti. To-day American imperialists were screening their enor-
mous military preparations under the plea of preparing a defense
against the attack of red imperialism.

At a time when American capitalistic newspapers are belching
forth such rubbish, rows of starving people can be seen in all the
wealthiest towns of America (in America, according to statistics of the
American Communist Party, there are 5 millions of unemployed) moving
slowly forward to receive a slice of bread. These rows of people, when
looked upon from the roofs of the skyscrapers, which have been construc-
ted by the hands of these same self-starving workers, they resemble long
tiny growing lines. This picture, comrades, remains vividly in our
imagination, and it was only recalled to our mind when comparing
it with the aid which is being rendered to the unemployed in U.S.S.R.

In spite of persecutions and oppressions, to which the American
Communist Party is subjected, the Party continues to lead the great
majority of workers in the bitter struggle against American capitalism.

One of our war slogans is : "Hands off from Republic of labourers
and peasants ! Hands off U.S.S.R. !

We, American mariners, take this occasion in order to propose

《Krasnoe Znamia》
（《红旗报》）
符拉迪沃斯托克，1925年7月5日。

不许干涉苏联！

美国海员致符拉迪沃斯托克工人的信。

同志们，符拉迪沃斯托克的工人们！

我们，六名美国海员，美国共产党党员，受约为《Krasnoe Znamia》撰写一篇文章。

在目睹了苏联在过去十年零九个月里取得的所有成就后，我们认为此类文章的最佳主题应是保卫苏联的问题。

我们要比以往更加严厉地警告你们，那些包围你们的资本主义国家正在对苏联发动新的攻击。我们现在清楚地理解了那些庞大的军事准备的原因，以及摩根（Morgan）、洛克菲勒（Rockefeller）、道威斯（Dawes）、柯立芝（Coolidge）等人在美国进行的反苏宣传运动的原因。这种反苏宣传正逐渐加剧，因为美国工人的处境日益恶化。这证明了美国资本主义的腐朽，以及苏联工农力量的不断增强，其影响力无疑将促使美国的贫困工人和农民在美国共产党的红旗之下团结起来；在共产国际的领导下，给美国乃至全世界的资本家以致命打击。

这就解释了为什么美国成千上万的资本主义报纸用耸人听闻的标题报道苏联的农民起义、斯大林向右转即转向资本主义、托洛茨基捍卫列宁主义，以及苏联人人因伏特加而发疯、数百万农民和工人濒临饿死等消息。

就在你们惩治顿涅茨盆地（Donetz Basin）匪徒的时候，华尔街报刊却通过新闻标题叫嚷苏维埃土地上的谋杀案。他们已经忘记，就在去年，他们才刚刚让萨科（Sacco）和万泽蒂（Vanzetti）流血牺牲。今天，美国帝国主义者以准备防御红色帝国主义攻击为借口，掩盖其大规模的军事准备。

当美国资本主义报纸大肆散布此类垃圾言论时，在美国最富有的城镇中（根据美国共产党的统计，美国有500万失业者），可以看到一排排饥民缓慢前行，只为领取一片面包。从由这些同样忍饥挨饿的工人双手建造的摩天大楼屋顶俯瞰，这些人排成的队伍宛如细长的生长线。同志们，这幅景象生动地留在我们的想象中，只有将其与苏联向失业者提供的援助进行对比时，它才再次浮现在我们的脑海中。

尽管美国共产党遭受迫害和压迫，该党仍继续领导绝大多数工人同美国资本主义进行艰苦斗争。

我们的战争口号之一是：“不许干涉工农共和国！不许干涉苏联！”

我们，美国海员，借此机会提出

following resolutions: " We, six American mariners, members of the
Communist Party in America, after having heard and seen the achievements
which have been attained during the past 10 years and 9 months by the
Dictatorship of the proletariat, vouch that on returning to America, we
will fulfill our communist duty with greater energy than formerly.
Being mariners we particularly feel the burden of this duty to be in-
cumbent upon us, because we are aware that in a near future we shall be
called upon to transport arms and soldiers against the workers and
peasants of U.S.S.R. We shall relate and explain all transport workers

in the slogan : " Not one rifle, not one soldier should be transported
against the workers and peasants in U.S.S.R., who are pursuing the
object of liberating the working class of the whole world".-

以下决议：“我们，六名美国海员，美国共产党党员，在听取并目睹了过去十年零九个月里无产阶级专政所取得的成就后，保证返回美国后将比以前更精力充沛地履行我们的共产主义义务。身为海员，我们特别感到这一重任责无旁贷，因为我们意识到在不久的将来，我们将被征召运送武器和士兵去对付苏联的工人和农民。我们将向美国所有运输工人讲述并解释我们在苏联期间所见的一切，并提出口号：‘不运送一支步枪、一名士兵去对付致力于解放全世界工人阶级的苏联工农’。”

The "Izvestia" of May 22nd writes:-
American Capitalism in China.

The policy of American imperialism in China was always one apart because of its special feature. America knew that sooner or later she will need the market of China and she was guarding it against the claims of other nations. Politically Americans showed activity since the Spring of 1928, principally perhaps because of the aggressive tendencies of Japan with respect to China. America began to express sympathies to China in a very careful manner when the latter was struggling against Japanese agression and particularly emphasized that the annexation of Manchuria will not be permitted. Then there came several other instances in which America gave the lead and the other Powers followed. Later on again America began to interest large financial circles in China and as a result offers were made by prominent personages and Syndicates to assist China in her reconstruction of the country. Advisers and experts began arriving in the beginning of this year, among which the Kammerer Finance Mission, is very important. Subsequently arrangements were made with American capitalists for the erection of a powerful Radio Station, the construction of workshops by Henry Ford for mounting cars on the spot, and the establishment of aerial service by the American "Aviation and Exploration Co." for carrying mails, etc.etc. Another Company again acquired for half a million Taels the Shanghai International Settlement Municipal Electricity Power Station and Department, which has thus become free of British control. This latter instance is significant of the growing activity of American capitalism as well as of the efforts by the country in question to oust her rivals from China.

The attack of American capitalism can be warded off by the development of a fresh civil war and anarchy or else by an explosion of a revolutionary movement. In any case American measures mean a gradual involving of China into that state in which are already the Central and South America. For other Powers and in the first place for England and Japan they are a threat for their loss of the Chinese market, if not altogether at least economically and as a detriment to the future interests of those countries. Therefore, American capitalistic ways only serve to enhance rivalry between the Imperialistic Powers, which is being carried out mainly by political methods, such as the encouragement to new militaristic groups.

The "Izvestia" of May 25th writes:-
Behind the scenes of civil war in China.

The war, which began in March, between Nanking and Kwangse Generals, was to a great extent supported by the Compradores of South China, who are closely connected with Great Britain, through the medium of the Hongkong-Shanghai Bank. Great Britain, however, having failed to save the Kwangse militarists in the Yangtsee Valley, continued to encourage further war in the North between Chiang-Kai Shek and Feng Yu Hsiang this time. There is no doubt that both Great Britain and Japan see an opportunity in the fresh civil war of China to check the attacks of American capitalism in this country through such means as the Kammerer Finance Syndicate and Military Advisers, etc. To attain this purpose the imperialists are trying to involve Russia in alleging that the latter is supporting Chinese circles.

5月22日的《消息报》（Izvestia）写道：-
美国资本主义在中国。

美国帝国主义在华政策因其特殊性而独树一帜。美国知道迟早需要中国市场，因此一直防备其他国家对这一市场的觊觎。自1928年春季以来，美国人在政治上表现出活跃姿态，这或许主要是因为日本对华侵略倾向所致。当中国抗击日本侵略时，美国开始以非常谨慎的方式表示同情，并特别强调不允许吞并满洲。随后又出现了几起美国带头、其他列强跟随的事例。此后，美国又开始引起大型金融界对中国兴趣，结果是一些知名人士和辛迪加提出协助中国重建国家。顾问和专家从今年年初开始抵达，其中卡默勒（Kammerer）财政使团尤为重要。随后，与美国资本家达成协议，建立一座强大的无线电台，由亨利·福特（Henry Ford）建造车间就地组装汽车，并由美国“航空与探险公司”（Aviation and Exploration Co.）建立航空服务以运送邮件等。另一家公司则以五十万两白银收购了上海公共租界工部局电气处及发电厂，从而使其摆脱了英国的控制。后一事例既表明了美国资本主义活动的日益增强，也表明了该国努力将竞争对手逐出中国。

可以通过引发新的内战和无政府状态，或者通过革命运动的爆发来抵御美国资本主义的攻击。无论如何，美国的措施意味着中国逐渐陷入中南美洲各国已经处于的那种状态。对于其他列强，首先是英国和日本来说，这是一种威胁，意味着它们将失去中国市场，即便不是完全失去，至少在经济上会失去，并将损害这些国家的未来利益。因此，美国资本主义的方式只会加剧帝国主义列强之间的竞争，这种竞争主要通过政治手段进行，例如鼓励新的军阀集团。

5月25日的《消息报》写道：-
中国内战的幕后。

3月爆发的南京与广西将领之间的战争，在很大程度上得到了华南买办的支持，这些买办通过汇丰银行与英国紧密相连。然而，英国未能在长江流域挽救广西军阀，于是这次继续鼓励北方蒋介石与冯玉祥之间进一步开战。毫无疑问，英国和日本都视中国新的内战为契机，试图通过卡默勒财政辛迪加和军事顾问等手段遏制美国资本主义在该国的攻势。为了达到这一目的，帝国主义者企图通过将俄国卷入其中，声称后者支持中国某些派系。

The "Krasnoe Znamya"(Red Banner ) of June 7. writes:-
Meeting of Chinese workers.

A meeting attended by about 800 people was held
in a Chinese Theatre by Chinese workers, mostly cargo
coolies. They were given a lecture by Comrade Losenko
on the subject of harm done by the use of vodka, opium
and other similar evils indulged in by the Chinese.
Furthermore the audience advocated certain improvements
for themselves in conditions of life such as a soup
kitchen, an interpreter in hospital, the high prices
to be lowered down, etc.

The "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) of June 5 writes:-

Comment on the Soviet Consulate raid in Harbin.

The Harbin raid testifies to the revival of anti-
Soviet plans of Mukden militarists, whose aim is to
seize the C.E.R. and who are to all appearances aided
in their plans by the Nanking Authorities and Japanese
military circles.
The Soviet Government is quite right in demanding
a stop to such provocation of the imperialists. The
special protection by Soviet Government of Chinese
citizens interests in Russia was shown in an exclusive
way by the Chinese Consulate being allowed to function
regularly in Soviet territory, enjoying all the rights
and privileges of a Consulate. However there is a
limit to every form of patience and forbearance. The
Chinese militarists in their ardour should not imagine
that they can treat the Soviet Consulates and their
citizens any way they please. A stop on the part of
of our Government in a more drastic manner than
merely futile protests and allowances must be made
to further provocation by Chinese militarists, who
have lost all sense of shame. The working masses of
China will understand the attitude of U.S.S.R. which
whilst defending itself against banditry, still remains
a true friend of the Chinese people in their opposition
to the imperialists.

The "Krasnoe Znamya" of June 1, writes:-

Provocation by Chang Ko Chen.

A falsified document was published by the White
Press and the Chinese newspaper "Kun Pao" purporting to
emanate and have been seized during the raid at the
Soviet Consulate and containing communication between
the Komintern in Moscow with Harbin, Vladivostock, etc.
The document is the more ridiculous because although
dated January 1929 is written in former orthography.
The belief that Chang Ko Chen together with his
White assistants and the Police is manufacturing these
"documents" is prevailing even amongst emigrant circles.

6月7日的《Krasnoe Znamya》（《红旗报》）写道：-
中国工人集会。

一场约有800人参加的集会在一家中国剧院举行，参与者多为搬运苦力。洛森科（Losenko）同志就伏特加、鸦片及其他类似恶习对中国人的危害发表了演讲。此外，听众还呼吁改善自身生活条件，如设立施粥所、在医院配备翻译、降低高昂物价等。

6月5日的《Krasnoe Znamya》（《红旗报》）写道：-

评论哈尔滨苏联领事馆遭搜查事件。

哈尔滨搜查事件证实了奉系军阀反苏计划的复活，其目的是夺取中东铁路，且其计划显然得到了南京当局和日本军界的支持。
苏联政府要求停止帝国主义者的此类挑衅是完全正确的。苏联政府对中国公民在俄利益的特别保护，体现为允许中国领事馆在苏联领土上正常运作，享有领事馆的一切权利和特权。然而，任何形式的耐心和容忍都是有限度的。中国军阀在狂热中不应以为可以随意对待苏联领事馆及其公民。我国政府必须采取比徒劳的抗议和容忍更为严厉的措施，制止已丧失羞耻心的中国军阀的进一步挑衅。中国广大民众将理解苏联的态度，苏联在自卫反击匪徒行径的同时，仍然是中国人民反对帝国主义的真朋友。

6月1日的《Krasnoe Znamya》写道：-

张作霖（Chang Ko Chen）的挑衅。

白俄报刊和中国报纸《昆报》（Kun Pao）刊登了一份伪造文件，声称该文件发自并在搜查苏联领事馆期间被缴获，内容涉及莫斯科共产国际与哈尔滨、符拉迪沃斯托克等地的通讯。这份文件尤为荒谬，因为虽然日期标注为1929年1月，却使用的是旧式拼写法。即使在流亡者圈子中，也普遍相信张作霖与其白俄助手及警察正在制造这些“文件”。

"The Red Banner"
Vladivostock, October 9, 1925.

（印：SPECIAL FILES 9199 6. 11. 28）

A new forgery.

New forged documents have been published by the French newspapers According to a plan described in these documents, communist cells in the post-offices, telegraph and radio-stations are to seize the post office, tel..graph and radio stations at a given moment. Then seizure of railways, printing offices, "Havas" agency, the Lebourger aerodrome, electric works and banks have also been planned. Comrade Cachin is mentioned in these documents as the president of the "French Soviet of People's Commissars". Two Russians, specially sent from Moscow, are to be appointed as the War and Navy ministers. One of these men is reported to be already in Paris. An official from the staff of the Political Representation will be placed at the head of the "French People's Commissar of Commerce".

Released from the torture-chambers of the Chinese Satraps.

Yesterday morning 15 Soviet citizens, prisoners from a Chinese gaol. arrived by steamer in Vladivostock. They were detained 17 months in prison. A month ago, i.e. on September 5, these Soviet citizens were released by decision of the Chinese Court.
A large crowd of toilers among whom were the representatives of the local administration, officials of the Commissariat of Foreign Affairs, Trade Unions, students and others, assembled at the jetty to welcome their arrival. The arrival of the steamer was accompanied by shouts "Hurrah" and the music of band. Their welcome was a joyous and enthusiastic demonstration. A meeting was organised at the jetty where several welcome speeches were delivered.

The following are the comrades who arrived; VASSIN, GAMBERG, MOROSOFF, ILIASHENKO, DYMCHINSKY, CONSTANTINOFF, GRIGORIEFF, TOLKA-CHEFF, MALYSHEFF, OGNEFF, KISSILEFF, SKATKIN, VERHOIIN, SAMSAKOFF and TONKIH.

D. C. P. , D. C. I.

《红旗报》
符拉迪沃斯托克，1925年10月9日。

（印：特别档案 9199 6. 11. 28）

又一新伪造品。

法国报纸刊登了新的伪造文件。根据这些文件中描述的计画，邮局、电报局和无线电台中的共产党细胞将在指定时刻夺取邮局、电报局和无线电台。随后还计画夺取铁路、印刷所、“哈瓦斯”通讯社、勒布尔热机场、发电厂和银行。在这些文件中，加香同志被提及为“法国人民委员苏维埃”主席。两名专门从莫斯科派来的俄罗斯人将被任命为陆军和海军部长。据称其中一人已抵达巴黎。政治代表处参谋部的一名官员将出任“法国商业人民委员”一职。

从中国总督的刑讯室中获释。

昨天上午，15名苏联公民——中国监狱的囚犯——乘轮船抵达符拉迪沃斯托克。他们被监禁了17个月。一个月前，即9月5日，这些苏联公民经中国法院裁定获释。
大批劳动者聚集在码头欢迎他们的到来，其中包括地方行政当局代表、外交人民委员部官员、工会人员、学生等。轮船抵达时伴随着“万岁”的欢呼声和乐队演奏的音乐。他们的欢迎仪式是一场欢乐而热情的示威活动。码头上组织了一次集会，会上发表了几篇欢迎演说。

以下是抵达的同志：瓦辛（VASSIN）、甘伯格（GAMBERG）、莫罗佐夫（MOROSOFF）、伊利亚申科（ILIASHENKO）、迪姆钦斯基（DYMCHINSKY）、康斯坦丁诺夫（CONSTANTINOFF）、格里戈里耶夫（GRIGORIEFF）、托尔卡切夫（TOLKA-CHEFF）、马雷舍夫（MALYSHEFF）、奥格涅夫（OGNEFF）、基西廖夫（KISSILEFF）、斯卡特金（SKATKIN）、维尔霍因（VERHOIIN）、萨姆萨科夫（SAMSAKOFF）和通基赫（TONKIH）。

D. C. P. , D. C. I.

（批：M.G. 5711/98 当局 6/11/26）

"The Red Banner"
Vladivostock, October 5, 1928.

Kuomintang and "Industrial Peace" in China.

During the period from January 1st to July 1 of this year
48 strikes occurred in Shanghai in 1.514 industrial enterprises,
which involved 165.537 workers. Out of these 48 strikes, which makes
an average of 8 (?) strikes a month, 38 strikes, or 80%, were caused
by conflicts between the workers and the capitalists. This gives an
illustration of the so-called "industrial peace" in China proclaimed
by the Kuomintang. 20 % (i.e. 10 strikes) of these strikes were
produced by conflicts between the labourers and a "third party", name-
ly, the administration, which causes troubles among
the workers by its actions such as illegal arrests, murder of workers,
arbitrariness of the law courts, misbehaviour of soldiers etc.

From the foregoing one can see that, despite the reaction-
ary regime, instituted by the Kuomintang, and the unmerciful struggle
against the labour movement, the Shanghai proletariat, in 10 cases
during six months, resisted the military-police oppression of the
nationalist bourgeoisie by political strikes.

The organisation of Shanghai labour, under the present Kuomintang
regime, has been more difficult than ever before. Therefore one
should not underestimate the revolutionary importance of the Shanghai
strikes in the labour movement in China. It is true, that, owing to
the above mentioned repressions, the number of active participants
in strikes is now insignificant when compared with that of the
1915-26 years. Great numbers of workers generally leave Shanghai for
the villages during the strike and remain there until work is resumed.
Thus only active minority conducts the strikes to the end.

In spite of this, however, the Shanghai proletariat, which has now
acquired experience during the past few years has gained definite suc-
cess in the struggle against the foreign and native capital during the past six months.

Reviewing the terms according to which the 48 strikes were
settled we find that in 28 instances the strikes were carried
out successfully and resulted in complete victory for the workers.
The latter were defeated only in 6 cases, a partial success was
obtained in 3 instances and 3 remained undecided. It is worth mentio-
ning that out of 48 strikes only 9 conflicts were submitted to the
decision of the Arbitration Commission, which was specially created
by the Kuomintang for the establishment of "peace" in industry.

Thus if we consider all elements participating in the settlement
of the strikers, we find that during the first part of 1928 year the
Shanghai proletariat achieved considerable success in their struggle
against the capitalists.

Under the reign of the most spiteful reaction, under the oppres-
sion of "Kuomintang" militarism, the victory of the Shanghai workers
proves that the nationalist bourgeoisie are unable to suppress the
labour movement and are obliged to reckon with the will of the masses
which are actively engaged in the defense of their interests.
A feature which is characteristic to the strike movement of this
period is that, unlike the strikes of former years, the present
strikes are directed against native capitalists and not against

《红旗报》
符拉迪沃斯托克，1928年10月5日。

国民党与中国的“工业和平”。

在今年1月1日至7月1日期间，
上海1,514家工业企业发生了48次罢工，
涉及165,537名工人。在这48次罢工中，平均每月8（?）次，有38次罢工，即80%，是由工人与资本家之间的冲突引起的。这说明了国民党所宣称的中国所谓的“工业和平”。这些罢工中有20%（即10次）是由工人与“第三方”（即当局）之间的冲突引起的，当局通过非法逮捕、杀害工人、法院专横、士兵行为不端等行为给工人制造麻烦。

从前文可以看出，尽管国民党建立了反动政权，并对劳工运动进行无情的斗争，但上海无产阶级在六个月内仍有10次通过政治罢工抵抗民族资产阶级的军警压迫。

在目前国民党统治下，上海劳工的组织工作比以往任何时候都更加困难。因此，不应低估上海罢工在中国劳工运动中的革命重要性。诚然，由于上述镇压，与1915-26年期间相比，目前罢工的积极参与者人数微不足道。在罢工期间，大量工人通常离开上海前往农村，并留在那里直到复工。因此，只有积极的少数派将罢工进行到底。

尽管如此，过去几年积累了经验的上海无产阶级，在过去六个月中与外国和本土资本的斗争中取得了明确的胜利。

回顾解决这48次罢工的条件，我们发现其中有28次罢工成功举行，并为工人带来了完全胜利。后者仅在6次案件中失败，3次案件取得部分成功，3次案件悬而未决。值得一提的是，在48次罢工中，仅有9起冲突提交给仲裁委员会裁决，该委员会是国民党为建立工业“和平”而特别设立的。

因此，如果我们考虑参与解决罢工的所有因素，我们会发现，在1928年上半年，上海无产阶级在与资本家的斗争中取得了相当大的成功。

在最恶毒的反动统治下，在“国民党”军阀主义的压迫下，上海工人的胜利证明，民族资产阶级无法镇压劳工运动，不得不顾及积极从事保卫自身利益的群众的意愿。
这一时期罢工运动的一个特点是，与往年的罢工不同，目前的罢工是针对本土资本家，而不是针对

No I. O... 9199 ...
Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) of Oct. 13, 1928.
H. 13. 28
Visit of American Timber-merchants.

Three American capitalists named Kalliot, Lamb and Mass arrived in Vladivostock from Tokio en route to Habarovsk in connection with timber business. One, however, returned to Tokio without proceeding further. These capitalists are representatives of large funds assigned for timber business and were making this tour to Habarovsk with a view to introducing machinery for that purpose. To illustrate the working of the timber products in United States the representatives in question had a cinematographic film for exhibition.

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" of October 19, 1928.

Militia has difficulties in Suchan.

Militia is powerless in Suchan against the activities of hooligans as there is one Militia man on service where there are II thousand residents. This state of affairs is made still worse by the fact that 51% of the residents are Koreans who cannot be relied upon to help the Militia fight hooliganism.

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" of October 25th, 1928.

Navigation for 1929.

The following plans for navigation have been made for the year 1929 in the Far East:- 6 extensive coasting voyages from the Black Sea to the Far East; 34 voyages along the Northern line in the Pacific; 4 Eastern Sakhalian voyages; one Kalimsky; one Lensky; one to the Isle of Wrangel; 8 Korean and Chinese; 26 Shanghai; 26 Japanese and 4 South China.
It is intended to reduce freight rates 20% for the Soviet Trade Fleet in Northern sailings for the transportation of cargo and labourers.
Comrade Yakovleff, Manager of the Far Eastern Offices of the Soviet Trade Fleet gave details as under of the sailings of steamers for the year 1929:-
Northern line - s.s. "Tomsk", "Erivan", "Indigirka", "Simferopol", "Astrakhan", "Hua-Shing", "Zinovieff" and "Krasin". There will also be "Tobolsk" and "Theodor Nette".
Sea communication with Odessa will be maintained by 4 ships including "Vorovsky" and "Lozovsky" the other two to be named by the Black Sea Ports.
The s.s. "Primorie" and another steamer will serve the Eastern Saknalian line.
S.S. "Stavropol" will operate on the Kolimsky line. For Lensky and Isle of Wrangel sailings special steamers adapted to the North Pole regions will be put on the line.
Five steamers of which "Zinovieff", "Krasin" and "Lozovsky" will make part will operate between Japan ports and Vladivostock.
The Soviet Trade Fleet is chiefly concerned with arranging communication with the Northern ports.

译自1928年10月13日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。
H. 13. 28
美国木材商人的访问。

三名名为卡利奥特（Kalliot）、兰姆（Lamb）和马斯（Mass）的美国资本家因木材业务从东京抵达符拉迪沃斯托克，途经哈巴罗夫斯克。然而，其中一人未继续前行，返回了东京。这些资本家是专为木材业务设立的大额基金的代表，此次前往哈巴罗夫斯克考察旨在为此目的引进机械。为了说明美国木材产品的运作情况，上述代表备有一部电影片以供放映。

译自1928年10月19日《红旗报》。

苏昌的民兵团面临困难。

在苏昌（Suchan），民兵团对流氓活动无能为力，因为在一万一千居民中仅有一名民警服役。这种情况因以下事实而更加恶化：51%的居民是朝鲜人，不能指望他们帮助民兵团打击流氓行为。

译自1928年10月25日《红旗报》。

1929年航运计画。

远东地区制定了以下1929年航运计画：从黑海到远东的6次长途沿海航行；太平洋北线34次航行；东萨哈林航线4次；加利姆斯基（Kalimsky）航线1次；连斯克（Lensky）航线1次；弗兰格尔岛（Isle of Wrangel）航线1次；朝鲜和中国航线8次；上海航线26次；日本航线26次；华南航线4次。
拟将苏联贸易船队在北方航线上运输货物和劳工的运费降低20%。
苏联贸易船队远东办事处经理雅科夫列夫（Yakovleff）同志详细说明了1929年的轮船航行安排如下：
北线 - “托木斯克”号（Tomsk）、“埃里温”号（Erivan）、“因迪吉尔卡”号（Indigirka）、“辛菲罗波尔”号（Simferopol）、“阿斯特拉罕”号（Astrakhan）、“华兴”号（Hua-Shing）、“季诺维也夫”号（Zinovieff）和“克拉辛”号（Krasin）。还将有“托博尔斯克”号（Tobolsk）和“费奥多尔·内特”号（Theodor Nette）。
与敖德萨的海上交通将由4艘船只维持，包括“沃罗夫斯基”号（Vorovsky）和“洛佐夫斯基”号（Lozovsky），另外两艘由黑海港口命名。
“滨海边疆区”号（Primorie）和另一艘轮船将服务于东萨哈林航线。
“斯塔夫罗波尔”号（Stavropol）将在科雷马（Kolimsky）航线上运营。对于连斯克和弗兰格尔岛航线，将投入适应北极地区的特种轮船。
五艘轮船，其中包括“季诺维也夫”号、“克拉辛”号和“洛佐夫斯基”号，将在日本港口和符拉迪沃斯托克之间运营。
苏联贸易船队主要关注安排与北方港口的交通联系。

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" of October 23, 1923.
Vladivostock.

District Conference of Labour Unions.
Foreign Seamen attend.

Seamen of foreign ships in port, on having learnt that on
October 20 the opening of the District Conference of Labour
Unions would take place, came to the Club of Vorovsky to see
for themselves whether what is written about the Russian
labourers in their own countries is correct.
The seamen included Germans, British, Chinese who very
attentively listened to the speakers, who delivered welcome
speeches first, which were translated for them by interpreters.
However the main thing they saw for themselves and that was
the simple, natural re-union and communication between the
labour leaders and the labour masses. They also saw the
unification of labourers with the Red Army. They saw how a
military Commissary reported to the members of organized
labourers' conference on the condition of the Red Army and they
heard how the Red Army told the labourers "We are on guard -
continue to work in peace and build up the Socialistic form
of government". They saw a peasant who came to welcome the
Conference of Labourers and who was a member and delegate of
the poor class of peasantry. They have never seen that sort
of a thing in London, Berlin or elsewhere. And these proletarians
also took the platform to welcome the Conference of our Unions.
A German seaman once said:- "When I first came to Vladivos-
tock and went sight-seeing I saw that you are building up a new
life. I saw that which I did not expect to see as our papers
write about totally different things.
A British seaman said that he would tell all about he had
seen when he gets back to London and the same was said by a
Chinese seaman.
All of them understood that there are still a great many
difficulties before the labourers of Soviet Russia and they
were not far wrong as the speakers made no secret of it at
the Conference.

At the Conference too attention was drawn to the fact that
Eastern labourers were not getting their share of good treatment.
It was said, for example, that Three thirds of labourers in
coal mines of Suchan were Chinese and out of 14.000 Gold roubles
belonging to the Culture Fund, only 2000 were spent for Chinese.
In the Union of Chinese wharf employees there were only 3
leading labourers, the rest being exploited. Chinese newspaper
"The Labourers' Way" had only a thousand subscribers and Chinese
workmen were not included in the Cooperative Organization.

The following are invited by the District International
Organization of Political Workers to attend a discussion on
"The Development of Propaganda Activities":- Comrades
Milovzoroff, Lialin, Geitzman, Kotler, Hvatsky, Rudenko, Pak-Ou,
Bolsunovsky, Gurshin, Makuroff, Krasilnikoff and Doljikoff.

The Italian Press of Rome reports that Great Britain is
endeavouring to develop a monarchist movement in Afghanistan.
News from Cairo is to the effect that a movement is on foot
in Afghanistan against the policy of the Shah. British agents
are reported to support the movement as fears are entertained in
London that a strong Afghanistan may get the Mussulman population
of India to help it.

译自1923年10月23日《红旗报》。
符拉迪沃斯托克。

地区工会代表大会。
外国海员出席。

停泊在港口的外国船只海员得知10月20日将召开地区工会代表大会后，来到沃罗夫斯基俱乐部，亲自看看他们本国报纸上关于俄罗斯工人的报道是否属实。
海员包括德国人、英国人和中国人，他们非常认真地聆听了发言者的讲话，发言者首先发表了欢迎辞，并由翻译为他们口译。
然而，他们亲眼看到的主要事情是劳工领袖与劳工群众之间简单、自然的团聚和交流。他们还看到了劳工与红军的团结。他们看到一位军事委员向有组织的劳工大会成员报告红军的状况，并听到红军对工人们说：“我们在站岗——请安心工作，建设社会主义形式的政府”。他们看到一位前来欢迎劳工大会的农民，他是贫农阶层的成员和代表。他们在伦敦、柏林或其他地方从未见过这样的事情。这些无产者也走上讲台欢迎我们的工会代表大会。
一名德国海员曾说：“当我第一次来到符拉迪沃斯托克观光时，我看到你们正在建立新生活。我看到了我没想到会看到的东西，因为我们的报纸写的完全是另一回事。”
一名英国海员说，他回到伦敦后会把他看到的一切告诉大家，一名中国海员也说了同样的话。
他们都明白，苏俄的劳工面前仍有许多困难，他们的看法并没有错，因为发言者在大会上对此毫不隐瞒。

在大会上，人们还注意到东方劳工没有得到应有的良好待遇。例如，据说苏昌煤矿的劳工中有三分之二是中国人，而在属于文化基金的14,000金卢布中，仅有2,000卢布用于中国人。在中国码头工人工会中，只有3名劳工领袖，其余人都受到剥削。中文报纸《劳工之路》只有一千名订阅者，中国工人未被纳入合作组织。

Vladivostock, October 11, 1927.

Across the Chinese Provinces.

2. Arrests of Indians. During one of the numerous raids in Canton on communist premises two Indians were arrested and charged with having conducted communist propaganda. The British newspapers, which, as our readers will observe, have particular reasons for alarm on all matters regarding Indians, devoted considerable attention to these arrests and reported certain interesting particulars. The Chief of the Canton Gendarms received "reliable reports" concerning a communist nest and, after consulting with the chief of the police, immediately made a search and effected the arrest. In order to give the whole affair the aspect of considerable importance, it was announced that during the search several "important documents had been found in Russian" which are being translated by the Police.

Then follows the "usual story". The arrested Indians "confessed" to being members of the communist party, declared themselves communist organizers carrying out communist work amongst the Indian residents in Canton and also amongst those arriving by steamers. After this arrest the Police instituted fresh searches and revealed "Indian headquarters in Canton", where a certain amount of arms and literature were being stored.

The Chinese authorities however cannot treat Indians in the manner as they treat their own people. Indians, strange as it may seem, are under the "protection and defense" of the British King and all his military and naval forces. Therefore the Chinese authorities, after exhaustive consultations, conferences and inquiries addressed to the Commissioner of Foreign Affairs decided to hand the Indians over to the British Consular authorities in Canton. The Indians were duly handed over and probably, after serving their term in the British gaol, will be deported to India unless there is a worse fate in store for them.

Yet this Indian case small and insignificant as it may appear alarmed the British press. This is not the first case of an arrest of revolutionary Indians conducting propaganda work amongst their fellow Indians countrymen residing in China or temporarily visiting that country. Quite recently "great communist plot" was unearthed in Swatow. According to official notification, the plotters, by engaging the services of the house servants of the manager of a British Steamship Co, were discovered smuggling arms and proclamations into various towns of the Kwantung province, the intention being to use them when a favourable moment arrived. Large stores of arms have been found in the premises of the above referred to manager. The Chinese authorities, who disclosed the "plot", made several arrests during the hubbub and quickly liquidated both the plot and plotters. Still the British are seriously alarmed. All the British steamers are being guarded by Indians. Wharves and godowns are also under constant and vigilant guard by special Indian police. It follows therefore that if the Chinese revolutionists succeeded in smuggling the arms, they must have acted in conjunction with the Indian, because it is an impossibility to avoid the Indians guards. It means therefore that the Indians who are specially brought from India to China for police work cannot be trusted. They are assisting the Chinese revolutionists, not those of Kuomintang type, but the communists. In reality there are strong reasons why the "dye hard" press should

2. 印度人被捕。在广州对共产党场所进行的多次突袭行动中，有两名印度人被捕，并被指控进行共产主义宣传。英国报纸——正如读者所见，它们在涉及印度人的所有事务上都有特别理由感到恐慌——对这些逮捕给予了极大关注，并报道了一些有趣的细节。广州宪兵队长收到关于一个共产党巢穴的“可靠报告”，在与警察局长协商后，立即进行了搜查并实施了逮捕。为了使整个事件显得相当重要，当局宣布在搜查过程中发现了数份“重要的俄文文件”，目前正由警方进行翻译。

随后是“老套的故事”。被捕的印度人“供认”自己是共产党员，自称是共产主义组织者，在广州的印度居民以及乘轮船抵达的印度人中开展共产主义工作。在这次逮捕之后，警方进行了新的搜查，并揭露了“广州的印度人总部”，那里储存了一定数量的武器和文献。

然而，中国当局不能像对待本国人民那样对待印度人。尽管听起来奇怪，但印度人处于英国国王及其所有海陆军力量的“保护和防卫”之下。因此，中国当局在经过详尽的磋商、会议并向外交专员进行咨询后，决定将这两名印度人移交给驻广州的英国领事当局。印度人已被正式移交，很可能在英国监狱服刑期满后，除非有更糟糕的命运等着他们，否则将被驱逐回印度。

然而，这起看似微不足道的印度人案件却引起了英国新闻界的恐慌。这并非首次发生在中国居住或暂时访问中国的革命印度人向其同胞进行宣传工作时被捕的案件。不久前，汕头揭发了一起“巨大的共产主义阴谋”。根据官方通报，阴谋者通过雇佣一家英国轮船公司经理的家仆，被发现向广东省各城镇走私武器和宣言，意图在有利时机到来时使用它们。在上述经理的场所内发现了大量武器储备。揭露该“阴谋”的中国当局在混乱中进行了数次逮捕，并迅速瓦解了阴谋及阴谋者。尽管如此，英国人仍深感恐慌。所有英国轮船均由印度人守卫。码头和仓库也由专门的印度警察持续严密看守。因此可以推断，如果中国革命者成功走私武器，他们必定是与印度人勾结作案，因为不可能避开印度警卫。这意味着，那些专门从印度带来中国从事警务工作的印度人是不可信任的。他们正在协助中国革命者，不是协助国民党类型的革命者，而是协助共产党人。实际上，“顽固派”新闻界有充分的理由感到

a "Shanghai Arya" of December 6th writes as follows:-
Political.

The price of fares.

Mr. Albert Thomas who has made a rapid tour of China
as Director of the Bureau of Labour in the League of Nations,
attended a banquet in Shanghai given in his honour by repre-
sentatives of Chinese labour unions. He made the following
statement:-
"I have come to the conclusion that the difficulties of
Chinese labour class are caused by the oppression brought about
in China by the unequal treaties".
The head of an international institution for the regula-
tion of labour matters ought to have a sounder not to say
more learned judgment of the real state of affairs. Only
a street demagogue and not a statesman and an educated
economist of world wide government economics would risk
to assert that Chinese pauperism and all other evils of
social life are the outcome of the so called unequal treaties.
Mr. Albert Thomas is not only a head of one of the
sections of the League of Nations; he is also a statesman of
France - one of her former Ministers! There is a certain
obligation in that. It is not the League of Nations that will
have to pay the price for Mr. Albert Thomas' words, but the
French Republic. By inciting the irresponsible elements
against the so called "unequal treaties", Mr. Thomas is thereby
compelling France to lose the following:-
1) Concessions in Tientsin, Hankow and what of Shanghai,
which is very rich, being populated by over a million inhabitant
and in which have been invested hundreds of millions of Francs.
2) Mr. Thomas is compelling France also to give up
hundreds million of Francs of the Boxer contribution, which
not only the wealthy countries such as Great Britain and
America, but even the labourers' and peasants' houses do not
intend to lose.
3) Mr. Thomas wishes France to give up participation
in Salt Gabelle monopoly, railway lines constructed by the
French and financed by France (and yet the Bolsheviks do not
give up the Chinese Eastern Railway), French tramways, electric
power stations, factories, mills, docks, wharves, banks,
transportation offices, etc, etc, as all these concerns and
institutions are founded on the treaties which Mr. Thomas
mentions and to which he attributes the poverty and hardships
of the Chinese labour class.
Mr. Thomas is playing into the hand of the III
International by such speeches and France and no other country
will reap the harvest of the storm.
Mr. Thomas evidently wishes to pass as an international
labour dictator in lieu of maintaining his position as Director
of the Bureau of Labour in Geneva. An appeal of the nature
made by Mr. Thomas as one of a socialist against capitalism is
too cynical even for a socialist!

A.R.
7/12/28.

12月6日的《上海雅利安人报》（Shanghai Arya）写道：-
政治。

票价问题。

阿尔伯特·托马斯先生（Mr. Albert Thomas）作为国际联盟劳工局局长对中国进行了快速巡视，出席了上海中国工会代表为他举行的宴会。他发表了以下声明：-
“我得出结论，中国劳工阶级的困难是由不平等条约在中国造成的压迫引起的。”
作为一个调节劳工事务的国际机构的负责人，本应对现实状况有更健全、甚至更博学的判断。只有街头煽动家，而非政治家或具有世界政府经济学知识的受过教育的经济学家，才会冒险断言中国的贫困和社会生活的所有其他弊病是所谓不平等条约的结果。阿尔伯特·托马斯先生不仅是国际联盟一个部门的负责人；他也是法国的政治家——法国的前部长之一！这其中有一定的责任。需要为阿尔伯特·托马斯先生的言论付出代价的不是国际联盟，而是法兰西共和国。通过煽动不负责任的分子反对所谓的“不平等条约”，托马斯先生 thereby 迫使法国失去以下利益：
1) 天津、汉口的租界，以及非常富庶、拥有一百多万人口、已投资数亿法郎的上海租界。
2) 托马斯先生还迫使法国放弃数亿法郎的庚子赔款份额，这不仅是大国如英国和美国，甚至是劳工和农民阶层都不打算失去的。
3) 托马斯先生希望法国放弃参与盐税垄断、由法国建造并提供资金的铁路线（然而布尔什维克并未放弃中东铁路）、法国电车、发电站、工厂、磨坊、船坞、码头、银行、运输办事处等，等等，因为所有这些企业和机构都建立在托马斯先生提及并归咎为中国劳工阶级贫困和苦难根源的那些条约之上。
托马斯先生通过此类演讲是在为第三国际助阵，而法国而非其他国家将承受这场风暴的后果。
托马斯先生显然希望以国际劳工独裁者的形象出现，以取代其作为日内瓦劳工局局长的职位。托马斯先生作为社会主义者发出的这种反对资本主义的呼吁，即使对社会主义者来说也太愤世嫉俗了！

A.R.
1928年12月7日.

The 'Echo' of December 4th writes as follows:-
SOVIET.

Plans of the Soviet Interns.

At a weekly meeting to commemorate the death of Sun Yat Sen, General Li Ching Hai made a statement pointing out to the plans of the Moscow Government to seize Sinkiang. "It is well known" said Gen. Li "that the Soviet leaders are divided in opinion about China. One group desires counteraction to carry out Soviet plans and the other advocates action in China by organizing a good Red Army of about 50,000 men well trained to operate in China by fire and sword. As a result of M. Ngow being visited last year by a representative of the Dalbureau (Far Eastern Bureau) of the Soviet Government the policy of the second group was adopted. However this was opposed by a merciless anti-communist campaign of the Kuomintang, which prevented any further activities. Seeing that their plans were failing on the coast of China, the Soviet Government decided to carry out plans of communism in China through the medium of Mongolia. This explains the activities of Moscow in Urga and efforts to extend the Siberian Railway line as far as Sinkiang.

There is therefore the question of establishing one mid. shelter where those unfortunate may find a refuge. One of the local organizations could take charge of an institution of that kind and undoubtedly response would be found in the Russian community to come to the assistance of organizers by donations.

12月4日的《回声报》（Echo）写道：

苏维埃。

苏维埃Interns的计划。

在纪念孙中山逝世的周会上，李景海将军发表声明，指出莫斯科政府夺取新疆的计划。“众所周知，”李将军说，“苏联领导人在对华问题上意见分歧。一派希望采取反制措施以执行苏联计划，另一派则主张通过在中国组织一支约5万人的训练有素的红军，以武力手段在中国采取行动。由于去年苏联政府远东局（Dalbureau）的代表访问了吴（Ngow，音译）先生，第二派的政策被采纳。然而，这遭到了国民党无情反共运动的反对，从而阻止了任何进一步的活动。鉴于其计划在中国沿海地区受挫，苏联政府决定通过蒙古为媒介在中国实施共产主义计划。这就解释了莫斯科在乌兰巴托（Urga）的活动以及努力将西伯利亚铁路线延伸至新疆的举动。

12月4日的《Russkaya Zya》写道：

俄罗斯人。

贫困俄罗斯人的收容所。

在这寒冷的日子里，应当记住，有些人正像去年几次发生的情况那样，因缺乏栖身之所和获得栖身之所的工作而冒着生命危险。因此，存在建立一个中型收容所的问题，以便那些不幸者能找到避难所。当地的一个组织可以负责此类机构，毫无疑问，俄罗斯社区会通过捐款来响应，以协助组织者。

Translation from the "Izvestia" of October 16, 1928.

Members of the Pamir Expedition proceed to Moscow.

TASHKENT, Oct. 15 (Tass) A group of members of the Soviet-
German Pamir Expedition proceeded to Moscow with Comrade Gorbunoff
at the head. At a conference of scientific societies Comrade
Gorbunoff made a report on the work of the expedition.

Growth of trade between U.S.S.R. and Afghanistan.

On October 12 a meeting, largely attended, was held by the
All-allied Eastern Chamber of Commerce in Afghanistan, at which
were present merchants of Afghanistan. Mr. Fazl-Ahmethan,
Chargé d'Affairs of Afghanistan for Soviet Russia, Comrade S.V.
Malisheff and other responsible members of different organiza-
tions were also present.
D.I. Schmorgoner, Secretary of the Chamber, in a report
pointed out that during the past five years trade between
Soviet Russia and Afghanistan had greatly increased. Whilst in
1923/24 the general total had reached 1,9 of millions of roubles,
in 1927/1928 during a period of 9 months it mounted up to
9,5 millions of roubles. This exceeds pre-war results which
in 1913 were only 1,2 millions of roubles.
Comrade Malisheff expressed a regret that the Afghan
merchants ■■ missed the Nijegorodsky Fair, which would have
facilitated business transactions for them. Calling upon them
to come into closer contact with State and co-operative trade
organizations, Comrade Malisheff remarked that at first Afghan
merchants will encounter difficulties in the peculiarities of
trade in Russia, but should not get discouraged. Mutual interests
should be upheld by both countries. Comrade Malisheff also
expressed the hope that in the forthcoming year trade between
them would considerably increase.
Mr. Hakimoff was the next speaker on behalf of the Afghan
merchants and then addressing them said:- "We should observe
the laws of the country in which we reside and with which we
have business connections". "The absence of a trade agreement
between Soviet Russia and Afghanistan is very detrimental to
trade interests. We learnt with much pleasure of the declaration
of Padishah Amanulla-Khan to the effect that negotiations of
above nature were close to an end with satisfactory results".
Mr. Hakimoff moreover emphasized the necessity of
doing away with existing obstacles in the methods of trade,
transportation, etc.etc..
Comrade Lejawa in conclusion suggested the formation of
an Afghan Section in the Chamber of Commerce in which Afghan
merchants and Soviet representatives of trade organizations
would participate.

instigator and security of national revolution in the East".
The second consists in the systematic growth of American

into the heart of British dominions in colonies. The latest

compelled a certain turn in the policy of England with regard
to China, is equally felt by the British diplomacy as when

译自1928年10月14日的《消息报》（Izvestia）。
德国与苏联的商业联系。

10月13日，一家最重要的德国制造农业机械公司的代表抵达顿河畔罗斯托夫（Rostov-Don）。其中一位是名为吉勒（Gille）的“Stock”工厂厂长，另一位是首席工程师兰道（Landau）。

译自1928年10月16日的《消息报》（Izvestia）。

帕米尔探险队成员前往莫斯科。

塔什干，10月15日（塔斯社电）苏联-德国帕米尔探险队的一组成员在戈尔布诺夫（Gorbunoff）同志的带领下前往莫斯科。在科学协会的一次会议上，戈尔布诺夫同志就探险队的工作作了报告。

苏联与阿富汗贸易的增长。

10月12日，阿富汗全盟东方商会举行了一次出席人数众多的会议，阿富汗商人出席了会议。阿富汗驻苏俄代办法兹尔-艾哈梅坦（Fazl-Ahmethan，音译）先生、马利舍夫（S.V. Malisheff）同志以及其他各组织的负责人也出席了会议。
商会秘书施莫戈纳（D.I. Schmorgoner，音译）先生在一份报告中指出，在过去五年中，苏俄与阿富汗之间的贸易大幅增长。虽然1923/24年度的总额仅为190万卢布，但在1927/1928年度的9个月期间，这一数字攀升至950万卢布。这超过了战前的水平，1913年仅为120万卢布。
马利舍夫同志对阿富汗商人■■错过了下诺夫哥罗德集市（Nijegorodsky Fair）表示遗憾，该集市本可以促进他们的商业交易。马利舍夫同志呼吁他们与国家和合作社贸易组织建立更紧密的联系，并指出，阿富汗商人起初会遇到俄罗斯贸易特殊性的困难，但不应气馁。两国应维护共同利益。马利舍夫同志还希望来年双方贸易将大幅增加。
哈基莫夫（Hakimoff，音译）先生作为阿富汗商人的代表下一个发言，他对商人们说道：“我们应当遵守我们居住并与其有商业往来的国家的法律”。“苏俄与阿富汗之间缺乏贸易协定对贸易利益非常有害。我们愉快地获悉，阿曼努拉汗（Padishah Amanulla-Khan）陛下已声明，上述性质的谈判已接近尾声并取得令人满意的结果”。
哈基莫夫先生还强调了消除现有贸易、运输等方法中障碍的必要性。
列扎瓦（Lejawa，音译）同志在总结时建议在商会内成立一个阿富汗分部，由阿富汗商人和苏联贸易组织代表参加。

大英帝国的殖民问题。

上述第一点是反对民族革命运动及苏联，英国在其中发现它是“东方民族革命的煽动者和保障”。
第二点在于美国帝国主义的系统性增长，这导致美国的爪子伸入英国殖民地统治的核心。美国近期对南京政府采取的行动迫使英国对华政策发生某种转变，英国外交界对此的感受同样强烈，正如当

America tries to penetrate South America, Africa and even India.
Thus the struggle for the maintenance of Colonial Empire is
double for the British diplomats viz: against U.S.S.R. and
U.S.A. This struggle is of vital importance for Great Britain
at the present time, for, on its depends the preservation of
the British Empire as it is to-day.

Japan and China Tariff Autonomy Negotiations.

When China proposed preliminary sanction for the increase
of Customs Tariff, the Japanese Government replied by a counter-
demand namely a guarantee, prior to negotiations, of the payment
of loans which have no security and were granted by Japan. This
demand is not the first of its kind. It has been invariably
brought forward by Japan whenever China made any attempt at
increasing the Customs tariff. This was also particularly
emphasized by the Japanese delegation at the Customs Conference
in 1925-26 when it was proposed to increase the tariff only
2½ %. China's debt without security amounted at the end of 1925
from 400 to 700 million Chinese dollars. Two thirds of this
sum are Japan's share. The most important are considered the
famous "Nishihara" loans granted in 1918, which really represented
ordinary subsidies to Japanese appointed men in Chinese
political field, who held power then. About 140 million Yen
of these loans were spent on briberies and political adventures
and the Chinese people are against recognizing them. Japan now
is attempting once more to bring forth this matter as a counter
claim, which is meant to paralyze Chinese demands. In the near
future an interesting development of happenings should be
expected connected with the Japan-China relations on the one
hand and the Customs question on the other.

因此，对于英国外交官而言，维持殖民帝国的斗争是双重的，即针对苏联和美国。这场斗争对当前的大英帝国至关重要，因为当今大英帝国的存续取决于此。

日本与中国关税自主谈判。

当中国提出初步批准增加海关关税时，日本政府以反向要求作为回应，即在谈判之前，保证偿还由日本提供的无担保贷款。这种要求并非首次提出。每当中国尝试增加海关关税时，日本 invariably 都会提出这一要求。在1925-26年的海关会议上，当提议仅增加2½%的关税时，日本代表团特别强调了这一点。截至1925年底，中国的无担保债务金额在4亿至7亿中国元之间。这笔款项的三分之二是日本的份额。其中最重要的是1918年提供的著名的“西原借款”（Nishihara loans），这些借款实际上是对当时掌权的中国政界中由日本任命的人物的普通补贴。这些借款中约有1.4亿日元用于贿赂和政治冒险，中国人民反对承认这些借款。日本现在试图再次提出此事作为反索赔，旨在瘫痪中国的要求。在不久的将来，预计会出现与中日关系一方面及关税问题另一方面有关的有趣事态发展。

Translation from the "Izvestia" of September 30, 1928.

At the 5th Congress of KIM the necessity to organize
a secretariat to deal with matters pertaining to Latin America
was recognized. It was decided to establish connections
by means of new sections and the improvement of those already
in existence. It was also decided to exchange representatives
between the Young Communists of United States of America and
Latin America and despatch propagandists from the former to
the latter part of the country. The Conference also discussed
military matters and tactics.

----------

There is a yearly book in publication entitled The
Komintern which deals with Economics, Politics, Labour
Movement etc. in Capitalistic countries for the years 1924
to 1927. Leading articles written by members of the Komintern
acquaint the reader with the present condition of labour
movement in Capitalistic countries and also give an idea
of the problems of the Komintern. Then follows information
on economics and the rest of the book deals with description
of the bourgeois countries and in the matter of knowledge
and inquiry appears perhaps the best part of the book. Our
readers are always on the lookout for information about
political parties of some country or another and fail to
find this easily. The book on Komintern gives all this
information about every country concerned although in a
brief form.

"The Red Banner"
Vladivostock, October 11, 1927.
（批：C... No. I. O. 9199 Date 10 ...）

Across the Chinese provinces.

The police ARE alarmed. The Shanghai Municipal Police has one good habit: every month it publishes reports about its "highly useful" activities during the preceding month, gives the number of cases of larceny and robberies committed, the attitude of Shanghai workers, the "social movements", secret devices plotted by the communists and by other "enemies of law and order" etc. Of course one cannot take these reports too seriously. They are compiled from the reports of open or secret detectives, informers and agents. These informers, certainly, know little about the workers' attitude or communist movement. However what is unknown and incomprehensible to them they invent out of their police imagination or, in some instances, withhold from publication declaring that certain matters declaring that "this is not for publication". It is certainly impossible to verify statements made by the police. Sometimes however their reports are not devoid of interest or importance.

To-day we received the most recent issue of these Police reports for the month of August. We will not weary our readers by recounting the police statistics regarding the number of burglars and prostitutes arrested, regarding secret public houses and gambling dens detected or closed by the Police, or that by far the greater number of thieves and prostitutes remain at large, or that the greater number of dens and public houses continue to exist with the full knowledge and assent of this same Police and under its very nose. We will direct our attention to that part of the report which contains that highly promising headline: "Communism" with which the Police commence their political report.

"The murder of a Chinese official informer, which recently took place, and the arrival of four Chinese communist leaders from Moscow show that the activities of local communists, in spite of repressions adopted by the Chinese administration, continue to exist!"

Such an introduction instills fear into the hearts of the local foreign and Chinese bourgeoisie of whom one may say with full justice: they are as "thievish as a cat and as timid as a hare". After this short but significant introduction the official report on some events follows. The Police accuses the Shanghai communists of distributing leaflets on the occasion of the anniversary of the execution of Sacco and Vanzetti ("two Italian Communists" - the Police explains - condemned and executed by the U.S.A. Government) and of propagating the movement to overthrow all authority in existence. The main fault of the Communists however is not this. "Although there were only twelve strikes and one walkout during this month and normal conditions were established at the end of the month the report states - however there is plenty of evidence that an extensive campaign to shake the workers' loyalty and entice them over to the communists' camp is being carried out".

In order to prove this statement the Police reports about the strike of 200 ricshawmen who by means of a strike wished to cause the Company to modify the rate of exchange of silver dollar fixed by it. Three of these strikers were arrested, as a matter of course, and then events began to develop very speedily. On the same day, the ricshawmen broke the window panes of the Company's office and marched along the street carrying banners upon which were inscribed, in bold letters, slogans summoning the ricshawmen to strike.

In the middle of the month another strike occurred: 400 female

遍及中国各省。

警方感到恐慌。上海公共租界工部局警务处有一个好习惯：每月发布关于其在上个月“极其有益”活动的报告，列出发生的盗窃和抢劫案件数量、上海工人的态度、“社会运动”、共产党人及其他“法律与秩序之敌”策划的秘密手段等。当然，人们不能太把这些报告当真。这些报告是根据公开或秘密侦探、线人和特工的报告汇编而成的。这些线人无疑对工人的态度或共产主义运动知之甚少。然而，对于那些他们未知且无法理解的事情，他们便凭警察的想象力杜撰出来，或者在某些情况下以宣称某些事项“不予刊登”为由扣留不报。要核实警方所作的陈述显然是不可能的。不过，他们的报告有时并非毫无趣味或重要性。

今天，我们收到了这些警方报告中最新的一期，即八月份的报告。我们不会通过复述警方关于被捕窃贼和妓女数量的统计数据、关于被警方发现或查封的秘密妓院和赌窟、或者关于绝大多数窃贼和妓女仍然逍遥法外、以及绝大多数此类场所和妓院在这同一警方的完全知情和默许下并在其眼皮底下继续存在的事实，来使我们的读者感到厌倦。我们将把注意力集中在报告中包含那个极具希望的大标题的部分：“共产主义”，警方以此开始其政治报告。

“最近发生的一名中国官方线人被谋杀事件，以及四名中国共产党领导人从莫斯科抵达，表明尽管中国当局采取了镇压措施，当地共产党人的活动仍在继续！”

这样的开场白让当地的外国和中国资产阶级心中充满了恐惧，对于这些人，我们可以公正地说：他们“像猫一样狡猾，像兔子一样胆小”。在这段简短但意义重大的引言之后，接着是关于一些事件的正式报告。警方指责上海共产党人在萨科和万泽蒂（“两名意大利共产党人”——警方解释道——被美国政府判处死刑并执行）被执行死刑周年纪念日之际散发传单，并宣传推翻现存一切权威的运动。然而，共产党人的主要过错并不在此。“尽管本月仅发生了十二次罢工和一次怠工，且在月底已恢复正常状况——报告称——但有充分证据表明，一场旨在动摇工人忠诚度并诱使他们加入共产党阵营的大规模运动正在进行中”。

为了证明这一说法，警方报告了200名人力车夫的罢工事件，他们希望通过罢工迫使公司修改其固定的银元汇率。理所当然地，其中三名罢工者被捕，随后事态迅速升级。同日，人力车夫砸碎了公司办公室的玻璃窗，并举着横幅沿街游行，横幅上用醒目的大字写着号召人力车夫罢工的标语。

本月月中旬发生了另一次罢工：400名女

pages.en:
2.
mill workers, desiring to swell their ranks, walked to another mill,
whose workers had not joined the strike. They broke the window panes
and forced the female workers to join them. As the result 5000 female
workers struck work. In fact the Police feel little sympathy towards
female workers. As a matter of fact, has it ever been seen that females
conduct themselves in such an indecent manner in respectable society.
And in addition to disporting "their vehement nature" these female
workers appear to be highly unreliable. They struck work on the 15th,
and resumed work on the 16th, and on the 17th they again
struck then resumed work only on the 20th. Such unnecessary work and
trouble for the Police ! So many sleepless nights for the Police
supervisors !

The Police speak warmly and feelingly about their valiant work,
the role played by them in strikes and communist movements and declare
that they render every possible assistance to the Chinese administration
in preserving order; what is this "assistance" to which they refer ?

By the request of the Chinese authorities the Municipal Police arres-
ted a Chinese Communist and handed him over to the Chinese. Two
Chinese were arrested for having posted up leaflets and were sentenced
to one month imprisonment after which they were to be handed over to
the Chinese authorities. 21 persons were arrested in connection with the
strikes and all were charged with having attempted to bring about the
strike, for obstructing the normal working of the factories and
distributing proclamations, urging the workers to go on strike.
Twelve of the arrested were sentenced to imprisonment, others were
fined. This "hand-made" work probably little satisfies the highly
developed sensitiveness of the local Police, who are accustomed to
much greater fields of activity. They therefore effected arrest of 16
members of various Trade Unions who were charged by the Chinese autho-
rities for having plotted against the safety of the State. They were
immediately handed over to the Chinese Military Authorities and their
ultimate fate is unknown. One can only conjecture it.

The month of September did not relieve the "difficult and respon-
sible situation" of the Police. We do not possess the official Police
report on the activities in September, but it is well known from
newspaper reports that, in addition to the usual strikes, agitation
and propaganda activities of the Communists and organising work by
the Trade Unions, several student demonstrations and clashes with the
police occurred during this month.

These took place on the first Sunday of September, on the day of
Communist Young Men's Association. A large crowd of students assembled
in the main street of the town, distributed proclamations, shouted
slogans and conducted themselves as people always do on such occasions.
The Police effected several arrests. On the following Sunday these
demonstrations were repeated. This time the number of students was
considerably greater. Their spirit was more heightened. They took
no heed of the Police orders to disperse and when the Police began
to take action the youths threw stones at them and also at the tramways.
As usual a great number of the youths were arrested . The Police now
expects this "forward movement" very Sunday. The surprise was very
great when yesterday, for, despite it being Sunday, no demonstrations
took place. The newspapers which usually report only events which
have already taken place, thought it necessary on this occasion to
report the disappointment experienced by the Police, who made all the
necessary preparations to cope with the expected trouble. Both the
Police and the Press were puzzled. September proved to be the most
critical month in the life of the students. During this month large
numbers of students flock into the big centres - especially Shanghai -
from all parts of China. Students commence, students' societies become
active and the student's mind seek answers to all the unsolved
questions. The Kuomintang press in an alarmed manner is watching
pages.zh:
2.
工，为了壮大队伍，走向另一家未参与罢工的工厂。她们砸碎玻璃窗，强迫女工加入她们。结果导致5000名女工罢工。事实上，警方对女工鲜有同情。事实上，在体面的社会中，何曾见过女性行为如此不端。此外，除了放纵她们“激烈的本性”外，这些女工似乎极不可靠。她们在15日罢工，16日复工，17日再次罢工，直到20日才复工。给警方带来这么多不必要的麻烦和工作！让警司们度过了多少个不眠之夜！

警方热情而感性地谈论他们的英勇工作、他们在罢工和共产主义运动中所扮演的角色，并宣称他们向中国当局提供一切可能的协助以维持秩序；他们所指的这种“协助”是什么？

应中国当局的要求，公共租界警务处逮捕了一名中国共产党人并将其移交给中方。两名中国人因张贴传单被捕，并被判处一个月监禁，之后将被移交给中国当局。21人因与罢工有关而被捕，所有人均被指控企图引发罢工、阻碍工厂正常运作以及分发号召工人罢工的宣言。被捕者中有十二人被判处监禁，其他人被罚款。这种“手工制造”的工作可能很难满足当地警方高度发达的敏感度，他们习惯于更大范围的活动领域。因此，他们逮捕了16名各工会成员，这些人被中国当局指控阴谋危害国家安全。他们随即被移交给中国军事当局，其最终命运不得而知。人们只能对此进行猜测。

九月份并未缓解警方面临的“困难且责任重大的局势”。我们没有警方关于九月份活动的正式报告，但从报纸报道中众所周知，除了通常的罢工、共产党人的煽动和宣传活动以及工会的组织工作外，本月还发生了几起学生示威以及与警方的冲突。

这些事件发生在九月的第一个星期日，即共产主义青年团协会日。大批学生聚集在市中心的主要街道上，分发宣言，高呼口号，其行为如同人们在此类场合一贯的表现。警方实施了数次逮捕。在接下来的星期日，这些示威活动再次上演。这次学生人数 considerably 更多。他们的情绪更加高涨。他们无视警方解散的命令，当警方开始采取行动时，青年们向警方以及电车投掷石块。照例，大量青年被捕。警方现在预计每个星期日都会出现这种“前进运动”。昨天令人非常惊讶的是，尽管是星期日，却没有发生示威活动。通常只报道已发生事件的报纸，认为有必要在此时报道警方所经历的失望，警方为应对预期的麻烦做了所有必要的准备。警方和新闻界都感到困惑。九月被证明是学生生活中最关键的月份。在此期间，来自中国各地的学生涌入大城市中心——尤其是上海。学生们开始行动，学生社团变得活跃，学生的思想寻求所有未解问题的答案。国民党报刊正警觉地注视着

pages.en:
3.
which path the students will select i.e. the path of study, or will
engage themselves in political and social work, as the students were in
the habit of doing in the past.

Special magazines and newspapers, Government orders, essays and
lectures - all these have been put into motion to prevent students from
falling under communist influence. The Police are assisting in this
work according to their ability and capacity. During the past few days
thorough searches were effected by the Police in Students' lodgings,
boarding houses, Universities and a lot of communist literature was
seized and some students' leaders arrested.

Whether all these measures, moral and physical, adopted by the
Chinese Kuomintang and the Police of the French Concession and Inter-
national Settlement will have any effect can only be seen during the
academic year which has just started.-

学生们将选择哪条道路，即是求学之路，还是像过去习惯那样投身于政治和社会工作。

专门的杂志和报纸、政府命令、文章和讲座——所有这些都已被动员起来，以防止学生受到共产主义影响。警方正在根据其能力和权限协助这项工作。在过去几天里，警方对学生宿舍、寄宿公寓、大学进行了彻底搜查，查获了大量共产主义文献，并逮捕了一些学生领袖。

中国国民党以及法租界和公共租界警方采取的所有这些道德和物理措施是否会产生任何效果，只能在刚刚开始的学年期间才能看出。-

P R O G R A M M E
OF THE COMMUNIST INTERNATIONAL
adopted by the Sixth Congress on September 1, 1928.
(Izvestia, September 5, 1928).

I N T R O D U C T I O N.

The epoch of militarism is one marked by the slow death of capitalism. The World War of 1914-1918 and the general crisis of capitalism, which it has created as the direct result of acute contradictions between the growth of productive forces of world economy and its frontiers (tariff walls) have shown and proved that the material foundations of socialism have already ripened in capitalistic society, that the capitalist cloak has become the unbearable fetters arresting the further development of humanity and the outstanding revolutionary problem as mirrored by history to-day is the overthrow of the yoke of capitalism.

Imperialism subjugates enormous masses of the proletariat of all countries, from capitalism's centres of power to the remotest corners of the colonial world, under the plutocratic dictatorship of finance and capitalism. Imperialism reveals and augments with an elementary vigour all the contradictions existing in capitalist society. It reduces class oppression to the utmost limits, increases the struggle between capitalist states to its greatest intensity and renders imperialist wars on a world-wide scale inevitable, shakes the foundations of existing order and is leading with the destiny of fate to the universal proletarian revolution.

By fettering the whole world with the chains of financing capital, by coercing the proletariat of all countries and all peoples and races, by selling them to its yoke by means of iron, blood and famine, by enormously augmenting the exploitation, oppression and enslavement of the proletariat and always reminding the latter of the outstanding problem, i.e., seizure of power, imperialism is creating the necessity for the workers to unite more closely themselves into an unique international army of proletarians of all countries, independent of state frontiers, national, cultural, linguistic or local distinctions or even those of sex or profession. Imperialism, while thus developing, and completing the process of the creation of material foundations of socialism, is simultaneously preparing an army of its own grave-diggers by causing the proletariat to organize themselves into an International Association of Labourers.

On the other hand, Imperialism is enticing the wealthiest so/
pages.zh:
纲 领
共产国际
由1928年9月1日第六次代表大会通过。
（《消息报》，1928年9月5日）。

导 言。

军国主义时代是资本主义缓慢死亡的时代。1914-1918年的世界大战以及由此产生的资本主义总危机，是世界经济生产力增长与其界限（关税壁垒）之间尖锐矛盾的直接结果，这场战争显示并证明了社会主义的物质基础在资本主义社会中已经成熟，资本主义的外衣已成为阻碍人类进一步发展的难以忍受的枷锁，而历史今天所反映出的突出革命问题就是推翻资本主义的桎梏。

帝国主义将各国庞大的无产阶级群众，从资本主义的权力中心到殖民世界最偏远的角落，都置于金融资本和资本主义的财阀独裁之下。帝国主义以一种原始的力量揭示并加剧了资本主义社会中存在的所有矛盾。它将阶级压迫推向极限，使资本主义国家之间的斗争达到最大强度，并使世界规模的帝国主义战争成为不可避免，动摇了现有秩序的基础，并注定要走向普遍的无产阶级革命。

通过用金融资本的链条束缚整个世界，通过胁迫所有国家、所有民族和种族的无产阶级，通过铁、血和饥荒的手段将他们卖身为奴，通过极大地增加对无产阶级的剥削、压迫和奴役，并不断提醒后者注意那个突出的问题，即夺取政权，帝国主义使得工人有必要更紧密地团结起来，组成一支独特的国际无产阶级大军，不受国家边界、民族、文化、语言或地方差异，甚至性别或职业差异的影响。帝国主义在这样发展和完善社会主义物质基础创造过程的同时，也通过促使无产阶级组织成国际劳动者协会，为自己准备了一支掘墓人大军。

另一方面，帝国主义正在引诱最富有的劳/

pages.en:
-2-
of the labor class away from the main working mass. Bribed and
corrupted by Imperialism the head of the labour class, consisting
of the leaders of the social-democratic party, who are interested
in imperialist plunder of the colonies and are loyal to "their own"
bourgeoisie and to "their own" imperialist state, joined the
proletariat's enemy during the decisive class battles. The split in
the socialist movement in 1914, produced by perfidy and by subse-
quent treacheries committed by social democratic parties which latter
practically became bourgeois labour parties, has demonstrated that
the international proletariat can fulfil its historic mission, namely,
overthrow the imperialist yoke and conquer the dictatorship of the
proletariat, only by an unmerciful struggle against social democracy.
The organisation of forces of the international revolution can only
be achieved on the basis of communism. The Second International of
Social Democracy, which became an imperialist agent in the ranks
of the labour class , has been replaced by the Third Communist Inter-
national, which is the international organization of the labouring
classes and embodies the authentic unity of the revolutionary mas-
ses throughout the world.

The War of 1914-1918 prompted the first attempts at the creation
of a new revolutionary international to offset the Second, the So-
cial-chauvinistic, International, and to act as a weapon to resist
militant imperialism (Zimmerwald, Kienthal). The victorious Russian
revolution of the proletariat has served as a stimulant to the
creation of Communist Parties in capitalist countries and in the
colonies. The Communist International was established in 1919,
which, for the first time in History, has developed into a practical
revolutionary struggle and has united the advanced elements of
European and American proletariats with those of China and India
and with the black-skinned toilers of Africa and America.

The Communist International - the unique and centralised inter-
national party of the proletariats - is the only perpetrator of the
principles of the First International, established on a new mass
basis of the revolutionary proletarian movement. Experience gained
from the first imperialist war and from the succeeding period of
revolutionary crises of capitalism, the experience of a number of
revolutions in Europe and colonial countries, combined with the
experience acquired by the dictatorship of proletariat in the
socialist transformation in U.S.S.R. and also the experience gained
from all work by the sections of the Communist International, which
work has been consolidated in the resolutions of the Communist Inter-
national's Congresses, and finally the international character of
the struggle between the imperialist bourgeoisie and the proletariat,
all call for the necessity to create an unique and common pro-
gramme for all sections of the Communist International. In this the
programme of the Communist International, which is the greatest
generalization of historical experience acquired by the international
revolutionary movement of the proletariat, is one for the struggle
for the dictatorship of the world proletariat, namely - the programme
for the struggle for world communism.

The Communist International, which unites the revolutionary
labourers and leads the million masses of oppressed and exploited
toilers against the bourgeoisie and its "socialist" agents, claims
to be the historical successor to the "Union of the Communists" and
to the First International, which was directed and guided by Karl
Marx, and is also successor to the best pre-war traditions of the
Second International. The First International laid the foundations
of the international proletarian struggle for socialism. The Second
International, during its zenith, prepared the soil for the extensive
propagation of the labour movement. The Third, Communist, Interna-
tional, continuing the work of the First International and absorbing
the fruits of the work of the Second International, has stripped
this latter of its opportunism, its social-chauvinism and its
bourgeois perversion of socialism and started realizing the realiza-
pages.zh:

动阶级阶层脱离主要的劳动大众。工人阶级的头部，由社会民主党领袖组成，他们被帝国主义贿赂和腐蚀，热衷于对殖民地的帝国主义掠夺，并忠于“他们自己的”资产阶级和“他们自己的”帝国主义国家，在决定性的阶级战斗中加入了无产阶级的敌人。1914年社会主义运动的分裂，是由社会民主党的背信弃义及随后的背叛行为造成的，这些政党实际上变成了资产阶级劳工政党，这一分裂表明，国际无产阶级只有通过对社会民主主义的无情斗争，才能完成其历史使命，即推翻帝国主义桎梏并赢得无产阶级专政。国际革命力量的组织只能在共产主义的基础上实现。社会民主党的第二国际已成为劳工阶级队伍中的帝国主义代理人，它已被第三共产国际所取代，后者是劳动阶级的国际组织，体现了全世界革命群众的真正统一。

1914-1918年的战争促使人们首次尝试建立一个新的革命国际，以抵消第二国际即社会沙文主义国际，并作为抵抗好战帝国主义的武器（齐美尔瓦尔德、昆塔尔）。俄国无产阶级革命的胜利刺激了资本主义国家和殖民地共产党组织的建立。共产国际于1919年成立，它在历史上第一次发展成为实际的革命斗争，并将欧美无产阶级的先进分子与中国和印度的先进分子以及非洲和美洲的黑人劳动者联合起来。

共产国际——无产阶级唯一且集中的国际政党——是在革命无产阶级运动新的群众基础上建立的第一国际原则的唯一执行者。从第一次帝国主义战争和随后的资本主义革命危机时期获得的经验，欧洲和殖民地国家多次革命的经验，结合苏联社会主义转型中无产阶级专政获得的经验，以及从共产国际各支部所有工作中获得的经验（这些工作已巩固在共产国际代表大会的决议中），最后，帝国主义资产阶级与无产阶级之间斗争的国际性质，都要求有必要为共产国际所有支部制定一个独特且共同的纲领。在此，共产国际纲领作为国际无产阶级革命运动所获得的历史经验的最大概括，是为争取世界无产阶级专政而斗争的纲领，即——为争取世界共产主义而斗争的纲领。

共产国际团结革命劳动者，领导数百万受压迫和被剥削的劳动者反对资产阶级及其“社会主义”代理人，它声称自己是卡尔·马克思指导和领导的“共产主义者同盟”和第一国际的历史继承者，也是第二国际战前最佳传统的继承者。第一国际奠定了国际无产阶级为社会主义而斗争的基础。第二国际在其鼎盛时期，为劳工运动的广泛传播准备了土壤。第三共产国际在继续第一国际的工作并吸收第二国际工作成果的同时，剔除了后者的机会主义、社会沙文主义及其对社会主义的资产阶级歪曲，并开始实现实

pages.en:
-3-
tion of the dictatorship of the proletariat. In this manner the Commu-
nist International continues to foster the glorious heroic traditions
of the international labour movement, of the British Chartists and
French rebels of 1871, of the French and German labour-revolutionists
of 1848, of the everlasting fighters and martyrs of the Paris Commune,
of these gallant soldiers of the German, Hungarian and Finnish revolu-
tions, of labourers of the defunct Czarist despotism, these victo-
rious standard bearers of the proletarian dictatorship and lastly, of
the Chinese proletariat- those heroes of Canton and Shanghai.

Relying upon historic experience acquired from the revolutionary
labour movement in all countries and by all peoples, the Communist
International in its theoretical and practical work wholly and unreser-
vedly supported the point of view of Revolutionary Marxism, which
subsequently developed into Leninism, which latter is simply Marxism
adapted to epoch of Imperialism and of proletarian revolutions.

By defending and propagating the dialectic materialism of Marx-En-
gels, and by applying it as a revolutionary method in acquiring the
knowledge necessary for the purpose of revolution, reformation, the
Communist International has carried on an active struggle against all
sorts of bourgeois world conceptions as also against all manner of
theoretical and practical opportunism. By holding to the persistent
class struggle of the proletariat, by subordinating the transitory,
partial, grouping and national interests of the proletariat to their
permanent, general and international interests, the Communist Internatio-
nal has unmercifully laid bare in its various forms the theory of
"class peace" borrowed by the reformists from the bourgeoisie. The
Communist International being the realization of the historical neces-
sity of international organization of the revolutionary proletariats,
the death knell of the capitalistic system, is the sole international
force which has as its programme the dictatorship of proletariat and
communism and which openly steps forward as the organizer of the
international proletarian revolution.

I. THE WORLD CAPITALIST SYSTEM, ITS DEVELOPMENT AND
INEVITABLE RUIN.

1. General laws of the development of capitalism and era
of industrial capital.

Capitalist society, formed on the basis of the development of the
production of goods, can be characterized as a monopoly, possessed by
the capitalistic and powerful land-owners class over the most important
and effective means of production, exploiting the hired labour of the
proletarian class, who are deprived of the means of production and are
compelled to sell their labour, producing goods for profit without
plan, anarchism of the process of production in the whole. Exploitation
and economic domination of the bourgeoisie are politically expressed in
organized capital as an instrument to suppress the proletariat.

The history of capitalism entirely justified the Marxian theory
of the laws governing the development of the capitalist society and
of the contradictions to this development, which are dragging the
entire capitalist system to its inevitable ruin.

In pursuit of profit the bourgeoisie have been obliged to develop
the productive forces on an ever increasing scale in order to streng-
then and widen the domination of the productive relations of capital.
In this manner the development of the capitalist system is constantly
reproducing internal contradictions, the most important of which are
those existing between the social character of the labour and the
pages.zh:
-3-
无产阶级专政。以此方式，共产国际继续培育国际劳工运动的光荣英雄传统，包括英国宪章派和1871年法国反叛者、1848年法国和德国劳工革命家、巴黎公社的永恒战士与烈士、德国、匈牙利和芬兰革命的英勇士兵、已故沙皇专制制度下的劳工，这些无产阶级专政的胜利旗手，以及最后，中国无产阶级——广州和上海的英雄们。

依靠从各国和各民族革命劳工运动中获取的历史经验，共产国际在其理论和实践工作中完全且毫无保留地支持革命马克思主义的观点，该观点随后发展为列宁主义，而后者仅仅是适应帝国主义和无产阶级革命时代的马克思主义。

通过捍卫和传播马克思-恩格斯的辩证唯物主义，并将其作为一种革命方法应用于获取革命和改革所需的知识，共产国际对各种资产阶级世界观以及各种形式的理论和实践机会主义进行了积极的斗争。通过坚持无产阶级持续的阶级斗争，将无产阶级暂时的、局部的、集团的和民族的利益服从于其永久的、一般的和国际的利益，共产国际无情地揭露了改良主义者从资产阶级那里借来的各种形式的“阶级和平”理论。共产国际作为革命无产阶级国际组织的历史必然性的实现，是资本主义体系的丧钟，是唯一以无产阶级专政和共产主义为纲领，并公开作为国际无产阶级革命组织者出现的国际力量。

一、世界资本主义体系，其发展与必然灭亡。

1. 资本主义发展的一般规律与工业资本时代。

建立在商品生产发展基础上的资本主义社会，其特征是资本主义和强大的地主阶级垄断最重要和最有效的生产资料，剥削被剥夺生产资料并被迫出卖劳动力的无产阶级阶级的雇佣劳动，无计划地为利润生产商品，整个生产过程处于无政府状态。资产阶级的剥削和经济统治在政治上表现为有组织的资本，作为镇压无产阶级的工具。

资本主义的历史完全证实了马克思关于支配资本主义社会发展的规律以及导致整个资本主义体系走向必然灭亡的发展矛盾的理论。

为了追求利润，资产阶级不得不以日益扩大的规模发展生产力，以加强和扩大资本生产关系的统治。以此方式，资本主义体系的发展不断再生产出内部矛盾，其中最重要的是劳动的社会性质与

pages.en:
-4-
private character of appropriation and between the growth of produc-
tive forces and the property relations of capitalism.
The domination of private ownership over the means of production
and the anarchical-elementary trend of this production have resulted
in disturbing the economic equilibrium existing between different
branches of industry in respect to the development of contradictions
between the tendencies towards unlimited scopes of production and the
limited capacity of consumption of the proletariat (general over-pro-
duction) which have led to the occurrence of devastating crises and
mass unemployment. The domination of private property also expressed
itself in the form of competition with in separate capitalist countri-
es, as also in the world markets.

This latter form of capitalist competition resulted in a series
of wars,- the inevitable companion to capitalist development.
On the other hand, the technical and economic advantages of mass pro-
duction have resulted in ruining or eliminating by competition the
pre-war forms of capitalist economy and have necessitated the ever-
increasing concentration and centralisation of capital.

In industry this law of concentration and capitalization is to
be seen, first of all, in the scrapping of small industrial plants
or in their allocation to the role of subsidiary units serving mass
production. In agriculture which naturally remained backward in the
general course of development owing to the existence of monopolized
land and absolute rent, this law manifested itself not only in the
process of differentiating the peasantry and proletarianizing its broad
masses, but, chiefly in open and secret strategy that makes the
small peasant holder subservient to amassed capital. The small agri-
culturist or tenant-holder can only retain mere shadow of independence
by means of intensified labour and systematic underfeeding.

The ever increasing use of machinery, the progressive improvement
in technics and the incessant advancement in the structure of capital,
accompanied by an increasing division of labour and its increased
productiveness have resulted in the employment of woman and child la-
bour; in the accumulation of a large reserve of the industrial army
which is being constantly recruited from among the proletariat, the
village peasants and from bankrupt small and middle bourgeoisie of
cities; the creation of a group of monied magnates at one end of so-
cial scale, and of a gigantic proletarian mass - at the other; the
incessant increase in the exploitation of the labour class, the reappea-
rance of deeply rooted contradictions in capital and their sequences
(crises, wars etc), the constant growth of social inequalities, the
increasing disgust of the population by the mechanical life of capi-
talist production,- all these are inevitably undermining capitalism
and accelerating its ruin.

Simultaneously a radical revolution has been in progress in the
social and cultural structure of capitalist society: decomposition
of parasitic groups of stock-holder bourgeoisie; decomposition of
family life as a manifestation of the growth of contradictions between
increased employment of women in industrial production and the forms
of family life, inherited chiefly from former economic epochs, the
growing degeneration of cultural life as the result of specialisation
of labour, abnormal development of cities and narrowness of village
life; supineness of the bourgeoisie, in spite of the enormous succes-
ses achieved in the region of positive science, to create synthetic
scientific world-conception; the growth of idealist, mystic and reli-
gious superstitions, - all these facts are heralding the approach
of the collapse of the capitalist system.
pages.zh:
