占有的私人性质之间的矛盾，以及生产力增长与资本主义财产关系之间的矛盾。
生产资料的私有制统治以及这种生产的无政府-自发趋势，导致了不同工业部门之间经济平衡的破坏，就无限扩大生产的趋势与无产阶级有限的消费能力（普遍生产过剩）之间的矛盾发展而言，这导致了毁灭性危机和大规模失业的发生。私有制的统治还表现为各资本主义国家内部以及世界市场上的竞争形式。

后一种形式的资本主义竞争导致了一系列战争，这是资本主义发展不可避免的伴侣。
另一方面，大规模生产的技术和经济优势导致战前形式的资本主义经济因竞争而破产或被淘汰，并 necessitated（使得）资本的不断集中和中心化。

在工业中，这种集中和资本化规律首先体现在小型工业设施的报废，或将其分配为服务于大规模生产的附属单位。在农业中，由于垄断土地和绝对地租的存在，其在总体发展进程中自然保持落后，这一规律不仅体现在农民分化和广大民众无产阶级化的过程中，而且主要体现在使小农持有人屈从于积聚资本的公开和秘密策略上。小农业经营者或佃户只能通过强化劳动和系统性营养不良来维持独立的 mere shadow（微弱影子）。

机器的使用日益增加，技术不断进步，资本结构 incessant advancement（持续进步），伴随着劳动分工的加剧及其生产率的提高，导致了妇女和儿童劳动力的雇用；积累了大量的工业后备军，这些后备军不断从无产者、乡村农民以及城市破产的小中和资产阶级中招募；在社会阶梯的一端创造了一群金融巨头，而在另一端则形成了庞大的无产阶级群众；对劳动阶级剥削的不断增加，资本中根深蒂固的矛盾及其后果（危机、战争等）的再现，社会不平等的不断增长，民众对资本主义机械化生活的日益厌恶——所有这些都不可避免地削弱资本主义并加速其灭亡。

同时，资本主义社会的社会和文化结构正在发生根本性变革：股东资产阶级寄生群体的分解；家庭生活的分解，表现为妇女在工业生产中的就业增加与主要继承自以前经济时代的家庭生活形式之间矛盾的增长；文化生活的日益堕落，这是劳动专业化、城市异常发展和乡村生活狭隘性的结果；尽管在实证科学领域取得了巨大成功，资产阶级却无力创造综合的科学世界观；唯心主义、神秘主义和宗教迷信的增长——所有这些事实都预示着资本主义体系崩溃的临近。

2. Epoch of financial capital (imperialism).

The period of industrial capitalism was essentially one of "free competition", a period of comparatively smooth evolution and expansion of capital throughout the world rendered possible by the sharing of yet unoccupied colonies or their armed seizure together with the incessant growth of internal contradictions of capitalism, the burden of which contradictions has been pressing chiefly upon the systematically plundered, oppressed and strangled colonial periphery. This period was substituted at the beginning of the 20th century by the period of imperialism, which was one of leaps and bounds in the development of capitalism, when free competition quickly surrendered its place to monopolies, when all the heretofore "free" colonies had already been divided up, when the struggle for the re-partitioning of colonies and spheres of influence unavoidably assumed the form of armed competition.

In this manner the contradictions of capitalism in all their ramifications and in a world wide scale found their definite expression in the epoch of imperialism (financial capitalism), which signifies the historical creation of a new form of capitalism; the establishment of new relations between various parts of the world capitalist economy and the principal classes of the capitalist society in their new aspect.

This new historic period came into existence on the basis of most important laws of development of capitalist society. It has sprung up from the development of industrial capitalism as its resultant historic continuation. It has heightened all the main tendencies and laws of motion of capitalism, all its basic contradictions and antagonisms. The law of concentration of contradictions of capital has created powerful unions of monopolies (cartels, syndicates, trusts etc.) new forms of combined gigantic enterprises brought under the single control of the banks. The grafting of industrial capital with that of the banks, the concentration of powerful landownership into a general system of capital organizations and the monopolist character of this form of capitalism have transformed the epoch of industrial capital into that of financial. "Free competition" of industrial capitalism which has substituted feudal monopoly and the monopoly of the commercial capital, has transformed itself into the monopoly of financial capital. But simultaneously capitalist monopolies, which sprang from free competition do not repel them, but exist over and besides them creating a number of important and acute contradictions, frictions and conflicts.

The increase in the use of complicated machinery, chemical processes electric energy; the increase of the organic structure of the capital as a result, and the drop in the level of profits caused by this which is temporarily paralyzed only with respect to the largest monopolies concerns by a policy of high cartel prices, produce a further race for colonial extra-profits and a struggle for a new partition of the world. The standardized mass production demands new foreign markets for the consumption of goods. The increasing demand for raw materials and fuel produces a vital rush for these sources. Finally, the system of high tariff protection which obstructs the export of goods and secures additional profits for export capital, creates the additional stimuli for export capital. That is why export capital now is becoming a decisive and specific form of economic bonds between different parts of capitalist world economy. Lastly, the monopolists' possession of colonial markets and of the sources of raw material are extremely increasing the general inequality of capitalist development to the utmost degree and are heightening the conflicts between the "great powers" of finance capital for the repartition of colonies and spheres of influence.

The growth of productive forces of world economy is thus leading to the further internationalization of economic life and at the same time to the struggle for the re-partition of the world (which was formerly divided among the big states of financial capital) and to a change in and heightening of the forms of that struggle and also to an alteration in the methods of lowering prices by means of forcible pressure (boycott, high tariff protection, custom conflicts, wars etc.). The monopolist form of capital consequently is accompanied by unavoidable imperialist wars which, by their proportions and destructive technical power, have no precedent in the history of the world.

2. 金融资本时代（帝国主义）。

工业资本主义时期本质上是“自由竞争”时期，这一时期资本在世界范围内的相对平稳演变和扩张成为可能，这是因为尚未被占领的殖民地被分享或通过武装手段夺取，同时资本主义的内部矛盾不断增长，而这些矛盾的负担主要压在系统性地被掠夺、压迫和窒息的殖民地外围身上。20世纪初，这一时期被帝国主义时期所取代，这是一个资本主义跳跃式发展的时期，此时自由竞争迅速让位于垄断，此前所有“自由”殖民地已被瓜分完毕，为重新瓜分殖民地和势力范围而进行的斗争不可避免地采取了武装竞争的形式。

以此方式，资本主义的所有分支矛盾及其在世界范围内的矛盾在帝国主义（金融资本主义）时代找到了明确的表达，这意味着一种新形式资本主义的历史性创造；建立了世界经济各部分与资本主义社会主要阶级之间在新面貌下的新关系。

这一新的历史时期是在资本主义社会发展最重要规律的基础上产生的。它作为工业资本主义发展的历史性延续而出现。它加剧了资本主义的所有主要倾向和运动规律，及其所有基本矛盾和对抗。资本矛盾集中规律创造了强大的垄断联盟（卡特尔、辛迪加、托拉斯等），即在银行单一控制下的新型联合巨型企业。工业资本与银行资本的嫁接，强大土地所有权集中到一般的资本组织体系中，以及这种资本主义形式的垄断特征，将工业资本时代转变为金融资本时代。取代封建垄断和商业资本垄断的工业资本主义“自由竞争”，已转变为金融资本的垄断。但同时，源于自由竞争的资本主义垄断并未排斥自由竞争，而是与其并存，从而产生了许多重要且尖锐的矛盾、摩擦和冲突。

复杂机械、化学过程和电能使用的增加；由此导致的资本有机构成的提高，以及由此引起的利润率下降（仅对最大的垄断企业而言，通过高卡特尔价格政策暂时缓解），引发了对殖民地超额利润的进一步追逐和对世界重新划分的斗争。标准化的大规模生产需要新的国外市场来消费商品。对原材料和燃料需求的增加导致了对这些来源的激烈争夺。最后，阻碍商品出口并为出口资本确保额外利润的高关税保护体系，为出口资本创造了额外的刺激。因此，出口资本现在正成为资本主义世界经济不同部分之间经济联系的决定性和特定形式。最后，垄断者对殖民市场和原材料来源的占有极大地加剧了资本主义发展的不平等程度，并加剧了金融资本“列强”之间为重新瓜分殖民地和势力范围而发生的冲突。

世界经济生产力的增长 thus（因此）导致经济生活的进一步国际化，同时也导致为重新划分世界（此前已在金融资本大国之间划分）而进行的斗争，以及该斗争形式的变化和加剧，还导致通过强制压力（抵制、高关税保护、海关冲突、战争等）降低价格方法的改变。因此，资本的垄断形式伴随着不可避免的帝国主义战争，就其规模和破坏性技术力量而言，这些战争在世界历史上是前所未有的。

3. Forces of Imperialism and revolution.

The imperialist form of capitalism, manifesting the tendency to combine the different fractions of the dominating class opposes the broad masses of the proletariat not against separate undertakings but against the whole class of capitalists and their state power to an increasing degree. On the other hand, this form of capitalism demolishes the narrow partitions which exist in the National State and widens the frame of the capitalistic State power of the dominating nation by counterpoising the millions of masses of national-oppressed peoples against this power both in the so-called minor nations and in the colonies. Finally this form of capitalism sets in a most critical moment the imperialist states one against other.

Under such circumstances, the State power acquires special importance for the bourgeoisie and becomes the dictatorship of the finance-capitalist oligarchy as also the manifestation of its concentrated power. The functions of this multi-national imperialist State spread in all directions. The development of State capitalistic forms, which facilitates competition in foreign markets (military economic mobilisation) as also the struggle against the labour class; the exceptional growth of militarism (armies, naval and aerial fleets, the employment of chemistry and bacteriology); the increasing pressure of the imperial State upon the labour classes (exploitation and direct suppression, on the one hand and the systematic policy of bribery of bureaucratic reform leaders - on the other ), -all manifest the colossal growth of the specific gravity of State power. Under such conditions, more or less large, every forward movement by the proletariat becomes transformed into an attack against State power, i.e. it becomes a political movement. So the development of capitalism, especially the imperialistic epoch of this development, reproduces basic contradictions of capitalism in a gradually increasing degree. Competition among the small capitalists ceases only for the purpose of surrendering to greater capitalists; when competition among the great capitalists slackens, it bursts forth in the gigantic concerns of capitalist magnates and their States. Local and national crises become transformed into a crisis which spread over a number of countries and then becomes universal crisis; local wars give place to coalition wars and finally to the universal wars; the class struggles of isolated groups of labourers are transformed into national ones and they then become the international struggle of the world proletariat against the world bourgeoisie. Finally two main revolutionary forces unite themselves against the powerfully organized forces of finance capital; on the one side are the labourers of the capitalist States and the masses of colonial people oppressed by xxx foreign aggression - on the other, both of whom xxx march under the guidance and hegemony of the international revolutionary proletarian movement.

However this main revolutionary tendency is being temporarily paralised through bribery of certain sections of the European, North-American and Japanese proletariat, by the imperialist bourgeoisie, and by the treachery of national bourgeoisie in the colonial and semi-colonial countries who are scared by the mass revolutionary movement. The bourgeoisies of imperialist powers, while gaining additional "extra-profit" due to their position in world markets in general (i.e. highly developed technic, investment of capital in countries affording high rate of profit, etc.) and also from the plundering of colonies and semi-colonies, increased the wages of "their own" special labourers from these extra-profits and thus made them interested in the development of "native" capitalism and in colonial plunder and for their loyalty to the imperialist State. This systematic bribery has been and still is being practised on a specially large scale in the strongest imperialist countries and has its most striking manifestation in the ideology and practice of labour aristocracy and in bureaucratic sections of the working classes who are the leading

3. 帝国主义与革命的力量。

作为资本主义的帝国主义形态，表现出统治阶级各阶层联合的趋势，它日益使广大的无产阶级群众不是反对个别企业，而是反对整个资本家阶级及其国家政权。另一方面，这种资本主义形态摧毁了民族国家中存在的狭隘界限，并通过在所谓的小国和殖民地中，将数以百万计的被压迫民族群众置于与该权力相对立的地位，从而扩大了统治民族的资本主义国家权力的框架。最后，这种资本主义形态在最关键的时刻使各个帝国主义国家彼此对立。

在这种情况下，国家政权对资产阶级具有特殊的重要性，并成为金融资本寡头的专政，也是其集中权力的表现。这个多国帝国主义国家的职能向四面八方扩展。国家资本主义形式的发展，促进了在国外市场的竞争（军事经济动员）以及对抗工人阶级的斗争；军国主义的异常增长（陆军、海军和空军舰队，化学和细菌学的应用）；帝国主义国家对工人阶级日益加剧的压力（一方面是剥削和直接镇压，另一方面是对官僚改革领袖的系统性收买政策），——所有这些都表明了国家政权比重的巨大增长。在这样的条件下，无产阶级的每一次或大或小的前进运动都转化为对国家政权的攻击，即它变成了一场政治运动。因此，资本主义的发展，特别是其帝国主义阶段，以逐渐增加的程度再生产出资本主义的基本矛盾。小资本家之间的竞争停止，只是为了向大资本家投降；当大资本家之间的竞争缓和时，它便在资本主义巨头及其国家的巨大企业中爆发。地方性和全国性的危机转变为波及多个国家的危机，进而成为普遍危机；局部战争让位于联盟战争，最终让位于世界大战；孤立工人群体的阶级斗争转变为全国性斗争，进而成为世界无产阶级反对世界资产阶级的国际斗争。最后，两大主要革命力量联合起来，对抗组织严密的金融资本势力；一方是资本主义国家的工人和被xxx外国侵略压迫的殖民地人民大众——另一方，两者都在国际革命无产阶级运动的指导和领导下xxx前进。

然而，这一主要的革命趋势因帝国主义资产阶级收买欧洲、北美和日本部分无产阶级，以及殖民地和半殖民地国家中被群众革命运动吓坏的民族资产阶级的背叛而暂时陷入瘫痪。帝国主义列强的资产阶级，凭借其在世界市场中的地位（即高度发达的技术、向提供高利润率的国家投资资本等）以及通过对殖民地和半殖民地的掠夺，获得了额外的“超额利润”，并从这些超额利润中增加了“他们自己”的特权工人的工资，从而使他们对“本土”资本主义的发展和殖民掠夺感兴趣，并保持对帝国主义国家的忠诚。这种系统性的收买过去并且现在仍在最强大的帝国主义国家中以特别大的规模进行，其最显著的表现体现在工人贵族的意识形态和实践中，以及作为领导层的工人阶级官僚阶层中

4. Imperialism and the downfall of capitalism.

Imperialism has developed productive forces of world capitalism
to a great degree. It has accomplished the preparation of all material
conditions of the socialist organisation of society. It demonstrates,
by wars, that the productive forces of world economy, which have
overstepped the limited boundaries of imperialist States, demand the
organization of economy on a world-wide international scale. Imperialism
endeavours to solve this contradiction by fire and sword and pave the
way towards a universal state-capitalist trust, embracing the entire
world economy. This bloody Utopia is being proclaimed by the social-
democratic ideologists as being peaceful method for the new brand of
"organised" capitalism. In reality in its path this Utopia is meeting
with unsurmountable obstacles of such dimensions that capitalism must
inevitably fail under the weight of its own contradictions. The law of
disproportionate development of capitalism, which has been heightened
during the imperialist epoch, makes it impossible for a lasting and
solid alliances to exist among the powers. On the other hand, a number
of imperialist wars, which are being transformed into world wars by
which the law of centralisation of capital is forcing itself
to its world-wide limits,- i.e. united world trust,- is being accompa-
nied by such devastations, is placing such burdens on the shoulders
of the labour class and millions of colonial proletarians and peasants
that capitalism must unavoidably perish under the blows of the proleta-
rian revolution.

By being the culminative phase of the development of capitalism,
by bringing the productive forces of world economy to their greatest
extent and by shaping the whole world after its own image, Imperialism
is drawing all the countries,xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

社会民主主义和工会主义的团体，它们成为资产阶级影响施加于无产阶级的直接渠道，因此是资本主义秩序的最佳支柱。

然而，帝国主义在促成被收买的工人阶级领袖阶层成长的同时，从长远来看，将削弱这些领袖对工人阶级的影响，因为资本主义矛盾的加剧、广大劳动群众状况的恶化、无产阶级的大规模失业、战争及其后果带来的高额开支、某些列强在世界市场上垄断地位的丧失、殖民地的丧失等——xxx 削弱了社会民主主义在群众中的威信。同样，对殖民地和半殖民地各阶层资产阶级的系统性贿赂，后者对民族革命运动的背叛以及他们与帝国主义列强的勾结，暂时阻碍了革命危机的发展。最终，这导致帝国主义压迫的加剧，导致民族资产阶级在人民群众中影响力的丧失，导致革命危机的高涨，促进广大农民群众的土地革命，并为无产阶级在殖民地和半独立国家争取独立和彻底民族解放的群众斗争中确立领导权创造了有利条件。

4. 帝国主义与资本主义的崩溃。

帝国主义极大地发展了世界资本主义的生产力。它完成了社会组织社会主义化所需的一切物质条件的准备。它通过战争表明，已经超出帝国主义国家有限边界的世界经济生产力，要求在世界范围内按国际规模组织经济。帝国主义企图用武力解决这一矛盾，并为建立一个囊括整个世界经济的世界性国家资本主义托拉斯铺平道路。这种血腥的乌托邦被社会民主主义的理论家们宣称为新型“有组织的”资本主义的和平方法。实际上，在这条道路上，这一乌托邦正遇到规模如此巨大以至于无法克服的障碍，使得资本主义必然在其自身矛盾的重压下失败。在帝国主义时代加剧的资本主义不平衡发展规律，使得列强之间不可能存在持久且稳固的联盟。另一方面，一系列帝国主义战争正转变为世界大战，资本集中规律正将其推向全球极限——即统一的世界托拉斯——伴随着如此巨大的破坏，给工人阶级以及数百万殖民地无产阶级和农民肩上带来如此沉重的负担，以至于资本主义不可避免地将在无产阶级革命的打击下灭亡。

作为资本主义发展的最高阶段，通过将世界经济的生产力发展到极致并按照其自身形象塑造整个世界，帝国主义正将所有国家，xxx…

In general it is the last stage of development of capital. Imperialism
is the eve of a world socialist revolution. The international proleta-
rian revolution, therefore, is developing from the conditions of
capitalism in general, and in particular - from its phase of imperia-
lism. Capitalist system, in its entirety, is struggling to its final
doom. The dictatorship of finance capital will disappear and make room
for the dictatorship of proletariat.

II. THE WORLD CRISIS OF CAPITALISM AND ITS PLACE
IN THE HISTORY OF MANKIND.

1. The World War and the course of the revolutionary crisis.

The imperialist struggle among the major capitalist states for
the new partition of the world ended in the first universal imperialist
war (1914-1918). This war shook the entire system of world capitalism
and established the beginning of its general crisis. The war involved
the service of the entire state economy of the belligerent countries,
having erected the gilded fist of state capitalism, and entailed
unproductive expenditures to an unlimited degree. It destroyed consi-
derable quantities of the means of production and living working
forces, ruined the broad masses of the people and placed an unbearable
burden on to the shoulders of the industrial workers, peasants and
colonial peoples. It has inevitably heightened the class struggle
transforming it into open mass insurrections and civil war. The wea-
kest link of the imperialist front collapsed with the downfall of
Czarist Russia. The February revolution of 1917 cast off the domina-
ting power of the big land-owners. The October revolution overthrew
the domination of the bourgeoisie. The victorious proletarian revo-
lution expropriated the expropriators, deprived the bourgeoisie and
land-owners of the means of production and for the first time in the
history of humanity, created and strengthened the dictatorship of
proletariat in a vast country, established the new soviet type of
State and laid the foundations for the international revolution of
the proletariat.

As the result of violent fluctuations in world capitalism and
the heightening of the class struggle under the direct influence of
the October proletarian revolution, a number of revolutions and re-
volutionary uprisings have taken place both in Europe and in colonial and
semi-colonial countries. In January 1918 there was a labour
revolution in Finland; in August 1918 - the so-called "rice riots"
in Japan; in November of 1918 - the revolutions in Austria and
Germany, which overthrew the regime of semi-feudal monarchies; in
March of 1919 - the proletarian revolution in Hungary and uprisings
in Korea occurred; in April of 1919 - the Soviet power was established
in Bavaria; in January of 1920 - the bourgeois-national revolution
took place in Turkey; in September 1920 - the factories in Italy were
seized by the workers; in March of 1921 - there was an insurrection
by workers in Germany; in September of 1923 - an insurrection occurred
in Bulgaria; in the autumn of 1923 - a revolutionary crisis swept in
Germany; in December of 1924 - there was an insurrection in Estonia;
in April of 1925 - an insurrection in Morocco; in August an insurrection

二、资本主义的世界危机及其在人类历史中的地位。

1. 世界大战与革命危机的进程。

主要资本主义国家之间为重新瓜分世界而进行的帝国主义斗争，以第一次世界性帝国主义战争（1914-1918）告终。这场战争动摇了整个世界资本主义体系，并确立了其总危机的开端。战争使参战国的整个国家经济服务于战争目的，竖起了国家资本主义的镀金拳头，并导致了无限度的非生产性支出。它摧毁了大量的生产资料和活的劳动力，破坏了广大民众的生活，并将难以承受的负担加在了产业工人、农民和殖民地人民的肩上。这不可避免地加剧了阶级斗争，将其转变为公开的大规模起义和内战。随着沙皇俄国的垮台，帝国主义战线最薄弱的一环崩溃了。1917年的二月革命推翻了大地主的统治权力。十月革命推翻了资产阶级的统治。胜利的无产阶级革命剥夺了剥夺者，剥夺了资产阶级和地主的生产资料，并在人类历史上第一次在一个幅员辽阔的国家中建立和巩固了无产阶级专政，建立了新型的苏维埃国家，并为无产阶级的国际革命奠定了基础。

由于世界资本主义的剧烈波动，以及在十月无产阶级革命的直接影响下阶级斗争的加剧，欧洲以及殖民地和半殖民地国家发生了一系列革命和革命起义。1918年1月，芬兰发生了劳工革命；1918年8月，日本发生了所谓的“米骚动”；1918年11月，奥地利和德国发生革命，推翻了半封建君主制政权；1919年3月，匈牙利发生无产阶级革命，朝鲜发生起义；1919年4月，巴伐利亚建立了苏维埃政权；1920年1月，土耳其发生了资产阶级民族革命；1920年9月，意大利的工厂被工人占领；1921年3月，德国工人举行起义；1923年9月，保加利亚发生起义；1923年秋，革命危机席卷德国；1924年12月，爱沙尼亚发生起义；1925年4月，摩洛哥发生起义；8月发生起义

in Syria; in May of 1926 - the General strike in England and in July
of 1927 there was a workers' insurrection in Vienna. All these occurren-
ces together with such events as the insurrection in Indonesia, the
troubles in India, the Great Chinese revolution, which shook the entire
continent of Asia, are but links in the international revolutionary
chain and integral parts of the deepest general crisis of capitalism.
This international revolutionary process has combined the direct
struggle for the immediate dictatorship of proletariat, national wars
and the colonial insurrections against imperialism, which insurrections
are connected with the agrarian movement of the millions of masses
of peasants. In this manner the great masses of humanity were drawn
into the revolutionary current. The world history has entered into a
new phase of development, namely into that of the permanent general
crisis of the capitalist system. In this respect the unity of world eco-
nomy has found its expression in the international character of revolu-
tion, while the inequality of the trend of its separate parts is
explained by the fact that revolutions have started at different time
in various countries.

The first attempts at revolutionary coups d'etat, which were
produced by the acute crisis of capitalism (1918 - 1921) ended in a
victory and the strengthening of the proletarian dictatorship in U.S.S.R.
and in the defeat of the proletariat in a number of other countries.
These defeats, in the first instance, were the results of treacherous
tactics of the social-democratic and reformist leaders of the Trade Uni-
ons, as well as the result of circumstances owing to which the communists
were not fully supported by the majority of the labour classes and
also to the fact that communist parties did not exist in num-
ber of most important countries. On the basis of these defeats which
have rendered it possible to increase the exploitation of the masses of
proletariat and colonial peoples through the drop in their living
standard, the bourgeoisie have achieved the partial stabilization of
capitalist relations.

2.Revolutionary crisis and counter-revolutionary
social-democracy.

In the course of international revolution a special importance of a
large force actively struggling against revolution and actively suppor-
ting stabilisation of capitalism is attributed to the leading cadres
of the social-democratic parties and reformist trade unions, and, on the
other hand, by the fighting capitalist organizations having Fascist
leaning.

The war crisis of 1914-1918 was accompanied by the disgraceful
failure of the social-democratic Second International. The leaders of
the national social-democratic parties with few exceptions voted
for war credits, declared themselves emphatically in favour of the
defense of imperialist "mother-lands" (i.e. state organisations of the
imperialist bourgeoisie) and, instead of struggling against the imperia-
list war, they became its loyal soldiers, propagandists and bards (so-
cial-patriotism transformed into social-imperialism) in complete contra-
diction to the thesis of the "Communist International" of Marx-Engels,
which asserts that under capitalism the proletarians have no motherland
and also in contradiction to the anti-war resolutions of the Stuttgart
and Basel Congresses. In the period which succeeded the war social-demo-
crats supported the predatory treaties (Brest Litovsk, Versailles);
and they actively participated in the bloody suppression of the pro-
letarian insurrections by the generals (Noske); they also conducted an
armed struggle against the first proletarian republic (Soviet Russia);
that treacherously betrayed the proletariat, which had already seized
the power (Hungaria); they participated in the imperialist League of
Nations (Thomas, Paul Boncour, Vandervelde); they directly took sides
with the imperialist slave-owners against colonial slaves (British Labour
Party); they also actively supported the most reactionary executioners

在叙利亚；1926年5月——英国大罢工，以及1927年7月维也纳发生的工人起义。所有这些事件，连同印度尼西亚的起义、印度的动荡、震撼整个亚洲大陆的中国大革命一起，不过是国际革命链条中的环节，也是资本主义最深刻总危机的组成部分。这一国际革命进程将争取无产阶级直接专政的直接斗争、民族战争以及反对帝国主义的殖民地起义结合了起来，而这些起义又与千百万农民群众的农业运动相联系。就这样，广大人类群众被卷入了革命洪流。世界历史已进入一个新的发展阶段，即资本主义制度永久总危机的阶段。在这方面，世界经济的一体性在革命的国际性质中得到了体现，而其各个部分发展趋势的不平衡，则是因为革命在不同国家于不同时间爆发所致。

由资本主义尖锐危机（1918-1921年）引发的最初几次革命政变尝试，以苏联无产阶级专政的胜利和巩固，以及其他一些国家无产阶级的失败而告终。这些失败，首先是由于社会民主党和工会改良主义领袖的背叛策略所致，也是由于共产党人未能获得大多数劳动阶级充分支持的情况所致，同时还因为许多最重要的国家中不存在共产党。基于这些失败，资产阶级得以通过降低大众生活水平来加强对无产阶级群众和殖民地人民的剥削，从而实现了资本主义关系的部分稳定。

2. 革命危机与反革命的社会民主主义。

在国际革命进程中，社会民主党及改良主义工会的领导骨干，以及另一方面具有法西斯倾向的战斗性资本主义组织，作为一支积极反对革命并积极支持资本主义稳定的强大力量，具有特殊的重要性。

1914-1918年的战争危机伴随着社会民主第二国际可耻的破产。各国社会民主党的领袖除少数例外，均投票赞成战争拨款，明确宣布拥护保卫帝国主义“祖国”（即帝国主义资产阶级的国家组织），他们非但没有反对帝国主义战争，反而成为其忠诚的士兵、宣传家和歌功颂德者（社会爱国主义转变为社会帝国主义），这完全违背了马克思和恩格斯的《共产国际》论断，该论断断言在资本主义下无产阶级没有祖国，同时也违背了斯图加特和巴塞尔代表大会的反战决议。在战后时期，社会民主党人支持掠夺性条约（布列斯特-立托夫斯克条约、凡尔赛条约）；他们积极参与将军们（诺斯克）对无产阶级起义的血腥镇压；他们对第一个无产阶级共和国（苏维埃俄国）进行武装斗争；他们背叛了已经夺取政权的无产阶级（匈牙利）；他们参与了帝国主义的国际联盟（托马斯、保罗·邦库尔、王德威尔得）；他们直接站在帝国主义奴隶主一边反对殖民地奴隶（英国工党）；他们还积极支持最反动的劳工阶级刽子手

Great General Strike of the British proletariat; they helped to

Systematically pursuing this counter-revolutionary line of
policy the social-democrats operate with both wings. Their "right"
wing is emphatically counter-revolutionary and is necessary for nego-
tiating and keeping contact with the bourgeoisie. Their "left" wing
is necessary for the exceedingly delicate process of duping the workers.
The "left" wing of social democracy, which plays with pacifist and
sometimes even with revolutionary words, is practically opposed
to the labourers, especially in most critical moments (for instance
British "independent" and "left" leaders of the Central Council
during the General Strike of 1926 and Otto Bauer & Co. during the
Vienna insurrection), and therefore the left wing is the most dange-
rous fraction of the social democratic parties. While serving the
interests of the bourgeoisie among labour classes and standing for
the principles of class cooperation and coalition with the bourgeoisie,
the social democrats are obliged at certain periods to assume the
role of an opposition party and even to go as far as to abet the
defense of proletarian class interests in this latter's economic
struggle only for the object of disgracefully betraying its most
vital interests (having already gained the confidence of a part of
the labour class) especially when decisive class battles are in
progress.

The main role of the social democrats consists at present in
undermining the requisite militant unity of the proletariat in its
struggle against imperialism. By splitting and demoralizing the
united front of the proletarian struggle against capital, the social
democrats become the principal supporters of imperialism in the
labour class. International social-democracy of all shades, the Second
International and its trade union branch - the Amsterdam unification
of Trade Unions - have thus become the reserve of the bourgeoisie so-
ciety and its most loyal defense.

3. Crisis of capitalism and Fascism.

Fascism has entered the ranks alongside with the social-democracy
with the assistance of which latter the bourgeoisie suppresses the
labourers or lessens their class vigilance.

The epoch of imperialism, the intensification of the class
struggle and (especially after the world imperialistic war) the
growth of the elements of civil war have led to the bankruptcy of
parliamentarism. On this account "new" methods of forms of government
have made their appearance (for instance, the system of small cabi-
nets, the creation behind the scene of oligarchal groups, the decay
and falsification of the system of the "people's representation", the
lessening and total abolition of "democratic liberties" etc.). This
process of reactionary encroachment assumes under certain historic
conditions the form of Fascism. Such conditions are: the
instability of capitalist relations; the existence of considerable
social outclassed elements, the impoverishment of broad strata of
petty city bourgeoisie and intellectuals, the discontentment existing
among the village small bourgeoisie, and finally the constant menace
of mass insurrections of the proletariat. The bourgeoisie are being
gradually forced to change over from the parliamentary system to the
Fascist method which is independent of party influences in order to
safeguard itself with a more stable, firm and steadfast power.
This method is one of direct dictatorship, which is theoretically

社会民主党人系统地推行这条反革命政策路线，双管齐下。他们的“右”翼公然反革命，对于与资产阶级谈判和保持接触是必要的。他们的“左”翼对于极其微妙地欺骗工人的过程是必要的。社会民主党的“左”翼玩弄和平主义甚至有时是革命的辞藻，但实际上反对劳动者，尤其是在最关键的时刻（例如1926年大罢工期间英国中央委员会的“独立”和“左”派领袖，以及维也纳起义期间的奥托·鲍尔等人），因此左翼是社会民主党中最危险的派别。社会民主党人在劳动阶级中服务于资产阶级的利益，主张阶级合作以及与资产阶级结盟的原则，因此在某些时期不得不扮演反对党的角色，甚至进而煽动捍卫无产阶级在其经济斗争中的阶级利益，其目的仅仅是为了可耻地背叛其最根本的利益（在已经赢得部分劳动阶级的信任之后），特别是在决定性的阶级战斗正在进行时。

目前，社会民主党人的主要作用在于破坏无产阶级在反对帝国主义斗争中所必需的战斗团结。通过分裂和瓦解无产阶级反对资本的联合战线，社会民主党人成为帝国主义在劳动阶级中的主要支持者。各种色彩的国际社会民主主义、第二国际及其工会分支——阿姆斯特丹工会联合会——因此成为了资产阶级社会的后备力量及其最忠诚的防御者。

3. 资本主义危机与法西斯主义。

法西斯主义已与社会民主主义并列进入行列，后者协助资产阶级镇压劳动者或削弱其阶级警惕性。

帝国主义时代、阶级斗争的加剧以及（特别是在世界帝国主义战争之后）内战因素的增长，导致了议会制的破产。因此，“新”的政府形式和方法应运而生（例如，小内阁制度、幕后寡头集团的建立、“人民代表”制度的衰败和伪造、“民主自由”的减少和彻底废除等）。这种反动侵蚀的过程在某些历史条件下采取法西斯主义的形式。这些条件是：资本主义关系的不稳定；存在大量的社会脱节元素；城市小资产阶级和知识分子广大阶层的贫困化；农村小资产阶级中存在的不满情绪；以及最后，无产阶级大规模起义的持续威胁。资产阶级逐渐被迫从议会制转向不受党派影响的法西斯主义方法，以便用更稳定、牢固和坚定的权力来保护自己。这种方法是一种直接专政，其在理论上

rattle.

While adapting themselves to the change in the political situation
the bourgeoisie adopts the methods of Fascism as also those of coali-
tion with social democracy, furthermore social democracy frequently
play the role of the Fascist in moments that are most critical in
the life of the bourgeoisie . In the course of its development it re-
veals Fascist tendencies, which, under different political conditions,
do not prevent it from creating opposition to the bourgeois government
in the form of an opposition party. The Fascist method and that of
coalition with social democracy, while being unusual methods for
"normal" capitalism and also being a symptom of general capitalist
crisis, are being used by the bourgeoisie for retarding the forward
movement of the revolution.

4. Contradictions in capitalist stabilisation and
Inevitability of the revolutionary collapse of capitalism.

The experience acquired during the historic after-war
period has shown that the stabilisation of capitalism acquired by
arbitrary measures against the labour classes together with systematic
lowering of their standard of living could not fail from being
incomplete, fleeting and unsound. Technical development which has
made great strides and which in some countries almost borders upon
technical revolution, the forced process of concentrating and centra-
lizing capital, the creation of gigantic trusts, "national" and "inter-
national" monopolies, the grafting of trusts together with government
power, the growth of world capitalist economy, are all incapable
of overcoming the general crisis of the capitalist system. The split
of world economy to two sections, i.e. the capitalist and socialist,
the shrinkage of markets, the anti-imperialist movement in the colo-
nies are considerably heightening all the contradictions of capita-
lism which has been developing on a perfectly new, after-war basis.
Technical progress itself and the rationalizing of industry, which
have the counter effect of closing down industrial undertakings, the
limitation of output, the unmerciful and rapacious exploitation of
the labourers are all leading towards an enormous state of unemploy-
ment, unheard of before. The absolute collapse in the condition
of labour class, including that in a number of highly developed
capitalist countries has become a fact. The growth of competition
among the imperialistic countries and the constant war menace and the
increasing tension of class conflicts are all creating a forerunner
for the new stage in the development of the general crisis of capita-
lism and of the world-proletarian-revolution.
As a result of the first tournament of imperialist wars (World
War of 1914-1918) and of the October victory gained by the labour class

披着“国际主义”的外衣，同时也代表着各“职业阶层”（实际上——这些是统治阶级的各个集团），法西斯主义利用小资产阶级、知识分子及其他群众的不满情绪，采取特定的社会蛊惑手段（反犹主义、对高利贷资本的单独攻击、反对议会贸易的叛乱），并以统一的雇佣的法西斯民兵、党务机器和官僚机构的形式进行腐败活动。此外，法西斯主义正试图渗透进劳工队伍，招募工人中最落后的阶层，利用他们对社会民主党人消极态度的不满等等。法西斯主义的主要问题是摧毁革命劳工先锋队，即无产阶级中的共产主义阶层及其普通成员。社会蛊惑、腐败与白色恐怖相结合，再加上对外政策方面极端的帝国主义侵略，构成了法西斯主义的主要特征。通过在资产阶级生活中特别关键的时期利用反资本主义的词句，法西斯主义在加强其国家权力后，逐渐抛弃其资本主义的遮羞布，越来越显露出其作为大资本恐怖独裁的本质。

资产阶级在适应政治局势变化时，既采用法西斯主义的方法，也采用与社会民主派结盟的方法；此外，在资产阶级生活最关键时刻，社会民主派经常扮演法西斯主义的角色。在其发展过程中，它显露出法西斯倾向，这在不同的政治条件下，并不妨碍它以反对党的形式对资产阶级政府制造反对。法西斯主义方法以及与社会民主派结盟的方法，虽然是“正常”资本主义的不寻常方法，也是总体资本主义危机的症状，但正被资产阶级用来延缓革命的前进运动。

4. 资本主义稳定中的矛盾与
资本主义革命性崩溃的不可避免性。

战后历史时期所获得的经验表明，通过针对劳工阶级的任意措施并系统性地降低其生活水平而获得的资本主义稳定，必然是不完整的、短暂的且不稳固的。取得了巨大进步的技术发展，在某些国家几乎接近技术革命，资本集中和集中的强制过程，巨型托拉斯、“国家”和“国际”垄断组织的建立，托拉斯与政府权力的结合，世界资本主义经济的增长，所有这些都无法克服资本主义体系的总体危机。世界经济分裂为两个部分，即资本主义和社会主义，市场的萎缩，殖民地的反帝国主义运动，都极大地加剧了在全新的战后基础上发展的资本主义的所有矛盾。技术进步本身以及工业的合理化，产生了关闭工业企业、限制产量、对劳动者进行无情和贪婪剥削的反作用，这些都导致了前所未有的大规模失业状态。包括在一些高度发达的资本主义国家在内的劳工阶级状况的绝对崩溃已成为事实。帝国主义国家之间竞争的增长、持续的战争威胁以及阶级冲突紧张局势的加剧，都为资本主义总体危机和世界无产阶级革命发展的新阶段创造了前奏。
作为第一次帝国主义战争竞赛（1914-1918年世界大战）的结果，以及劳工阶级在前沙皇帝国取得的十月胜利

in the ex-Tzar's Empire, world economy was split into two radically
hostile camps: namely, the camp of imperialist states and the dictator-
ship of proletariat of U.S.S.R. The difference in class structure, in
nature of class power, the radical differences in aims pursued by
internal and external economic and cultural policy, the radically diffe-
rent course of development are all leading to a violent collision between
the capitalistic world and the land of victorious proletariat. Within
confines of the former united world economy two antagonistic systems are
now struggling, namely: the system of capitalism and that of socialism.
The class struggle, which up to the present has been pursued under
conditions that deprived the proletariat of having their own state
power, is now being conducted on a large, world-wide scale, furthermore
the world proletariat now has its own state, which is the sole mother-
land of the international proletariat. The existence of the Soviet Rus-
sia Union with its universal influence over the toiling and oppressed
masses is itself a glowing manifestation of the grave crisis in which
the universal capitalist system finds itself to-day and also of the
extended and exasperated class struggle, unknown formerly to history.

The capitalist world, unable to surmount internal contradictions,
is striving to create international unions (League of Nations) which
are pursuing one aim namely: to stop the irresistible growth of the
revolutionary crisis, to suppress the Union of the Proletarian Repub-
lics by means of blockade or war. Simultaneously, all the forces of the
revolutionary proletariat and oppressed colonial masses are rallying
round U.S.S.R.; the united world coalition of labour is being opposed
by the world coalition of capital, which is corroded internally, but
is armed from head to foot. Thus, as the result of the first clash of
the imperialist wars (1914-1918) a new contradiction having world-wide
historical proportions and significance, has grown up namely - the
contradiction which exists between U.S.S.R. and the capitalist world.

On the other hand internal antagonisms in the capitalist section
of world economy have become heightened. The transference of the econo-
mic center of the world to U.S.A. and the transformation of the
almighty American dollar into the world exploitor have jeopardized
the relations between U.S.A. and European capitalism, chiefly that of
Great Britain. The conflict between the most powerful conservative
country - Great Britain and the greatest country of young imperialism -
U.S.A., which has already conquered the world hegemony, has become the
axis of world conflicts amongst the states of finance-capital. Germany,
plundered by the Treaty of Versailles, which has regenerated economi-
cally and has again adopted the imperialist policy, is again marching
forth as a serious competitor in the world market. A knot of contra-
dictions is being entangled in the Pacific, where the American-Japanese
conflict has its chief base. On a par with these chief antagonisms
clashing interests are in force among the changing and unstable grou-
pings of powers, moreover the minor states are playing the role of
auxiliary weapons in the hands of imperialist giants and their coali-
tions.

The growth of the productive capacity of world capitalism accom-
panied by the shrinkage of international markets in Europe as a result
of the Great War, together with the elimination of U.S.S.R. from the
capitalist world, also the monopoly of the most important sources
of raw material and fuel, have all resulted in producing conflicts
amongst capitalist countries. The "peaceful" competition for oil,
rubber, cotton, coal and metals and the new partition of markets and
spheres of investment of capital are inevitably leading to a new world
war, the more destructive the greater is rapidly progressing technic.
Simultaneously contradictions are growing up between the parent
states and their colonies and semi-colonial countries. A certain
relaxation existing in European imperialism as the result of the great
war, the development of capitalism in the colonies, the influence of
the Soviet Revolution, the centrifugal tendencies existing in Great
Britain, the greatest maritime and colonial power (Canada, Australia,
South Africa), have all rendered it easier to promote insurrections

世界经济分裂为两个根本敌对的阵营：即帝国主义国家阵营和苏联的无产阶级专政。阶级结构的不同、阶级权力的性质、内部和外部经济与文化政策所追求目标的根本差异、截然不同的发展道路，所有这些都导致资本主义世界与胜利无产阶级国家之间的剧烈碰撞。在原统一的世界经济范围内，两种对抗性的体系现在正在斗争，即：资本主义体系和社会主义体系。迄今为止在无产阶级缺乏自己国家权力的条件下进行的阶级斗争，现在正在大规模的全球范围内进行，此外，世界无产阶级现在拥有自己的国家，这是国际无产阶级唯一的祖国。苏维埃俄罗斯联盟的存在及其对劳动和被压迫群众的普遍影响，本身就是当今普遍资本主义体系所处严重危机的鲜明体现，也是历史上前所未有的广泛且激化的阶级斗争的体现。

资本主义世界无法克服内部矛盾，正试图建立国际联盟（国际联盟），其唯一目的是：阻止革命危机不可阻挡的增长，通过封锁或战争镇压无产阶级共和国联盟。同时，所有革命无产阶级和被压迫殖民地群众的力量都聚集在苏联周围；劳动的世界联合阵线正面对着一个内部腐朽但全副武装的资本世界联合阵线。因此，作为第一次帝国主义战争冲突（1914-1918）的结果，产生了一个具有世界历史规模和意义的新矛盾，即——苏联与资本主义世界之间存在的矛盾。

另一方面，世界经济中资本主义部分的内部对抗已经加剧。世界经济中心向美国的转移，以及万能的美元转变为世界剥削者，危及了美国与欧洲资本主义的关系，主要是与英国的关系。最强大的保守国家——英国，与已获得世界霸权的最年轻的帝国主义大国——美国之间的冲突，已成为金融资本国家间世界冲突的轴心。德国受到《凡尔赛条约》的掠夺，但在经济上已恢复元气并再次采取帝国主义政策，正再次作为世界市场上的严肃竞争对手向前迈进。太平洋地区纠缠着一团矛盾，美日冲突是其主要基础。除了这些主要对抗之外，在不断变化和不稳定的权力集团中，利益冲突也在起作用，而且小国在帝国主义巨头及其联盟手中扮演着辅助武器的角色。

世界资本主义生产能力的增长，伴随着由于大战导致的欧洲国际市场萎缩，加上苏联从资本主义世界中脱离，以及对最重要原材料和燃料来源的垄断，所有这些都导致了资本主义国家之间的冲突。对石油、橡胶、棉花、煤炭和金属的“和平”竞争，以及市场和资本投资领域的重新划分，不可避免地导致新的世界大战，随着技术的迅速进步，其破坏性将更大。同时，宗主国与其殖民地和半殖民地国家之间的矛盾也在增长。由于大战导致的欧洲帝国主义的某种缓和，殖民地资本主义的发展，苏联革命的影响，最大的海上和殖民强国英国（加拿大、澳大利亚、南非）存在的离心倾向，所有这些都使得促进起义变得更加容易

13.
in the colonial and semi-colonial countries. The great Chinese revo-
lution which set hundreds of million of the Chinese people in motion
has made a large breach in the whole system of imperialism. Uninterrup-
ted revolutionary unrest amongst the hundreds of millions of Indian
workers and peasants threatens to break down the domination of Great
Britain - the world's stronghold of imperialism. The growth of ten-
dencies in the countries of Latin America directed against the power-
ful imperialism of U.S.A. represents a force which is undermining
the expansion of North-American capital. In this manner the revolu-
tionary process in colonies, is involving the great majority of the
world population subordinated to finance-capitalist oligarchy of
the few "Great Powers in the struggle against imperialism, is
also a manifestation of a deeply rooted general crisis of the
capitalist system. In Europe also where imperialism has subjugated
a number of minor nations, the national question is a factor which is
contributing to the heightening of internal contradictions of capi-
talism.
Finally, the inevitable revolutionary crisis is ripening within
the walls of imperialism: the bourgeois offensive against the labour
class, against their living standard, their organisations, their
political rights and also increase of White Terrorism are all producing
the ever-increasing resistance of the broad masses of the prole-
tariat and the heightening of the class struggle between the labour
class and trusts, __________.

The colossal struggle by labour against capital; the increasing
process of radicalism amongst the masses; the growth of influence
and authority of the Communist Parties; the enormous growth of sym-
pathy of broad masses of labourers towards the homeland of proleta-
rian Dictatorship - all clearly reveal the increase of new revolutio-
nary impetus within the confines of imperialism.

In this manner the system of world imperialism together with the
partial stabilisation of capitalism are being attacked from different
sides, i.e. by contradictions and conflicts amongst imperialist
powers; by millions of masses of colonial peoples who are rising to
struggle; by the revolutionary proletariat of parent states; and
lastly by the U.S.S.R. proletarian dictatorship which is the hegemon
of the entire world revolutionary movement. The international revo-
lution is developing.

Imperialism is collecting all its forces against it. Expeditions
against the colonies, a new world war and the drive against U.S.S.R. -
are the outstanding problems of imperialism. This will inevitably
bring about the loosening of all forces of international revolution
and bring about the inevitable collapse of capitalism.

III. FINAL AIM OF THE COMMUNIST INTERNATIONAL -
THE WORLD REVOLUTION .

The ultimate aim, to which the Communist International is aspiring,
is to substitute the world capitalist economy by the universal system
of communism. Communist society, which is in the making by all the
movements of historic development, is the only escape left to humanity,
for only by it will the contradictions of the capitalist system be
removed which system is menacing humanity by degradation and ruin.

The communist order abolishes the division of society into classes,
that is to say, while dispensing with anarchy resulting from capita-
list industrialism, it puts an end to all manners of forms of exploi-
tation and oppression of one man against another. The place of the
struggling classes will be taken by the members of the united society
of world labour. For the first time in history humanity will take
its fate into its own hands. Instead of destroying innumerable

在殖民地和半殖民地国家。使数亿中国人民行动起来的中国大革命，已在整个帝国主义体系中打开了一个巨大的缺口。印度数亿工人和农民中持续不断的革命动荡，威胁着要瓦解大英帝国——这个世界帝国主义堡垒的统治。拉丁美洲各国出现的针对美国强大帝国主义的倾向日益增长，构成了一股正在削弱北美资本扩张的力量。就这样，殖民地的革命进程卷入了世界人口的绝大多数，他们受少数“大国”金融资本寡头的支配，正投身于反对帝国主义的斗争，这也表现了资本主义体系根深蒂固的总危机。在欧洲，帝国主义也征服了一些小民族，民族问题也是一个促使资本主义内部矛盾加剧的因素。

最后，不可避免的革命危机正在帝国主义的围墙内成熟：资产阶级对劳工阶级、对其生活水平、对其组织、对其政治权利的进攻，以及白色恐怖的加剧，都在引起无产阶级广大民众日益增长的抵抗，并导致劳工阶级与托拉斯之间阶级斗争的激化，__________。

劳工反对资本的巨大斗争；群众中激进主义进程的加剧；共产党影响力和威望的增长；广大劳工群众对无产阶级专政祖国同情心的巨大增长——所有这些都清楚地表明，在帝国主义范围内新的革命动力正在增加。

就这样，世界帝国主义体系连同资本主义的部分稳定正受到来自不同方面的攻击，即：帝国主义列强之间的矛盾和冲突；起来斗争的数百万殖民地群众；母国的革命无产阶级；以及作为整个世界革命运动霸主的苏联无产阶级专政。国际革命正在发展。

帝国主义正在集结其所有力量来对抗它。对殖民地的远征、新的世界大战以及对苏联的进攻——是帝国主义面临的突出问题。这将不可避免地导致国际革命所有力量的松动，并带来资本主义不可避免的崩溃。

三、共产国际的最终目标——
世界革命。

共产国际所追求的最终目标，是用普遍的共产主义体系取代世界资本主义经济。由历史发展的所有运动正在形成的共产主义社会，是人类剩下的唯一出路，因为只有这样才能消除资本主义体系的矛盾，该体系正以堕落和毁灭威胁着人类。

共产主义秩序废除了社会的阶级划分，也就是说，它在摒弃资本主义工业主义所产生的无政府状态的同时，终结了一切形式的人对人的剥削和压迫。团结的世界劳工社会的成员将取代相互斗争的阶级。人类历史上第一次将自己的命运掌握在自己手中。不再为了在阶级和民族之间的战斗中摧毁无数

14.
quantities of human live and immense wealth in battles between class
and peoples, humanity will employ all its energies for the struggle
against the forces of nature in order to raise and develop its own
collective power.

With the abolition of private ownership of means of production
and by turning them into common property, the world system of com-
munism will substitute the elementary force of the world market and
competition and the blind course of social production by organized
production conducted with thorough knowledge and plan and calculated
to satisfy the speedy growth of social needs. Together with the
abolition of anarchy in production and competition, devastating
crises and still more devastating wars will also be eliminated.
A well organised and calculated management of all material resources
and a healthy economic development based on a boundless and speedy
rise of the productive forces will counteract the colossal and
wasteful expenditure of productive forces and spasmodical development
of society.

The abolition of private ownership and the disappearance of
classes will put a stop to the exploitation of one class by another.
Labour ceases to be work for the profit of class enemies. It will
cease to serve as a means for earning livelihood only, but will
become the most essential vital necessity. Poverty will disappear.
Economic inequality will cease to exist among people as also will
poverty of the enslaved classes and their miserably low living
standard in general; under the new division of labour human hierarchy
will disappear, and simultaneously the contradictions between intel-
lectual and physical labour will disappear. Finally all traces of
social inequality of sexes will likewise disappear. The organs of
class domination will likewise disappear and the first of them
to give will be State power. This latter, being the embodiment of
class domination, will gradually die off in proportion as the classes
likewise fade away. All kinds of class compulsion will gradually
cease to exist. The disappearance of classes will be accompanied by
the abolition of all kinds of monopoly of education. Culture will
become a common asset and former class ideology will cede its place
to materialist world-conception. Under such circumstances of life
any phase of domination of the people by others will become impos-
sible and there will open up an immense field for social selection
and harmonious development of all the faculties which are deeply
placed in human nature.

No restrictions whatever of a social character will be placed
in the way to thwart the growth of productive forces. Neither private
ownership of the means of production, nor avaricious calculations
for profit, nor the artificial support of ignorance of the masses
and their poverty, which jeopardizes technical progress in capita-
list society, or even enormous unproductive expenditure will exist
in Communist society. The most expedient use of the forces of nature
and natural conditions of production which prevail in particular
parts of the world; the abolition of contrasts between the village and
city, which are created by continued backwardness of agriculture and
low standard of its technic; the maximum cooperation between science
and technic, research work and its practical application to the
highest social scale; a well-calculated organisation of scientific
labour; the adoption of the most improved methods of accountancy
and well-calculated economic regulations; the speedy growth of
public requirements, which are the most powerful internal incentive
of the entire system - all these foregoing conditions will insure
the maximum productiveness of public labour and will liberate,
in turn, human energy for the powerful growth of science and arts.

14.
人的生命和巨大的财富，人类将运用其全部精力去与自然力量作斗争，以提高和发展其自身的集体力量。

随着生产资料私有制的废除并将其转变为公共财产，世界共产主义体系将以有组织、基于全面知识和计划、旨在满足社会需求快速增长的生产，取代世界市场和竞争的原始力量以及社会生产的盲目进程。随着生产中无政府状态和竞争的废除，破坏性的危机以及更具破坏性的战争也将被消除。对所有物质资源进行组织良好且经过计算的管理，以及建立在生产力无限快速提升基础上的健康经济发展，将抵消生产力的巨大浪费和社会的痉挛性发展。

私有制的废除和阶级的消失将制止一个阶级对另一个阶级的剥削。劳动不再是为阶级敌人的利润而工作。它将不再仅仅作为谋生手段，而将成为最基本的生活必需。贫困将消失。人们之间的经济不平等将不复存在，被奴役阶级的贫困及其普遍极低的生活水平也将不复存在；在新的分工下，人类等级制度将消失，同时脑力劳动和体力劳动之间的矛盾也将消失。最后，性别社会不平等的任何痕迹也将同样消失。阶级统治的机构也将同样消失，其中首先退出历史舞台的是国家权力。后者作为阶级统治的体现，将随着阶级的同样消退而逐渐消亡。各种形式的阶级强制将逐渐停止存在。阶级的消失将伴随着各种教育垄断的废除。文化将成为共同资产，昔日的阶级意识形态将让位于唯物主义世界观。在这样的生活环境下，任何人对他人的统治阶段都将变得不可能，并将为深深植根于人性中的所有能力的社会选择和和谐发展开辟广阔的领域。

不会施加任何具有社会性质的限制来阻碍生产力的增长。无论是生产资料的私有制，还是对利润的贪婪算计，无论是人为地支持大众的无知和贫困（这在资本主义社会中危及技术进步），甚至是巨大的非生产性支出，都不会存在于共产主义社会中。最有效地利用世界各地 prevailing 的自然力量和生产自然条件；消除因农业持续落后及其技术水平低下而产生的城乡对立；科学与技术、研究工作及其在最高社会规模上的实际应用之间的最大合作；科学劳动的组织良好；采用最先进的会计方法和经过周密计算的经济法规；公共需求的快速增长，这是整个体系最强大的内部激励因素——所有上述条件将确保公共劳动的最大生产率，并反过来解放人类能量，以促进科学和艺术的强大增长。

15.
The development of the productive forces of the world's communist society renders possible the prosperity of humanity and the maximum reduction of time employed for material production and, therefore, for unprecedented cultural development. This new culture of the united for the first time in the history mankind, has abolished everything and all kinds of state boundaries and will, unlike capitalism, rely upon clear and transparent relations among the peoples. Therefore it will bury for ever all mysticism, religion, prejudices and superstitions and will give a powerful impetus to the development of the all-conquering knowledge of science.

When communist society will have developed on its own basis, when public productive forces will have grown up together with general development of humanity, when the new society will have written on its banner: "Each according to his capacity and each according to his needs", this, the highest stage of communism presupposes, as its preliminary historic condition, the lower stage of its development - the socialist stage. In this stage the communist society is emerging from capitalist society, it comes out all covered-in commercial, moral and mental respects - with the birth-marks of old society, in the bosom of which it was given birth. The productive forces of socialism are still insufficiently developed to secure the distribution of the products of labour according to everybody's needs; they are distributed according to work. The division of labour, i.e. fixing up of certain particular labour functions to a certain particular group of persons has not yet been wiped away and in particular the contrast between mental and physical work has not yet been removed. There are still present, despite the abolition of classes, the last remnants of the old class divisions of society, therefore the remnants of the proletarian state power, coercion and law. Therefore there are still remaining certain vestiges of inequality which have not yet died away.
The contrast between villages and cities is also not yet totally removed. Yet all these remnants of old society are not defended or disputed by any social force. Being a production of a certain level of development of productive forces, they disappear gradually in no measure as humanity, liberated from the fetters of capitalist order, is rapidly conquering the forces of nature, educates itself anew in a spirit of communism and passes over from socialism to accomplished communism.

IV. TRANSITORY PERIOD FROM CAPITALISM TO SOCIALISM
AND THE DICTATORSHIP OF THE PROLETARIAT.

1. The transitory period and seizure of power by the proletariat

Between capitalist and communist societies there exists a period of revolutionary transition from one to other. To it corresponds also a political transitory period, in which the state cannot be anything but the revolutionary dictatorship of the proletariat. The transition from the world dictatorship of imperialism to the world dictatorship of the proletariat embraces a long period of struggle by the proletariat, of its reverses and of its victories; a period of general crisis in capitalist relations and increase of social revolutions, i.e. of civil wars between the proletariat and the bourgeoisie; a period of national wars and colonial insurrections, which, while not being socialist movements of the revolutionary proletariat, form the integral part of the world proletarian revolution, so long as they are undermining imperialist domination; a period admitting the simultaneous existence of both capitalist and socialist social-economic systems within the world economy, their "peaceful" relations and their armed struggle; a period of formation of the unions of soviet socia-

15.
世界共产主义社会生产力的发展使人类的繁荣和用于物质生产的时间最大程度减少成为可能，从而带来前所未有的文化发展。这种在人类历史上首次联合起来的新文化，废除了一切和各种形式的国家边界，并将不像资本主义那样，依赖于人民之间清晰透明的关系。因此，它将永远埋葬所有神秘主义、宗教、偏见和迷信，并将有力地推动全能的科学知识的发展。

当共产主义社会在其自身基础上得到发展，当公共生产力随着人类的总体发展而增长，当新社会在其旗帜上写下：“各尽所能，按需分配”时，这一共产主义的最高阶段预设了其发展的较低阶段——社会主义阶段——作为其初步的历史条件。在这个阶段，共产主义社会从资本主义社会中产生，它在商业、道德和精神各方面都带着旧社会的胎记，因为它是在旧社会的怀抱中诞生的。社会主义的生产力尚未充分发展到能够保证按每个人的需要分配劳动产品的程度；产品是按劳分配的。分工，即将某些特定的劳动职能固定给某些特定的人群，尚未被消除，特别是脑力劳动和体力劳动之间的对立尚未消除。尽管阶级已被废除，但旧的社会阶级划分的最后残余仍然存在，因此无产阶级国家权力、强制和法律的残余也仍然存在。因此，某些尚未消亡的不平等痕迹仍然存在。
城乡之间的对立也尚未完全消除。然而，旧社会的这些残余并未受到任何社会力量的维护或争议。作为生产力一定发展水平的产物，它们随着人类摆脱资本主义秩序的束缚，迅速征服自然力量，以共产主义精神重新教育自己，并从社会主义过渡到成熟的共产主义，而在一定程度上逐渐消失。

四、从资本主义到社会主义的过渡时期
和无产阶级专政。

1. 过渡时期和无产阶级夺取政权

在资本主义社会和共产主义社会之间，存在一个从前者向后者的革命过渡时期。与之相应的还有一个政治过渡时期，在此期间，国家只能是无产阶级的革命专政。从帝国主义的世界专政向无产阶级的世界专政的过渡，涵盖了一个漫长的时期，其中包括无产阶级的斗争、挫折和胜利；资本主义关系的总危机和社会革命的增加，即无产阶级与资产阶级之间的内战；民族战争和殖民地起义的时期，这些虽然不属于革命无产阶级的社会主义运动，但只要它们削弱帝国主义统治，就构成世界无产阶级革命的组成部分；一个允许资本主义和社会主义社会经济体系在世界经济中同时存在的时期，它们的“和平”关系及其武装斗争；苏维埃社会主义联盟的形成时期……

period of their intimate connection with colonial peoples and so on.
Disproportion in economic and political development is an absolute
law of capitalism. During the epoch of imperialism this disproportion
becomes still more aggravated and heightened. It follows from the
above, that the international revolution of the proletariat cannot
be considered as a simultaneous or universal act. It follows therefore
that the triumph of socialism may be attained, firstly, only in a
few, or even in a single, isolated capitalist country. Such a proletarian victory, however, contributes to the only element of the basis
for world revolution and thereby still more aggravates the general
crisis of capitalism. Thus the capitalist system, as a whole, arrives
at its final failure. Dictatorship by finance disappears, giving
place to dictatorship by the proletariat. While the bourgeois revolutions meant only the political liberation of the already existing
and economic dominating order of productive relations and the transfer
of power from the hands of one class of exploiters into those of
another, the proletarian revolution means the latter's intrusion
into the established order of property relations in bourgeois
society, expropriation of exploiting classes and the seizure of
power by a class which puts before it a problem of radical reorganization of the economic basis of society and the abolition of any
kind of exploitation of one man by another. However, while the
bourgeois revolution has succeeded only after centuries of work
in putting an end to the political domination of feudal nobility
throughout the world, breaking down its domination by a number of
separate revolutions, the international revolution of proletariat
being by no means a single act but extending over an entire epoch,
can, owing to more intimate connection existing among the
countries, solve its problem in a shorter period. It is only after
the complete world victory of the proletariat and after the consolidation of its world power that a lasting epoch of intense construction of the world's socialist economy can follow.
The seizure of power by the proletariat is a preliminary condition to the growth of the socialist forms of economy and to the
cultural growth of the proletariat reshaping its own nature anew,
growing ripe for the role of society leader and in all branches
of life, involving, in this process of transformation, the remaining
classes thereby preparing the ground for the entire abolition of
classes. During the struggle for dictatorship by the proletariat
and for the succeeding reformation of the social order and against
the union of land-owners and capitalists, a union of labourers and
peasants is being formed under the latter's political hegemony, the
union which is the base of the dictatorship of the proletariat.

The transitory period as a whole is characterized by the
merciless suppression of the resistance of exploiters, by the organization of socialist construction, by the mass reshaping of the
people along socialist lines, by the gradual abolition of classes.
It is only after the solution of these great historic problems
that the society of the transitory period begins to transform itself
into a communist society.

In this manner a necessary preliminary condition to the transformation of world capitalist economy into a socialist one is the
dictatorship of world proletariat. This dictatorship can be put
into effect only as the result of the victory of socialism in
separate countries or in a group of them by way of organizing new
socialist republics entering into the federalist union with those
which had already existed, when a net-work of these federalist
unions increases in number, including the colonies liberated from
the imperialist yoke, when the federation of such republics is
finally transformed into a union of soviet socialist republics of
the world, realizing the unification of mankind under the hegemony
of the international state-organized proletariat.

主义国家，一个帝国主义国家对它们进行战争的时期，一个它们与殖民地人民紧密联系的时期等等。经济和政治发展的不平衡是资本主义的绝对规律。在帝国主义时代，这种不平衡变得更加加剧和严重。由此可知，无产阶级的国际革命不能被视为一种同时或普遍的行动。因此，社会主义的胜利可能首先只在少数几个，甚至在一个孤立的资本主义国家中取得。然而，这样的无产阶级胜利有助于构成世界革命基础的唯一要素，从而进一步加剧资本主义的总体危机。因此，资本主义体系作为一个整体，走向其最终的失败。金融独裁消失，让位于无产阶级独裁。资产阶级革命仅仅意味着对已经存在且在经济上占主导地位的生产关系秩序的政治解放，以及权力从一类剥削者手中转移到另一类剥削者手中，而无产阶级革命则意味着后者侵入资产阶级社会中既定的财产关系秩序，剥夺剥削阶级，并由一个将社会经济的根本重组和废除任何形式的人对人的剥削作为自身任务的阶级夺取政权。然而，虽然资产阶级革命经过数个世纪的努力，通过一系列单独的革命，才终结了封建贵族在世界范围内的政治统治，打破了其统治，但无产阶级的国际革命绝非单一行动，而是贯穿整个时代，由于各国之间存在着更紧密的联系，能够在较短的时期内解决其问题。只有在无产阶级取得完全的世界性胜利并巩固其世界权力之后，才能随之进入一个密集建设世界社会主义经济的持久时代。

无产阶级夺取政权是社会主义经济形式增长和无产阶级文化成长的先决条件，无产阶级在此过程中重塑自身本性，成熟到足以担任社会领导者的角色，并在生活的所有领域中，在这一转变过程中涉及其余阶级，从而为彻底废除阶级奠定基础。在为无产阶级专政及随后的社会秩序改革而斗争，并反对地主和资本家联盟的过程中，正在形成一种在后者政治霸权下的劳动者和农民联盟，该联盟是无产阶级专政的基础。

过渡时期整体的特征是对剥削者抵抗的无情镇压，社会主义建设的组织，按照社会主义路线对民众进行大规模重塑，以及阶级的逐步废除。只有在解决了这些伟大的历史问题之后，过渡时期的社会才开始转变为共产主义社会。

以这种方式，将世界资本主义经济转变为社会主义经济的必要先决条件是世界无产阶级的专政。这种专政只能作为社会主义在个别国家或一组国家中胜利的结果而实施，其方式是组织新的社会主义共和国，并与已存在的共和国结成联邦制联盟，当这些联邦制联盟的网络数量增加，包括从帝国主义枷锁中解放出来的殖民地时，当这些共和国的联邦最终转变为世界苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟时，实现在国际国家组织的无产阶级霸权下的人类统一。
无产阶级夺取政权不是一种和平的

"conquest" of the bourgeois state machine already in existence by means of parliamentary majority. The bourgeoisie makes use of violence and terrorism in order to keep for itself and to strengthen its plundered property and its political domination. The bourgeoisie cannot, as in former days of feudal nobility, give up its historic place to a new class without a desperate and furious struggle. Therefore its resistance should be broken only by means of stern violence on the part of the proletariat. The seizure of power by the proletariat is a forceful overthrow of the bourgeois power, the destruction of the capitalist state administration (bourgeois army, police, bureaucracy, courts, parliaments etc., and their substitution by new organs of proletarian authority which is, before everything else, the weapon in the suppression of exploitation.

2. Dictatorship of the proletariat and its soviet form.

The most expedient form of proletarian power is, as the experience of the October revolution of 1917 and the Hungarian revolution that has immensely widened experience of the Paris commune of 1871, have shown, a new type of state, radically differing from the bourgeois state not only in its class character but even in its internal structure, namely - the type of soviet state. Only this type of state, evolved by the broad mass movement of the toilers, can assure the highest degree of activity to the masses and, therefore, it is the greatest pledge in final victory.

The state of the soviet type, being the highest form of proletarian democracy, differs essentially from bourgeois democracy, which represents a veiled form of bourgeois dictatorship. The soviet proletarian state is the latter's dictatorship, its class absolutism. Unlike the bourgeois democracy, it openly declares its class character, openly pursues the object of suppression of exploiters for the sake of the great majority of the proletariat. It denies political rights to its class opponents and it may, under particular historic conditions, invest the proletariat with a number of temporary privileges for the purpose of strengthening its leading role in conjunction with the unmatched petty-bourgeois peasantry. By disarming and suppressing its class opponents, the proletarian state is considering, at the same time, this privation of political rights and certain restrictions of freedom, as a temporary expediency of struggle and not attempts made by exploiters to save or to take back their privileges. It inscribes on its banner that the proletariat is not taking the power into its hands for ever or for the defense of its corporative or narrow professional interests, but in order to unify the remaining non-organized masses of peasants, proletarians and semi-proletarians, as well as the toiling peasants, together with the foremost classes of workers, by gradually and systematically abolishing class division. As it is a universal form of unification and organization of masses under the guidance of the proletariat, the soviets practically involved the broad masses of proletariat, peasants and toilers into a struggle and socialist construction; they involve them xxxs in the governing of state, basing its work upon mass organizations of the labour class, put into effect principles of broad democracy within toiling masses and are standing nearer to masses than any other form of power. The right of recall of delegations, the right of their recall, the union between executive and legislative powers, the elections not on territorial but on production principle (from factories, workshops etc.) - all this secures to the labour class and to the mass of toilers, marching under its hegemony, constant, active participation in all social matters - economic, political, military and cultural, thus establishing marked difference between the bourgeois parliamentary republic and the soviet dictatorship of the proletariat.

The bourgeois democracy with its principle of formal equality of citizens before law depends on the crying class inequality in material economic respect. Leaving totally untouched, defending and strengthening monopoly of capitalist class and the right of big land-owners on the means of production, the bourgeois democracy turns the formal equality

“征服”，即通过议会多数派来接管现存的资产阶级国家机器。资产阶级使用暴力和恐怖手段，以保持和加强其掠夺来的财产及其政治统治。资产阶级不能像昔日封建贵族那样，不经绝望和激烈的斗争就将自己的历史地位让给一个新阶级。因此，其抵抗只能通过无产阶级方面的严厉暴力来打破。无产阶级夺取政权是对资产阶级权力的强力推翻，是对资本主义国家行政机构（资产阶级军队、警察、官僚机构、法院、议会等）的摧毁，并以新的无产阶级权力机构取而代之，这首先是镇压剥削的武器。

2. 无产阶级专政及其苏维埃形式。

正如1917年十月革命和匈牙利革命的经验所表明的那样，这些经验极大地丰富了1871年巴黎公社的经验，最适宜的无产阶级权力形式是一种新型国家，它不仅在阶级性质上，甚至在其内部结构上都与资产阶级国家有着根本的不同，即——苏维埃国家类型。只有这种由广大劳工群众运动演变而来的国家类型，才能确保群众最高程度的积极性，因此，它是最终胜利的最大保证。

苏维埃类型的国家作为无产阶级民主的最高形式，本质上不同于代表资产阶级专政隐蔽形式的资产阶级民主。苏维埃无产阶级国家是后者的专政，是其阶级绝对主义。与资产阶级民主不同，它公开声明其阶级性质，公开追求为了绝大多数无产阶级的利益而镇压剥削者的目标。它否认其阶级对手的政治权利，并且可能在特定的历史条件下，赋予无产阶级一些临时特权，目的是在与无可匹敌的小资产阶级农民结合的情况下加强其领导作用。通过解除其阶级对手的武装并予以镇压，无产阶级国家同时将这种政治权利的剥夺和某些自由限制视为暂时的斗争权宜之计，而非剥削者为保存或夺回其特权所做的尝试。它在旗帜上写明，无产阶级掌握权力并非为了永久或为了保卫其团体或狭隘的职业利益，而是为了将剩余的未组织起来的农民、无产阶级和半无产阶级群众，以及劳动农民，与最先进的工人阶级联合起来，通过逐步和系统地废除阶级划分。由于它是在无产阶级指导下统一和组织群众的普遍形式，苏维埃实际上将广大的无产阶级、农民和劳动者卷入斗争和社会主义建设；他们让他们 xxxs 参与国家治理，将其工作建立在工人阶级的群众组织之上，在劳动群众中实行广泛民主的原则，并且比任何其他形式的权力都更贴近群众。代表的罢免权，他们的召回权，行政权和立法权的结合，选举不是基于地域原则而是基于生产原则（从工厂、车间等）——所有这些都确保了工人阶级及其霸权下行进的广大劳动者持续、积极地参与所有社会事务——经济、政治、军事和文化事务，从而确立了资产阶级议会共和国与无产阶级苏维埃专政之间的显著差异。

资产阶级民主以其公民在法律面前形式平等的原则为基础，依赖于物质经济方面令人痛心的阶级不平等。资产阶级民主完全不动、捍卫并加强资本家阶级对生产资料的垄断和大土地所有者的权利，将形式上的平等

instance, the democratic rights and liberties - into a juridical
fiction and, therefore, into a means of deceit and enslavement of mas-
ses. The so-called democracy, being a manifestation of political domi-
nation of bourgeoisie, is therefore a capitalist democracy. The soviet
state, by depriving the exploiting classes of means of production and
by monopolising these means of production in the prolet riat's hands,
as a dominant class, guarantees to them material conditions for the
realisation of the rights to labour class and to toilers in general, by
securing houses, public utility dwellings, printing offices, means of
transport etc. for the labour class.

With regard to political rights the soviet state, while depriving
the people's enemies and exploiters of these rights, is the first state
who abolish inequality of citizenship, based, in the systems now in
existence, on the difference of sex, religion, nationality; it estab-
lishes in this respect an equality that has not yet been realized in
any bourgeois country, at the same time over here the dictatorship of
the proletariat resolutely puts the material groundwork, assisting
to realisation and practice of this equality; such, for instance, is
emancipation of women, contribution to industrialisation of former
colonies etc.

Soviet democracy is therefore a proletarian democracy, the democ-
racy of the toiling masses, the democracy against exploitation.
The soviet state effects the complete disarmament of the bourgeoisie
and a concentration of arms in the hands of the proletariat; it is a
state of armed proletariat. The organisation of armed forces is being
effected on class principle in accordance with the system of proleta-
rian dictatorship and securing to the industrial proletariat a leading
role. This organisation, relying upon revolutionary discipline, ensures
at the same time constant and intimate connection between fighters of
the red army and the fleet and toiling masses, their participation in
the governing of country and construction of socialism.

3. Dictatorship of proletariat and expropriation of expropriators.

The victorious proletariat uses the power, already seized, as a
lever for the economic revolution, i.e. for the revolutionary refor-
mation of property relations of capitalism with regard to socialist
ways of production. A starting point of this greatest economic revolu-
tion is the expropriation of land owners and capitalists i.e. conver-
sion of bourgeois monopolist property into a property of the proleta-
rian state.
In this respect the Communist International puts forward the
following main problems of the proletarian dictatorship:

A. INDUSTRY, TRANSPORT, COMMUNICATIONS SERVICES.

a) The confiscation and proletarian nationalisation of all big in-
dustrial enterprises (factories, mills, mines, electric stations),
at present the property of private capital, with transfer into the
hands of the soviets of all state and communal enterprises.
b) The confiscation and proletarian nationalisation of private-
capital railways, automobile and water transport, as well as the means
of aerial transport (commercial and passenger aerial fleet), with
transfer into the hands of the soviets of the state and communal right
of ownership over transport of all kinds.
c) The confiscation and proletarian nationalisation of the private-
capitalistic means of communications (telegraph, telephone, radio)
with transfer into the hands of the soviets of the state, municipal
& c. communications.
d) The organisation of workers' administration in industry. The
creation of state organs of administration with close participation in
it of the Trade Unions. Reservation of the same role to factory commit-
tees.

在被剥削阶级，首先是无产阶级面前，法律将民主权利和自由变成一种法律虚构，从而变成欺骗和奴役群众的手段。所谓的民主，作为资产阶级政治统治的表现，因此是资本主义民主。苏维埃国家通过剥夺剥削阶级的生产资料并将这些生产资料垄断在作为统治阶级的无产阶级手中，通过为工人阶级提供住房、公用住宅、印刷所、交通工具等，保证了他们实现劳动权以及一般劳动者权利的物质条件。

在政治权利方面，苏维埃国家在剥夺人民的敌人和剥削者的这些权利的同时，是第一个废除基于现行制度中性别、宗教、国籍差异的公民身份不平等的国家；它在这方面建立了一种在任何资产阶级国家尚未实现的平等，同时在这里，无产阶级专政坚决地为这种平等的实现和实践奠定物质基础；例如妇女解放、促进前殖民地工业化等。

因此，苏维埃民主是无产阶级民主，是劳动群众的民主，是反对剥削的民主。苏维埃国家实行资产阶级的完全解除武装，并将武器集中在无产阶级手中；它是一个武装无产阶级的国家。武装力量的组织是按照无产阶级专政的制度并根据阶级原则进行的，确保工业无产阶级发挥领导作用。这一组织依靠革命纪律，同时确保红军和舰队的战士与劳动群众之间保持持续和密切的联系，使他们参与国家管理和社会主义建设。

3. 无产阶级专政与剥夺剥夺者。

胜利的无产阶级利用已经掌握的权力作为经济革命的杠杆，即对资本主义财产关系进行符合社会主义生产方式的革命性改造。这场最伟大的经济革命的起点是剥夺地主和资本家，即将资产阶级垄断财产转变为无产阶级国家的财产。

在这方面，共产国际提出了无产阶级专政的以下主要问题：

A. 工业、交通、通讯服务。

a) 没收并实行无产阶级国有化所有目前属于私人资本的大型工业企业（工厂、磨坊、矿山、发电站），并将所有国家和 communal（公社/地方公共）企业移交给苏维埃。
b) 没收并实行无产阶级国有化私人资本的铁路、汽车和水路运输，以及航空运输手段（商业和客运航空机队），并将各种运输的国家及 communal（公社/地方公共）所有权移交给苏维埃。
c) 没收并实行无产阶级国有化私人资本主义的通讯手段（电报、电话、无线电），并将国家、市政等通讯设施移交给苏维埃。
d) 在工业中组织工人管理。建立有工会密切参与的行政管理国家机关。工厂委员会保留同样的作用。

e) Adaptation of industrial production for the purpose of
satisfying the needs of the broad masses of toilers. Reorganization
of those branches of industry adapted to the demand of the dominating
class of consumers (articles of luxury etc.) The reinforcement of
these branches of industry, which will contribute towards the amelio-
ration of agriculture in order to secure cooperation with the peasants,
the raise of state economy and the acceleration of the development
of popular economy in general.

B. AGRICULTURE.

a) The confiscation and proletarian nationalisation of all private
land and property in cities and villages (private as well as those
belonging to monasteries, churches etc.) with transfer into the hands
of the soviets of state and municipal land property, including forest
stock, mines, waters etc. and the subsequent nationalisation of all
lands.
b) The confiscation of all productive properties in big land
estates as buildings, implements and cattle, the enterprises for
the manufacture of agricultural production ( big flour mills, cheese-
dairies, dairies, drying-places etc.).
c) The transfer of large estates, especially those having model
economic character or large economic importance, to the administration
of soviet economies.
d) The transfer of a part of the lands formerly belonging to
land owners and other confiscated lands, especially in those places
where these lands were cultivated by farmers on lease and used as a
means for the economic enslavement of farmers into the use of pea-
sants ( to poorest and partially to the middle classes). The amount
of land which is to be handed over to farmers has been determined
both by consideration of expediency and by necessity of neutralizing
the peasantry and to draw them over the side of the proletariat;
this amount varies according to different conditions.
e) The prohibition, in order to secure lands for the peasants
and for the purpose of facilitating the struggle against the transfer
of these lands into the hands of capitalists, of any purchase or
selling of lands. A resolute struggle against violators of this law.
f) Struggle against money lenders. Abolition of servitude obli-
gations. Suppression of debts contracted by the exploited classes of
peasants. To relieve the poorest peasants from taxes etc.
g) Broad state measures for raising productive forces of agri-
culture: rural electrification, the building of tractors, the produc-
tion of chemical manure, the raising of clean seeds and the breeding
of cattle on soviet estates, the organisation on a large scale of
agricultural credit etc.
h) The support and financing of the rural cooperative societies
and of all forms of collective production in villages (associations,
communes etc.) Systematic propaganda for the creation of cooperative
unions of farmers (cooperation for sale, supply and credit) on the
basis of the mass activity of peasants and propaganda of transition
to the large forms of agricultural production, which will facilitate -
in view of the uncontested technical and economic advantages of economy
the obtaining of the larger economic profit, as well as the most
comprehensible to the masses of toilers means of transition to socia-
lism.

C. COMMERCE and CREDIT.

a) Proletarian nationalisation of private banks ( with transfer
into the hands of the proletarian State of the whole stock of gold,
valuable papers, deposits etc) and transfer into the hands of the
proletarian State of State, municipal and other banks.
b) Centralisation of bank operations with subordination of all
nationalized big banks to the central state bank.
c) Nationalization and transfer into the hands of organs of the
soviet state of the wholesale trade and big retail trading enterpri-
ses (godowns, elevators, shops, stock of goods etc).
d) The encouragement, in every way, of organised consumptive

e) 调整工业生产以满足广大劳动群众的需求。重组那些适应主导消费阶级需求（奢侈品等）的行业部门。加强那些有助于改善农业的行业部门，以确保与农民的合作，提升国家经济并加速整体国民经济的发展。

B. 农业。

a) 没收并实行无产阶级国有化城市和乡村中的所有私人土地和财产（私人的以及属于修道院、教堂等的财产），将国家和市政的土地财产，包括森林储备、矿山、水域等移交给苏维埃，并随后将所有土地国有化。
b) 没收大型地产中的所有生产性财产，如建筑物、农具和牲畜，以及农产品加工企业（大型面粉厂、奶酪厂、乳品厂、烘干场等）。
c) 将大型地产，特别是那些具有模范经济性质或重大经济意义的地产，移交给苏维埃经济体管理。
d) 将原属地主的一部分土地和其他被没收的土地，特别是在那些土地由佃农耕种并被用作经济奴役农民手段的地方，转交给农民使用（给最贫困者，部分给中农）。移交給农民的土地数量既考虑到适宜性，也考虑到中立化农民并将其拉到无产阶级一边的必要性；这一数量根据不同情况而有所不同。
e) 为确保农民拥有土地并便于防止这些土地转入资本家手中，禁止任何土地买卖。坚决打击违反此法的行为。
f) 打击放贷者。废除奴役性义务。免除被剥削农民阶层所欠债务。减轻最贫困农民的税收等负担。
g) 采取广泛的国家措施以提高农业生产力：农村电气化，制造拖拉机，生产化肥，在苏维埃农场培育良种和繁殖牲畜，大规模组织农业信贷等。
h) 支持和资助农村合作社以及乡村中各种形式的集体生产（协会、公社等）。在农民群众活动的基础上，系统宣传建立农民合作联盟（销售、供应和信贷合作），并宣传向大规模农业生产形式过渡，鉴于其无可争议的技术和经济优势，这将有助于获得更大的经济效益，也是广大劳动群众最容易理解的向社会主义过渡的方式。

C. 商业和信贷。

a) 对私人银行实行无产阶级国有化（将全部黄金储备、有价证券、存款等移交给无产阶级国家），并将国家、市政和其他银行移交给无产阶级国家。
b) 集中银行业务，将所有国有化的大银行隶属于中央国家银行。
c) 将批发贸易和大型零售贸易企业（仓库、升降机、商店、货物库存等）国有化并移交给苏维埃国家机构。
d) 通过各种方式鼓励有组织的消费

societies, which is the most important part of the distributive
apparatus, on the basis of unity, in the system of its work for
securing self-active participation of the masses in its building up.
e) Monopoly of foreign trade.
f) Abrogation of state debts due to foreign and home capitalists.

E. DEFENSE OF LABOUR, WAYS OF LIFE etc.

a) Reduction of the working day to 7 hours, and to 6 hours in
particularly unhealthy branches of production, further reduction of
the working day and establishment of 5 working days a week in the
countries with highly developed production. The regulations of the
working day according to the growth of the productiveness of labour.
b) The prohibition, as a rule, of night work and of women's work
in particularly unhealthy enterprises. Prohibition of child labour.
Prohibition of extra work.
c) Special short working day for the young peoples (maximum of
6 hours working day for youths up to 18 years of age). Socialistic
reorganisation. Reorganisation on socialist lines of the labour of
young people by means of coordination of material production with gene-
ral or political education.
d) State insurance of all kind (invalids, old age, accidents,
unemployment etc.) on the basis of complete self-administration of
those insured by state ( and those insured by private owners as long
as private enterprises are in existence).
e) Large sanitary measures, organisation of medical assistance
free of charge. Struggle against social diseases (alcoholism, venereal
maladies, tuberculosis).
f) Social equality of women and men before the law and in family
life, radical revision of matrimonial and family laws, declaration
of maternity as being a social function, defense of maternity and
infancy. Beginning of the realisation by the society of infant and
youth nursing and their education (infant schools, kindergarten etc).
Creation of institutions for the gradual facilitation of family eco-
nomy (social kitchens and laundries), plan and cultural struggle
against ideology and traditions contributing towards the enslavement
of women.

F. DWELLING FUND.

a) The confiscation of big privately owned dwellings.
b) The handing over of the confiscated houses to the local so -
viet's management.
c) To settle the labour population in the bourgeois quarters of
cities.
d) The handing over to labour organisations of palaces, the
big social or private dwellings.
e) Realisation of the large programme of dwelling construction.

F. NATIONAL AND COLONIAL PROBLEMS.

a) Recognition of the rights of all nationals, regardless of
race, full self-determination, that is, a self-determination admitting
of state separation.
b) Voluntary union and centralisation of military and economic
forces of all peoples liberated from capitalism for the struggle
against imperialism and for the building up of socialist economy.
c) Unrelenting and resolute struggle against all sorts of res-
trictions or restraints directed against any nationals, nation or
race. Full equality of all nations and races.
d) Full assistance and support of the soviet state to the cultures
of the nationals liberated from the capitalist nations together with
proletarian line of policy for the development of these cultures.
e) Full support to the economic, political and cultural growth
of the formerly oppressed "regions", "borderlands" and "colonies" on
the line of their socialist reformation for the creation of a strong
base for full and real national equality.
