社团，这是分配机制中最重要的部分，在其工作体系中基于统一性，确保群众积极参与其建设。
e) 对外贸易垄断。
f) 废除欠外国和本国资本家的国家债务。

E. 劳动保护、生活方式等。

a) 将工作日减少到7小时，在特别不健康的生产部门减少到6小时，在生产高度发达的国家进一步减少工作日并实行每周5个工作日。根据劳动生产率的增长调节工作日。
b) 原则上禁止夜班工作和妇女在特别不健康的企业中工作。禁止童工。禁止加班。
c) 为青年人规定特别的短工作日（18岁以下青年最多6小时工作日）。社会主义重组。通过将物质生产与普通教育或政治教育相结合，按社会主义路线重组青年劳动。
d) 各类国家保险（残疾、养老、事故、失业等），基于由国家（以及在私营企业存在期间由私人业主）投保者的完全自我管理。
e) 大规模卫生措施，组织免费医疗援助。打击社会疾病（酗酒、性病、肺结核）。
f) 妇女和男子在法律和家庭生活中的社会平等，彻底修订婚姻和家庭法，宣布生育为社会职能，保护母婴。开始由社会实施婴幼儿和青年的护理及其教育（托儿所、幼儿园等）。建立逐步减轻家庭经济负担的机构（公共食堂和洗衣房），有计划地开展文化斗争，反对导致妇女受奴役的意识形态和传统。

F. 住房基金。

a) 没收大型私有住房。
b) 将被没收的房屋移交给地方苏维埃管理。
c) 将劳动人口安置在城市的资产阶级居住区。
d) 将宫殿、大型社会或私人住宅移交给劳动组织。
e) 实施大规模住房建设计划。

F. 民族和殖民地问题。
*(注：原文此处标号重复为F，依原文译出)*

a) 承认所有民族的权利，不分种族，享有充分的自决权，即允许国家分离的自决权。
b) 自愿联合并集中所有从资本主义解放出来的人民的军事和经济力量，以进行反对帝国主义和建设社会主义经济的斗争。
c) 不懈且坚决地打击针对任何民族、国家或种族的各种限制或约束。所有民族和种族的完全平等。
d) 苏维埃国家全力支持从资本主义国家解放出来的各民族的文化，并采取无产阶级政策路线发展这些文化。
e) 全力支持以前受压迫的“地区”、“边远地区”和“殖民地”在经济、政治和文化上的增长，沿着社会主义改造路线，为建立充分和真实的民族平等奠定坚实基础。

pages.en:
f) Struggle against all vestiges of chauvinism, national hatred,
race prejudices and similar ideological products of the feudal and
capitalistic barbarism.

3. MEANS OF IDEOLOGICAL INFLUENCE.

a) Nationalisation of printing offices.
b) Monopoly of press and publishing enterprises.
c) Nationalisation of large cinema enterprises, theatres etc.
d) To profit by the nationalised means of "intellectual production"
for the wide political and general education of toilers and for the
construction of a new socialistic culture on proletarian class basis.

4. BASES OF ECONOMIC POLICY OF THE PROLETARIAN DICTATORSHIP.

It is necessary, in the course of realisation of all these problems
of proletarian dictatorship to keep in view the following principles:
1) The complete abolition of private ownership of land and the
nationalisation of all lands cannot be put into effect immediately in
highly developed capitalist countries, where the principle of private
ownership has already succeeded in taking deep root among the broad
masses of peasants. In such countries the nationalisation of land may
be effected only gradually, through measures of transitory character.

2) The nationalisation of production should not, as a rule, be
extended on the small and average economy (those of peasants, tradesmen,
house industry, small and middle-class merchants, small manufacturers
etc.) Firstly, because the proletariat should strictly discriminate
between the earned by labour property of a simple manufacturer, that
may and should be gradually led into the channel of socialistic con-
struction, and the property of the capitalist exploiter, whose liqui-
dation is a necessary preliminary to socialist construction. Secondly,
because the proletariat which has seized power, may not have enough
organised forces, especially at the starting period of dictatorship,
to enable it not only to destroy capitalism, but also to unify the
small and middle-class individual productive enterprises on a new,
socialistic, basis. These petty private economies (in the first place
peasant's economy), can be drawn into a general socialist organisation
of production and distribution only gradually and with the systematic
and powerful support of the proletarian state. The forcible breaking
of their economic organisation and their forced collectivisation would
give negative results.

3) The existence of a large number of small productive units (in the
first place farmers, tradesmen, small traders etc) not only in the
colonies, semi-colonies and economically backward countries, where
the petty bourgeois masses are in the majority, but even in the centres
of the capitalist world economy (U.S.A., Germany and to some extent
Britain ), renders necessary the preservation, in some or other measure
in the first stages of its development,- of market forms of economic uni-
ty, monetary system etc. Diversity of economic organisations ( from
socialised large industry into an economy of a small peasant or trades-
man ) will certainly be responsible for the struggle of these diverse
economic forms; the diversity of classes and class groups, correspon-
ding to these economic forms, with various stimuli of economic activity
and with their contradictory economic interests; finally the existence
in all branches of the economic life of routine or traditions, inheri-
ted from the bourgeois society which cannot be got rid of all at once,-
all this requires on the part of the economic directors of the proleta-
riat correct combination (on the basis of market relations) of big socia-
listic industry with small economy of petty manufacturers, i.e. of such
combination which can secure a leading role to socialist industry along
with the highest possible development of peasants' agriculture.
pages.zh:
f) 同一切沙文主义、民族仇恨、种族偏见以及封建和资本主义野蛮制度的类似意识形态产物进行斗争。

3. 意识形态影响的手段。

a) 印刷厂国有化。
b) 垄断新闻和出版企业。
c) 大型电影企业、剧院等国有化。
d) 利用国有的“精神生产”手段，对劳动者进行广泛的政治和普通教育，并在无产阶级阶级基础上建设新的社会主义文化。

4. 无产阶级专政的经济政策基础。

在实现无产阶级专政的所有这些问题的过程中，必须牢记以下原则：
1) 在高度发达的资本主义国家，由于私有制原则已在广大农民群众中根深蒂固，因此完全废除土地私有制和将所有土地国有化不能立即实施。在这些国家，土地国有化只能通过过渡性质的措施逐步实现。

2) 生产国有化通常不应扩展到小型和中等经济单位（如农民、手工业者、家庭工业、小商人和中等商人、小制造商等的经济）。首先，因为无产阶级应严格区分简单制造商通过劳动获得的财产（这种财产可以且应当逐步纳入社会主义建设的轨道）与资本家剥削者的财产（后者的消灭是社会主义建设的必要前提）。其次，因为掌握政权的无产阶级，特别是在专政初期，可能没有足够的有组织的力量，使其不仅能摧毁资本主义，还能在新的社会主义基础上统一中小个体生产企业。这些小型私营经济（首先是农民经济），只有在无产阶级国家的系统性和有力支持下，才能逐步被纳入生产和分配的总体社会主义组织中。强行打破其经济组织并强制实行集体化将产生负面结果。

3) 不仅在殖民地、半殖民地和经济落后国家（那里小资产阶级群众占多数），甚至在资本主义世界经济中心（美国、德国以及在某种程度上英国），存在大量小型生产单位（首先是农民、手工业者、小商贩等），这使得在其发展的最初阶段，必须在某种程度上保留市场形式的经济统一体、货币制度等。经济组织的多样性（从社会化的大工业到小农或手工业者的经济）必然导致这些不同经济形式之间的斗争；与这些经济形式相对应的阶级和阶级群体的多样性，具有各种经济活动的刺激因素及其相互矛盾的经济利益；最后，在经济生活的所有分支中，存在着从资产阶级社会继承下来的、无法一下子摆脱的习惯或传统——所有这些都要求无产阶级的经济领导者在市场关系的基础上，将大型社会主义工业与小制造商的小经济正确结合，即这种结合既能确保社会主义工业的领导地位，又能使农民农业得到尽可能高的发展。

Therefore the larger is the specific gravity of the individual
peasant labour in the whole economy of the country and the larger
the volume of the market relations, plan direction will acquire lesser
importance and in the greater degree the economic plan is dependent
on the forecast of economic relations. On the contrary the smaller the
specific gravity of the small economy, the greater xxx is the parti-
cipation of the socialised labour, the more powerful are the accumu-
lated and socialized masses of means of production, the less is the
amount of market relations, the more importance has a plan when compared
with elementary action, the more considerable is the importance of the
universal methods of plan direction in the matters of production and
distribution.

The technical and economic advantages of heavy socialised produc-
tion, the centralisation of the general economic management (industry,
transport, big agricultural economies etc) in the hands of the proleta-
rian state, the plan direction of the output, the state administration
(budget, taxes, administrative legislation and legislature in general)
are leading to the gradual and systematic elimination of private
capital. On the other hand, ranking with this there is a process of
systematical involving of masses of peasants by means of the organisa-
tion of co-operative societies and by the growth of collective forms
of agriculture, into a general system in the development of socialism.
The forms and methods of economic activity tied up with market rela-
tions (wages, purchase-selling, credit and banks etc) are the levers
for the socialist transformation so long as these levers are used
in enterprises strictly socialistic in type, i.e. socialist section
of the economy.

In this manner the market relations, under the proletarian
dictatorship, if a correct policy is pursued by the soviet government,
will contain in their development their own ruin; while contributing
to the elimination of the private capital, the further centralisation
and concentration of the means of production in the hands of proleta-
rian state, they concur to the abolition of the market relations
in general.

In case of probable capitalist military intervention and of las-
ting counter-revolutionary war against dictatorship of the proletariat
the whole attention of the economic directing organs should be con-
centrated on the defence of the interests of the proletarian dicta-
torship; in this case the necessity may arise for a military-communist
economic policy ("military-communism") which is an organisation
of state economy for the purpose of war defense together with a
system of enforced pressure upon the capitalist groups (confiscations,
requisitions) and with the more or less complete cessation of free
trade and market relations and the sharp elimination of individual
stimuli of small producers entailing the fall of productive forces
of the country. The policy of "military communism" while undermining
the material basis of those classes within country which are hostile
to the labour class, in securing rational distribution of the stocks,
contributes to the success of the war struggle of the proletarian
dictatorship and, though it has its historic raison d'etre, it cannot
be looked upon as a system of "normal" economic policy of the proleta-
rian dictatorship.

5. PROLETARIAN DICTATORSHIP AND MARKETS.

The proletarian dictatorship is a continuation of its class
struggle under new conditions. It is a stubborn struggle, bloody or
bloodless, forcible or peaceful, military or economic - against the
forces and traditions of the old society, against foreign capitalist
enemies, against the remnants of the exploiting classes within the
country, against the sprouts of the new bourgeoisie arising on the basis
of the production, which has not yet been abolished.

When civil war is still in progress, the stubborn class struggle
assumes new form, firstly the form of a struggle against the remnants
of the old economic order with its new sprouts, on the one hand,
and socialistic forms of economy - on the other; the forms of struggle

因此，个体农民劳动在全国经济中的比重越大，市场关系的规模越大，计划指导的重要性就越小，经济计划在更大程度上依赖于对经济关系的预测。相反，小经济的比重越小，社会化劳动的参与度 xxx 越大，积累和社会化的生产资料 masses 越强大，市场关系的数量越少，与自发行动相比，计划的重要性就越大，计划指导在生产 and 分配事务中的普遍方法的重要性也就越显著。

重工业社会化生产的技术和经济优势，总体经济管理（工业、交通、大型农业经济等）集中在无产阶级国家手中，对产出的计划指导，国家行政管理（预算、税收、行政立法和一般立法）正导致私人资本的逐步和系统性消除。另一方面，与此并行的是，通过组织合作社和发展农业集体化形式，将广大农民群众系统地卷入社会主义发展的总体体系的过程。与市场关系相联系的经济活动形式和方法（工资、买卖、信贷和银行等）是社会主义改造的杠杆，只要这些杠杆被严格用于社会主义类型的企业，即经济的社会主义部门。

以这种方式，在无产阶级专政下，如果苏维埃政府执行正确的政策，市场关系在其发展中将包含其自身的毁灭；它们在有助于消除私人资本、进一步集中和汇聚生产资料于无产阶级国家手中的同时，也促成了市场关系的一般废除。

如果可能发生资本主义军事干预以及针对无产阶级专政的持久反革命战争，经济领导机构的全部注意力应集中于保卫无产阶级专政的利益；在这种情况下，可能需要实行军事共产主义经济政策（“军事共产主义”），这是一种为战争防御目的而组织的国家经济，伴随着对资本主义集团的强制压力体系（没收、征用），自由贸易和市场关系的或多或少完全停止，以及严厉消除小生产者的个人刺激因素，从而导致国家生产力的下降。“军事共产主义”政策虽然削弱了国内敌对工人阶级的那些阶级的物质基础，并通过确保物资的合理分配，有助于无产阶级专政战争斗争的胜利，尽管它具有历史存在的理由，但不能被视为无产阶级专政的“正常”经济政策体系。

5. 无产阶级专政与市场。

无产阶级专政是在新条件下其阶级斗争的延续。这是一场顽强的斗争，无论是流血的还是不流血的，强制的还是和平的，军事的还是经济的——反对旧社会的势力和传统，反对外国资本主义敌人，反对国内剥削阶级的残余，反对在尚未被废除的生产基础上 arising 的新资产阶级的萌芽。

当内战仍在进行时，顽强的阶级斗争采取新的形式，首先是一方面反对带有新萌芽的旧经济秩序残余，另一方面反对社会主义经济形式；斗争的形式

change at different stages of the socialistic development, and in
its first stages this struggle may, under certain conditions, assume
an acute character; the first stage of the proletarian dictatorship
the proletarian policy towards other classes and social groups within
the country will be determined by the following principles:
1) big bourgeoisie and land-owners, the units of military officers
devoted to them, the generals and the upper classes of bureaucracy are
irreconcilable enemies of the labour class, therefore against them an
unmerciful struggle is required. The professional organizing ability
of certain sections parts of them may be used, but, as a rule, not
before the dictatorship has been strengthened and all exploiters' plots
and insurrections have been suppressed.
2) With regard to the intellectuals, educated in bourgeois tradi-
tions, the upper classes of which are intimately connected with the
commanding staff of capital, the proletariat, while suppressing most
resolutely every counter-revolutionary movement of the hostile intellec-
tuals, should at the same time not lose sight of the necessity
of employing this trained social force for socialist construction by
encouraging in every way the neutral groups and particularly those
friendly to labour revolution. When working out plans of socialist
economic-technical and cultural construction, the proletariat should
systematically gain over its side the technical intelligentsia, sub-
mitting them to its ideological influence and securing their close
cooperation in matters of social construction.
3) With regard to peasants, the problem faced by communist parties
consists in relying upon the agricultural proletariat to gain over their
side all the exploited and toiling elements of villages, making discri-
mination among various groups of peasants and taking into consideration
their special gravity, the victorious proletariat should by all possible
means give support to the poor semi-proletarian classes of peasantry,
handing over to them part of the land-owners' lands, facilitating their
struggle with the usurers etc. The proletariat must neutralise the
middle classes of peasants and mercilessly suppress the slightest resis-
tance on the part of the village bourgeoisie allied with the land-owners.
In proportion with the consolidation of its dictatorship and with the
development of socialist construction the proletariat should abandon
the policy of neutralisation, adopt a policy of solid alliance with the
middle class masses of peasants, refraining at the same time from
sharing any power with them. The dictatorship of the proletariat is, on
the one hand, a manifestation of the fact that only the industrial
labourer are capable of directing the whole mass of toilers, and, on
the other, that the dictatorship of the proletariat, being its absolutely
is at the same time a special form of class union between the proletariat
this vanguard of the toilers, and the numerous non-proletarian toiling
classes, the alliance directed against capital, the alliance aiming at
the latter's complete destruction, at the complete suppression of bourg-
eois resistance and attempts at restoration from outside, the alli-
ance aiming at a final creation and consolidation of socialism,
4) Petty bourgeoisie of cities, which is always wavering between
the two extremities between the treachery and sympathy for the prole-
tariat - should also be neutralised and, as far as possible, won over
to the proletarian side. This may be accomplished by allowing small
property ownership, a certain freedom of economic transactions, by
abolishing usury and by various forms of assistance rendered to them
by the proletariat in the struggle against all forms of capitalist
oppression.

MASS ORGANISATIONS IN THE SYSTEM OF PROLETARIAN
DICTATORSHIP.

When putting into effect all these problems of proletarian dicta-
torship, the problems and functions of mass organisations and, in the
first place those of labour organisations - are being radically chan-
ged. The professional productive unions, these labour mass organisa-
tions, in which broad masses of proletariat are for the first time united
and trained are during the capitalist period the main weapon of
struggle by strike, then of the mass struggle against capital and its
state. Under the proletarian dictatorship they transform themselves

在社会主义发展的不同阶段会发生变化，而在其初期阶段，这种斗争在某些条件下可能具有尖锐的性质；在无产阶级专政的第一阶段，无产阶级对国内其他阶级和社会群体的政策将由以下原则决定：

1) 大资产阶级和地主、效忠于他们的军官团体、将军以及官僚阶层的上层人物是工人阶级不可调和的敌人，因此必须对他们进行无情的斗争。他们中某些部分的专业组织能力可以被利用，但通常只有在专政得到加强、所有剥削者的阴谋和叛乱被镇压之后方可如此。

2) 关于受资产阶级传统熏陶的知识分子，其上层与资本的领导层有着密切的联系，无产阶级在坚决镇压敌对知识分子的一切反革命运动的同时，不应忽视通过鼓励中立群体、特别是那些对劳工革命友好的群体，来利用这支受过训练的社会力量进行社会主义建设的必要性。在制定社会主义经济技术和文化建设计划时，无产阶级应系统地争取技术知识分子站在自己一边，使他们接受自己的意识形态影响，并确保他们在社会建设事务中进行紧密合作。

3) 关于农民，共产党面临的问题在于依靠农业无产阶级，争取农村中所有被剥削和劳作的元素站在自己一边，区分不同的农民群体并考虑到他们的特殊比重，胜利的无产阶级应尽一切可能支持贫农半无产阶级阶层，将部分地主的土地移交给他们，便利他们与高利贷者等的斗争。无产阶级必须使中农保持中立，并无情地镇压与地主结盟的乡村资产阶级的任何微小抵抗。随着其专政的巩固和社会主义建设的发展，无产阶级应放弃中立政策，采取与广大中农群众建立牢固联盟的政策，同时不与它们分享任何权力。无产阶级专政一方面表明只有产业工人能够领导广大劳动者，另一方面，无产阶级专政作为其绝对……（原文不清）同时也是工人阶级这一劳动者先锋队与众多非无产阶级劳动阶级之间的一种特殊的阶级联合形式，这种联盟旨在反对资本，旨在彻底摧毁资本，彻底镇压资产阶级的抵抗和来自外部的复辟企图，旨在最终建立和巩固社会主义，

4) 城市小资产阶级总是在背叛和对无产阶级的同情这两个极端之间摇摆不定——也应使其保持中立，并尽可能争取到无产阶级方面。这可以通过允许小私有制、一定的经济交易自由、废除高利贷以及无产阶级在反对各种形式资本主义压迫的斗争中向他们提供各种形式的援助来实现。

无产阶级专政体系中的群众组织。

在实施无产阶级专政的所有这些问题时，群众组织的问题和职能，首先是劳工组织的问题和职能，正在发生根本性的变化。职业生产工会，这些劳工群众组织，在其中广大无产阶级首次被团结和训练，在资本主义时期是罢工斗争的主要武器，随后是对抗资本及其国家的群众斗争的主要武器。在无产阶级专政下，它们转变为

into a principal lever, into such a school of communism, which involves
large masses of the proletariat into the socialist management of
production, into an organisation directly connected with all branches
of the government administration, exercising influence upon all branches
of its work being watchful of the permanent outstanding interests of
the labour class and carrying out a struggle against the bureaucratic
degeneration of the administrative organs of the soviet state. Trade
Unions, therefore, are transforming themselves into a back-bone of the
economic and state organisation of the proletariat in so far as they
are supplying directing staffs for the constructive work, in the measure
of their involving in this work the masses of the proletariat and in the
measure of their placing before them the struggle against the bureau-
cratic degeneration, which is unavoidably produced by the influences,
foreign to the proletariat, and by insufficient culture of masses.

The cooperative organisations of the labour class, condemned under
the capitalist regime - despite reformist utopias to the contrary - to
a comparatively modest role, sometimes transforming themselves, owing
to general conditions of the capitalist system and to the policy of
reformist leaders, into a mere addition to this capitalist system, can
and should become the most important integral parts of the distribut-
ing apparatus under the dictatorship of proletariat.

Lastly, the agricultural cooperative peasant societies (purchasing,
selling, credit, productive) when properly guided and under the
systematic struggle against capitalist elements, can and should become
one of the basic or linking forms establishing connection between city
and village. The cooperative unions, which - as far as they were proved
capable of living under capitalism - were unavoidably transforming
themselves into capitalistic enterprises, because they were dependent
on capitalist industry, capitalist banks, capitalist economic society
in general and were guided by reformists, village bourgeoisie and
sometimes even by land-owners - these unions under the proletarian
dictatorship are developing themselves within the system of surrounding
relations and are dependent on the proletarian industry, proletarian
banks etc. When the right line of proletarian policy is pursued, when
systematic class struggle against capitalist elements carried on without
cooperative organisations, when directed by the socialist industry -
the agricultural cooperative societies are becoming one of the most
important levers of socialist reconstruction of villages. All this
does not eliminate the possibility of cooperative and especially agri-
cultural associations becoming in some countries, under the guidance
of bourgeoisie and its social-democratic agents, a stronghold of counter-
revolutionary activity and sabotage of the economic construction by
the labour revolution.

In the constructive and fighting work performed by various prole-
tarian organisations, the proletariat secures unity of will and action,
effecting this unity by means of directing role of the communist party
within the system of the dictatorship of the proletariat.

The proletariat's party bases itself directly on the Trade Unions
and on a number of other organisations, including masses of labourers,
and through them and the peasants (soviets, cooperatives, young men's
associations etc) is governing the entire soviet system. It is
only with an unreserved support of the soviet power by all mass orga-
nisations, when there is unity of class will, when guided by the
party, that the proletariat could accomplish its role of organiser of
new society.

7. DICTATORSHIP OF PROLETARIAT AND CULTURAL REVO-
TION.

This role of organiser of a new human society necessitates the
existence of a certain standard of cultural maturity on the part of the
proletariat, the reshaping of its own nature, a constant supply of new
cadres with a technical knowledge and working for the
final aim of the construction of socialism and new socialist culture.

一个主要的杠杆，变成一所共产主义学校，它将广大无产阶级卷入生产的社会主义管理之中，成为一个与政府行政部门所有分支直接相连的组织，对其所有工作部门施加影响，警惕工人阶级的永久突出利益，并与苏维埃国家行政机关的官僚主义退化进行斗争。因此，工会正在转变为无产阶级经济和国家组织的骨干，因为它们为建设工作提供管理人员，在它们将广大无产阶级卷入这项工作的程度上，以及在它们向无产阶级提出反对官僚主义退化的斗争的程度上，这种退化是由异于无产阶级的影响和群众文化不足所不可避免地产生的。

工人阶级的合作组织，在资本主义制度下——尽管改良主义的乌托邦持相反观点——被注定处于相对 modest 的角色，有时由于资本主义体系的一般条件和改良主义领导人的政策，它们甚至转变为该资本主义体系的 mere 补充，但在无产阶级专政下，它们能够而且应该成为分配机构的最重要组成部分。

最后，农业合作社农民协会（采购、销售、信贷、生产），在适当引导和对资本主义元素进行系统斗争的情况下，能够而且应该成为建立城乡联系的基本或链接形式之一。合作社联盟——就其在资本主义下被证明具有生存能力而言——不可避免地转变为资本主义企业，因为它们依赖于资本主义工业、资本主义银行、一般的资本主义经济社会，并由改良主义者、乡村资产阶级，有时甚至由地主指导——这些联盟在无产阶级专政下，在周围关系体系内发展，并依赖于无产阶级工业、无产阶级银行等。当执行正确的无产阶级政策路线时，当在没有合作社组织的情况下对资本主义元素进行系统的阶级斗争时，当由社会主义工业指导时——农业合作社就成为乡村社会主义重建的最重要杠杆之一。所有这些并不排除在某些国家，在资产阶级及其社会民主党代理人的指导下，合作社特别是农业协会可能成为反革命活动的堡垒，并对劳工革命的经济建设进行破坏的可能性。

在各种无产阶级组织进行的建设和战斗工作中，无产阶级确保了意志和行动的统一，通过在无产阶级专政体系中共产党的领导作用来实现这种统一。

无产阶级政党直接建立在工会和包括广大劳动者在内的许多其他组织之上，并通过它们以及农民（苏维埃、合作社、青年协会等）治理整个苏维埃体系。只有在所有群众组织毫无保留地支持苏维埃政权，阶级意志统一，并在党的指导下，无产阶级才能完成其作为新社会组织者的角色。

7. 无产阶级专政与文化革命。

这种作为新人类社会组织者的角色，要求无产阶级具备一定的文化成熟度标准，重塑其自身性质，不断供应具备技术知识的新干部，并为建设社会主义和新社会主义文化的最终目标而努力。

While the bourgeois revolution against feudalism is possible
only when within the feudal society forms a new class, standing,
through its cultural development, above the average class and which
plays within the feudal class a role of hegemon, the proletarian
revolution will develop under totally different conditions. Exploited,
economically, oppressed politically and strangled culturally, the
labour class during the transitory period and after it had fought
for state power, destroyed the bourgeois monopoly of education, ac-
quired command of science and changed its own nature. For the mass
bred of communist self-consciousness and for the sake of socialism the
change of nature of masses of people is essential, what is possible only
in the course of practical movement through a revolution; therefore
revolution is necessary not only because there is no other way left
to overthrow the dominating class, but also because it is only in the
course of a revolution that overthrowing class can purify itself of the
mud of the old society and be in a position to create a new society.

By abolishing the monopoly held by the capitalist class over the
means of production, the labour class should also abolish the bourgeois
monopoly of education, that is to seize all schools including others.
Particularly important problem faced by the proletariat is the training
of industrial specialists out of the labour class (engineers, techni-
cians, organizers etc.) as well as for military purposes, science,
arts etc.) Ranking with this there is a problem to raise the general
culture of the proletarian masses, their political education, their
knowledge and the technical training to give them experience in social
work and administration, to struggle against the remnants of the bour-
geoisie and the petty bourgeois prejudices etc.

Only in a measure as the proletariat succeeds in moving forward
its vanguard elements for filling up all those commanding posts
of socialistic construction and culture, in the measure as these ele-
ments are increasing in number by involving new elements during the
process of cultural revolutionary transformation and by gradually
abolishing distinctions existing within their own classes between the
"advanced" and "backward" proletariat, there is being simultaneously
created the guarantee of victorious socialist construction and security
against bureaucratic putrefaction and class degeneration.
The proletariat, however, is reshaping anew in the process of revolution
not only its own nature, but also the nature of other classes, and in
the first place that of the numerous petty bourgeois classes of towns
and villages and particularly that of the toiling classes of peasants.
By making the broad masses adhere to cultural revolution, by drawing
them into the process of socialist construction, by unifying and by
teaching them communist methods, by carrying on a resolute struggle
against all anti-proletarian and trade-corporation ideologies, especial-
ly by systematically overcoming the general and cultural backwardness
of the village, the labour class is preparing the abolition of class
division in society.

Among the problems of cultural revolution, faced by the broad
masses, a particular place is occupied by the struggle against the
religious opium of the people - religion - a struggle which should be
carried on systematically and most relentlessly. The proletarian power
should discontinue any state support to the church, which was an agent
of the dominating classes; it should prevent any church interference
with state organised education and teaching and must unmercifully
suppress the counter-revolutionary activities of church organisations.
At the same time the proletarian authority, while tolerating a free
profession of creeds and abolishing the privileged position of the
former mother-church, is carrying on with all possible means an anti-
religious propaganda and is reconstructing all educational and teaching
work on the basis of scientific materialist world conception.

5. STRUGGLE FOR WORLD DICTATORSHIP OF PROLETARIAT
AND THE BASIC TYPES OF REVOLUTIONS.

In the international revolution of proletariat different processes
take place at different times; A proper proletarian revolutions revolu-
tions of the bourgeois-democratic type, proletarian revolutions
revolution

资产阶级反封建的革命，只有在封建社会内部形成一个新阶级，该阶级凭借其文化发展水平高于平均阶级水平，并在封建阶级内部扮演霸主角色时，才成为可能；而无产阶级革命则将在完全不同的条件下发展。劳动阶级在经济上受剥削，在政治上受压迫，在文化上受扼杀，在过渡时期及之后，它为争取国家政权而斗争，打破了资产阶级对教育的垄断，掌握了科学并改变了自身的性质。为了在群众中培育共产主义自觉意识，也为了社会主义起见，改变广大群众的性质是至关重要的，而这只有通过革命的实际运动过程才能实现；因此，革命之所以必要，不仅因为没有其他途径可以推翻统治阶级，而且因为只有在革命过程中，推翻旧制度的阶级才能洗清自身沾染的旧社会污泥，从而有能力创建一个新社会。

通过废除资本家阶级对生产资料的垄断，劳动阶级也应当废除资产阶级对教育的垄断，即接管包括其他学校在内的所有学校。无产阶级面临的一个特别重要的问题，是从劳动阶级中培养工业专家（工程师、技术人员、组织者等）以及用于军事、科学、艺术等目的的人才。与此同等重要的是提高无产阶级大众的一般文化水平、他们的政治教育、知识以及技术培训，使他们在社会工作和管理方面获得经验，并与资产阶级残余及小资产阶级偏见等进行斗争。

只有当无产阶级成功地推动其先锋分子去填补社会主义建设和文化的所有那些指挥岗位，只有当这些分子在文化革命转型过程中通过吸纳新成员而数量增加，并逐步消除其阶级内部“先进”与“落后”无产阶级之间存在的区别时，胜利进行社会主义建设的保障以及防止官僚腐化和阶级蜕化的安全机制才会同时建立起来。然而，无产阶级在革命过程中不仅重塑了自身的性质，也重塑了其他阶级的性质，首先是城乡众多小资产阶级阶级的性质，特别是农民劳动阶级的性质。通过使广大群众坚持文化革命，将他们纳入社会主义建设进程，统一并教导他们共产主义方法，坚决反对一切反无产阶级和行会主义意识形态，特别是通过系统地克服农村普遍存在的文化和落后状态，劳动阶级正在为社会中阶级划分的废除做准备。

在广大群众面临的文化革命问题中，反对人民的宗教鸦片——宗教——的斗争占据着特殊地位，这场斗争应当系统且毫不留情地进行。无产阶级政权应停止对作为统治阶级代理人的教会的任何国家支持；应防止教会干涉国家组织的教育和教学工作，并必须无情地镇压教会组织的反革命活动。与此同时，无产阶级当局在容忍信仰自由并废除前国教特权地位的同时，正利用一切可能的手段进行反宗教宣传，并在科学唯物主义世界观的基础上重构所有的教育和教学工作。

5. 为争取无产阶级世界专政而斗争及革命的基本类型。

在无产阶级的国际革命中，不同的进程在不同时间发生：适当的无产阶级革命、资产阶级民主类型的革命、无产阶级革命

of the proletariat; colonial liberation wars; colonial revolutions;
and in the long run, the revolutionary process leads to world dicta-
torship on the part of the proletariat.

Inequality in the development of capitalism, heightened during the
imperialist period, has called into existence these various types,
the different stages of its maturity in various countries, the variety
and specific conditions of the revolutionary process. These circumstan-
ces render historically unavoidable the variance of ways and prompt-
ness of the proletarian advent into power; they render necessary
the existence in a number of countries of certain transitory stages,
leading to the dictatorship of proletariat and then also the various
forms of socialist construction in various countries.

The variance in conditions and ways of transition to the dicta-
torship of the proletariat in separate countries may be reduced to
three main types.

Countries with highly developed capitalism (U. S. A., Germany,
Britain etc.), with powerful productive forces, centralized in a
great degree production, with relatively unimportant role of small
economy, with a-long-time-ago formed up bourgeois-democratic poli-
tical order. In these countries the main point of the programme is imme-
diate establishment of the dictatorship of proletariat. In the econo-
mic respect the most characteristic features are: expropriation of
all big production; the organization of a considerable number of
soviet states economics and, inversely, the transfer of a comparati-
vely small share of the lands to peasants; the comparatively insigni-
ficant dimensions of market relations; the speedy progress of the
socialist development in general and the collectivization of peasants'
economy in particular.

Countries with an average level of development of capitalism
(Spain, Portugal, Hungary, Balkan states etc) with considerable
traces of semi-feudal relations in agriculture together with a certain
minimum of material conditions necessary for socialist construction,
and with the bourgeois-democratic order still in progress of reform.
In some of these countries there is the possibility of more or less
rapid transformation of bourgeois-democratic revolution into a socia-
list revolution; in others - revolutions of a proletarian type are
possible, but with greater number of problems of bourgeois-democratic
character to be solved. Therefore in this instance the dictatorship
of the proletariat may arrive not immediately but in the course of a
process of transition from democratic dictatorship of proletariat and
peasants to the socialist dictatorship of proletariat; in these coun-
tries where the revolution is developing directly as a proletarian
revolution, it presupposes that the proletariat holds direction of the
broad rural peasant movement; generally speaking, the agrarian revolu-
tion plays a most important, sometimes even decisive, role; after the
expropriation of big property the greatest part of the confiscated
land is given to peasants; the dimension of the market relations after
proletariat's victory is considerable; the problem of the creation of
peasant cooperatives and their further unification in the production
occupies an important place among other problems of the socialist
building up. The progress of this construction is comparatively slow.

Colonial and semi-colonial countries (China, India etc.) and de-
pendent countries (Argentina, Brazil etc.) with a rudimentary, some-
times considerably developed, industry insufficient moreover in a ma-
jority of cases for independent socialist construction; the countries
with predominant feudal-medieval relations, and finally the countries
where important industrial, commercial, bank enterprises, principal
means of transport, lands and plantations are concentrated in the
hands of foreign imperialist groups. In this instance of prime impor-
tance is the struggle against feudalism, against pre-capitalistic forms
of exploitation and the promotion of unrelenting agrarian-peasant
revolution on the one hand, and the struggle against foreign imperia-
lism for national freedom on the other. Transition to dictatorship of
proletariat is possible in this instance only through a number of
preparatory stages after a whole period of transformation of the

无产阶级的革命；殖民地解放战争；殖民地革命；而从长远来看，革命进程将导致无产阶级的世界专政。

资本主义发展的不平衡性在帝国主义时期加剧，导致了这些不同类型的产生，各国成熟阶段的不同，以及革命过程的多样性和具体条件。这些情况使得无产阶级夺取权力的方式和迅速程度在历史上不可避免地存在差异；这使得在许多国家存在某些通向无产阶级专政的过渡阶段成为必要，进而也使得各国社会主义建设的形式多种多样。

各国向无产阶级专政过渡的条件和方式的差异，可归结为三种主要类型。

资本主义高度发达的国家（美国、德国、英国等），拥有强大的生产力，生产在很大程度上集中，小经济的作用相对微不足道，资产阶级民主政治秩序早已形成。在这些国家，纲领的重点是立即建立无产阶级专政。在经济方面，最显著的特征是：剥夺所有大型生产资料；组织相当数量的苏维埃国家经济，相反，转让给农民的土地份额相对较小；市场关系的规模相对 insignificant（原文如此，意为微小）；社会主义发展总体进展迅速，特别是农民经济的集体化。

资本主义发展水平中等的国家（西班牙、葡萄牙、匈牙利、巴尔干国家等），农业中留有相当多的半封建关系痕迹，同时具备社会主义建设所需的最低限度的物质条件，资产阶级民主秩序仍处于改革进程中。在这些国家中，有些有可能或多或少迅速地将资产阶级民主革命转变为社会主义革命；而在另一些国家，可能发生无产阶级类型的革命，但需要解决更多具有资产阶级民主性质的问题。因此，在这种情况下，无产阶级专政可能不会立即到来，而是在从工农民主专政向社会主义无产阶级专政过渡的过程中实现；在这些革命直接作为无产阶级革命发展的国家，前提是无产阶级掌握着广大农村农民运动的领导权；一般而言，农业革命起着最重要、有时甚至是决定性的作用；在剥夺大地产后，大部分被没收的土地分给农民；无产阶级胜利后，市场关系的规模相当大；建立农民合作社及其在生产中的进一步联合的问题，在社会主义建设的其他问题中占据重要地位。这种建设的进展相对缓慢。

殖民地和半殖民地国家（中国、印度等）以及附属国（阿根廷、巴西等），其工业基础薄弱，有时虽有相当发展，但在大多数情况下仍不足以进行独立的社会主义建设；这些国家以封建中世纪关系为主，最后，还有一些国家的重要工业、商业、银行企业、主要交通工具、土地和种植园集中在外国帝国主义集团手中。在这种情况下，首要重要的是反对封建主义、反对前资本主义形式的剥削，并推动不懈的农业农民革命，另一方面则是反对帝国主义以争取民族自由。在这种情况下，只有经过一系列准备阶段，在经过整个转变时期之后，才可能过渡到无产阶级专政

bourgeois-democratic revolution into a socialist revolution, and
the successful socialist construction - in most cases is possible
only with the direct support of the proletarian dictatorship.

In still more backward countries (for instance in some parts
of Africa) where there is no hired labour, where the majority of
the population still lives in tribal form and where the remnants of
primitive-generic forms, with almost entire absence of national
bourgeoisie and where foreign imperialism mostly plays the role of
a military occupant, dispossessing land, - the struggle for a national
liberation has a foremost importance. National liberation and its
success here may clear the way for the development of socialism,
skipping the capitalist stage, provided powerful assistance is rende-
red by the countries of proletarian dictatorships.

So during the epoch, when the seizure of power by the proletariat
is being put forth as an outstanding problem, when there is already
in existence the dictatorship of the proletariat in the U.S.S.R., as
a fact of world wide importance,-the liberative movements in the
colonial and semi-colonial countries, provoked by the penetration
therein of world capitalism, may result, despite not sufficiently
ripe social relations in these countries, in their immediate deve-
lopment with the aid and assistance of the proletarian dictatorship
and the international proletarian movement in general.

3. MABADLA FOR THE IMMEDIATE TASK OF THE COMMUNIST
PARTIES IN COLONIAL COUNTRIES.

The special conditions of revolutionary struggle in the most
important colonial and semi-colonial countries, the inevitability of
a long period of struggle for democratic dictatorship of proletariat
and peasants and transformation of this dictatorship into that of the
proletariat, and lastly, the decisive importance of national factors
put before the communist parties of these countries a number of spe-
cific problems, representing by themselves a preparatory stage to
dictatorship of the proletariat. The principal of these special pro-
blems, in the opinion of the Communist International, are the follo-
wing:
1) the overthrow of the authority of foreign imperialism, feudal
and land-owners' bureaucracy.
2) the establishment of democratic dictatorship of the proleta-
riat and peasants on soviet principles.
3) Full national freedom and state of unification.
4) Abrogation of state debts.
5) the nationalisation of large enterprises (industrial, trans-
port, banks and others) belonging to imperialists.
6) the confiscation of lands belonging to land-owners, churches
and monasteries. Nationalisation of all lands.
7) establishment of 7 hours working day.
8) the organisation of revolutionary labour peasant army.

In the measure of development and of heightening of further
struggle (sabotage of bourgeoisie, confiscation of enterprises belon-
ging to the classes of bourgeoisie, inevitably transforming itself
into the nationalisation of big industry) in those colonies and semi-
colonies where the proletariat plays a role of director, the succeeding
bourgeois-democratic revolution will transform itself into a revolu-
tion of the proletariat. In the colonies, where there is no proleta-
riat, the overthrow of imperialist power should mean the organisation
of the authority of the people's (peasants) soviets, the confiscation
of foreign enterprises and lands and their transfer into state hands.

资产阶级民主革命转变为社会主义革命，以及成功的社会主义建设——在大多数情况下，只有在无产阶级专政的直接支持下才可能实现。

在更为落后的国家（例如非洲的某些地区），那里没有雇佣劳动，大部分人口仍以部落形式生活，原始氏族形式的残余依然存在，几乎完全没有民族资产阶级，而外国帝国主义主要扮演军事占领者的角色，剥夺土地——争取民族解放的斗争具有首要的重要性。在此类国家，如果得到无产阶级专政国家的有力援助，民族解放及其成功可以为社会主义的发展扫清道路，从而跨越资本主义阶段。

因此，在这个时代，当夺取政权成为无产阶级面临的突出问题时，当苏联已经存在作为具有世界重要性事实的无产阶级专政时——由世界资本主义渗透所引发的殖民地和半殖民地国家的解放运动，尽管这些国家的社会关系尚不够成熟，但在无产阶级专政及国际无产阶级运动的普遍援助和帮助下，可能会直接发展为社会主义。

3. 殖民地国家共产党当前任务的基础。

最重要的殖民地和半殖民地国家革命斗争的特殊条件、为建立工农民主专政并进行长期斗争以及将这种专政转变为无产阶级专政的必然性，最后，民族因素的决定性重要性，向这些国家的共产党提出了一系列具体问题，这些问题本身构成了通向无产阶级专政的准备阶段。共产国际认为，这些特殊问题中的主要问题如下：
1) 推翻外国帝国主义、封建势力和地主官僚的统治。
2) 按照苏维埃原则建立工农民主专政。
3) 充分的民族自由和国家统一。
4) 废除国家债务。
5) 将属于帝国主义者的大型企业（工业、交通、银行等）国有化。
6) 没收属于地主、教堂和修道院的土地。所有土地国有化。
7) 实行七小时工作制。
8) 组织革命工农军队。

随着斗争的发展和进一步加剧（资产阶级的破坏活动、没收属于资产阶级阶级的企业，这不可避免地转化为大工业的国有化），在那些无产阶级起领导作用的殖民地和半殖民地，随后的资产阶级民主革命将转变为无产阶级革命。在没有无产阶级的殖民地，推翻帝国主义权力应意味着组织人民（农民）苏维埃政权，没收外国企业和土地并将其移交给国家手中。

- 28 -

From the point of view of the struggle against imperialism
and of the conquest of power by the labour class, colonial
revolutions and national-liberation movements are playing a very
important role. Colonies and semi-colonies are also of importance
during the transitory period, because with regard to industrial
countries the question of the organization of socialist world
economy, the establishment of correct reciprocal relations between
industry and agriculture, depend to a large extent on the attitude
of imperialism. Fraternal fighting alliance with the colonial
toiling masses is, therefore, one of the main problems of the
world industrial proletariat as a source of struggle against
imperialism.
Thus the course of the world revolution, whilst recruiting
workers of parent-states for struggle for the dictatorship of
proletariat, is at the same time raising hundreds of million
colonial labourers and peasants for a struggle against foreign
imperialism. With the existence of centres of socialism under
the form of soviet republics and with their increasing economic
strength the colonies, separated from imperialism, get closer and
gradually unite with the industrial hot-beds of world socialism.
They are being drawn into the channel of socialist construction,
more over the development of capitalism as a dominating system
and get a chance for speedy economic and cultural progress. Being
politically grouped around the centres of proletarian dictatorship,
the peasant soviets in the former backward colonies and the
labour and peasant soviets in the former colonies of a more
developed type, are being included into a general system of
increasing federation of the soviet republics and thereby into
the system of the world dictatorship of proletariat.
The development of socialism as a new system of production
is acquiring a world-wide scale.

V. DICTATORSHIP OF PROLETARIAT IN U.S.S.R AND INTERNATIONAL
SOCIALIST REVOLUTION.

I. Building up of socialism in U.S.S.R and class struggle.

A very grave crisis in the capitalist system is principally
manifested by the cleavage of world economy into two parts viz:
that of the capitalistic countries and of those where socialism
is in a process of construction. The strengthening of proletarian
dictatorship within U.S.S.R, the success in socialist construction,
the growth of influence and authority of U.S.S.R among the proletarian
masses and oppressed peoples of colonies, therefore, signify
continuance, increase and development of international socialist
revolution.
Labourers of soviet republics, possessing sufficient financial
means in their country not only for the overthrow of land-owners
and bourgeoisie, but even for the building up of socialism, have,
aided by international proletariat heroically repulsed the armed
attacks of internal and external counter-revolutions; they have
strengthened their union with the principal masses of peasants
and achieved marked success in the matter of socialist revolutionary
construction.
The union between proletarian socialist industry and peasant
economy; the growth of productive forces of agriculture leading to
socialistic industry; the co-ordination of this industry with
agriculture in lieu of being used for the service of supplying
consumption to parasitic classes; the production, opposed to
making capitalistic profits, but destined for the ever increasing
needs of the masses, which in the long run stimulates to a high
degree the process and finally the concentration of economic
management in the hands of proletarian states, by means of
expedient distribution of it - all this furnishes the proletariat
with opportunities to make rapid progress in socialist construction.

- 28 -

从反对帝国主义斗争和工人阶级夺取权力的角度来看，殖民地革命和民族解放运动发挥着非常重要的作用。在过渡时期，殖民地和半殖民地也具有重要意义，因为就工业国而言，社会主义世界经济体系的组织、工农业之间正确相互关系的建立，在很大程度上取决于对待帝国主义的态度。因此，与殖民地劳动群众的战斗联盟是世界工业无产阶级反对帝国主义斗争的主要任务之一。
因此，世界革命的进程在为争取无产阶级专政而招募母国工人的同时，也动员了数以亿计的殖民地劳工和农民起来反对外国帝国主义。随着以苏维埃共和国形式存在的社会主义中心的出现及其经济实力的增强，脱离帝国主义的殖民地将日益接近并逐渐与世界社会主义的工业中心联合起来。它们被纳入社会主义建设的轨道，此外，资本主义作为一种主导体系的发展使它们获得了快速经济和文化进步的机会。在政治上围绕无产阶级专政中心聚集起来的前落后殖民地的农民苏维埃，以及前较发达类型殖民地的工农苏维埃，正被纳入不断扩大的苏维埃共和国联邦体系，从而纳入世界无产阶级专政体系。
社会主义作为一种新的生产体系的发展正在获得世界性的规模。

V. 苏联的无产阶级专政与国际社会主义革命。

I. 苏联的社会主义建设与阶级斗争。

资本主义体系的严重危机主要表现为世界经济分裂为两部分，即资本主义国家和正在建设社会主义的国家。苏联内部无产阶级专政的加强、社会主义建设的成功、苏联在殖民地无产阶级群众和被压迫人民中影响力和威望的增长，因此标志着国际社会主义革命的持续、扩大和发展。
苏维埃共和国的劳动者在国内拥有足够的财政手段，不仅用于推翻地主和资产阶级，甚至用于建设社会主义，他们在国际无产阶级的帮助下英勇击退了内外反革命势力的武装进攻；他们加强了与广大农民群众的联盟，并在社会主义革命建设方面取得了显著成就。
无产阶级社会主义工业与农民经济的结合；导致社会主义工业发展的农业生产力的增长；协调这一工业与农业的关系，使其不再服务于寄生阶级的消费供应；生产的目的不是获取资本主义利润，而是为了满足群众日益增长的需求，这在长远来看极大地刺激了这一进程，并最终通过合理分配将经济管理集中在无产阶级国家手中——所有这些都为无产阶级在社会主义建设中取得快速进展提供了机会。

-29-

By raising productive forces of the general state economy,
following the course of industrialization of U.S.R., the rapid
progress of which is stimulated by both the internal and external
situations, the proletariat of U.S.R despite the systematically
repeated attempts at economic and financial boycott by the capita-
listic countries, is maintaining a firm attitude in economics
and business generally. Industry, transport, agriculture and
bank systems are flourishing with the aid of state commerce and
cooperative societies.

Where rural economy is concerned the raising of productive
forces is also progressing under certain restrictions ( nationaliza-
tion of land, prohibition of sale and purchase, progressive
taxation, financing of co-operative societies of poor and middle
classes, hired labour legislation, forfeiture of political and
civil rights, etc., etc.). However, technically, rural economy
has not yet reached the progress which would enable peasants
to establish large economic concerns and this leads the latter
to seek the co-operation of the so-called "new bourgeoisie".

The proletariat of U.S.R having power over the most important
centres of economic management. Private capital in towns having
considerably decreased during the period of "new economic policy",
is being systematically replaced by the above. All exploiting
elements in villages resulting from money and goods transactions
are suppressed by good methods of organization for constructive
work and trade. Co-operation is encouraged under proletarian
dictatorship and this leads to the firm establishment of socialism.
Serious problems of a constructive nature are being gradually
solved and development of proletarian co-operatives, banking
institutions and other forms of business are making a marked
progress.

In this manner socialism, being also a great economic force
determining the course of things in U.S.R., is making gigantic
strides in the way of general development and is gradually over-
coming difficulties created by the petty bourgeois nature of the
country and those resulting from various periods of class
contradiction. The necessity of providing new implements for
industry and total reconstruction of its methods, naturally bring
forth difficulties into the way of socialist development, which
can be explained as due to the technical and economic backwardness
of the country and the ruination it underwent during the time
of imperialist and civil wars. In spite of this, however, the
living standard of the labour class and the general toiling masses
is continually improving and side by side with socialistic
reconstruction and scientific organization of industry a seven
hours' labour day is being gradually introduced, all of which
promises brighter prospects for the conditions of labour where
the work and life of labourers are concerned.

The labour class, supported by the economic growth of U.S.R.,
solidly allied with masses of peasants and guided by members
of the Communist Party of their own class, constantly recruits
larger and larger numbers of toiling comrades to join in the
socialist construction. The methods employed to enlist these are:-
formation of mass organizations such as parties, professional
unions, communistic youth societies, co-operatives of every
description, women's organizations, labour and peasant women
unions, societies known as "voluntary", workers', village
correspondents, sporting, scientific, educational and other unions;
encouragement of the spirit of initiative in masses, the occupation
by workers of responsible posts in all branches of economy and
administration of socialist construction, training of workers in
general and in high schools so as to form new cadres of men of
proletarian class able to govern.
pages.zh:
-29-

通过提高整个国家经济的生产力，遵循苏联工业化的路线，其快速发展受到国内外形势的刺激，尽管资本主义国家系统地试图进行经济和金融抵制，苏联无产阶级在经济和一般商业领域仍保持着坚定的立场。在国家商业和合作社的帮助下，工业、交通、农业和银行系统蓬勃发展。

就农村经济而言，生产力的提高也在一定限制下取得进展（土地国有化、禁止买卖、累进税制、资助贫农和中农的合作社、雇佣劳动立法、剥夺政治和公民权利等）。然而，从技术上讲，农村经济尚未达到使农民能够建立大型经济实体的进步水平，这导致后者寻求与所谓的“新资产阶级”合作。

苏联无产阶级掌握着最重要的经济管理中心。在“新经济政策”期间，城镇中的私人资本已大幅减少，正被上述力量系统地取代。村庄中因货币和商品交易而产生的所有剥削要素，都通过良好的组织和建设工作及贸易方法加以抑制。在无产阶级专政下鼓励合作，这导致社会主义的稳固确立。建设性质的严重问题正逐步得到解决，无产阶级合作社、银行机构和其他商业形式的发展取得了显著进步。

就这样，社会主义作为决定苏联事态进程的巨大经济力量，在总体发展道路上迈出了巨大的步伐，并逐渐克服由国家的小资产阶级性质以及各个时期阶级矛盾所造成的困难。为工业提供新设备并彻底重建其方法的必要性，自然给社会主义发展带来了困难，这可归因于国家的技术和经济落后以及其在帝国主义战争和内战期间遭受的破坏。尽管如此，工人阶级和广大劳动群众的生活水平仍在不断提高，与此同时，随着社会主义重建和工业的科学组织，七小时工作制正逐步推行，所有这些都预示着在涉及劳动者工作和生活的劳动条件方面有着更光明的前景。

工人阶级在苏联经济增长的支持下，与广大农民群众结成牢固联盟，并由本阶级的共产党成员指导，不断招募越来越多的劳动同志加入社会主义建设。为此采用的方法包括：组建各种群众组织，如政党、工会、共产主义青年团、各类合作社、妇女组织、工农妇女联合会、被称为“自愿”的社团、工人通讯员、乡村通讯员、体育、科学、教育及其他联合会；鼓励群众的主动精神，让工人在社会主义建设的所有经济和行政部门担任负责职务，在普通学校和高等学校培训工人，以便形成能够管理国家的新型无产阶级干部队伍。

pages.en:
- 30 -

2. Importance of U....e and its international
revolutionary obligations.

The dictatorship of proletariat in U.S.R, having defeated
Russian imperialism and liberated all colonies and oppressed
nations of the former Tsarist empire by systematically allowing
of their independent political and other development, the indus-
trialization of their territories and the granting of judicial
rights to these autonomous countries, states, republics, etc.,
for their own self-determination, was thereby attained equality
for different nationalities constituting the Union of Soviet
Socialistic Republics.

U. . . . being a country of proletarian dictatorship and
socialistic construction and having reached important achievements
for the labour class, established union between labourers and
peasants, introduced the teaching of Marx and proved herself in
various ways, naturally became the centre of support for
all oppressed peoples movements, the hot-bed of international
revolution and the most important factor in the history of the
world. The world proletariat finds in U.S.R. a true motherland
and a strong advocate of colonial movements.

U. . . . appears to-day, in the background of general crisis,
as the most important factor. This not only because U.S.R no longer
belongs to the world imperialistic system, having detached itself
from it by creating a foundation for new, socialistic
system of economy, but also because it plays the principal part
as an international promoter of proletariat revolution, incites
proletarians of all countries to seize power and is a living
example of the fact that labour class is capable of constructing
socialism after destroying capitalism. It serves as an emblem
of fraternal relations between the different nationalities
of all countries of the Union of Soviet Socialistic Republics
and of economic unification of the toilers of the whole world.
The same sort of socialist economy must be established by the
rest of the world proletariat.

Simultaneous existence of two systems of economy viz: the
socialistic system in U.S.R and the capitalist system in other
countries, creates a problem for the proletariat necessitating
opposition to the capitalist world against boycotts, blockade,
etc., and at the same time requiring economic connections with
these capitalistic countries in the form of foreign trade, credit,
loans, concessions, etc., all of which are needed for a successful
construction of socialism.

Capitalistic states, despite the fact of their being
interested in the markets of U.S.R, are constantly wavering between
the advantages of commerce and a fear of the growth of U.S.R, the
latter meaning extension of international revolution. Imperialist
powers have a tendency towards encircling USSR with counter-
revolutionary designs, desiring its defeat and purporting to
establish an universally bourgeois-terroristic regime.
The systematic attempts made by imperialism towards the above
end and the constant threat of war will not prevent the All-Russia
Communist Party (Bolsheviks) of the Communist International
directing proletarian dictatorship in U.S.R, from fulfilling its
international obligations and from giving support to oppressed
nations, labour movements in capitalistic countries, colonial
anti-imperialistic movements or any other form of struggle
against oppression.
pages.zh:
- 30 -

2. 苏……的重要性及其国际革命义务。

苏联的无产阶级专政击败了俄罗斯帝国主义，通过系统地允许前沙皇帝国的所有殖民地和被压迫民族在政治及其他方面独立发展、实现其领土工业化，并赋予这些自治国家、州、共和国等以司法权利和自决权，从而实现了构成苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟的不同民族的平等。

苏……作为一个实行无产阶级专政和社会主义建设的国家，在工人阶级方面取得了重要成就，建立了工农联盟，引入了马克思学说，并以各种方式证明了自己，自然成为所有被压迫人民运动的支持中心、国际革命的温床以及世界历史上最重要的因素。世界无产阶级在苏联找到了真正的祖国和殖民地运动的坚定倡导者。

在当今普遍危机的背景下，苏……显得最为重要。这不仅是因为苏联不再属于世界帝国主义体系，而是通过为新社会主义经济体系奠定基础而脱离了该体系，还因为它作为国际无产阶级革命的主要推动者发挥着主要作用，鼓动各国无产阶级夺取政权，并且是一个活生生的例子，证明工人阶级在摧毁资本主义后有能力建设社会主义。它是苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟各国不同民族之间兄弟关系以及全世界劳动者经济统一的象征。世界其余部分的无产阶级必须建立同样的社会主义经济。

两种经济体系的同时存在，即苏联的社会主义体系和其他国家的资本主义体系，给无产阶级带来了一个问题，使其必须反对资本主义世界的抵制、封锁等，同时又需要以对外贸易、信贷、贷款、特许权等形式与这些资本主义国家保持经济联系，所有这些对于成功建设社会主义都是必需的。

资本主义国家尽管对苏联的市场感兴趣，但经常在商业利益和对苏联增长的恐惧之间摇摆不定，后者意味着国际革命的扩展。帝国主义列强倾向于用反革命阴谋包围苏联，希望击败它，并企图建立普遍的资产阶级恐怖统治。帝国主义为实现上述目的而进行的系统性尝试以及持续的战争威胁，并不会阻止共产国际领导下的全俄共产党（布尔什维克）在苏联履行其国际义务，也不会阻止其支持被压迫民族、资本主义国家的劳工运动、殖民地反帝国主义运动或任何其他形式的反压迫斗争。

pages.en:
- 31. -

5. Obligations of the International Proletariat
towards U.S.S.R.

The international proletariat, on its part, having U.S.S.R as the
motherland and protector of its conquests as well as the most
strong factor in the international liberation movement, is bound to
contribute to the success of socialist construction of U.S.S.R and
to defend it against attacks from the capitalistic powers.
"The world political situation has put forward, as
"an outstanding problem, the dictatorship of proletariat,
"and all events of the world's politics are unavoidably
"centred around one main point namely: struggle of the
"world bourgeoisie against Soviet Russian Republic, which
"should, without fail, group around itself the pro-soviet
"elements of the foremost workers of all countries and
"enlist all national-liberation movements in the colonies
"and of oppressed nations". (Lenin).

In case of an attack against U.S.S.R by the imperialist states
and of war against it, the international proletariat should
respond by fearless and resolute mass uprisings and struggle for
the overthrow of the imperialist government to attain dictatorship
of proletariat and alliance with U.S.S.R.

It will be necessary for the colonies of the imperialist
countries attacking U.S.S.R to divert the attention of the imperialistic
military forces in order to have more freedom in the anti-
imperialist struggle with a view to organizing revolutionary
uprisings and obtaining complete independence.

Development of socialism in U.S.S.R and the growth of its
international influence is provoking hatred and mobilization
of forces on the part of capitalistic powers, but at the same
time it is stirring up greatest sympathy of the broad masses of
workers of the whole world and readiness of all oppressed
peoples to fight in defence of the country of proletariat dictator-
ship should imperialists attempt to attack it.

Thus under the existing conditions of contradiction in the
modern world economy and of general capitalistic crisis, an armed
imperialist attack against the Soviet Union will inevitably lead
to a strong revolutionary explosion, which may bury capitalism
in some of the so-called civilised countries and may result in
victorious revolutions in the colonies, opening the way for
proletariat dictatorship and socialism.

VI. STRATEGY AND TACTICS OF THE COMMUNIST INTERNATIONAL
IN THE STRUGGLE FOR DICTATORSHIP OF PROLETARIAT.

I. Ideologists, hostile to communism, among the labour
class.

Revolutionary communism, in its struggle against capitalism,
for the dictatorship of proletariat, encounters at times in the
labour circles a certain tendency towards an ideological submission
of proletariat to imperialist bourgeoisie. This state of affairs,
however, does not last very long as labour members involved are
usually incapable of holding out in an organized manner and soon
submit to proletarian stern discipline.
pages.zh:
- 31. -

5. 国际无产阶级对苏联的义务。

国际无产阶级方面，视苏联为其成果的祖国和保护者，以及国际解放运动中最强大的力量，有义务为苏联社会主义建设的成功做出贡献，并保卫其免受资本主义列强的攻击。“世界政治局势已将无产阶级专政作为一个突出问题提了出来，世界政治的所有事件都不可避免地围绕着一个中心点，即：世界资产阶级对抗苏维埃俄罗斯共和国的斗争，后者必须毫无例外地将各国先进工人中的亲苏元素团结在自己周围，并动员殖民地及被压迫民族的所有民族解放运动”。（列宁）。

如果帝国主义国家对苏联发动攻击并对其开战，国际无产阶级应以无畏和坚决的大规模起义作为回应，并为推翻帝国主义政府、实现无产阶级专政以及与苏联结盟而斗争。

攻击苏联的帝国主义国家的殖民地有必要转移帝国主义军事力量的注意力，以便在反帝国主义斗争中获得更多自由，旨在组织革命起义并获得完全独立。

苏联社会主义的发展及其国际影响力的增长引起了资本主义列强的仇恨和力量动员，但同时也激起了全世界广大工人群众的最大同情，以及一旦帝国主义者试图攻击无产阶级专政国家时，所有被压迫人民准备起来保卫该国的意愿。

因此，在现代世界经济矛盾和普遍资本主义危机的现有条件下，对苏联的武装帝国主义攻击将不可避免地导致强烈的革命爆发，这可能会埋葬某些所谓文明国家的资本主义，并可能导致殖民地的革命胜利，为无产阶级专政和社会主义开辟道路。

六、共产国际在争取无产阶级专政斗争中的战略和战术。

I. 工人阶级中敌视共产主义的思想家。

革命共产主义在反对资本主义、争取无产阶级专政的斗争中，有时会在劳工界遇到一种使无产阶级在意识形态上屈从于帝国主义资产阶级的倾向。然而，这种情况持续的时间并不长，因为涉及的劳工成员通常无法有组织地坚持下去，并很快服从于无产阶级的严格纪律。

pages.en:
- 32 -

The great social stronghold of imperialism together with
its attributes such as schools, press, theatre and church reveals
itself in the existence of confessional and reformatory inclinations
within the labour class, presenting an obstacle in the way of
socialist revolution of the proletariat.
Confessional tendencies, with a religious colouring, are
manifesting themselves amongst the labour class in the so-called
confessional trade unions, often connected with other similar
bourgeois political organisations or some church organisation
of a dominating character ( catholic professional unions, christian
young men and women's unions, jewish zionist organisations, etc.)
leaders of these organisations whilst sprinkling with holy water
all the hideousness of the capitalistic regime and terrifying
their followers with threats of after life punishment, are the
most reactionary element in the proletarian camp.

Modern "socialist" reformism is one of the commercially-
cynical imperialist forms of proletarian submission to the
ideological influence of bourgeoisie. Fundamentally imitating
imperialist policy, it is embodied in the anti-socialist and
extremely counter-revolutionary "American Federation of Labour".
"Ideological" dictatorship of the american professional bureaucracy
and american dollar together with british reformism and the log's
socialists from the labour party as well as amsterdam, german
and austrian international leaders of social democracy whilst
employing marxist phraseology betray the true theory of marxism.
"Socialist" reformism is the principal enemy of revolutionary
communism in the labour movement and is therefore a force directed
against proletarian revolution.

In respect of foreign policy social democrats, under pretext
of the "defence of motherland" actually help imperialistic war.
support of "holy alliance" of the imperialist powers (league of
nations), preaching of ultra-imperialism, mobilisation of masses
under false pacifist slogans and other forms of active support to
imperialism in its attacks against U. S. S. R. and the threatening war
against the latter - these are the main features of foreign policy
of reformism.

In respect of home policy social democrats give direct assis-
tance to the capitalistic regime. They support capitalist
rationalization, class peace, industry peace, co-operation between
employers and labourers, maintenance of police forces, army, etc.,
all of which constitutes home policy of reformism.

Whilst simulating professional struggles, reformism manages
to arrange matters in such a way that the capitalist class is
guaranteed against all trouble and is assured of the safety of
its rights of ownership.

Theoretically social democrats have betrayed marxism to a
full extent. They have adopted liberal-bourgeois reformism and
social-capitalism; substituted marx theory of contradictions of
capitalism by the bourgeois doctrine of harmonious development;
ignored the doctrine of crisis and impoverishment of the proletariat;
turned the ardent theory of class struggle into vulgar propaganda
of class peace; advocated "democratisation" of capital theory in
lieu of class contradictions doctrine; substituted the theory of
wars, unavoidable under capitalism, by bourgeois slogans of pacifism
and false teaching of "ultra-imperialism"; propagated "sound"
capitalism to take gradually the form of socialism as against the
theory of revolutionary collapse of capitalism; substituted revolu-
tion by evolution; aided the building up of bourgeois states in
lieu of destroying them; propagated coalition with bourgeoisie
to oppose dictatorship of proletariat; supported the defence of
imperialist motherlands as against proletarian solidarity; promoted
