- 32 -

帝国主义巨大的社会堡垒，连同其附属机构如学校、报刊、剧院和教会，表现为工人阶级内部存在的宗派和改良主义倾向，这构成了无产阶级社会主义革命的障碍。

带有宗教色彩的宗派倾向在所谓的宗派工会中 manifesting（显现）于工人阶级之中，这些工会往往与其他类似的资产阶级政治组织或某种占主导地位的教会组织（如天主教职业工会、基督教青年男女联合会、犹太复国主义组织等）相联系。这些组织的领导者在用圣水掩盖资本主义制度的所有丑恶行径并用死后惩罚的威胁恐吓其追随者的同时，是无产阶级阵营中最反动的元素。

现代“社会主义”改良主义是帝国主义使无产阶级在意识形态上屈从于资产阶级影响的一种商业性犬儒形式。它在根本上模仿帝国主义政策，体现于反社会主义且极度反革命的“美国劳工联合会”。美国职业官僚机构和美国美元的“意识形态”独裁，连同英国改良主义、工党中的洛格（Log's）社会主义者，以及阿姆斯特丹、德国和奥地利的社会民主国际领导人，在使用马克思主义辞藻的同时背叛了真正的马克思主义理论。“社会主义”改良主义是劳工运动中革命共产主义的主要敌人，因此是一股针对无产阶级革命的力量。

在外交政策方面，社会民主党人以“保卫祖国”为借口，实际上帮助帝国主义战争。支持帝国主义列强的“神圣同盟”（国际联盟），宣扬超帝国主义，在虚假的和平主义口号下动员群众，以及其他形式地积极支持帝国主义对苏联的攻击及对苏联的战争威胁——这些都是改良主义外交政策的主要特征。

在内政方面，社会民主党人直接协助资本主义制度。他们支持资本主义合理化、阶级和平、产业和平、雇主与劳动者之间的合作、维持警察部队、军队等，所有这些构成了改良主义的内政政策。

在模拟职业斗争的同时，改良主义设法安排事务，使得资产阶级阶级免受一切麻烦，并确保其所有权的安全。

在理论上，社会民主党人已彻底背叛了马克思主义。他们采用了自由资产阶级改良主义和社会资本主义；用资产阶级的和谐发展学说取代了马克思关于资本主义矛盾的学说；忽视了危机和无产阶级贫困化的学说；将热烈的阶级斗争理论变成了庸俗的阶级和平宣传；提倡资本理论的“民主化”以代替阶级矛盾学说；用资产阶级的和平主义口号和“超帝国主义”的虚假教条取代了资本主义下不可避免的战争理论；宣扬“健全”的资本主义将逐渐采取社会主义的形式，以反对资本主义革命崩溃的理论；用进化取代革命；帮助建立资产阶级国家而不是摧毁它们；宣扬与资产阶级结盟以反对无产阶级专政；支持保卫帝国主义祖国以反对无产阶级团结；促进

pages.en:
- 33 -

idealistic philosophy and playing up to the religious soul of
the bourgeoisie.
The above reveals tendencies leading to the bourgeois
degeneration of social democracy.

Constructive Socialism (Macdonald & Co), the name of which alone
means an idea of struggle against proletarian revolution and
favouring the capitalistic order of things, promotes anti-revolution-
ary and bourgeois traditions of Fabianism (Webb, R. Shaw, Lord
Oliver, etc.) By denying in principle the idea of dictatorship
of proletariat and the forcible means of struggle against bourgeoisie,
it supports such struggle against proletariat and colonial peoples.

"Constructive Socialism" whilst professing state capitalism,
under the guise of socialism, with the imperialists of both
hemispheres, declares class struggle as "pre-scientific" and pro-
claims a moderate program of nationalization with compensation in
the form of land income tax and other surplus profits as a means
of abolishing capitalism. "Constructive Socialism" known to be
opposed to the dictatorship of proletariat and in full accord with
bourgeoisie, is an active enemy of communistic movement of the
proletariat and of colonial revolutions.

A particular form of the "Constructive Socialism" is "Co-
operatism" or "Cooperative Socialism" (Charles Gyd, Potemkin etc)
which also resolutely rejects class struggle and propagates
organization of consumers' co-operative societies as a means of
eliminating capitalism, whilst in reality it only strengthens it.
"Co-operatism" makes use of co-operative consumers as propaganda
means to influence broad masses and to carry on severe struggle
against revolutionary labour movement, preventing the latter from
achieving its aim, and is at present a strong factor in the camp
of reformist counter-revolution.

The so-called "Guild Socialism" (Penty, Orage, Hobson and
others) is an attempt to unify "revolutionary" syndicalism with
the bourgeois-liberal Fabianism, anarchist 'national industrial
guilds' with late capitalistic organizations, and medieval trade-
corporations ignorance with the idea of modern capitalism.
Guild socialism whilst basing itself on the principle of abolition
of the "system of wages" will not give way to labour control over
industry. In striving to unify labourers, intellectuals and
technicians into a federation of "national industrial guilds",
guild socialism is supporting bourgeoisie and imperialism in every
way. It thus opens the road to a kind of Fascist "Co-operative
State". By rejecting parliamentarism followers of guild socialism
condemn the labour class to inactivity and passive submission to
bourgeoisie. It, therefore, resembles utopian opportunism
practised by trade unions and as such is bound to play a counter-
revolutionary role.

Austrian-Marxism is another form of social-democratic reformism.
It is an extremist section of it and is the most subtle form of
deceit for toiling masses. Austrian-Marxism breaks away in many
respects from real principles on which the theory of Marx is found.
It plays up to religious organisations, supports British reformism,
advocates "class co-operation", coalition with bourgeoisie with a
view to suppressing proletarian revolution etc. It attacks labourers
who are on the road to communism and is, therefore, a more dangerous
enemy of the proletariat that open partisan movements on behalf
of imperialism.
pages.zh:
- 33 -

唯心主义哲学，并迎合资产阶级的宗教灵魂。
上述情况揭示了导致社会民主主义资产阶级蜕化的倾向。

“建设性社会主义”（麦克唐纳等人），仅其名称便意味着一种反对无产阶级革命、 favoring 资本主义秩序的理念，它宣扬费边主义（韦伯、萧伯纳、奥利弗勋爵等）的反革命和资产阶级传统。通过原则上否认无产阶级专政的思想以及对抗资产阶级的强制斗争手段，它支持这种针对无产阶级和殖民地人民的斗争。

“建设性社会主义”虽然打着社会主义的幌子主张国家资本主义，并与两半球的帝国主义者联手，宣称阶级斗争是“前科学的”，并宣布实行带有补偿措施的温和国有化方案，以土地所得税和其他剩余利润的形式作为废除资本主义的手段。“建设性社会主义”已知反对无产阶级专政并与资产阶级完全一致，是共产主义运动和无产阶级及殖民地革命的积极敌人。

“建设性社会主义”的一种特殊形式是“合作主义”或“合作社会主义”（夏尔·纪德、波将金等），它也坚决拒绝阶级斗争，并宣传组织消费者合作社作为消除资本主义的手段，而实际上它只是加强了资本主义。“合作主义”利用消费合作社作为宣传手段来影响广大民众，并对革命劳工运动进行严厉斗争，阻止后者实现其目标，目前它是改良主义反革命阵营中的一个强大因素。

所谓的“基尔特社会主义”（彭蒂、奥拉奇、霍布森等人）试图将“革命”工团主义与资产阶级自由派的费边主义、无政府主义的“国家工业基尔特”与晚期资本主义组织、以及中世纪行会的愚昧与现代资本主义思想统一起来。基尔特社会主义虽然基于废除“工资制度”的原则，但不会让位于劳工对工业的控制。在努力将劳动者、知识分子和技术人员统一为“国家工业基尔特”联合会的过程中，基尔特社会主义在各方面支持资产阶级和帝国主义。因此，它为某种法西斯式的“合作国家”开辟了道路。通过拒绝议会制，基尔特社会主义的追随者使工人阶级陷入不活动状态，并被动地服从于资产阶级。因此，它类似于工会所实践的乌托邦机会主义，因而注定要扮演反革命的角色。

奥地利马克思主义是社会民主改良主义的另一种形式。它是其中的极端派别，也是对劳动群众最微妙的欺骗形式。奥地利马克思主义在许多方面背离了马克思理论所依据的真正原则。它迎合宗教组织，支持英国改良主义，提倡“阶级合作”，与资产阶级结盟以镇压无产阶级革命等。它攻击走向共产主义的劳动者，因此，比公开代表帝国主义利益的党派运动更是无产阶级的危险敌人。

pages.en:
- 34 -

In the face of tendencies which form part of "socialist
reformism", communism is confronted with a number of petty-
bourgeois influences embracing several categories of class.
These categories, being politically unstable, waver between
left wing and right wing policy and often revert from loud
revolutionary boasting to deepest pessimism and complete capitula-
tion before the enemy. When any sudden political changes take
place followers of above categories may prove to be the most
dangerous agents of disorganisation in the proletarian ranks
and an obstacle to revolutionary movement of the proletariat.

Anarchism, whose most prominent representatives (Kropotkin,
Jean Grave and others) have, during the war of 1914-1918, trea-
cherously joined the ranks of imperialist bourgeoisie, denies the
existence of centralised and disciplined organisations of proletariat
as a necessity and thereby weakens them in the face of powerful
capitalist organisations. By advocating individual terrorism,
Anarchism disapproves of the methods of mass organisation and
mass struggle for proletariat. By denouncing the theory of the
dictatorship of proletariat in the interests of "freedom", anarchism
deprives the proletariat of the most important and efficient
weapon against bourgeoisie, its armies and other organs of oppression.
Anarchism is gradually assuming the nature of a sect by changing
its views and tactics versus proletarian struggle and is becoming
more of an ally to the counter-revolutionary forces.

"Revolutionary Syndicalism", whose many followers during the
period of war, at its most critical time, became partial to the
"anti-parliamentary" counter-revolutionaries of a fascist type or
adopted the methods of peaceful reformists of social democracy
such as Anarchism, for example, with its principle of denouncing
political struggle, prevents labourers from being revolutionised
wherever it still has power to exercise influence by advocating
the necessity to refrain from insurrections, strikes and other
such like methods of revolutionary struggle. It is, consequently,
ranked with social-democracy.

"Social democracy is the principal enemy of proletarian
revolution by supporting all above mentioned tendencies and
new influences against U.S.R. Social democrats who have completely
betrayed Marxism are becoming more and more partial to fascism.
Hence the new born socialism of the Second International.

In colonial countries and among oppressed peoples or races
in general, communism is meeting with opposition from certain
particular circles and at certain periods which, however, turn
reactionary during new stages of development.

Sun-Senism in China was the ideology of petty-bourgeois
"socialism". In the "Three Principles" (nationalism, democracy
and socialism) the conception of "people" covered and suppressed
the conception of "class", whilst socialism did not figure as
any particular form adopted by the class proletariat, but as a
vague conception of social prosperity. Struggle with imperialism
was not co-ordinated with that of the process of class struggle
in the country. Sun-Senism, therefore, having accomplished
an initiative role in the Chinese Revolution, later transformed
itself into a passive theory. It has become part of the Kuomintang,
at present an openly counter-revolutionary force. It is, consequently
imperative that masses of Chinese proletariat and toiling peasants
should offer a strong opposition to Kuomintang and fight the
ideology of Sun-Senism.

Movements such as Ghandism in India, impregnated with religious
belief and idealizing reactionary forms of life, stop proletarians
from engaging in class struggle and finally become reactionary
movements. Ghandism has gradually turned against revolutionary
tendencies of the people. Communism must fight it hard.
pages.zh:
- 34 -

面对构成“社会主义改良主义”一部分的种种倾向，共产主义面临着涵盖几个阶级阶层的小资产阶级影响。这些阶层在政治上不稳定，在左翼和右翼政策之间摇摆不定，并且经常从大声的革命吹嘘转变为最深的悲观主义和对敌人的完全投降。当发生任何突然的政治变化时，上述阶层的追随者可能证明是无产阶级队伍中最危险的破坏分子，也是无产阶级革命运动的障碍。

无政府主义，其最著名的代表人物（克鲁泡特金、让·格拉夫等）在1914-1918年战争期间背叛性地加入了帝国主义资产阶级的行列，否认集中和有纪律的无产阶级组织存在的必要性，从而在面对强大的资本主义组织时削弱了它们。通过倡导个人恐怖主义，无政府主义不赞成无产阶级的大众组织和大众斗争方法。出于对“自由”的利益考虑，无政府主义谴责无产阶级专政理论，剥夺了无产阶级对抗资产阶级及其军队和其他压迫机构的最重要和最有效的武器。无政府主义通过改变其对无产阶级斗争的观点和策略，逐渐呈现出宗派的性质，并日益成为反革命力量的盟友。

“革命工团主义”，其许多追随者在战争期间，在其最关键的时刻，倾向于法西斯类型的“反议会”反革命分子，或者采用了社会民主党和平改良主义者的方法，例如无政府主义，以其谴责政治斗争的原则，在它仍有能力施加影响的地方，通过主张必须避免起义、罢工和其他此类革命斗争方法，阻止劳动者被革命化。因此，它被归类为社会民主主义。

“社会民主主义通过支持上述所有倾向和针对苏联的新影响，成为无产阶级革命的主要敌人。完全背叛了马克思主义的社会民主党人越来越倾向于法西斯主义。因此产生了第二国际的新生社会主义。

在殖民地和一般受压迫的民族或种族中，共产主义在某些特定圈子和某些时期遇到反对，然而，这些反对在新的发展阶段变得反动。

中国的孙文主义是小资产阶级“社会主义”的意识形态。在“三民主义”（民族主义、民权主义和民生主义）中，“人民”的概念掩盖并压制了“阶级”的概念，而民生主义并不表现为无产阶级阶级所采用的任何特定形式，而是一种模糊的社会繁荣概念。反帝斗争未与国内阶级斗争进程相协调。因此，孙文主义在中国革命中发挥了开创性作用后，后来转变为一种被动理论。它已成为国民党的一部分，而国民党目前是一支公开的反革命力量。因此，中国无产阶级和劳动农民群众必须对国民党进行强烈反对，并与孙文主义的意识形态作斗争。

印度的甘地主义等运动，浸透着宗教信仰并将反动的生活形式理想化，阻止无产阶级参与阶级斗争，并最终变成反动运动。甘地主义已逐渐转向反对人民的革命倾向。共产主义必须与之进行艰苦斗争。

pages.en:
- 35 -

Garvey's former ideology of the petty negroowners in America,
who still have some influence on the negro masses, became also an
impediment in the efforts to revolutionize the masses in question.
Instead of maintaining the principle of social equality of negroes,
it began to promote the idea of "Back to Africa" and not actual
struggle against American imperialism. This tendency should be
seriously opposed because it only serves to check the negro-
liberation movement against American imperialism and supports
non-democratic ideas of a non-existent "Negro Kingdom".
Proletarian communism differs from all above tendencies in
that it is internationally revolutionary and more in conformity
with Marx Engels' principles. It does practical revolutionary work
for the dictatorship of proletariat extending to the general masses.

2. Principal problems of communist strategy and tactics.

Successful struggle of the Communist International for the
dictatorship of the proletariat, necessitates the existence of a
compact, militarized, well disciplined and closely connected with
the masses Communist Party in every country.

The Communist Party is a vanguard of the labour class and
is composed of the best, most conscientious, active and courageous
members of it. It personifies common experiences of all proletarian
struggles. Being founded on the revolutionary Marxist theory and
representing general interests of the labour class, the Party
supports unity of proletarian principles, will, revolutionary action,
etc. It is a revolutionary organization in itself bound by stern
discipline and rigid rules. It is devoted to revolution and the
proletarian masses, who experience its correct political guidance.
The Communist Party in order to solve the problem of the
dictatorship of proletariat should promulgate and strive after
the following strategical aims:-

The securing of its influence over the majority of members
of the labour class, including women workers and toiling youths.
For this purpose it would be necessary for the Party to dominate
over broad mass organizations (trade unions, factory committees,
co-operative societies, sporting, cultural organizations, etc.). The
most important achievement, from this point of view, would be to
gain the confidence of professional unions, these real mass organiza-
tions of the labour class, so closely connected with the everyday
struggles.

The realization of leadership of the proletariat over broad
masses of toiling people is another necessary condition to attain
proletarian dictatorship. For this purpose the Communist Party
should extend its influence to people in towns, villages, lower
class intellectuals and petty bourgeois classes in general not
forgetting the peasants, a very important section. This can be better
achieved with the aid of agricultural workers, poor country people
and workers in general. With regard to the middle class peasants,
the Communist Party should pursue the policy of neutralizing them in
countries of highly developed capitalism. The solution of all these
problems by the proletariat, which is the promoter of interests of
the whole nation and the leader of broad masses of the people in their
struggle against oppression by the capital, is a binding condition
of the victorious communistic revolution.
pages.zh:
- 35 -

加维以前在美国黑人小业主中的意识形态，至今仍对黑人群众有一定影响，也成为努力使有关群众革命化的障碍。它不再坚持黑人社会平等的原则，而是开始宣扬“回到非洲”的思想，而非对美国帝国主义进行实际斗争。应当认真反对这种倾向，因为它只会遏制反对美国帝国主义的黑人解放运动，并支持一个不存在的“黑人王国”的非民主思想。
无产阶级共产主义不同于上述所有倾向，在于它是国际性的革命，并且更符合马克思和恩格斯的原则。它为向广大民众扩展的无产阶级专政进行实际的革命工作。

2. 共产主义战略和战术的主要问题。

共产国际为无产阶级专政进行的成功斗争，要求在每个国家都存在一个紧凑的、军事化的、纪律严明的并与群众紧密联系的共产党。

共产党是工人阶级的先锋队，由其中最好、最有觉悟、最积极和最勇敢的成员组成。它体现了所有无产阶级斗争的共同经验。建立在革命马克思主义理论基础之上并代表工人阶级整体利益的党，支持无产阶级原则、意志、革命行动等的统一。它本身就是一个受严格纪律和刚性规则约束的革命组织。它致力于革命和无产阶级群众，群众体验着其正确的政治指导。
为解决无产阶级专政问题，共产党应颁布并努力追求以下战略目标：

确保其对工人阶级大多数成员的影响，包括女工和劳动青年。为此，党有必要主导广泛的群众组织（工会、工厂委员会、合作社、体育和文化组织等）。从这一观点来看，最重要的成就是赢得职业工会的信任，这些是工人阶级真正的群众组织，与日常斗争紧密相连。

实现无产阶级对广大劳动群众的领导，是实现无产阶级专政的另一个必要条件。为此，共产党应将其影响力扩展到城镇人民、乡村人民、下层知识分子和一般小资产阶级阶层，不要忘记农民这一非常重要的部分。借助农业工人、贫苦农民和一般工人，可以更好地实现这一目标。关于中农，共产党应在高度发达的资本主义国家采取中立他们的政策。无产阶级作为整个国家利益的促进者和广大人民反抗资本压迫斗争的领导者，解决所有这些问题是取得共产主义革命胜利的必要条件。

pages.en:
- 36.-

From the point of view of the world wide struggle of
proletariat, the most important strategical problems of the
Communist International are those affecting revolutionary struggle
in the colonies, semi-colonies and dependent countries. This
struggle means the enlisting of broad masses of colonial labour
class and peasants under the banners of revolution and this cannot
be achieved without the close co-operation between the proletariat
of capitalist nations and the toiling masses of the oppressed
countries.

The Communist International by propagating revolution against
imperialism under the banner of proletarian dictatorship in the
so-called "civilized countries", assists any anti-imperialistic
movement arising in the colonies, semi-colonies and dependent
countries, as for example Latin America. It carries on propaganda
against every kind of chauvinism and imperialistic "off-hand"
treatment of big and small oppressed peoples and races which is
seen in the attitude towards negroes, "yellow labour", anti-semitism,
etc. adopted by the Communist International. It also fights the
chauvinism of Great Powers, imperialistic bourgeoisie and its
social democratic agent - the Second International by counter-
opposition in the form of fraternal relations and equality being
offered to the oppressed peoples and races by . . . .

Communist parties in Imperialistic countries are under an
obligation to support colonial freedom and revolutionary
movements and those of the oppressed nations. This duty falls
primarily to the labour class of the country oppressing a colony
or race of people in either financial or political way. Communist
parties should openly encourage the colonies concerned to fight
for their independent rights and self-government irrespective
of the imperialistic country to which they are subjected.
Insurrections, national wars, propaganda and such like means of
defense against imperialism should be strongly advocated and
supported.

In the colonial and semi-colonial countries the duty of
the Communist party centres is to carry on fearless and determined
struggle against foreign capitalism and propagate friendship and
alliance with the proletariat of imperialistic countries. Agrarian
revolution should also be promoted so that the peasants make
measures for the over-throw of the yoke of land owners and seize
lands. Reactionary and medieval influences of clergy, missions, etc.
should be severely opposed too.

One of the main problems is to arrange for independent
organisation of labourers and peasants ( class communism of the
proletariat, trade unions, peasant unions and revolutionary soviet
committees) and their alienation from the influence of bourgeoisic
when this latter obstructs revolutionary organisation and struggle
against imperialism.

When working out their tactics every Communist party should
take into consideration the actual internal and external situation,
correlation of class forces, degree of stability and strength of
the bourgeoisie, the extent of preparedness of the proletariat,
the attitude of different classes, etc. Depending on all these
conditions the Party works out its slogans and methods whereby
to be governed when the time comes for quick mobilization and
organisation of masses. Developing revolutionary situation
by gradual introduction of various measures the Party aims at
the seizure of power and the overthrow of bourgeois-capitalist
society.
pages.zh:
- 36.-

从世界无产阶级斗争的角度来看，共产国际最重要的战略问题是那些影响殖民地、半殖民地和附属国革命斗争的问题。这场斗争意味着将广大的殖民地工人阶级和农民群众团结在革命的旗帜下，而这如果没有资本主义国家的无产阶级与被压迫国家的劳苦大众之间的密切合作，是无法实现的。

共产国际通过在所谓“文明国家”中以无产阶级专政为旗帜宣传反帝国主义革命，援助在殖民地、半殖民地和附属国（例如拉丁美洲）出现的任何反帝国主义运动。它开展宣传，反对各种沙文主义以及帝国主义对大小被压迫民族和种族的“随意”对待，这种态度体现在共产国际对黑人、“黄种劳工”、反犹主义等所采取立场上。它还通过……向被压迫民族和种族提供兄弟般的关系和平等，以此对抗大国沙文主义、帝国主义资产阶级及其社会民主主义代理人——第二国际。

帝国主义国家的共产党有义务支持殖民地自由和革命运动，以及被压迫民族的运动。这一责任主要落在以金融或政治方式压迫某一殖民地或某一种族人民的国家的工人阶级身上。共产党应公开鼓励相关殖民地为争取独立权利和自治而斗争，无论其受哪个帝国主义国家统治。应大力倡导和支持起义、民族战争、宣传以及此类防御帝国主义的手段。

在殖民地和半殖民地国家，共产党中心机构的职责是开展无畏且坚决的斗争，反对外国资本主义，并宣传与帝国主义国家无产阶级的友谊和联盟。还应推动农业革命，以便农民采取措施推翻地主的枷锁并夺取土地。神职人员、传教团等的反动和中世纪影响也应受到严厉反对。

主要问题之一是安排工人和农民的独立组织（无产阶级的阶级共产主义、工会、农会和革命苏维埃委员会），并在资产阶级阻碍革命组织和反帝国主义斗争时，使其脱离资产阶级的影响。

在制定策略时，每个共产党都应考虑实际的内外局势、阶级力量对比、资产阶级的稳定程度和实力、无产阶级的准备程度、各阶层的态度等。根据所有这些条件，党制定出其口号和方法，以便在需要快速动员和组织群众时有所遵循。通过逐步引入各种措施来发展革命形势，党的目标是夺取政权并推翻资产阶级资本主义社会。

pages.en:
- 37 -

When revolutionary animation has been aroused, the dominating
classes are disorganised, the masses are in a state of fermenta-
tion, certain classes are wavering in their sympathy towards
the proletariat, and the masses are prepared for an uprising
and offering of sacrifices - the proletarian party should lead
them in an attack against the bourgeois State. This may be
achieved by means of propaganda of various slogans in favour of
Soviet system, labour control of productions, peasant committees
for the seizure of large lands from rich land-owners, the disarming
of bourgeoisie and arming the proletariat and organisation of
mass uprisings, to which all branches of party agitation and
propaganda should submit implicitly. The mass uprisings should
consist of strikes, demonstrations (peaceful and armed) and finally
a general strike accompanied by a coup d'etat against the State
power of bourgeoisie. The last part of the struggle should be
carried out in military style accompanied by unlimited devotion
and heroism of the proletariat. Uprisings of this nature should
be prepared by organising masses into military units to assist
the revolutionary army and fleet.

In adopting new and more inciting slogans, great caution
should be exercised to maintain the observance of the principles
of Lenin's political tactics so that the masses would consider
measures taken as correct on the part of the Party. Failure in
overlooking this often results in dissension occurring among the
masses. Another feature to be avoided is that when a revolutionary
situation has reached such a stage that a daring and decisive
attacks against the enemy is required, no delay in carrying it
out should be allowed as it means giving a chance to the enemy
and risking the defeat of the revolutionary movement.

If revolutionary animation happens to lack, Communist parties
should endeavour to arouse it by means of various slogans in
co-ordination with the views of the Communist International.
The Party should be active and maintain the spirit of revolution
in the masses.
Thus the tactics of the Communist Party during the whole
of the pre-revolutionary period should be united and this will
lead to final victory of the proletariat over the capitalists,
reformists, etc.

Correct application of the method of tactics in the problem
of conquering masses in general entails systematic and tenacious
work amongst professional unions and other mass organisations
of the proletariat. It is the duty of every communist to be a
member of some professional union however reactionary it may be.
Only in this manner can any successful results be obtained by the
Party.

Unlike the heretical policy of reformists communists are
all for the maintenance of unity in the professional unions of
every country so as to aid the work of the Red International
of Professional Unions.

Parties of the Communist International prove themselves
everywhere the friends in need and protectors of the labour
masses and they promote the following in their interests:-
For labourers questions of economic struggle including matters
pertaining to capital, wages, working day hours, obligatory
arbitration, unemployment, etc., followed by questions of
political struggle namely big industrial conflicts, rights of
unions, strikes, taxation, high cost of living, Fascism, persecu-
tion of revolutionary parties, white reign of terror, policy of
government in general, attitude of U.S.S.R. to colonial revolu-
tions, struggle for the international professional movements,
anti-imperialistic and war menaces and opposition.
pages.zh:
- 37 -

当革命热情被激发，统治阶级陷入混乱，群众处于沸腾状态，某些阶层对无产阶级的同情发生动摇，且群众已准备好起义并做出牺牲时，无产阶级政党应领导他们向资产阶级国家发起攻击。这可以通过宣传各种有利于苏维埃制度、工人控制生产、农民委员会夺取大地主的大片土地、解除资产阶级武装并武装无产阶级以及组织群众起义的口号来实现，党的所有煽动和宣传部门都应无条件服从于此。群众起义应包括罢工、示威（和平的和武装的），最后是以针对资产阶级国家政权的政变为伴随的总罢工。斗争的最后阶段应以军事风格进行，并伴随着无产阶级的无限奉献和英雄主义。此类起义应通过将群众组织成军事单位来协助革命军队和舰队来进行准备。

在采用新的和更具煽动性的口号时，应格外谨慎，以保持对列宁政治战术原则的遵守，从而使群众认为党所采取的措施是正确的。忽视这一点往往会导致群众内部发生分歧。另一个需要避免的情况是，当革命局势发展到需要对敌人进行大胆和果断的攻击时，不允许在执行上有任何延误，因为这意味着给敌人以机会，并使革命运动面临失败的风险。

如果缺乏革命热情，共产党应努力通过与共产国际观点相协调的各种口号来激发它。党应保持活跃，并在群众中维持革命精神。
因此，共产党在整个革命前时期的战术应当是统一的，这将导致无产阶级最终战胜资本家、改良主义者等。

正确运用征服广大群众问题的战术方法，需要在职业工会和其他无产阶级群众组织中进行系统和坚韧的工作。每个共产党员都有义务加入某个职业工会，无论其多么反动。只有通过这种方式，党才能取得任何成功的结果。

与改良主义的异端政策不同，共产党人全力维护各国职业工会的团结，以援助红色职业工会国际的工作。

共产国际的各党派在任何地方都证明自己是劳苦大众急需的朋友和保护者，并为了他们的利益促进以下事项：
对于工人，包括涉及资本、工资、工作日时长、强制仲裁、失业等问题的经济斗争，随后是政治斗争问题，即大型工业冲突、工会权利、罢工、税收、高生活成本、法西斯主义、对革命政党的迫害、白色恐怖统治、政府总体政策、苏联对殖民地革命的态度、争取国际职业运动、反帝国主义和战争威胁及反对。

pages.en:
- 33 -

For peasants - matters relating to taxation policy,
hypothetic indebtedness, struggle against the claims of capital,
land questions, etc. In fact the Communist Party desires that
a state of things synonymous to proletarian dictatorship in
progressive capitalistic countries and in some colonies should
be established everywhere else.

Systematic work should equally be carried out among the
proletarian and peasant youth principally through KIM and its
branches and also among women workers and peasants, bearing in
mind the special conditions under which they live, so that they
may join their demands to those of the proletarians in general.

With regard to the struggle against oppression of colonial
peoples, the communist parties should advocate the following
demands:- equality of all nations and races, abolition of all
privileges to foreigners, liberty of labour and peasant organisation,
reduction of working day hours, prohibition of child labour,
suppression of speculation, reduction and abolition of land rent,
reduction of taxes, boycott against taxation together with the
principal demands on which the Communist Parties are based viz:
full political independence of countries concerned, expulsion of
imperialists, establishment of labourers' and peasants' governments,
the transfer of lands to the people, eight hours' labour day and
other similar matters. In the meantime Communist parties should
secure the support in imperialistic countries for the struggles
in the colonies by instituting campaigns for the withdrawal
of troops from the latter, propaganda in the army and navy in
favour of freedom for the colonies, strikes, boycotts and other
forms of mass protests against imperialistic policy.

The Communist International should pay special attention to
gradual preparation of the people to struggle against the menace
of imperialist wars. For this purpose no efforts should be spared
to reveal the bourgeois plans concealed in the advocacies of pacifism.
Communist parties should not cease to organise propaganda in
the army and fleet by legal or illegal means. Any imperialistic
war should eventually be transformed into a civil war with a view
to defeating the imperialistic government and U.S.S.R. and the
colonies be protected against attacks of the imperialists.
Propaganda unmasking the activities under false pretexts of the
League of Nations and recalling to the people's mind the
experiences of 1914-1918 should be the primary duty of all branches
and every members of the Communist International.

International Class Discipline is an absolute necessity for
the co-ordination of revolutionary work and uprisings and as a
means of successful guidance for the proletariat of the world.
It should be sternly observed by all communists ranks on being
issued in the form of instructions from the governing body of the
Communist International.

Unlike Socialistic Second International, every party of which
is subordinate to its national bourgeoisie and its motherland,
sections of the Communist International are subject to one kind
of discipline only viz that of the international proletariat
which assures victorious struggle for the workers of all countries
and subsequent dictatorship of the proletariat in the whole world.
Also unlike the Second International, which is causing a falling
off of the Trade Unions, opposing the struggle for freedom of the
colonial peoples and practising unity with bourgeoisie, the
Communist International is an organisation, which stands on guard
for the unity of the proletarians of all countries and the co-operation of the toilers of all races and peoples in their struggle
against the imperialistic yoke.
pages.zh:
- 33 -

对于农民——涉及税收政策、抵押债务、反对资本诉求的斗争、土地问题等事项。事实上，共产党希望在与进步资本主义国家和某些殖民地中相当于无产阶级专政的状态，能在其他地方普遍建立。

同样应在无产阶级和农民青年中开展系统工作，主要通过青年共产国际（KIM）及其分支机构进行，同时也应在女工和农妇中进行，牢记她们生活的特殊条件，以便她们能将自己的要求与广大无产者的要求结合起来。

关于反对压迫殖民地人民的斗争，共产党应倡导以下要求：所有民族和种族平等，废除外国人的所有特权，工人和农民组织的自由，缩短工作日时长，禁止童工，抑制投机，减少和废除地租，减税，抵制税收，以及共产党的主要基本要求，即：相关国家的完全政治独立，驱逐帝国主义者，建立工人和农民政府，土地归人民所有，八小时工作制及其他类似事项。同时，共产党应通过在帝国主义国家发起从殖民地撤军的运动、在陆海军中进行有利于殖民地自由的宣传、罢工、抵制以及其他形式的反对帝国主义政策的群众抗议，来确保对殖民地斗争的支持。

共产国际应特别注意逐步准备人民以应对帝国主义战争的威胁。为此，应不遗余力地揭露隐藏在和平主义主张背后的资产阶级计划。共产党应不断通过合法或非法手段在军队和舰队中组织宣传。任何帝国主义战争最终都应转化为内战，旨在击败帝国主义政府，并保护苏联和殖民地免受帝国主义者的攻击。揭露国际联盟在虚假借口下的活动，并唤起人们对1914-1918年经历的记忆的宣传，应是共产国际所有分支机构和每个成员的首要职责。

国际阶级纪律对于协调革命工作和起义，以及作为成功指导世界无产阶级的手段，是绝对必要的。所有共产党员层级在收到共产国际管理机构以指令形式发布的纪律时，都应严格遵守。

与社会党第二国际不同，第二国际的每个党派都从属于其本国资产阶级和祖国，而共产国际的各分部只服从一种纪律，即国际无产阶级的纪律，这确保了各国工人的胜利斗争以及随后在全世界范围内的无产阶级专政。此外，与导致工会衰落、反对殖民地人民争取自由的斗争并与资产阶级实行统一的第二国际不同，共产国际是一个捍卫各国无产阶级团结的组织，并促进所有种族和人民中的劳动者在反对帝国主义枷锁的斗争中进行合作。

pages.en:
- 39 -

The Communists are carrying on anti-imperialistic struggle
with boundless courage in all sections of the international
classes, despite the bloody reign of terror emanating from the
bourgeois circles, with a firm belief that the victory of the
proletariat is unavoidable and inevitable in the long run.

"The Communists believe that it is not necessary for them
to hide their opinions or intentions. They openly declare that
their aims can be attained only by means of forceful overthrow
of the whole present social order of things.
Let the dominating classes tremble in fear before the wrath
of the communist revolution. Proletarians will lose only their
fetters in it and will gain the whole world.
Proletarians of all countries unite!"
pages.zh:
- 39 -

尽管资产阶级圈子散发出血腥的恐怖统治，共产党人在国际阶级的各个部门中以无限的勇气进行反帝国主义斗争，坚信无产阶级的胜利从长远来看是不可避免和必然的。

“共产党人认为，他们没有必要隐瞒自己的观点或意图。他们公开宣布，他们的目标只能通过强力推翻整个现存社会秩序来实现。
让统治阶级在共产主义革命的怒火面前颤抖吧。无产者在这场革命中失去的只是锁链，而他们获得的将是整个世界。
全世界无产者，联合起来！”

The "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) of June 7 writes:- 9.199.
29.6.29.
Left Wing of the Japanese Labour Movement and the
Pan Pacific Conference in Vladivostock.

The Left Wing of the Labour Movement in Japan is one of
the most prominent and active bodies of the labour class
connected with the Pan Pacific Secretariat.
The Japanese labour movement numbering about 300.000
organized members is not confined to one association. It is
divided into numerous small unions and different political
alienations such as the Right Reformatory, the Medium and
the Left Movements. In the first mentioned the Sodomei
Federation holds most prominent place with Suzuki, who is
well known in the Far East, at the head, the Japanese calling
him Hompers. There are about 30.000 members of the Sodomei.
In addition to the above there are other reformatory inclined
organizations namely The Japanese Seamen's Union (54 thousand
members), The Arsenal Workers' Federation (40.000 members)
and Federation of the Workers of State Concerns (13.000 members).
All these organizations by December 1928 formed a joint
body known as "The League of the Right Wing" just about
the time of Albert Thomas' visit to Japan. This league
numbers about 150.000 organized workers, which makes up for
half the whole of the organized proletariat of Japan.
Politically they support the Social Democratic Party known
as the Siakai Minsuto, which is a bourgeois inclined Party.
Then comes the Medium organization which differs but
little from the Reformatory. The League of this latter
is known as "Kumiai Domei" and numbers about 50.000 members.
The Party it supports is the Nihon Taisuto (Japanese Masses
Party). This is a social democratic party of semi-foreign
style.
With reference to members of the above organization
it is well to note that whilst the leaders entertain
"right" tendencies the masses of Medium organizations
are inclined more to the "left". This dissension is
very welcome to the left wing of the Japanese labour
movement.
What is the left wing of the Japanese Labour Movement?
There are at present 90 "left" unions in Japan in various
branches of industry. These unions were united by the
central organization known as the Hiogikai, numbering about
35 to 40 thousand organized workers. Hiogikai is the
organizing centre for revolutionary oppositions in the
ranks of the two first mentioned organizations. Hiogikai
and the whole of the revolutionary Opposition compose
the League of Unity (Toitzu Domei) which numbers about
100.000 members. This number makes up the revolutionary
army of the Left Wing of the Japanese Labour Movement.
Hiogikai and Toutzu Domei politically are closely connected
with the Peasant and Labour Party known as the Rodo Nominto,
which is more numerous and influential in the Japanese
labour masses than the social democratic Party referred to.
HIOGIKAI and TOITSU DOMEI were the organizations of
the Japanese Proletariat, which took an active part both
in the formation of the Pan Pacific Secretariat of Labour
Unions and in its subsequent activities.
The success of the Left Wing amongst Japanese labour
masses frightened Japanese capitalists and the Japanese
Government. After effecting numerous arrests of communists
and members of the revolutionary labour movement in March
of 1928 the Japanese Government issued orders to
close down the Hiogikai and Rodo Nominto Party, hoping
thereby to disorganize the revolutionary proletarian
movement in Japan. Leaders of Rodo Nominto made several

6月7日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）写道：- 9.199。
29.6.29。
日本劳工运动的左翼与符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）的泛太平洋会议。

日本劳工运动的左翼是与泛太平洋书记处联系最紧密、最为突出和活跃的工人阶级团体之一。
拥有约300,000名组织成员的日本劳工运动并不局限于一个协会。它分为众多小型工会和不同的政治派别，如右翼改良派、中间派和左翼运动。在上述第一个派别中，总同盟（Sodomei Federation）占据最突出的地位，由在远东颇有名气的铃木（Suzuki）领导，日本人称他为“皇帝”（Hompers）。总同盟约有30,000名成员。
除上述组织外，还有其他倾向于改良主义的组织，即日本海员工会（54,000名成员）、兵工厂工人联合会（40,000名成员）和国营企业工人联合会（13,000名成员）。
所有这些组织在1928年12月组建了一个联合机构，称为“右翼联盟”，这正值阿尔伯特·托马斯（Albert Thomas）访问日本之际。该联盟拥有约150,000名组织工人，占日本整个有组织无产阶级的一半。
在政治上，他们支持被称为社会民权党（Siakai Minsuto）的社会民主党，这是一个倾向资产阶级的政党。
接下来是中间组织，其与改良派的差别微乎其微。后者的联盟称为“组合同盟”（Kumiai Domei），拥有约50,000名成员。
它所支持的政党是日本大众党（Nihon Taisuto）。这是一个具有半外国风格的社会民主党。
关于上述组织的成员，值得注意的是，虽然领导人持有“右”倾倾向，但中间组织的群众更倾向于“左”。这种分歧非常符合日本劳工运动左翼的利益。
什么是日本劳工运动的左翼？
目前日本各行业有90个“左翼”工会。这些工会由名为评议会（Hiogikai）的中心组织联合起来，拥有约35,000至40,000名组织工人。评议会是前两个提到的组织内部革命反对派的组织中心。评议会和整个革命反对派组成了统一联盟（Toitzu Domei），拥有约100,000名成员。这一数字构成了日本劳工运动左翼的革命军队。
评议会和统一联盟在政治上与农民劳动党（Rodo Nominto）有着密切的联系，该党在日本劳工群众中比前述社会民主党拥有更多成员和更大影响力。
评议会和统一联盟是日本无产阶级的组织，它们积极参与了泛太平洋工会书记处的成立及其后续活动。
左翼在日本劳工群众中的成功使日本资本家和日本政府感到恐惧。在1928年3月大规模逮捕共产党人和革命劳工运动成员后，日本政府下令关闭评议会和农民劳动党，希望以此瓦解日本的革命无产阶级运动。农民劳动党的领导人进行了几次

However, the Japanese Authorities, did not succeed to

The "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) of June 7 writes:-

Left wing of the Japanese Labour Movement and the
Pan Pacific Conference in Vladivostok.

The left wing of the Labour Movement in Japan is one of
the most prominent and active bodies of the labour class
connected with the Pan Pacific Secretariat.

The Japanese Labour Movement numbering about 100,000
organized members is not confined to one association. It is
divided into numerous small unions and different political
affiliations such as the Right Reformatory, the Medium and
the Left Movements. In the first mentioned the National
Federation holds most prominent place with Suzuki, who is
well known in the Far East, at the head. The Japanese calling
him emperors. There are about 50,000 members of this body.
In addition to the above there are other reactionary affiliated
organizations namely the Japanese Seamen's Union (about 20,000
members), the Arsenal Workers' Federation (about 10,000 members)
and Federation of the clerks of State Concerns (about 10,000 members).
All these organizations by December 1926 formed a joint
body known as 'The League of the Right Wing' just about
the time of Lozovsky's visit to Japan. This league
numbers about 100,000 organized workers, which makes up for
half the whole of the organized proletariat of Japan.
Politically they support the Social Democratic Party known
as the Minsei Jinsuto, which is a bourgeois inclined party.
Then comes the medium organization which differs but
little from the Reformatory. The League of this latter
is known as "Rodo Domei" and numbers about 30,000 members.
The party it supports is the Nihon Taishuto (Japanese Masses
Party). This is a social democratic party of semi-reign
style.

In reference to members of the above organization
it is well to note that whilst the leaders entertain
'right' tendencies the masses of medium organizations
are inclined more to the 'left'. This dissension is
very close to the left wing of the Japanese Labour
Movement.

What is the left wing of the Japanese Labour Movement?
There are at present 90 'left' unions in Japan in various
branches of industry. Those unions were united by the
central organization known as the Hyogikai, numbering about
35 to 40 thousand organized workers. Hyogikai is the
organizing centre for revolutionary oppositions in the
ranks of the two first mentioned organizations. Hyogikai
and the whole of the revolutionary opposition compose
the League of Unity (Toitsu Domei) which numbers about
100,000 members. This number makes up the revolutionary
army of the left wing of the Japanese Labour Movement.
Hyogikai and Toitsu Domei politically are closely connected
with the Peasant and Labour Party known as the Rodo Nominto,
which is more numerous and influential in the Japanese
Labour masses than the social democratic party referred to.
HYOGIKAI and TOITSU DOMEI were the organizations of
the Japanese proletariat, which took an active part both
in the formation of the Pan Pacific Secretariat of Labour
Unions and in its subsequent activities.

The success of the left wing amongst Japanese Labour
masses frightened Japanese capitalists and the Japanese
Government. After effecting numerous arrests of communists
and members of the revolutionary labour movement in March
of 1928 the Japanese Government issued orders to
close down the Hyogikai and Rodo Nominto Party, hoping
thereby to disorganize the revolutionary proletarian
movement in Japan. Leaders of Rodo Nominto made several

日本劳工运动的左翼与符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）的泛太平洋会议。

The Pan Pacific Conference of Labour Unions.
（印：FOREIGN OFFICE... C.O. REGISTRY... 2199... 10. 6. 20）
Moscow, 25 (Tass). The Committee of the General
Allied Central Council of Labour Unions, having heard
the report of Comrade Lozovsky regarding the Pan Pacific
Conference of Labour Unions to be held in Vladivostock
on August 15, passed a resolution for the organization
in Vladivostock of a Bureau of the General Allied Central
Council of Labour Unions with a view to assisting and
making preparations for the Pan Pacific Conference, as
well as for the reception of the delegates as they arrive.
The above Committee decided to start a campaign in
the press explaining and drawing the particular attention
of the public to the fact that the Soviet labour movement
is connected with the labour movements of colonial and
semi-colonial countries through the medium of the
Pan Pacific Secretariat.
The following were elected for the Bureau in
preparation of the Pan Pacific Congress and the welcoming
of delegates:- Comr. Ismailoff Chairman, Lokteff, Vice
Chairman and Malutin, Koltzoff, Punin and Paveliev
members. The Bureau has been instructed to start
immediate work of preparations.

泛太平洋工会会议。
（印章：外交部... 殖民地部登记处... 2199... 1920年6月10日）
莫斯科，25日（塔斯社）。全苏工会中央理事会委员会听取了洛佐夫斯基同志关于将于8月15日在符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）举行的泛太平洋工会会议的报告后，通过了一项决议，即在符拉迪沃斯托克设立全苏工会中央理事会局，以协助和筹备泛太平洋会议，并接待抵达的代表。
上述委员会决定在报刊上开展宣传活动，解释并提请公众特别注意以下事实：苏联劳工运动通过泛太平洋书记处这一媒介，与殖民地和半殖民地国家的劳工运动相联系。
选举产生以下人员组成筹备泛太平洋大会和欢迎代表的局：伊斯梅洛夫（Ismailoff）同志为主席，洛克捷夫（Lokteff）为副主席，马卢京（Malutin）、科尔佐夫（Koltzoff）、普宁（Punin）和帕韦利耶夫（Paveliev）为委员。该局已受命立即开始筹备工作。

Translation from the "Russkoe Slovo" (Russian Word) published
in Harbin dated January 16, 1929.

New adventure of Mr. Moravsky.

Mr. Moravsky, whose name is widely known in the Far East,
is the centre of political (Russian) attention in Shanghai
at present. A great many adventures are connected with his name.
Moravsky participated in the uprising of Czech General Gaida
in Vladivostock against Gen. Sazonoff. At that time he was
saved by the Americans. Later on Moravsky joins the Siberian
Autonomists and gets round the old man Sazonoff, who is honest
and an idealist, and involves the latter in the case of printing
non-existent Siberian Government stamps. This happened in
Shanghai where a printing office was established and samples
of the stamps are ready when at the request of the Soviet
Consul General, the French authorities raided the printing
office, confiscated the stamps in question and arrested the
persons concerned including Mr. Moravsky. As a result the
latter was expelled from the French Concession and shortly
afterwards Mr. Sazonoff died. It still remains a mystery what
was the idea of printing those stamps. It is alleged that either
Moravsky wanted to sell them to American stamp collectors or
compromise thereby the Siberian Autonomous movement.

Mr. Moravsky continued activities, interviewed on some
unknown matters foreigners, travelled to Japan and attempted
to get Podtiaguin's funds there, styled himself the head of
the Representatives of Siberian Autonomous Organizations,
promised various concessions to Americans and Japanese if
these latter would help in the movement "to free Siberia
from the Bolsheviks," and in general made his existence
on the strength of the "Siberian Autonomy".

In the spring of 1928 Mr. A. P. Golovacheff, who is the
leader of the Siberian Autonomous movement, having found
activities of Mr. Moravsky somewhat suspicious, when in Shanghai
excluded Mr. Moravsky from membership of the Representatives
of the Siberian Autonomous Organizations. At the time Mr.
Golovacheff reminded Mr. Moravsky of his political actions,
referred to his connection with the murder of one Vereteliak,
pointed out the way Moravsky disposed of the funds belonging
to the Organization and called the case with the stamps as
an act of provocation. It would seem as though after all the
above the career of Mr. Moravsky would end, but he still
continues to be "active". Only recently he issued two
publications in the form of appeals in Shanghai signed by
the Council of Representatives, etc. In these appeals Mr.
Moravsky calls upon people to join the movement to free
Siberia, as being a country on the advance line. The question
arises what makes Mr. Moravsky issue these appeals in Shanghai
which is pretty far from the advance line? The matter is
quite simple. Mr. Moravsky needs to prove that he is at the
head of a strong organization which has supporters in the
Far East and Siberia and means thereby to mislead some other
foreigners with a view to obtaining money.

Amongst foreigners there are often people made easily to
believe or simply actuated by avarice that with Russians
one can do anything and even obtain concessions, railways, etc.
for trifling sums of money.

Moravsky at present is spreading the rumour in Shanghai
that American capitalists are ready to finance him and his
Council of Representatives of Siberian Autonomous Organizations
to the extent of 15 million Gold dollars if only he agrees
to grant them concessions as follows:- 99 years on the Ussuri
Railway, 43 years on Suchan Mines and also Fishing Concessions
etc. Moravsky "agreed" to all that, but told the Americans

译自1929年1月16日哈尔滨出版的《Russkoe Slovo》（俄语意为“俄罗斯言论”）。

莫拉夫斯基先生的新冒险。

莫拉夫斯基先生，其名字在远东广为人知，目前是上海政治（俄罗斯）关注的中心。许多冒险活动都与他的名字联系在一起。莫拉夫斯基曾参与捷克盖达将军（General Gaida）在海参崴反对萨佐诺夫将军（Gen. Sazonoff）的起义。当时他得到了美国人的救助。后来，莫拉夫斯基加入了西伯利亚自治派，并欺骗了诚实且理想主义的老人萨佐诺夫，使后者卷入印刷根本不存在的西伯利亚政府邮票的案件。此事发生在上海，当时一家印刷所已经建立，邮票样本也已准备就绪，此时应苏联总领事的要求，法国当局突袭了该印刷所，没收了相关邮票，并逮捕了包括莫拉夫斯基先生在内的相关人员。结果，后者被驱逐出法租界，不久后萨佐诺夫先生去世。印刷这些邮票的目的究竟为何，至今仍是个谜。据称，要么是莫拉夫斯基想将它们卖给美国的集邮者，要么是想以此破坏西伯利亚自治运动。

莫拉夫斯基继续活动，就一些不明事项采访外国人，前往日本，试图在那里获取波德佳金（Podtiaguin）的资金，自称为西伯利亚自治组织代表委员会主席，承诺如果美国人及日本人帮助“将西伯利亚从布尔什维克手中解放出来”的运动，将给予他们各种特许权，总之，他是依靠“西伯利亚自治”的名义维持生存。

1928年春，西伯利亚自治运动的领导人A. P. 戈洛瓦切夫（A. P. Golovacheff）先生发现莫拉夫斯基先生的活动有些可疑，当其在上海时，将莫拉夫斯基先生排除在西伯利亚自治组织代表委员会的成员之外。当时，戈洛瓦切夫先生提醒莫拉夫斯基注意其政治行动，提及他与一起谋杀维列捷利亚克（Vereteliak）案件的关联，指出莫拉夫斯基处置属于该组织资金的方式，并称邮票案件为挑衅行为。看来在上述一切之后，莫拉夫斯基先生的生涯本该终结，但他仍然继续“活跃”。就在最近，他在上海以代表委员会等名义签署并发布了两份呼吁书形式的出版物。在这些呼吁书中，莫拉夫斯基先生号召人们加入解放西伯利亚的运动，称其为处于前线的国家。这就产生了一个问题：是什么促使莫拉夫斯基先生在距离前线相当遥远的上海发布这些呼吁书？事情很简单。莫拉夫斯基需要证明他领导着一个在远东和西伯利亚拥有支持者的强大组织，并以此误导其他外国人，旨在获取资金。

在外国人中，经常有一些人容易轻信，或者仅仅受贪婪驱使，认为与俄罗斯人打交道可以做成任何事，甚至只需花费微不足道的金额就能获得特许权、铁路等。

莫拉夫斯基目前在上海散布谣言，称美国资本家愿意资助他和他的西伯利亚自治组织代表委员会，金额高达1500万金美元，只要他同意授予他们如下特许权：乌苏里铁路99年特许权，苏昌煤矿43年特许权，以及渔业特许权等。莫拉夫斯基“同意”了所有这些条件，但告诉美国人

Translation from the "Krasnoe .namya" of October 5 and 4, 1923.

Correspondence from Kobe.

During the recent months Japanese Imperialism is going through difficult times. It has found itself between the hammer and the anvil the first in the form of American imperialism and the second in the shape of Chinese national movement. A very complicated and dangerous situation indeed and with future prospects still more so. Japan's interests in China are very big. The danger threatening them comes from two sides; in the first place from China, which is getting more powerful with every succeeding day, and secondly from the United States which have long since set their eyes on China as a field suitable for their interests.

Washington and Japanese Imperialism have clashed in China. It is a well known fact that when an army finds itself in a difficult situation it endeavours to maintain the position of its advance line. The Japanese imperialism is in exactly the same state of affairs. If forced to retreat owing to circumstances in China, Japanese imperialism will certainly not give up its standing in Manchuria. For the sake of Manchuria Japan will risk anything because the latter has made of Manchuria already a part of economic and political Japanese imperialistic area. Thus Manchuria for the next few years will be the scene of serious international complications and particularly in matters concerning the Pacific Coast.

L. Hamilton.

Reconstruction of Afghanistan.

Extensive and various plans have been drawn up with a view to effecting a thorough reconstruction of Afghanistan. New schools military and civil, clubs, labour institutions etc. will be established and the labour class will be given facilities to learn professions to make them qualified workers. Telegraphic communications will also be established with several places in the neighbourhood as far as Persia.

Translation from the "Izvestia" of October 2nd 1923.

The Institute of Eastern Languages in Leningrad.

The Government Commission of the Institute of Eastern Languages with Comrade Enukidze at the head decided that facilities should be granted to students of the Institute to travel for practice purposes once a year or so to China, Afghanistan, Persia and Turkey. Furthermore it was decided to give definite appointments to graduating students and start a publication "Present Day East".

Comrade A.N. Voznesensky, who was formerly in charge of the Eastern Department of the Commissariat for Foreign Affairs, Member of the Krestintern Council and Tass Correspondent in Japan in 1923, has been appointed Rector of the Institute of Eastern Languages in Leningrad.

来自神户的通讯。

在最近几个月里，日本帝国主义正经历艰难时期。它发现自己处于铁锤和砧板之间，前者是美国帝国主义的形式，后者是中国民族运动的形态。这确实是一个非常复杂和危险的局势，未来的前景更是如此。日本在中国的利益非常大。威胁这些利益的危险来自两个方面；首先来自中国，中国正日益强大；其次来自美国，美国早已将中国视为适合其利益的领域。

华盛顿和日本帝国主义在中国发生了冲突。众所周知，当一支军队陷入困境时，它会努力维持其前线阵地。日本帝国主义正处于完全相同的境地。如果因中国局势所迫而撤退，日本帝国主义肯定不会放弃其在满洲的地位。为了满洲，日本愿意冒任何风险，因为日本已使满洲成为其经济和政治帝国主义区域的一部分。因此，在未来几年内，满洲将成为严重国际并发症的舞台，特别是在涉及太平洋沿岸的事务上。

L. 汉密尔顿。

阿富汗的重建。

为了对阿富汗进行彻底的重建，已经制定了广泛而多样的计划。新的军事和民用学校、俱乐部、劳工机构等将会建立，劳工阶级将获得学习职业技能的机会，使其成为合格的工人。还将建立与周边多个地区（远至波斯）的电报通信。

译自1923年10月2日的《Izvestia》（消息报）。

列宁格勒东方语言学院。

以叶努基泽同志（Comrade Enukidze）为首的东方语言学院政府委员会决定，应允许学院学生每年左右一次前往中国、阿富汗、波斯和土耳其进行实习。此外，还决定给毕业生安排固定职务，并创办一份名为《今日东方》的刊物。

曾任外交部东方司负责人、农民国际理事会成员及1923年塔斯社驻日记者的A.N. 沃兹涅先斯基（A.N. Voznesensky）同志，已被任命为列宁格勒东方语言学院院长。

The "Krasnoe Znamya" of March 5th writes:-
Komintern in the East.

The first five years of the work of Komintern can be
roughly described as a period of open rebellion of the
proletariat in capitalistic countries. The marked feature
of the next five years is the wave of revolutionary uprisings
and skirmishes amongst the colonial nations.
In summing up colonial revolutionary attainments, it is
necessary to mention that nowhere did the revolution of oppressed
nations or rather their masses have a final success and even
where temporary success had been obtained it was soon counter-
acted by the world capitalism. In the course of this process
the colonial revolution whilst developing and striving after
a higher stage of class struggle, came in contact with the
bourgeois wing of open treachery in the national freedom
movement co-operating with imperialism in opposing the proletariat
and peasantry. In other countries it only initiated and stopped
at that without the masses realizing as yet class differentiation.
The co-ordination of the two tendencies of world revolution -
namely proletarian and colonial - has already been attained
in some degree or another in the sense of ideology, class
distinction and politics. Nothing more can be said as where
organizational connection is concerned it is not yet sufficient
to deprive imperialism of technical possibility of dealing
blows to the individual groups and detachments of socialistic
revolution.
The following were the most important events directed
against British imperialism during the second portion of
the ten years:- the general strike of the miners and the
Chinese revolution both of which proceeded on an independent
basis. In dealing with the general strike by bribing its
headquarters and persecuting labour organizations with the
aid of reformists at the time, British imperialism was in a
position to act without looking back at the East. It was
just then that its rear in China and India was threatened
with danger. Following the above Imperialistic England was
able to start on a military intervention in China with ease,
having succeeded in suppressing the activities of labour
organizations and paralyzing the trade unions.
The uprising in Indonesia took place before it had time
to co-ordinate its activities with the revolution in China.
As is known the uprising in Java was suppressed before it
extended to other islands, which in turn were dealt with
at the start by the Dutch troops, already free after the
bloodshed in Java.
The same may be said of the military attacks by the native
tribes of North Africa in 1925 against the French Imperialism
which took place at different periods and which never coincided
with the uprisings in Syria, which latter occurred again at
times different from disturbances in the labour world of France.
Finally the two revolutionary colonial tendencies, whose
destiny it may be to play a decisive role in the next five years,
namely the Chinese and Indian revolutions, although very close
to one another failed to fall in at the height of their
development. The revolutionary wave in India, which has
surpassed anything hitherto known in the sense of labour
masses activity, takes place between the two periods of Chinese
revolution.
There is no reason to conceal or disguise the political,
tactical and organizational mistakes, weaknesses and slips
allowed and committed in the course of colonial strife.
The Sixth Congress of the Komintern in its decisions
and resolutions realized these mistakes to the full extent,
analyzed their causes and sources and formulated in consequence
of these experiences lessons for the future struggle.

3月5日的《Krasnoe Znamya》（红旗报）写道：-
共产国际在东方。

共产国际工作的第一个五年大致可以描述为资本主义国家无产阶级公开反抗的时期。接下来五年的显著特征是殖民国家中革命起义和小规模冲突的浪潮。
在总结殖民地革命成就时，必须指出，受压迫民族的革命，或者更确切地说是其群众的革命，在任何地方都没有取得最终成功，即使在取得暂时成功的地方，也很快被世界资本主义所抵消。在这个过程中，殖民地革命在发展和争取更高阶段的阶级斗争时，接触到了民族自由运动中公开叛变的资产阶级翼，后者与帝国主义合作反对无产阶级和农民。在其他国家，革命仅由此发起并停滞于此，群众尚未意识到阶级分化。世界革命的两种倾向——即无产阶级和殖民地——在意识形态、阶级区分和政治方面已经在某种程度上实现了协调。至于组织联系，无可多言，目前的联系尚不足以剥夺帝国主义对社会主义革命的个别团体和分队进行打击的技术可能性。
在这十年的后半段，针对英国帝国主义的最重要事件如下：矿工大罢工和中国革命，两者均在独立基础上进行。在处理大罢工时，英国帝国主义通过贿赂其总部并借助改良主义者迫害劳工组织，得以在不顾及东方的情况下采取行动。正是在那时，其在中国和印度的后方受到了危险威胁。继此之后，帝国主义的英国能够轻易地开始对中国的军事干预，因为它成功镇压了劳工组织的活动并使工会瘫痪。
印度尼西亚的起义发生得过早，来不及将其活动与中国革命协调起来。众所周知，爪哇的起义在蔓延到其他岛屿之前就被镇压了，而其他岛屿则在爪哇流血事件结束后，随即被荷兰军队处理。
1925年北非土著部落对法国帝国主义的军事攻击也是如此，这些攻击发生在不同时期，从未与叙利亚的起义重合，而叙利亚的起义又与法国劳工界的动荡发生在不同时间。
最后，两种革命性的殖民地倾向，其命运可能是在未来五年发挥决定性作用，即中国和印度革命，虽然彼此非常接近，但未能在其发展的高峰期同步。印度的革命浪潮，就劳工群众活动的意义而言，超过了以往已知的任何情况，发生在中国革命的两个时期之间。
没有理由隐瞒或掩饰在殖民地斗争过程中允许和犯下的政治、战术和组织上的错误、弱点和失误。
共产国际第六次代表大会在其决定和决议中充分认识到这些错误，分析了其原因和根源，并根据这些经验教训制定了未来斗争的方针。

The Chinese revolution was an especially serious
fore-warning to imperialism. In the days of victory
of the Shanghai labourers it became clear to everyone,
to friends as well as enemies, that the Chinese revolution
has tackled the knot of the imperialistic system as a whole.
A decisive victory in this point would have meant a deathly
blow to the system in question. Then followed the mobilization
of all weapons of the world imperialism in order to attain
success in Shanghai and defend the "prestige", i.e. the "right"
of colonial plundering in the whole of the East.
It is only now that we see what diplomatic efforts,
what co-operation the imperialists showed in the days of
Shanghai and Wuhan trouble in order to unify their actions
for the defeat of the Chinese revolution. The wide masses
of European and American proletariat can now see for themselves
that the reformists in all countries concerned and particularly
in England, having supported imperialism, thereby repeated
the treachery of 1914.
Indian revolution will have against it a united world
imperialism in a different form to that of the Chinese,
as the colonial monopoly of England arouses mad jealousy
on the part of American capitalists. The colonial revolution
will know how to take advantage of the conflicts and disagreements in the camp of imperialists only after it has won and
secured serious success. This change in the situation will
happen so as to improve the tasks of the colonial revolution
only as a result of an open military encounter in the midst
of the imperialists, in other words after a new world war.

( The above is an extract from an article published in
No. 9-10 of the "Communistic International" Journal. )

中国革命对帝国主义来说是一个特别严重的预警。在上海工人胜利的日子里，无论是朋友还是敌人，大家都清楚地看到，中国革命已经抓住了整个帝国主义体系的关键结。在这一关键点上的决定性胜利，将意味着对该体系的致命打击。随后，世界帝国主义动员了其所有武器，以便在上海取得成功并捍卫其“威望”，即在整个东方进行殖民掠夺的“权利”。

直到现在我们才看到，在上海和武汉动荡期间，帝国主义者为了统一行动以击败中国革命，展现了怎样的外交努力和合作。欧美广大无产阶级现在可以亲眼看到，有关各国、特别是英国的改良主义者支持了帝国主义，从而重演了1914年的背叛行径。

印度革命所面对的将是另一种形式的世界帝国主义联合阵线，这与中国的处境不同，因为英国的殖民垄断引起了美国资本家的疯狂嫉妒。殖民革命只有在赢得并确保取得重大成功之后，才知道如何利用帝国主义阵营内部的冲突和分歧。这种局势的变化，只有作为帝国主义内部公开军事遭遇的结果——换句话说，即在新一轮世界大战之后——才会发生，从而改善殖民革命的任务。

Translation from the "Izvestia" of March 23,
Imperialists on Soviet Cognizance of the East

The weakest spot of the imperialistic world is the East and colonies. The powerful movement of Eastern countries to obtain their freedom is undermining the very foundation of the strength of world capitalism. In spite of the temporary defeat of the Chinese revolution and the alternative success and failure of revolutionary movements in other colonies and semi-colonies and in particular in India - this "best gem of the British Crown" - imperialism continues to feel keenly the threat to its existence in colonies.

For the success of the freedom movement in the East the existence and prosperity of Soviet Russia is of vital importance. The example of a country, opposed to the united frontier of imperialists, is a thing which holds the attention and hopes of the oppressed masses of the East and of the whole world and mobilizes forces from amongst these masses for revolutionary activities. In order to understand the important part of this, one of its kind, Soviet country it is but necessary to see with what fear and hatred our common enemies watch everything that happens in Russia, taking for example, the study of the East, its revolutionary movement and the surroundings in which it is developing.

"Revolution in the East". "Soviet plans in the Colonies". Such are the headings under which "The Times", the most powerful organ of British imperialism, in its issue of February 15 gives space to one and a half column to describe the work of the Soviet study of the East. This description begins by reference to Soviet Russia "turning to the East so as to conquer the West with its aid" and an assertion to the effect that the Soviet Government clearly sees the weakness of European capitalism namely the colonies and is attacking this capitalism through the East. With this end in view U.S.S.R. "making use of the Imperialistic Russia institutions" has re-organized Eastern schools and established a "department of propaganda in different languages". "Where, at the time of the old regime, students of the Orient, official interpreters and diplomats had their education, communists are now teaching propagandists and professional revolutionaries".

Further description is somewhat after the style of Rockamball(?) . The British newspaper finds three centres "of communist propaganda in the East" - Vladivostock, Tashkent and Moscow. In Vladivostock, for instance, there is a radio station of power enabling the Komintern to send reports to Japan, China and even Dutch Indies and "get young Malays to come to Vladivostock to learn the art of civil war". In Tashkent the correspondent of "The Times" finds several institutions "working out ways and means of penetrating India and Afghanistan". The attention of the above paper, full of fear, is centred, amidst other things, on the "Bulletin of Asia-Minor Press", published in Tashkent, the fault of which lies in printing a quotation of Lenin and in its first issue in calling upon readers to study the question of the East with systematic attention.

The greatest impression is, however, made on the correspondent by the Moscow way of dealing with Eastern matters. As for instance "Representatives of coloured races, invited to Moscow, are given an example of authority and the prosperity of the Red Comrades". Negroes are shown old palaces and are allowed to sit on Imperial thrones. Then these thus spoiled coloured natives are sent to study in the University of Stalin. The more capable pupils are taken on as aspirants into scientific associations for 80 Rls a month, board and lodging.

译自3月23日《消息报》，
帝国主义者眼中的苏维埃对东方的认知

帝国主义世界最薄弱的环节是东方和殖民地。东方国家争取自由的强大运动正在动摇世界资本主义力量的根基。尽管中国革命暂时受挫，其他殖民地和半殖民地（特别是印度——这颗“大英帝国皇冠上最好的宝石”）的革命运动成败交替，但帝国主义继续敏锐地感受到其在殖民地的生存所受到的威胁。

苏维埃俄国的存在和繁荣，对于东方自由运动的成功至关重要。作为一个与帝国主义联合战线相对立的国家，其榜样吸引着东方及全世界被压迫群众的关注和希望，并从这些群众中动员力量进行革命活动。要理解这个独一无二的苏维埃国家所起的重要作用，只需看看我们的共同敌人是以怎样的恐惧和仇恨注视着俄罗斯发生的一切，例如他们对东方研究、其革命运动及其发展环境的关注。

“东方革命”。“苏维埃在殖民地的计划”。英国帝国主义最有力的喉舌《泰晤士报》在2月15日的版面上，用一栏半的篇幅描述了苏维埃对东方的研究工作，标题即是如此。这篇描述开篇便称苏维埃俄国“转向东方，以便借助东方征服西方”，并断言苏维埃政府清楚地看到了欧洲资本主义的弱点，即殖民地，并通过东方攻击这一资本主义。为此目的，苏联“利用帝俄时期的机构”重组了东方学校，并建立了“多语种宣传部门”。“在旧政权时期，东方学生、官方翻译和外交官接受教育的地方，现在由共产主义者教导宣传员和职业革命家”。

进一步的描述 somewhat 带有洛克巴尔（Rockamball(?)）式的风格。这家英国报纸发现了东方“共产主义宣传”的三个中心——符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）、塔什干和莫斯科。例如，在符拉迪沃斯托克，有一个功率强大的广播电台，使共产国际能够向日本、中国甚至荷属东印度发送报告，并“吸引年轻的马来人来到符拉迪沃斯托克学习内战的艺术”。在塔什干，《泰晤士报》的记者发现有几个机构正在“制定渗透印度和阿富汗的方法和手段”。上述充满恐惧的报纸的注意力，除其他事项外，集中在塔什干出版的《小亚细亚新闻公报》上，该刊物的“罪过”在于刊登了列宁的引文，并在创刊号中呼吁读者系统地关注东方问题。

然而，给记者留下最深印象的是莫斯科处理东方事务的方式。例如，“受邀前往莫斯科的有色人种代表，见证了红色同志们的权威和繁荣”。黑人被带领参观古老的宫殿，并被允许坐在帝国的宝座上。然后，这些被宠坏的有色土著被送往斯大林大学学习。更有能力的学员被作为 aspirants（候补研究员）吸纳进科学协会，月薪80卢布，包食宿。

pages.en:
- 2 -

The careful selection of these aspirants, in the opinion
of the correspondent, points to the fact that they are
assigned for special work of propaganda.
Moreover the "spiritual" work in Soviet Russia is carried
on in accordance with the teaching of Marx and as inspired
by the active Communism. For example the Magazine "Novi Vostok"
(The New East), a publication of the Scientific Association
for the study of the East, appears to select its data depending
on current political happenings. "The perusal of this magazine "
states the correspondent "gives one an idea of which country
has been chosen by the Komintern for the next attack". The
last issue, as an example, was widely commenting on India.
Documents seized in Shanghai in 1926 (?) pointed to the next
revolution in India in 1928(!!!) and Indians were asked to
go to Moscow to be taught how to engage in propaganda, cause
riots, and start and develop civil war".
Such is the picturization as given by the informer
(most probably a White army man) of the leading British
Imperialistic newspaper. In this description things are
so misrepresented and mixed up as to resemble a detective
story, and hardly deserve clearing up. One thing is certain
and that the above description is dictated by fear. The one
who invented those details, told lies (probably on being paid
for it), but the publisher and corrector was undoubtedly
guided by a vague, but not a mistaken instinct and understanding
that the very fact of the existence of Soviet Russia is a
serious blow to the sovereignty and domination of the imperia-
lists in the colonies - which, really, is a more serious factor
than ten thousand propagandists taken together. These latter
must be invented, because the forthcoming twilight of the
dominion of British Imperialism, is easier explained by
somebody's evil minded misdeeds. Hence, negroes, spoilt by
the sight of Romanoff's thrones, Indians studying the art
of uprisings (as though this art could be taught from school
books) and all this anti-Bolshevist nonsense, with which the
leaders of to-day's British Empire, endeavour to calm
the fears in their hearts, which arise every time they look
into the future. This nonsense is, moreover, supported by
the Conservatives in order to strengthen their stubborn and
narrow policy and to prevent any commercial agreement. Also
to check the encounter of historical forces by a self-
advantageous policy of anti-Soviet intrigues and futile
aggressive attacks.
This policy is still there. This explains the author's
reference in the above mentioned article to the signs of
aggressiveness on the part of British imperialism such as
the re-arming of the Indian Army, the development of British
aerial communication in the Minor and Near East), attempting
to disguise this reference by assertions that there is really
no need to fear any attacks and that it is more a product
of imagination founded on the spirit of militarism prevalent
in ██████ Soviet Russia. The Eastern territory of Soviet
Russia as a matter of fact in addition to connecting the
labour masses of oppressed countries with Russia, is like a gate
which we, Soviet Russians, must defend against any attempts
at intervention by the exploiters dominating in the countries
concerned. This feature is an aid to the study of the East
by Soviet Russia, which is but another means of struggle in
favour of socialism and world wide revolution and which
can only be proud by the fear-inspired reference of the
imperialistic Press.
ALAKS.

据记者认为，对这些候补研究员的精心挑选表明，他们是被指派从事特殊的宣传工作。

此外，苏维埃俄国的“精神”工作是按照马克思的学说并在积极共产主义的鼓舞下进行的。例如，东方科学研究协会出版的杂志《新东方》（Novi Vostok），似乎根据当前的政治事件来选择其资料。记者称：“阅读这本杂志让人了解到共产国际选择了哪个国家作为下一次攻击的目标。”例如，最新一期广泛评论了印度。1926年（？）在上海缴获的文件指出，下一次革命将于1928年在印度爆发（!!!），并要求印度人前往莫斯科，学习如何从事宣传、制造骚乱以及发动和发展内战”。

这就是那位告密者（很可能是一名白军分子）向这家主要的英国帝国主义报纸提供的描绘。在这种描述中，事情被歪曲和混淆得如同侦探小说一般，几乎不值得澄清。有一点是肯定的，即上述描述是由恐惧所驱使的。编造这些细节的人说了谎（可能是为了报酬），但出版者和修订者无疑受到一种模糊但并非错误的本能和理解所引导，即苏维埃俄国存在这一事实本身，就是对帝国主义者在殖民地的主权和统治的严重打击——这确实比一万名宣传员加在一起更为重要的因素。后者必须被虚构出来，因为大英帝国统治即将到来的黄昏，更容易被解释为某人心怀恶意的不法行为。因此，出现了因目睹罗曼诺夫王朝宝座而被宠坏的黑人、学习起义艺术的印度人（仿佛这门艺术可以从教科书中教授）以及所有这类反布尔什维克的 nonsense（胡言乱语），当今大英帝国的领导人试图以此平息他们每次展望未来时心中产生的恐惧。此外，保守派支持这种胡言乱语，以加强其顽固和狭隘的政策，并阻止任何商业协定。同时也为了通过利己的反苏维埃阴谋和徒劳的攻击性行动来遏制历史力量的交锋。

这项政策依然存在。这就解释了作者在上述文章中提及英国帝国主义侵略迹象的原因，如重新武装印度军队、发展英国在小亚细亚和近东的航空通讯等，并试图通过断言实际上无需担心任何攻击来掩饰这一提及，声称这更多是基于 ██████ 苏维埃俄国盛行的军国主义精神的想象产物。事实上，苏维埃俄国的东方领土除了将受压迫国家的劳动群众与俄罗斯联系起来外，就像一扇大门，我们苏维埃俄国人必须保卫它，以防相关国家中占主导地位的剥削者进行任何干预企图。这一特征有助于苏维埃俄国对东方的研究，这只是有利于社会主义和世界革命的另一种斗争手段，帝国主义报刊出于恐惧的提及只能令其感到自豪。

ALAKS.

Translation from
The "Izvestia" of March 20, 1929, Moscow.

England and China.

London, 18 March (Tass) Reuter reports: "In replying
to the question brought up at the House of Commons, Navy
Minister Bridgeman, stated that no official request had come
from the Chinese Government to send British naval officers
to serve in the Chinese Fleet. As to unofficial inquiries
on the subject, the British Government replied that so long
as the agreement is in force prohibiting the importation
of arms into China, England cannot render such assistance
as requested to China. England will, however, gladly do so
so soon as the limitations, governed by the said agreement,
are abolished."

----------

"The "unofficial inquiries" to send British naval officers
to serve in the Chinese Fleet are a new significant proof
of the relations, which are being established between Nanking
and the principal Imperialistic Powers as well as of the hopes
which the Government of Nanking has in the support of
the Powers. The reply given by Bridgeman is not significant
of the futility of these hopes, for, as the British Naval
Minister says, England is prepared to assist China in this
as soon as the agreement prohibiting importation of arms
into China is abolished. This agreement, concluded in 1919,
in reality is not observed by any of the parties concerned;
it is sufficient to point out that in British Shipyards in
Hongkong warships for the Cantonese Government are under
construction. Nevertheless it compels at times a too
open military assistance to Chinese groups of different
kind. From reports appearing recently in the Foreign Press,
United States of America (the least interested in the arms
trade in China) intend to show initiative in the matter
of abolition of the prohibition, which is unpleasant to the
Chinese Authorities. If these reports are correct one may
be certain that America will be followed by all other Powers
and thus the present Chinese Authorities will obtain direct
and open military assistance in various form from the imperialists.
The rendering of this assistance will, undoubtedly, become the
bone of contention and the object of hostility between
America and England, both of which are fighting for the
dominating influence in China.

1929年3月20日莫斯科《消息报》。

英国与中国。

伦敦，3月18日（塔斯社）路透社报道：“在回答下议院提出的问题时，海军大臣布里奇曼表示，中国政府并未正式请求派遣英国海军军官在中国舰队服役。至于关于此事的非正式询问，英国政府答复称，只要禁止向中国进口武器的协议仍然有效，英国就不能应要求向中国提供此类援助。然而，一旦上述协议规定的限制被废除，英国将乐意提供援助。”

----------

“派遣英国海军军官在中国舰队服役”的“非正式询问”，是南京与主要帝国主义列强之间正在建立的关系的新的重要证明，也是南京政府对列强支持所抱希望的证明。布里奇曼的答复并不意味着这些希望是徒劳的，因为正如英国海军大臣所说，一旦禁止向中国进口武器的协议被废除，英国就准备在这方面援助中国。这项于1919年达成的协议，实际上并未被任何一方遵守；只需指出一点，在香港的英国造船厂正在为广东政府建造军舰。尽管如此，它有时仍迫使各方避免对中国各派系提供过于公开的军事援助。根据最近外国报刊的报道，美国（对中国军火贸易兴趣最小）打算在废除这一令中国当局不快的禁令方面表现出主动性。如果这些报道属实，可以肯定美国将得到其他所有列强的追随，从而现任中国当局将从帝国主义者那里获得各种形式的直接和公开的军事援助。提供这种援助无疑将成为美英之间争论的焦点和敌视的对象，两国都在为在中国的主导影响力而斗争。

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" of November 23, 1928.

The Pan Pacific Congress of Labour Unions
in Vladivostock.

Moscow, 23 (Tass). In connection with the Pan-Pacific
Congress of Labour Unions convened in Vladivostock for
August 1, 1929, the Pan Pacific Secretariat of Labour Unions
issued an appeal to all professional organisations of the
Pan-Pacific countries.
It is said in the appeal that the efforts of imperialism
to strangle the labour class and prevent the freedom
movement are closely connected with imperialistic internal
antagonism and will inevitably bring about a war in the
Pacific. The Congress will enable the Pan-Pacific Labour
Unions to have joint discussions as to a future programme
of action prior to the breaking out of the war.
International unity of the labour movement to resist
the attacks of capitalism and imperialism is one of the
main and immediate tasks of the labour class. In the Pacific
the necessity of this unity is the more emphasized now
owing to attempts of Japanese Imperialism to organize a
counter institution to the Pan Pacific Secretariat of Labour
Unions in the form of "An Asiatic Labour Confederation",
which will be approved by the Japanese Imperialism. It is
necessary to disclose the working of that organization
meant to cause a split.
The appeal furthermore advocates that the programme
of activities at the forthcoming Congress should be drafted
in consideration of demands and needs of the present time
and distributed in all countries on the Pacific Coast.
The Secretariat suggests the following agenda for
the Congress:- Report of the Secretariat. Military Danger
and struggle with Imperialism. Movement of Freedom in
the colonies and the part of labour unions and christian
organizations. International unity of labour movement,
immigration and emigration in the Pacific Coast countries.
Programme of activities :- Seven hours' labour day,
maximum pay for labour, women's and children's labour,
unemployment, social legislation, direct problems in China,
Japan, India, Indonesia, Korea, Philippines, etc.
The Secretariat requests all organizations sending
delegates to the Congress to formulate their suggestions
for the agenda as well as their opinions on all matters
so as to make it easier to inform all other organizations
connected with it.

H.B.M. Consul
Lieut. Coll G.H.R. Halland, J.B.E., N. China Command.
Capt, J.P. Shelley , North China Command.
Lieut. E.F. Carlson, U.S. Marine Corps.

译自1928年11月23日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

在符拉迪沃斯托克召开的泛太平洋工会代表大会。

莫斯科，23日（塔斯社电）。鉴于定于1929年8月1日在符拉迪沃斯托克召开泛太平洋工会代表大会，泛太平洋工会书记处向泛太平洋各国的所有职业组织发出呼吁书。
呼吁书称，帝国主义扼杀工人阶级并阻碍自由运动的努力，与帝国主义内部的对抗密切相关，并将不可避免地导致太平洋战争。此次大会将使泛太平洋各工会能够在战争爆发前，就未来的行动纲领进行共同讨论。
工人运动在国际上团结一致，以抵抗资本主义和帝国主义的攻击，是工人阶级主要且紧迫的任务之一。在太平洋地区，由于日本帝国主义试图建立一个与泛太平洋工会书记处相对抗的机构，即“亚洲劳工联合会”，该机构将得到日本帝国主义的认可，因此这种团结的必要性现在更加突出。有必要揭露那个旨在造成分裂的组织的运作。
此外，呼吁书主张，即将召开的大会的活动纲领应根据当前的需求和需要来起草，并在太平洋沿岸所有国家分发。
书记处建议大会采用以下议程：- 书记处报告。军事危险与反帝斗争。殖民地的自由运动以及工会和基督教组织在其中的作用。工人运动的国际团结，太平洋沿岸国家的移民和出境问题。
活动纲领：- 七小时工作日，最高工资，妇女和儿童劳动，失业问题，社会立法，中国、日本、印度、印度尼西亚、朝鲜、菲律宾等地的直接问题。
书记处请所有派遣代表参加大会的组织提出对议程的建议以及对所有事项的意见，以便更容易地通知所有与之相关的其他组织。

Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) Nov. 7, 1928.

Anniversary of Russian Revolution.

In connection with the eleventh anniversary of Soviet
Revolution many greetings on the occasion were received
by the Russian proletariat from other countries. One of
these was a telegram from Swedish seamen of the s.s. "Benares"
and the other from the Union of Red German soldiers.

A word about "coolies" and "boys", etc.

There is a vast difference between then and now in the
treatment of yellow servants. Those who lived in the Russian
Far East before will understand what is meant.
For example to-day we see in Shanghai on Nanking Road
how a hired native policeman hits on the head a Chinese
coolie who happens to get mixed up in the traffic. Instructions
from the Police Station by telephone are to remove the body
and that's all. There are very few horses in Shanghai, but
these are replaced by human "ponies" - the rickshaws. One can
experience a feeling of "imperialism" when riding in those.
A Yellow, dirty and sweating, pulls the carriage in which
a White is sitting in comfort and woe if the former makes
a wrong turn or something like that, at once the well dressed
foot of the latter hits him in the back regardless of his
tiredness. This is very amusing to some people and often
wives of British merchants are heard to relate such instances
with a smile when travelling outside Asia.
In China, in Shanghai, his own country, a Chinese has
no right to walk on every street, but in his home - the U.S.S.R.
a Chinese or a Korean is a citizen equal to others.

We have thousands and hundreds of thousands Koreans
and Chinese organized in labour unions and participating in
public, economic, and state work of the country. Often
both Chinese and Koreans hold responsible posts in different
official administrations and concerns.

Translation from the Krasnoe Znamya of November 10, 1928.

A message from prisoners in Mukden.

Dear friends in the Primorie,
On the day of the IIth anniversary of October we send you
our warm comradely greetings and sincere thanks for the
steady and persistent maintenance and support of Soviet power
in the Far East. News penetrating only too scarce behind the
prison walls give us joy and help us to bear hardships patiently
in the assurance that the cause of the labourers is in
reliable hands and on the right track. Once again friendly
greetings and wishes of all success.
Prisoners of the Mukden Gaol.

Accidents in American Aviation.

In the first six months of 1928 there were 390 accidents
with 153 casualties and 276 people wounded. These apply mostly
to amateur aviation. In the regular service there were only 34
accidents with six deaths. However it is a high percentage
generally considering that in Soviet Russia during the same
period of time there were no accidents at all. The pilots are
in a great measure responsible for the accidents, then comes
the fault of the motors not being in good state of repairs and
lastly bad meteorological conditions.

译自1928年11月7日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

俄国革命周年纪念。

值此苏维埃革命十一周年之际，俄国无产阶级收到了来自其他国家的许多贺电。其中一份是来自“贝纳雷斯”号（s.s. "Benares"）轮船上的瑞典海员，另一份来自德国红色士兵联盟。

关于“苦力”和“侍童”等的一点看法。

如今与过去相比，对待黄色仆役的方式有着巨大的差异。以前居住在俄罗斯远东地区的人都会明白这是什么意思。
例如，今天我们在上海南京路上看到，一名受雇的本地巡捕用头撞击一名恰好卷入交通纠纷的中国苦力。警察局通过电话下达指令，要求移走尸体，仅此而已。上海的马匹很少，但取而代之的是人力“小马”——即黄包车。乘坐这些车时，人们可以体验到一种“帝国主义”的感觉。一个肮脏、流着汗的黄色人种，拉着坐着一位舒适白人的车子，如果前者转错了弯或发生类似情况，后者穿着考究的脚会立刻踢向前者的背部，全然不顾其疲惫。这对某些人来说非常有趣，经常听到英国商人的妻子在离开亚洲旅行时，微笑着讲述此类事例。
在中国，在上海，在他自己的国家，中国人无权走在每一条街道上，但在他的家园——苏联，中国人或朝鲜人是与他人平等的公民。

我们有成千上万乃至数十万的朝鲜人和中国人组织在工会中，并参与该国的公共、经济和国家工作。中国人和朝鲜人经常在不同的官方行政机构和企事业单位中担任重要职务。

译自1928年11月10日《红旗报》。

来自沈阳囚犯的信息。

滨海地区的亲爱的朋友们，
在十月革命十一周年纪念日，我们向你们致以热烈的同志般的问候，并衷心感谢你们对远东苏维埃政权的坚定和持续维护与支持。透过监狱高墙渗透进来的消息虽然寥寥无几，却给我们带来了喜悦，并帮助我们要耐心地忍受苦难，因为我们确信劳动者的事业掌握在可靠的人手中，并且走在正确的道路上。再次致以友好的问候和祝一切顺利。
沈阳监狱囚犯。

美国航空事故。

1928年上半年，共发生390起事故，造成153人死亡，276人受伤。这些事故主要涉及业余航空。在定期航班服务中，仅发生34起事故，造成6人死亡。然而，总体而言，这是一个很高的百分比，考虑到在同一时期，苏维埃俄罗斯根本没有发生任何事故。飞行员对事故负有很大责任，其次是发动机维修状况不佳，最后是恶劣的气象条件。

pages.en:
Translation from the "Krasnoe marya" of November 22, 1928.

The Pan Pacific Congress of Labour Unions
in Vladivostok.

Moscow, 23 (Tass). In connection with the Pan-Pacific
Congress of Labour Unions convened in Vladivostok for
August 1, 1929, the Pan Pacific Secretariat of Labour Unions
issued an appeal to all professional organisations of the
Pan-Pacific countries.
It is said in the appeal that the efforts of Imperialism
to strangle the labour class and prevent the freedom
movement are closely connected with imperialistic internal
antagonism and will inevitably bring about a war in the
Pacific. The Congress will enable the Pan-Pacific Labour
Unions to have joint discussions as to a future programme
of action prior to the breaking out of the war.
International unity of the labour movement to resist
the attacks of capitalism and imperialism is one of the
main and immediate tasks of the labour class. In the Pacific
the necessity of this unity is the more emphasized now
owing to attempts of Japanese imperialism to organize a
counter institution to the Pan Pacific Secretariat of Labour
Unions in the form of "an Asiatic Labour Confederation",
which will be approved by the Japanese Imperialism. It is
necessary to disclose the working of that organization
meant to cause a split.
The appeal furthermore advocates that the programme
of activities at the forthcoming Congress should be drafted
in consideration of demands and needs of the present time
and discussed in all countries on the Pacific coast.
The Secretariat suggests the following agenda for
the Congress:- Report of the Secretariat. Military danger
and struggle with imperialism. Movement of freedom in
the colonies and the part of labour unions and Christian
organizations. International unity of labour movement,
immigration and emigration in the Pacific Ocean countries.
Programme of activities :- even hours' labour day,
maximum pay for labour, women's and children's labour,
unemployment, social legislation, direct protection in China,
Japan, India, Indonesia, Korea, Philippines, etc.
The Secretariat requests all organizations sending
delegates to the Congress to formulate their suggestions
for the agenda as well as their opinions on all matters
so as to make it easier to inform all other organizations
connected with it.

译自1928年11月22日《红旗报》（原文误植为 Krasnoe marya）。

在符拉迪沃斯托克召开的泛太平洋工会代表大会。

莫斯科，23日（塔斯社电）。鉴于定于1929年8月1日在符拉迪沃斯托克召开泛太平洋工会代表大会，泛太平洋工会书记处向泛太平洋各国的所有职业组织发出呼吁书。
呼吁书称，帝国主义扼杀工人阶级并阻碍自由运动的努力，与帝国主义内部的对抗密切相关，并将不可避免地导致太平洋战争。此次大会将使泛太平洋各工会能够在战争爆发前，就未来的行动纲领进行共同讨论。
工人运动在国际上团结一致，以抵抗资本主义和帝国主义的攻击，是工人阶级主要且紧迫的任务之一。在太平洋地区，由于日本帝国主义试图建立一个与泛太平洋工会书记处相对抗的机构，即“亚洲劳工联合会”，该机构将得到日本帝国主义的认可，因此这种团结的必要性现在更加突出。有必要揭露那个旨在造成分裂的组织的运作。
此外，呼吁书主张，即将召开的大会的活动纲领应根据当前的需求和需要来起草，并在太平洋沿岸所有国家进行讨论。
书记处建议大会采用以下议程：- 书记处报告。军事危险与反帝斗争。殖民地的自由运动以及工会和基督教组织在其中的作用。工人运动的国际团结，太平洋国家的移民和出境问题。
活动纲领：- 偶数小时工作日（原文不清，可能意指标准工时），最高工资，妇女和儿童劳动，失业问题，社会立法，对中国、日本、印度、印度尼西亚、朝鲜、菲律宾等地的直接保护等。
书记处请所有派遣代表参加大会的组织提出对议程的建议以及对所有事项的意见，以便更容易地通知所有与之相关的其他组织。

pages.en:
Translation from the "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) Nov.7, 1928.

Anniversary of Russian Revolution.

In connection with the eleventh anniversary of Soviet
revolution many greetings on the occasion were received
by the Russian proletariat from other countries. One of
these was a telegram from Swedish seamen of the s.s. "Senares"
and the other from the Union of Red German soldiers.

A word about "coolies" and "boys", etc.

There is a vast difference between then and now in the
treatment of yellow servants. Those who lived in the Russian
Far East before will understand what is meant.
For example to-day we see in Shanghai on Nanking Road
now a hired native policeman hits on the head a Chinese
coolie who happens to get mixed up in the traffic. Instructions
from the Police Station by telephone are to remove the body
and that's all. There are very few horses in Shanghai, but
these are replaced by human "ponies" - the rickshaws. One can
experience a feeling of "imperialism" when riding in those.
A Yellow, dirty and sweating, pulls the carriage in which
a white is sitting in comfort and woe if the former makes
a wrong turn or something like that, at once the well dressed
foot of the latter hits him in the back regardless of his
tiredness. This is very amusing to some people and often
wives of British merchants are heard to relate such instances
with a smile when travelling outside Asia.
In China, in Shanghai, his own country, a Chinese has
no right to walk on every street, but in his home - the U.S.S.R.
a Chinese or a Korean is a citizen equal to others.

We have thousands and hundreds of thousands Koreans
and Chinese organized in labour unions and participating in
public, economic, and state work of the country. Often
both Chinese and Koreans hold responsible posts in different
official administrations and concerns.

Translation from the Krasnoe Znamya of November 7, 1928.

A message from prisoners in Sukden.

Dear friends in the remote,
On the day of the 11th anniversary of October we send you
our warm comradely greetings and sincere thanks for the
steady and persistent maintenance and support of Soviet power
in the Far East. News penetrating only too scarce behind the
prison walls give us joy and help us to bear hardships patiently
in the assurance that the cause of the labourers is in
reliable hands and on the right track. Once again friendly
greetings and wishes of all success.
Prisoners of the Sukden Gaol.

Accidents in American Aviation.

In the first six months of 1928 there were 39 accidents
with 153 casualties and 276 people wounded. These apply mostly
to amateur aviation. In the regular service there were only 34
accidents with six deaths. However it is a high percentage
generally considering that in Soviet Russia during the same
period of time there were no accidents at all. The pilots are
in a great measure responsible for the accidents, then comes
the fault of the motors not being in good state of repairs and
lastly bad meteorological conditions.

译自1928年11月7日《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

俄国革命周年纪念。

值此苏维埃革命十一周年之际，俄国无产阶级收到了来自其他国家的许多贺电。其中一份是来自“塞纳雷斯”号（s.s. "Senares"）轮船上的瑞典海员，另一份来自德国红色士兵联盟。

来自苏克登（Sukden，原文不清，疑为沈阳 Mukden 之误）囚犯的信息。

偏远地区的亲爱的朋友们，
在十月革命十一周年纪念日，我们向你们致以热烈的同志般的问候，并衷心感谢你们对远东苏维埃政权的坚定和持续维护与支持。透过监狱高墙渗透进来的消息虽然寥寥无几，却给我们带来了喜悦，并帮助我们要耐心地忍受苦难，因为我们确信劳动者的事业掌握在可靠的人手中，并且走在正确的道路上。再次致以友好的问候和祝一切顺利。

美国航空事故。

1928年上半年，共发生39起事故（原文数字与前文不同，照实译出），造成153人死亡，276人受伤。这些事故主要涉及业余航空。在定期航班服务中，仅发生34起事故，造成6人死亡。然而，总体而言，这是一个很高的百分比，考虑到在同一时期，苏维埃俄罗斯根本没有发生任何事故。飞行员对事故负有很大责任，其次是发动机维修状况不佳，最后是恶劣的气象条件。
