"Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) of May 5 writes as follows:-
To Labourers, Peasants and Red Army
（印：... 9.199 ... 29.5.29 ...）

The Committee of Red Army Men of Germany send their fraternal greetings to you on behalf of the army men and labourers of Germany and particularly Berlin, assuring you of their fidelity to Proletarian Revolution and a promise to fight for U.S.S.R.

May Day of 1929 is of more significance than ever to the international proletariat. German proletariat has decided on that day to rise up against the bourgeoisie and social-democrats as well as to oppose imperialistic war threat against U.S.S.R. When the labourers of Germany are ready to demonstrate and demand improvements for the labour class, the Chief of Berlin Police, is preparing to have bloodshed on the streets of Berlin on May 1. He has declared that he will turn the streets of the Capital of Germany into a military camp and will fire upon the demonstrators if they dare parade the streets. Still the members of the Union of Red Army Men and Berlin proletarians will demonstrate on May 1. They will show thereby their readiness to fight their class enemies in the countries and in defence of U.S.S.R. The following mottoes will be pronounced in Germany by the proletarians on May 1:-
Against the imperialistic war!
Down with Fascism and Reformism!
For the Defence of U.S.S.R.!
For the victory of proletarian revolution!
Under the banners of Lenin the German Labour Class will march in honour of the victorious German October.
Willy Leow.

In Defence of U.S.S.R. and for the Downfall of Capitalism!

Comrades,
In a few days we shall celebrate Labour Day when millions of young and older labourers will demonstrate their desire to fight. 40 years have elapsed since the institution of the IInd International when the first appeal was made to the proletarians of the whole world to prove themselves ready for the overthrow of capitalistic form of governments by holding powerful demonstrations on May 1. This has been done year after year. The labour party members in large numbers could never have thought that the social-democrats will one day refuse to support the mottoes they at first promoted. Proletarian demands to-day meet with opposition from the treacherous social democrats. The world war has taught the international proletariat a good lesson. There is another imperialistic war against U.S.S.R. threatening May 1. When to-day we see the social democratic minister of Germany named Grzesinsky and the Police Chief of Berlin, another social-democrat named Zergibel imprison hundreds of best revolutionaries and forbidding the May 1 demonstrations, this is proof of their treachery.
The Union of Communist Youth must mobilize all young labourers to oppose the forthcoming and impending war against U.S.S.R. in the defence of proletarian dictatorship all over the world and the downfall of capitalistic form of government. With these wishes the Union send you comradely greetings.
The Central Union of Communistic Youth of Germany.
Berlin April 19, 1929.
pages.zh:
5月5日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）写道：-
致工人、农民和红军
（印：... 9.199 ... 29.5.29 ...）

德国红军战士委员会代表德国特别是柏林的军人和劳动者，向你们致以兄弟般的问候，并向你们保证他们对无产阶级革命的忠诚以及为苏联而战的承诺。

1929年的五一节对国际无产阶级具有比以往更重大的意义。德国无产阶级决定在这一天起来反对资产阶级和社会民主党人，并反对针对苏联的帝国主义战争威胁。当德国劳动者准备示威并要求改善工人阶级待遇时，柏林警察局长却准备在5月1日让柏林街头血流成河。他宣称要将德国首都的街道变成军营，如果示威者敢上街游行，他就向他们开火。尽管如此，红军战士联盟成员和柏林无产者仍将在5月1日举行示威。他们将以此表明他们准备在国内打击阶级敌人并保卫苏联。5月1日，德国无产者将喊出以下口号：-
反对帝国主义战争！
打倒法西斯主义和改良主义！
保卫苏联！
争取无产阶级革命的胜利！
在列宁的旗帜下，德国工人阶级将为纪念胜利的德国十月革命而进军。
威利·莱奥（Willy Leow）。

保卫苏联，推翻资本主义！

同志们，
几天后我们将庆祝劳动节，届时数百万年轻和年长的劳动者将展示他们的战斗意愿。自第二国际成立并首次呼吁全世界无产者在5月1日举行大规模示威以证明他们准备好推翻资本主义政府形式以来，已经过去了40年。这一行动年复一年地得以实施。工党成员大量加入时，从未想到社会民主党人有朝一日会拒绝支持他们最初提倡的口号。今天，无产阶级的要求遭到了背信弃义的社会民主党人的反对。世界大战给国际无产阶级上了深刻的一课。另一次针对苏联的帝国主义战争正威胁着五一节。当我们今天看到德国的社会民主党部长格热辛斯基（Grzesinsky）和柏林警察局长、另一位名为泽吉贝尔（Zergibel）的社会民主党人监禁数百名最优秀的革命者并禁止五一示威时，这就是他们背叛行为的证明。
共产主义青年团联盟必须动员所有年轻劳动者，反对即将爆发和迫在眉睫的对苏战争，以保卫全世界的无产阶级专政并推翻资本主义政府形式。怀着这些愿望，联盟向你们致以同志般的问候。
德国共产主义青年团中央联盟。
1929年4月19日，柏林。

"Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) of April 23, 1929.

The International Club at Vladivostock.

A Swedish sailor from the s.s. "Dehli" writes:
"Comrades, I have been for the first time in Russia and will attempt to relate our impressions. Regretfully our stay here was very short, but nevertheless we have good impression of Soviet country. In most countries a clergyman calls on board and takes us away with him, whereas here we were invited to a club. Every evening after the work was over we were asked to the Club and then to theatre or cinema or else we stayed there and held interesting discussions. We were very pleased every time with our restful hours."
The International Club in Vladivostock is the only one of its kind along the Pacific Coast and seamen visiting Vladivostock know of it. In spite of the Club not being too comfortably arranged, the number of foreign visitors to it is increasing. Various excursions are arranged for these visitors.
It has been, however, difficult to make the Club popular amongst members of labour unions. International education is rather neglected. The 3rd Conference of labour unions emphasized the necessity of enlisting greater attention to this branch of activity. Attempts are now being made to bring foreign seamen together with professional workers.
Vladivostock is about to have the 2nd Pan Pacific Congress of Labour Unions. The labour population must be well informed of the programme of the Conference. This will be a big step towards international education. The International Club and foreign seamen must take part in the Conference.

Trade.

The Soviet Syndicate of Matches has despatched to China via the Port of Vladivostock 720 thousand boxes of matches.

（印：POLITICAL BRANCH / FOREIGN OFFICE / 29.5.29）

Copy to :
H. B. M. Consul,
Col. Halland,
Capt. Shelley &
Lieut. Carlson
29.5. B.Y.M.

WS

1929年4月23日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）。

符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock）的国际俱乐部。

“德里”号（s.s. "Dehli"）轮船的一名瑞典水手写道：
“同志们，这是我第一次来到俄国，我将尝试讲述我们的印象。遗憾的是，我们在这里停留的时间非常短，但尽管如此，我们对苏维埃国家留下了良好的印象。在大多数国家，牧师会上船并将我们带走，而在这里，我们被邀请去俱乐部。每天工作结束后，我们都被邀请到俱乐部，然后去剧院或电影院，或者我们就留在那里进行有趣的讨论。每次我们对休息时光都感到非常满意。”
符拉迪沃斯托克的国际俱乐部是太平洋沿岸唯一此类俱乐部，访问符拉迪沃斯托克的海员都知道它。尽管俱乐部的设施安排得不太舒适，但前往该俱乐部的外国访客人数正在增加。为这些访客安排了各种游览活动。
然而，要使俱乐部在工会成员中流行起来却很困难。国际教育相当被忽视。工会第三次会议强调有必要更加关注这一活动领域。目前正试图将外国海员与专业工人聚集在一起。
符拉迪沃斯托克即将举行第二届泛太平洋工会大会。必须让劳动人口充分了解大会的议程。这将是迈向国际教育的一大步。国际俱乐部和外国海员必须参加大会。

贸易。

苏联火柴辛迪加已通过符拉迪沃斯托克港向中国发送了72万盒火柴。

（印：政治处 / 外务科 / 29.5.29）

抄送：
英国驻华领事，
霍兰上校（Col. Halland），
谢利船长（Capt. Shelley）及
卡尔森中尉（Lieut. Carlson）
29.5. B.Y.M.

WS

The "Krasnoe Znamya" (Red Banner) of May 30th
Problems of the Pan Pacific Congress of
Labour Unions. (Interview with Comr. Lozovsky).

During the two years dating from the inauguration of
the organization of the Pan Pacific Secretariat of Labour
Unions, great events have taken place on the Pacific Coast.
The defeat of the Chinese labour movement has dealt a
considerable blow to the Pan Pacific Secretariat, reaction
having rendered the Secretariat unlawful at the time and
prevented it from fully carrying out problems set for it
by the Conference at Hankow.
Nevertheless the Pan Pacific Secretariat had greatly
assisted the Chinese labour movement, opposing foreign
influences and uniting the conscious elements of Chinese
labour movement.
In Japan, in spite of the reign of terror, the revolution-
ary wing of the Japanese labour movement never ceased to
have connection with the Secretariat. The latter on the
other hand rendered every assistance in its power to the
"left" wing of the labour movement, in the latter's hard
struggle against reformers and capitalists.
During the two years of its existence the Pan Pacific
Secretariat included in the international labour movement
the proletariat of the Philippine Islands and the vanguard
elements of the labour movement in Australia, having also
established connections with the labour movement of Formosa,
Singapore, Pan Pacific countries and Latin America.
Up to the present owing to the severe police vigilance
and terrorism labour unions of Indonesia are not too well
connected with the Pan Pacific Secretariat, although they
were in the first ranks of initiators for the unification
of labourers on the Pacific Coast. Furthermore connection
is also weak with the labour unions of India, but this will
be improved and then the united front of the labourers
of Pacific Coast will be secured.
The Pan Pacific Secretariat has had to work all this
time under very hard conditions. In order to sum up
the activities of two years the Conference of the Pacific
Labour Unions is being convened at Vladivostock. An attempt
to convene this Conference in Australia failed. The
Australian Government strongly objected to the Conference
being held in its territory.
The programme of the Pan Pacific Conference includes
the problem of opposition to war and imperialism, the
question of national freedom movement, emigration questions,
problems affecting women's and children's labour,
organizational and constitutional questions of education
and enlightenment and programme of activities. Taking into
consideration the racial, national and cultural variety
which the Pacific Coast represents, it is not surprising
that the programme of the Conference is extensive.
The Conference will have to solve three main problems:
opposition to war, opposition to racial distinction and
the instigation of one race against another and opposition
to prohibition of extremist labour unions, which should be
legalized. Already at the Conference in Hankow in 1927
a programme of activities had been drawn up with the
following slogan as a guide:- "equal pay for equal labour
irrespective of the colour of skin and of the sex".
The Conference will have to deal with the above question.
The difference between conditions of life of the labourers
on the Pacific Coast is too great. Australian labourers
get paid for labour 15 to 20 times as much as the Chinese
labourers. In view of the extent of industry in the
East in its development, such a state of things threatens
the level of the labourers of capitalistic countries.

5月30日的《红旗报》（Krasnoe Znamya）
泛太平洋工会大会的问题。（采访洛佐夫斯基同志）。

在泛太平洋工会秘书处组织成立以来的两年间，太平洋沿岸发生了重大事件。中国工人运动的失败对泛太平洋秘书处造成了相当大的打击，反动势力当时使秘书处成为非法组织，并阻碍其充分执行汉口会议为其设定的任务。
尽管如此，泛太平洋秘书处极大地援助了中国工人运动，反对外国影响并团结中国工人运动中的觉悟分子。
在日本，尽管处于恐怖统治之下，日本工人运动的革命派从未停止与秘书处的联系。另一方面，后者在其权力范围内向工人运动的“左”翼提供了一切援助，支持其在反对改良主义者和资本家的艰苦斗争中。
在存在的两年期间，泛太平洋秘书处将菲律宾群岛的无产阶级和澳大利亚工人运动的先锋分子纳入国际工人运动，并与台湾、新加坡、泛太平洋国家和拉丁美洲的工人运动建立了联系。
截至目前，由于严厉的警察监视和恐怖主义，印度尼西亚的工会与泛太平洋秘书处的联系并不紧密，尽管它们曾是发起太平洋沿岸劳动者统一的第一批先驱。此外，与印度工会的联系也很薄弱，但这将会得到改善，随后太平洋沿岸劳动者的统一战线将获得保障。
泛太平洋秘书处一直不得不在非常艰难的条件下工作。为了总结两年的活动，太平洋工会会议正在符拉迪沃斯托克召开。此前试图在澳大利亚召开此次会议未能成功。澳大利亚政府强烈反对在其领土上举行会议。
泛太平洋会议的议程包括反对战争和帝国主义的问题、民族自由运动问题、移民问题、涉及妇女和儿童劳工的问题、教育和启蒙的组织及章程问题以及活动计划。考虑到太平洋沿岸所代表的种族、民族和文化多样性，会议议程广泛并不令人惊讶。
会议必须解决三个主要问题：反对战争、反对种族歧视以及反对煽动一个种族对抗另一个种族，并反对禁止极端主义工会，这些工会应当合法化。早在1927年的汉口会议上，就已制定了一项活动计划，并以以下口号为指导：“同工同酬，不分肤色和性别”。
会议将处理上述问题。太平洋沿岸劳动者的生活条件差异太大。澳大利亚劳动者的工资是中国劳动者的15到20倍。鉴于东方工业发展的程度，这种状况威胁到资本主义国家劳动者的生活水平。

（批：上海公共租界工部局警务处

The "Izvestia" of May 28th writes as follows:-

Scandalous process in Shanghai.
The organizer of an attack on the
Soviet Consulate is a black-mailer.

Shanghai, May 26 (Tass). The secret informer
of the British Intelligence Service and the principal
organizer of the attack on Soviet Consulate in 1927,
named Pick, who had published in the British reactionary
publication "The North China Daily News" a series of
provocative articles against U.S.S.R., has been arrested
by the Police of the International Settlement on a charge
of defrauding Chinese. At the preliminary examination
in Court Pick stated that the authorities who assisted
him in the fraud, had offered him a large sum of money
to keep quiet about the matter.
The arrest of Pick caused a tremendous sensation in
the Settlement. His case will be tried in a few days.
--------
We cannot overlook the concluding episode of Shanghai
adventures of Mr. Pick, because this offender in small
affairs, thanks to the British Intelligence Service, but
recently was entitled to mention in the world's history.
Captain Eugene Pick began to be known in Shanghai in
1927 when in the local British Press began to appear
his anti-sensational "revelations" of various Bolshevik
plots in China. These appearances of Pick in the Press,
who posed as one in principle opposed to Bolshevism and
Semitism, later on served as "documents" in which the
entire imperialistic and particularly British Press of
the Far East and partly in Europe found support in their
wild anti-Soviet campaign. If we are not mistaken his
statements were repeated on several occasions in the
British Parliament itself. Having thus rendered a good
service to the British donkeys (?) Pick was accepted
in the field of British Intelligence Service in Shanghai.

5月28日的《消息报》（Izvestia）写道：-

上海的丑闻案件。
袭击苏联领事馆的组织者是一名敲诈勒索者。

上海，5月26日（塔斯社）。英国情报局的秘密线人、1927年袭击苏联领事馆的主要组织者，名为皮克（Pick），曾在英国反动刊物《字林西报》（The North China Daily News）上发表了一系列针对苏联的挑衅性文章，现因诈骗中国人被公共租界警方逮捕。在法庭初步审讯中，皮克称，协助他进行诈骗的当局曾向他提供一大笔钱，让他对此事保持沉默。
皮克的被捕在租界引起了巨大轰动。他的案件将在几天后审理。
--------
我们不能忽视皮克先生在上海冒险经历的结尾插曲，因为这名在小事中犯罪的 offender，得益于英国情报局，最近竟有资格在世界历史上被提及。
尤金·皮克（Eugene Pick）上尉于1927年开始在上海为人所知，当时当地英国报刊开始刊登他关于中国各种布尔什维克阴谋的反耸人听闻的“揭露”。皮克在报刊上的这些露面，使他摆出一副原则上反对布尔什维克主义和闪米特主义（Semitism）的姿态，后来成为了“文件”，整个帝国主义、特别是远东和部分欧洲的英国报刊在其疯狂的anti-Soviet运动中从中找到了支持。如果我们没有记错的话，他的陈述甚至在英国议会本身也被重复了几次。通过这样为英国 donkeys (?) 提供了良好的服务，皮克被接纳进入英国驻上海情报局领域。

The "Izvestia" of May 25, 1929 writes as follows:-
August First - International Opposition Day
to Imperialistic War.

Berlin, May 23 (Tass) The Western European Bureau
of the Komintern published information about the Conference
held by Communistic Parties in Brussels with a view to
discussing preparations for an international anti-military
day. On May 16 the Conference was held in Brussels in
which 13 most prominent Communistic parties took part
all of which belong to the capitalistic countries of Europe,
there were also representatives of unlawful Parties and
those of Kim and Profintern. At the opening of the
Conference a representative of the Central Communistic Party
of Germany gave information on the May Day disturbances in
Berlin.
The principal matter discussed was however the
plan of preparations for the international anti-military
day, which was previously decided upon by the VIth
Congress of the Komintern. A conference held in March in
Berlin suggested that the anti military day be assigned
for August I, 1929, it being attended by representatives
of 14 European communistic Parties.
It is necessary for the purpose of carrying out the
plans of the anti-military day successfully that unconditional
consent be obtained from the various members of the
Communistic Parties to refrain from all influence of the
"right" and conciliating tendencies and to combat passiveness.
New practical suggestions for the promotion of the
campaign were made to the Communistic Parties in brief
form. It was considered necessary to unite and maintain
in unity the wide masses of labourers employed in different
concerns and members of various proletariat organizations
both during the preparations for and the actual process
of the anti-military day. The Anti-military day is to
be marked chiefly by cessation to work and mass demonstrations
on that day.
For the consecutive development and increase of the
campaign in favour of the anti-military day, all questions
pertaining to it must be systematically made clear and
particularly by showing the people what plans are being
made against U.S.S.R. in the form of a war. This matter
should be stressed upon in the Communistic Press and also
dealt with during the Government sessions as a thing to
be strongly objected to. Publications should be distributed
in working concerns containing matter against war and
advocating revolutionary opposition to it. Literature
should also be widely distributed against imperialistic
policy and armaments.
Upon the conclusion of discussion on the above matters,
the Conference heard some information on the subject of
the situation in India and the revolutionary spirit of
a labour uprising in India; it was also decided to send
comradely greetings to the textile workers on strike in
Bombay.
In conclusion the Conference passed a resolution that
an appeal be made to all labourers and members of the mass
revolutionary organizations to participate in the preparations
of and the carrying out of August I programme.

1929年5月25日的《消息报》（Izvestia）写道：——
八月一日——国际反对帝国主义战争日。

柏林，5月23日（塔斯社）共产国际西欧局发布了关于在布鲁塞尔举行的共产党会议的信息，旨在讨论筹备国际反战日事宜。5月16日，会议在布鲁塞尔举行，13个最著名的共产党派代表参加，这些党派均属于欧洲资本主义国家，此外还有非法政党的代表以及青年共产国际和红色工会国际的代表。在德国共产党中央委员会代表开幕发言时，通报了柏林五一节骚乱的情况。
然而，讨论的主要事项是筹备国际反战日的计划，该计划此前已由共产国际第六次代表大会决定。3月在柏林举行的一次会议建议将反战日定在1929年8月1日，当时有14个欧洲共产党的代表出席。
为了成功执行反战日的计划，必须获得各共产党成员的无条件同意，以抵制所有“右”倾和调和倾向的影响，并克服消极被动。会议以简要形式向各共产党提出了促进运动的新实际建议。认为有必要在反战日的筹备期间及实际进行过程中，团结并保持受雇于不同企业的广大劳工群众及各无产阶级组织成员的统一。反战日的主要标志是在当天停工和举行大规模示威游行。
为了连续发展和加强支持反战日的运动，必须系统地澄清与此有关的所有问题，特别是向民众展示针对苏联的战争计划。此事应在共产主义报刊上加以强调，并在政府会议期间作为强烈反对的事项进行处理。应向工作场所分发包含反战内容和倡导革命性反对战争的出版物。还应广泛分发反对帝国主义政策和军备的文献。
在上述事项讨论结束后，会议听取了一些关于印度局势和印度劳工起义的革命精神的信息；还决定向孟买罢工的纺织工人致以同志般的问候。
最后，会议通过了一项决议，呼吁所有劳工和群众革命组织的成员参与八月一日计划的筹备和执行工作。

（印：政治处（外事科） 日期 29.6.28）

"Izviestia"
Moscow, August 22, 1926.

6th CONGRESS OF THE COMMUNIST INTERNATIONAL.
29 Session.

Revolutionary movement in the colonies.

At the morning sitting of August 21 which was presided over
by Comrade Remmele (Germany) closing speeches were delivered by Co.
Sicander(India), Strakhoff(China), and Pepper and Kuusinen.
At the evening sitting Congress approved of the thesis with regard
to the colonial question and appointed a committee to final draft it.
Comrade Sicander asserted that British imperialism in India strives
chiefly to secure the monopoly of the situation and use India as a
source for obtaining industrial raw material and agricultural products
on the one hand, and as a market for British industrial products -
on the other. Comrade Sicander stated that these themes, coupled with
military ones, render the construction of railway net-work in India
inevitable. The investment of capital by Britain in India is for
this purpose and not for the developing of heavy industry and the
industrialisation of India into an independent economic unit.
Comrade Sicander then touched on the question of India's national
bourgeoisie. We, he said, are not being xxif deceived with regard to
the Indian bourgeoisie. It is, without doubt, counter-revolutionary,
betrays the revolution and compromises by agreements with imperialism.
Those, who believe that the Indian bourgeoisies have not yet betrayed
the Indian revolution in the same manner as the Kuomintang did with
the Chinese one, are mistaken. During the period of political crisis, or
war, the higher classes of the Indian bourgeoisie will march hand in
hand with British imperialism. The lower xxxxxx bourgeois classes will
struggle for the political power and will endeavour to use labourers
and peasants in this struggle as gunfodder. We should unmask the petty
bourgeoisie which possess influence among the masses.
Comrade Strakhoff in the name of the Chinese delegation made the
following declaration. The assertion made by Pepper previously that
Sun-Senism reigned in the Chinese party, but that now Trotzkiism succeeds
is incorrect. During the Canton insurrection Comrade Pepper advanced
the slogan: "Village self-administration". Just at that time the pea-
sants were engaged in the insurrection. Thus comrade Pepper went
one step farther than did Trotzky who asserted that the Chinese re-
volution was on the decline. Comrade Pepper in the Programme Committee
defended the point of view that in China one does not speak now of
feudalism but of "Asiatic methods of production", which abstractly denies
the slogan of "nationalisation of the land". It is easily understood
therefore why comrade Pepper opposed the anti-imperialistic movement
to agrarian revolution, although in reality xxx to overthrow imperialism
is impossible without an agrarian revolution.
The industrialisation of colonies is impossible because the
imperialists support the most backward system of land ownership. The
nationalist bourgeoisie are strongly interwoven with semi-feudalism,
the gentry and land-owners. Certainly the bourgeoisie are opposed to
militarism so long as it does not undermine the foundation upon which
the exploitation of the toiling people rests. However, when this question

《消息报》
莫斯科，1926年8月22日。

共产国际第六次代表大会。
第29次会议。

殖民地的革命运动。

在8月21日上午的会议上，由雷梅勒同志（德国）主持，西坎德尔同志（印度）、斯特拉霍夫（Strakhoff，中国）以及佩珀（Pepper）和库西宁（Kuusinen）作了总结发言。
在晚上的会议上，大会批准了关于殖民地问题的提纲，并任命了一个委员会来完成最终草案。
西坎德尔同志断言，英国在印度的帝国主义主要致力于确保其垄断地位，一方面将印度作为获取工业原材料和农产品的来源，另一方面作为英国工业产品的市场。西坎德尔同志指出，这些主题加上军事主题，使得在印度建设铁路网成为必然。英国在印度的资本投资正是出于此目的，而非为了发展重工业或将印度工业化成为一个独立的经济单位。
随后，西坎德尔同志谈到了印度民族资产阶级的问题。他说，我们在印度资产阶级问题上并没有被xxif（原文不清）欺骗。毫无疑问，它是反革命的，背叛革命并通过与帝国主义达成协议来进行妥协。那些认为印度资产阶级尚未像国民党背叛中国革命那样背叛印度革命的人，是错误的。在政治危机或战争时期，印度资产阶级的上层阶级将与英国帝国主义携手并进。下层xxxxxx资产阶级阶级将为争夺政治权力而斗争，并企图在这场斗争中将劳工和农民当作炮灰。我们应该揭露在群众中具有影响力的小资产阶级。
斯特拉霍夫同志代表中国代表团发表如下声明。佩珀此前声称孙文主义曾在中国党内占统治地位，但现在托洛茨基主义取而代之，这种说法是不正确的。在广州起义期间，佩珀同志提出了“乡村自治”的口号。就在那时，农民正投身于起义。因此，佩珀同志比托洛茨基走得更远，后者声称中国革命正在衰退。佩珀同志在纲领委员会中捍卫了这样一种观点，即在中国现在谈论的不是封建主义，而是“亚细亚生产方式”，这在抽象层面上否定了“土地国有化”的口号。因此，很容易理解为什么佩珀同志将反帝国主义运动与土地革命对立起来，尽管实际上xxx（原文不清）没有土地革命就不可能推翻帝国主义。
殖民地的工业化是不可能的，因为帝国主义者支持最落后的土地所有制体系。民族资产阶级与半封建势力、士绅和地主紧密交织在一起。当然，只要军国主义不破坏剥削劳动人民的基础，资产阶级就反对军国主义。然而，当这个问题

is put to the test there will be either the dictatorship of bourgeois and
land-owners, or the dictatorship of the proletariat and peasants. We must
support the national liberation movement. But, at the samexxxxxxx time, we
must strongly oppose national-fascism and national-reformism. We should
win over the petty bourgeoisie to our side always taking care that our
party should not fall under the influence of the petty bourgeoisie.
Comrade Pepper stated that the problem polemics on the subject of the
the Canton insurrection had not been started by him, but by comrade Lomi-
nadze. The resolution, adopted by the IX Plenum of the Executive Committee
of the Communist International, paid due tribute, on the one hand, to the
heroic insurrection of the Canton proletariat, and on the other - criti-
cised the blunders committed by those persons who prepared and directed
the riot. It was impossible to identify, as Comrades Strakhoff and Lominad-
dze had done, the heroic struggle of the Chinese proletariat with the
mistakes committed by the leading circles of the Chinese Communist party.
We should expose all mistakes committed at the Canton riot in order to
enable us in future not only to organize insurrection, but also victorious
insurrections.
Comrade Kuusinen(Finland) who succeeded Pepper stated, after criti-
cising the opinions of some of the previous speakers: We have achieved
a very notable success at this congress. It is the first time we have fa-
ced into Indian and American problems. It is first time that we have
made endeavour to discuss the colonial question. Our main problem is to
build up parties and trade unions, to command the masses not to liberate
them from the influence of national-reformism; to struggle bitterly
against imperialism and the latter's assistants, the social-democrats.
Acting in cooperation with our allies in the colonies, with the exploited
masses of peasants and colonial slaves, the proletariat will victoriously
conquer in the struggle against imperialism.-

Moscow, August 22, 1925.

5th CONGRESS OF THE INTERNATIONAL of YOUNG COMMUNISTS.
1st Session.

On August 20 the opening of the 5th Universal International Congress
of the Communist Youth was inaugurated in Moscow. It was opened by an
address delivered by Comrade Hitaroff who said : "When opening Congress
we declare our loyalty to the Comintern and promise in future to be
its faithful soldiers. During those 4 years, which have elapsed since
our last Congress, the International of Young Communists has proved
itself to be a powerful fighting organisation. However our organization
has incorporated so far an insufficient number of labour youths. We have
to consider the question how to develop KIM into a greater mass orga-
nization. We are confident that this problem will be successfully solved.
We shall not indulge in the present session in haranguing about peace as
is being done by the pacifists of all countries. When the time comes how-
ever KIM will show how it can struggle against war".
Comrade Bukharin who was greeted with applause said : "I welcome the
vanguard of the toiling self-sacrifying youths, who are struggling
throughout the world for world revolution. Your congress is being held
at a moment when special unity in the struggle is required from you. A new
generation, which does not know and does not remember the great imperia-
list war now is growing up. The signs of a new war are visible. This danger
is a very real one. To struggle against it KIM should mobilize, in addition
to its own forces, hundreds of thousands or millions of the youthful
toiling masses. Young toilers are everywhere fighting at the front lines.
They must be prepared to divert the imperialist war into a civil one for
the purpose of establishing the dictatorship of the proletariat. The
6th Congress of the Communist International is working in this direction
and the 5th Congress of the International of Young Communists must do the
same. The principal task of the Young Internationals is to struggle, not
by the press alone, but also by sheer strength to overcome the war menace.
KIM will adopt its own programme at its Congress. This programme will serve
as the banner under which the young revolutionaries will combat and score
victories. The main problem of your Congress must be - to discuss the
question of new methods to win over the toiling masses. Representatives
of three generations are present at this sitting i.e. fighters of the
Paris Commune, participants in the October revolution, and representatives
of the new generation whose duty is to build up world communism. The
youthful workers should learn from their elder brethern how to work. It
will be their lot to blow up the capitalist world and establish the
foundation of a strong proletarian dictatorship throughout the world.
On the conclusion of Comrade Bukharin's speech Comrade Hitaroff, the
President, read the text of the military oath approved by Congress. All
delegates and public present arose and repeated after Hitaroff the
words of the oath: " Being loyal to the will of our great leaders, Lenin
and Liebknecht, we swear to mobilize the youthful toilers of the whole
world irreconcilably to struggle against the imperialists of all countries
who are preparing war against U.S.S.R. -the stronghold of the world's
labour class. We swear to be in the first ranks in the struggle for com-
munism and remember the glorious traditions of the young men's Communist
International, so that we will constantly and persistently work that,
when the war breaks out, the soldiers of all countries will be prepared
to take arms for the defense of the Soviet Union, for the defense of the
oppressed peoples, for the overthrow of the bourgeoisie, for the victory

《消息报》。
莫斯科，1925年8月22日。

青年共产国际第五次代表大会。
第一次会议。

8月20日，青年共产主义者第五次世界代表大会在莫斯科开幕。希塔罗夫（Hitaroff）同志致开幕词，他说：“在大会开幕之际，我们宣告对共产国际的忠诚，并承诺在未来成为其忠实的战士。自上次大会以来的四年间，青年共产国际已证明自身是一个强大的战斗组织。然而，迄今为止，我们的组织吸纳的劳动青年数量仍显不足。我们必须考虑如何将青年共产国际（KIM）发展为更庞大的群众组织。我们相信这一问题将得到成功解决。在本次会议上，我们不会像各国和平主义者那样沉溺于空谈和平。然而，当时机到来时，青年共产国际将展示其如何与战争作斗争”。

布哈林（Bukharin）同志在掌声中说道：“我向全世界为世界革命而斗争的、勤劳且勇于自我牺牲的青年先锋队致以欢迎。你们的代表大会召开之际，正是要求你们在斗争中实现特别团结的时刻。新一代正在成长，他们不了解也不记得伟大的帝国主义战争。新战争的迹象已可见。这种危险是非常真实的。为了与之斗争，青年共产国际除了动员自身力量外，还应动员数十万乃至数百万的年轻劳动群众。年轻劳动者 everywhere 都在前线战斗。他们必须做好准备，将帝国主义战争转化为内战，以建立无产阶级专政为目的。共产国际第六次代表大会正朝此方向努力，青年共产国际第五次代表大会也必须如此。青年国际的主要任务不仅是通过报刊，还要凭借纯粹的力量去克服战争威胁。青年共产国际将在其代表大会上通过自己的纲领。该纲领将成为年轻革命者进行战斗并取得胜利的旗帜。你们代表大会的主要问题必须是——讨论争取劳动群众的新方法问题。出席本次会议的代表来自三代人，即巴黎公社的战士、十月革命的参与者，以及负有建设世界共产主义使命的新一代代表。青年工人应向他们的兄长们学习如何工作。炸毁资本主义世界并在全球范围内建立稳固的无产阶级专政基础，将是他们的命运。”

布哈林同志讲话结束后，主席希塔罗夫同志宣读了经大会批准的军事誓词全文。所有在场代表及公众起立，跟随希塔罗夫复述誓词：“忠于我们伟大领袖列宁和李卜克内西的意志，我们发誓毫不妥协地动员全世界的年轻劳动者，与所有准备对苏联——世界工人阶级堡垒——发动战争的各国帝国主义者作斗争。我们发誓在争取共产主义的斗争中站在最前列，铭记青年共产国际的光荣传统，以便我们持续不断地努力，使各国士兵在战争爆发时准备好拿起武器，保卫苏维埃联盟，保卫被压迫人民，推翻资产阶级，争取

Moscow, September 28, 1928.

（印：... POLICE ... 2192 ... Sep 10 '28）

Activities of the Executive Committee of the Communist Interna-
tional.

The first plenary session of the Executive Committee recently
elected at the 6th Congress of the Communist International was held
on September 3. The following members of the presidium were elected.
Members: Barbe, Bell, Bukharin, Ritlow, Ylek, Kato, Katayama,
Kolaroff, Bela-Koon, Kuusinen, Lozovsky, Manuilsky, Molotoff, Mousseau,
Fruhiack, Piatnitzky, Remmele, Ross, Semard, Serra, Stalin, Telman,
Hitaroff(KIM), Tzetkina Klara, Chilboom, Chiu-Vito, Chmeral, Ember-Dreau,
Ercoli.
Candidates: Foster, Hansen, Gekker, Lensky, Milovitch, Politt,
Poorman, Rust(KIM), Chang Pi Ao.

On September 8 the first sitting of the newly elected Committee
took place. The committee elected the following members to the po-
sition of secretariat:
Members: Barbe, Bell, Bukharin, Kuusinen, Molotoff, Piahnitzky,
Remmele, Serra, Chiu-Vito, Chmeral, Ember-Dreau.
Candidates: Manuilsky, Lozovsky, Hitaroff.

The presidium discussed at this sitting the question of the
situation in the French and Austrian Communist Parties. In the
resolution regarding the policy of the French Communist Party the
Presidium stated, that the results of the election campaign in France
wholly justified the tactics and line of policy agreed upon by the
conference of the French Communist Party in January 1927 and endorsed
by the 9th Plenary of the Executive Committee of the Communist Inter-
national. The above resolution emphasized considerable importance re-
garding the struggle against the war menace, which must continue
to remain "the main spring of the activity of the F.C.P."
The struggle against the war menace and against repressions confronts
the party with the problem of combatting formal legalism.-

W. C. I.

共产国际执行委员会的活动。

最近在共产国际第六次代表大会上新选出的执行委员会第一次全体会议于9月3日举行。选举产生以下主席团成员。
成员：巴尔贝（Barbe）、贝尔（Bell）、布哈林（Bukharin）、里特洛（Ritlow）、伊莱克（Ylek）、加藤（Kato）、片山（Katayama）、科拉罗夫（Kolaroff）、贝拉·库恩（Bela-Koon）、库西宁（Kuusinen）、洛佐夫斯基（Lozovsky）、马努伊尔斯基（Manuilsky）、莫洛托夫（Molotoff）、穆索（Mousseau）、弗鲁希亚克（Fruhiack）、皮亚特尼茨基（Piatnitzky）、雷梅尔（Remmele）、罗斯（Ross）、塞马尔（Semard）、塞拉（Serra）、斯大林（Stalin）、特尔曼（Telman）、希塔罗夫（Hitaroff，青年共产国际）、蔡特金娜·克拉拉（Tzetkina Klara）、希尔布姆（Chilboom）、邱维托（Chiu-Vito）、奇梅拉尔（Chmeral）、安伯-德劳（Ember-Dreau）、埃尔科利（Ercoli）。
候补委员：福斯特（Foster）、汉森（Hansen）、盖克尔（Gekker）、伦斯基（Lensky）、米洛维奇（Milovitch）、波利特（Politt）、普尔曼（Poorman）、拉斯特（Rust，青年共产国际）、张毕奥（Chang Pi Ao）。

9月8日，新当选的委员会举行了第一次会议。委员会选举以下成员担任书记处职务：
成员：巴尔贝（Barbe）、贝尔（Bell）、布哈林（Bukharin）、库西宁（Kuusinen）、莫洛托夫（Molotoff）、皮亚尼茨基（Piahnitzky）、雷梅尔（Remmele）、塞拉（Serra）、邱维托（Chiu-Vito）、奇梅拉尔（Chmeral）、安伯-德劳（Ember-Dreau）。
候补委员：马努伊尔斯基（Manuilsky）、洛佐夫斯基（Lozovsky）、希塔罗夫（Hitaroff）。

主席团在这次会议上讨论了法国和奥地利共产党局势的问题。在关于法国共产党政策的决议中，主席团指出，法国竞选活动的结果完全证明了法国共产党1927年1月会议商定并经共产国际执行委员会第九次全体会议批准的战术和路线方针是正确的。上述决议强调了反对战争威胁斗争的重要性，该斗争必须继续作为“法共活动的主要动力”。
反对战争威胁和反对镇压的斗争，使党面临着反对形式合法主义的问题。-

Moscow, September 15, 1927.

There is no unexplored part of Pamir.
The following telegram has been received from the Pamir Expe-
dition:
Our problem has been solved. The Gorbunoff and Scherbakoff
parties walked along the Tanymas and Bartang passes, crossed over
to Yangulen and mounted the territory to its sources, made a land-
survey, botanical and geological exploration. The group of Krylenko,
Dorofeev and Razmirovitch, having discovered two new passes from
Tanymas into the valley of Bratang, descended along one by one and
crossed into Yangulen where they joined the Gorbunoff group. Both
parties mounted the Yangulen glacier and discovered a new pass into
which is 5.200 metres high, outcropping the Fedchenko glacier. It has
been discovered that the Fedchenko glacier is connected by snow fields
with Yangulen glacier which is 20 mile in length.

帕米尔高原已无未探索区域。
收到来自帕米尔探险队的如下电报：
我们的问题已解决。戈尔布诺夫（Gorbunoff）和谢尔巴科夫（Scherbakoff）两队沿塔内马斯（Tanymas）和巴尔坦格（Bartang）山口行进，穿越至杨古伦（Yangulen），并溯源地而上，进行了土地测量、植物学和地质学勘探。克雷连科（Krylenko）、多罗费耶夫（Dorofeev）和拉兹米罗维奇（Razmirovitch）小组发现了从塔内马斯进入布拉坦格（Bratang）山谷的两个新山口，依次沿其中一个下降，穿越至杨古伦，并与戈尔布诺夫小组会合。两队均登上了杨古伦冰川，并发现了一个海拔5,200米的新山口，该山口高出费德琴科（Fedchenko）冰川。现已发现，费德琴科冰川通过雪原与长达20英里的杨古伦冰川相连。

(39) Session.
The closing of Congress.

To-day's sitting of Congress opened at 9.o'clock and was pre-
sided over by Comrade Remmele. Comrade Bukharin made a report of the
commission's work on the Programme of the Communist International.
After a brief resume of the work performed by the programme commis-
sion Congress unanimously adopted the programme which was accompa-
nied by greetings and applause by all present at Congress. Members
of the Congress rose and sang the "International".

On the proposal submitted by Comrade Amber-Dro, Congress unani-
mously incorporated into its ranks the parties of Korea, Ireland,
New Zealand, Paraguay, Cuba, Columbia and Equador, which countries
were represented at Congress by sympathisers. Comrade Paredes (Equa-
dor) in the name of the newly incorporated parties delivered an
address in which he assured listeners that the new members of the
Comintern will undertake every effort to bolshevize their ranks and
bring about the unification of workers and peasants in their countri-
es under the Comintern banner for cooperation against Imperialism
and colonial oppression and for the defense of U.S.S.R., the
motherland of the world's proletariat.

After the election of members to the Executive Committee
and the International Control Commission, Comrade Remmele declared
that the works of the Universal Congress of the Communist Internatio-
nal were ended and consequently Congress was brought to a close.-

《消息报》
莫斯科，九月

共产国际第六次代表大会
(39) 次会议。
大会闭幕。

今日的大会会议于9点开幕，由雷梅尔（Remmele）同志主持。布哈林同志作了关于共产国际纲领委员会工作的报告。在简要总结纲领委员会所做的工作后，大会一致通过了该纲领，全场与会者报以问候和掌声。大会代表起立高唱《国际歌》。

根据安伯-德罗（Amber-Dro）同志提出的提议，大会一致将朝鲜、爱尔兰、新西兰、巴拉圭、古巴、哥伦比亚和厄瓜多尔的政党纳入其行列，这些国家由同情者代表出席大会。帕雷德斯（Paredes）同志（厄瓜多尔）代表新加入的政党发表讲话，他向听众保证，共产国际的新成员将竭尽全力使其队伍布尔什维克化，并在共产国际的旗帜下实现本国工人和农民的联合，以合作反对帝国主义和殖民压迫，并保卫苏联——世界无产阶级的祖国。

在执行委员会和国际监察委员会成员选举结束后，雷梅尔同志宣布，共产国际世界代表大会的工作已结束，因此大会闭幕。-

Moscow, September 1, 1927.

6th Congress of the Communist International.
38 Session.

Resolution on the necessity of rendering greater support to MOPR
(International Society of relief to revolutionaries).

The trend of class contradictions in capitalist countries and
the struggle of the peoples in the colonies and semi-colonies
against their oppressors and exploiters are responsible for the
intensification of White terrorism, Fascism, augmentation of repres-
sive measures of class "justice" and increased oppression of the
exploited classes and downtrodden peoples. In connection with this
the 6th Congress of the Communist International has decided:

1) The course of events during the last years has wholly justi-
fied the decisions adopted by the 4 and 5th Universal Congresses
of the Comintern with regard to MOPR, as an independent and not-party
relief organisation, has justified the absolute support rendered
to it by all communist parties.
2) As MOPR is a non-party organization and renders assistance
to all victims of revolutionary struggle on the one hand, and, on the
other - recruits its members without regard to party allegiance, it is
the most effective weapon for the realization of the tactics of a
united front.
The Communist parties are interested in the work of MOPR more
that any other party is, and therefore should always render assistance
to MOPR in its work either by participating in all its campaigns,
especially those launched for the amnesty and the right of escape, or
allotment to MOPR of space in the columns of their newspapers.
3) As one of the present outstanding problems of MOPR is the
struggle against Fascism, the Communist parties should render any
possible assistance to MOPR in this work. One of the most important
problems confronting the communist sections, especially the American
section, is the struggle against the Ku Klux Klan (the Fascist
organisation in the U.S.A.) and against the barbarous Lynch law with
the negroes. This struggle will be crowned with success only
when millions of white labourers will be mobilized to take their
part in it. An especially important problem, faced by all sections
of MOPR, is the struggle against White terrorism in China + the terro-
rism which is being openly practised by the Kuomintang.
4) Growth of the revolutionary movement in the colonial and
semi-colonial countries contributes in the highest degree to the
increased persecution of the toilers in these countries. The communist
parties in capitalist countries should render help to the sections
of MOPR, immediately they are created and organized so as to enable
them to deal with these great problems which fall to them in the
colonies and semi-colonies of the respective countries.
5) The above problems are closely connected with the struggle
by the toiling peoples for the right of escape, to which struggle
little attention has been so far paid by the communist parties, but
which in the future requires special attention from the parliamen-
tary communist fractions.
The communist parties of the parent states are facing therefore
special problem on the matter of carrying out the struggle against
extradition of revolutionaries from the territories of foreign
concessions in China.

《消息报》
莫斯科，1927年9月1日。

共产国际第六次代表大会。
第38次会议。

关于必须给予国际革命战士救济会（MOPR）更大支持的决议。

资本主义国家阶级矛盾的加剧，以及殖民地和半殖民地人民反抗压迫者和剥削者的斗争，导致了白色恐怖、法西斯主义的强化，阶级“司法”镇压措施的增多，以及对被剥削阶级和受压迫民族的压迫加剧。鉴于此，共产国际第六次代表大会决定：

1) 过去几年的事态发展完全证明了共产国际第四次和第五次世界代表大会关于将国际革命战士救济会（MOPR）作为一个独立的、非党派的救济组织所作出的决定是正确的，也证明了所有共产党给予其绝对支持是正确的。
2) 由于国际革命战士救济会是一个非党派组织，一方面向所有革命斗争的受害者提供援助，另一方面在招募成员时不考虑其党派归属，因此它是实现统一战线战术的最有效武器。
共产党比任何其他政党都更关心国际革命战士救济会的工作，因此应始终在其工作中给予协助，无论是通过参与其发起的所有运动，特别是为争取大赦和逃亡权而发起的运动，还是在其报纸版面上为国际革命战士救济会提供篇幅。
3) 由于国际革命战士救济会当前的突出问题之一是反对法西斯主义的斗争，共产党应在这一工作中给予国际革命战士救济会一切可能的援助。共产党各支部，尤其是美国支部，面临的最重要问题之一，是反对三K党（美国的法西斯组织）以及针对黑人的野蛮私刑法律的斗争。只有动员数百万白人劳工参与其中，这场斗争才能取得成功。国际革命战士救济会所有支部面临的一个特别重要的问题，是反对中国的白色恐怖以及国民党公开实施的恐怖主义。
4) 殖民地和半殖民地国家革命运动的发展，极大地助长了对这些国家劳动者的迫害加剧。资本主义国家的共产党应在国际革命战士救济会的各支部一经建立和组织起来时就给予帮助，使其能够处理落在它们身上的、涉及各自国家殖民地和半殖民地的重大问题。
5) 上述问题与劳动人民争取逃亡权的斗争密切相关，迄今为止共产党对这一斗争关注甚少，但未来需要议会中的共产党团给予特别关注。
因此，母国的共产党在从中国外国租界领土引渡革命分子的问题上，面临着开展斗争的特殊任务。

To the increasing activity of the capitalistic elements, to the attempts of sabotage made by the counter-revolution and to the demoralising influence of the bureaucratism, the working class guided by the all-Russia Communist Party of Bolsheviks will counteract the increasing activities of the capitalist elements, the sabotage attempts launched by counter-revolutionists and the demoralizing influence of bureaucracy by enforcing the regime of the dictatorship of the proletariat, by intensified development of proletarian democracy and by increasing the activity, independence and revolutionary open mindedness of the broad proletarian masses. 5) The undersigned delegations state in the name of their respective communist parties, that they approve of all the decisions adopted by the Central Committee of the All-Russia Communist party which are directed against the Menshevist opposition, and approve of the exclusion of this latter's members from the communist party. Simultaneously they approve of all the decisions adopted for this purpose by the Central Committee. The struggle between the Comintern and Russian Communist Party against the petty-bourgeois Trotzky group resulted in the latter's complete elimination in U.S.S.R. and in the Comintern.
6) The undersigned delegations especially emphasize the all increasing menace of Capitalist intervention against U.S.S.R. xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx. The greater the success of the socialists, the more intensive becomes the attack by the imperialists against the U.S.S.R. and the sooner the sooner the counter revolutionary war against U.S.S.R will come. This war, the inevitability of which was foreseen by Lenin, hangs like a menacing sword over the heads of the toiling peoples of all countries. In this gigantic class war the Comintern must and will survive its historic military trial. The Comintern will hoist the banner and turn the war of exploiters into xxxxxx a civil war of the all-oppressed for the victory of the proletarian dictatorship. In the present situation, the main problem confronting all communists in all countries is that of mobilizing all the international proletariat and all the oppressed peoples for the defense of U.S.S.R. which is the only socialist Motherland of the labour class and is the source, the basis and strongest support of world revolution.

the proletarian class struggle and the basis of the struggle of the
oppressed colonial peoples.
2) The most important results of the socialist constructive work
are: achievements made by the soviet socialist industrialisation;
development of State industry above pre-war level, incessant increase
in the ranks of the industrial proletariat, introduction of the 8 hours
working day, increase in wages and in the productivity of labour,
radical reconstruction of all the processes of industrialism. Simulta-
neously with the growth of socialist State industry the importance of
other economic branches of the proletarian State has increased i.e.
transport, State budget, Banks, Commercial organisations, all of which,
while rendering the monopoly of foreign trade secure, have systematical-
ly dislodged private capital and replaced it by State cooperative eco-
nomic organisations which have succeeded in gaining the predominant
position in the markets. The agricultural policy of the party has also
achieved marked success: namely, increasing the area of land under
cultivation, general increase in agricultural production, introduction
of technical improvements and strengthening of cooperation between
towns and villages.
3) These achievements do not and cannot mean that all difficulties,
dangers and contradictions, derived from abstract conditions of socia-
list constructive work, as from technical and economic back-
wardness of the country, or the attack by the internal hostile class
forces against the proletariat and from the counter-revolutionary
policy of all the imperialist countries which are opposed to U.S.S.R.,
have now been removed.
To these difficulties may be added - on the one hand - the problems of
import and export, capital stock, reduction of costs of production
and industrial prices, unemployment, scarcity of industrial goods in
the villages, and -on the other hand - the problem of grain hoarding.
4) The All-Russia Communist Party, in its policy,
proclaims as its right principle that in order to surmount these dif-
ficulties and advance further on the road of socialism and unmerciful

共产国际第六次代表大会。
第32次会议。

以下声明由泰尔曼同志在大会上宣读，代表德国、捷克斯洛伐克、波兰、匈牙利、瑞典、芬兰、挪威、丹麦、拉脱维亚、立陶宛、爱沙尼亚以及青年共产国际（KIM）的各国代表团，就瓦尔加和马努伊尔斯基报告中所涉及的苏联局势问题发表意见：
1) 下述各代表团所代表的共产党及各支部一致赞同全俄共产党及其列宁中央委员会所执行的政治和组织政策。这一正确的布尔什维克政策是在帝国主义包围的最艰难环境下执行的，它已在社会建设领域取得了巨大成就，使工农群众的物质和文化水平逐步提高，加强了工农阶级的合作，确保了无产阶级及其共产党的最高权威，巩固了无产阶级专政，并提高了苏联作为国际革命运动源泉、无产阶级阶级斗争堡垒以及被压迫殖民民族斗争基础的威望。
2) 社会主义建设工作的最重要成果包括：苏维埃社会主义工业化取得的成就；国家工业发展超过战前水平；工业无产阶级队伍不断壮大；实行八小时工作制；工资和劳动生产率提高；对所有工业化进程进行根本性重组。随着社会主义国家工业的增长，无产阶级国家的其他经济部门的重要性也随之增加，即交通、国家预算、银行、商业组织，所有这些部门在确保对外贸易垄断的同时，系统地排挤私人资本，并以国家合作经济组织取而代之，这些组织已成功在市场上占据主导地位。党的农业政策也取得了显著成功：即扩大耕地面积，农业生产普遍增长，引入技术改进，并加强城乡之间的合作。
3) 这些成就并不意味着，也不可能意味着，源于社会主义建设工作抽象条件的、源于该国技术和经济落后的、源于国内敌对阶级势力对无产阶级的攻击、以及源于所有反对苏联的帝国主义国家的反革命政策的所有困难、危险和矛盾现已消除。
除了这些困难外，一方面还有进出口、资本存量、降低生产成本和工业价格、失业、农村工业品短缺等问题，另一方面还有粮食囤积问题。
4) 全俄共产党在其政策中宣布其正确原则是，为了克服这些困难并在社会主义道路上进一步前进，毫不留情地

"Izviestia"
Moscow, August 30, 1928.

6th CONGRESS OF THE COMMUNIST INTERNATIONAL.
36th Session.

At the morning sitting of August 29 Comrade Piatnitsky submitted
the report by the Mandatory Commission.

515 delegates attended the 6th Congress ( an excess of 40 over
the 5th Congress), 372 of these delegates had the right to vote and
143 were advisory. Invitations to attend the Congress were sent to
66 sections comprising 4.024.159 members (who have paid their membership
fees for the first quarter of 1928 year); 1.798.859 of whom are in
Communist party and 2.225.300 are members of KIM.

Out of the 66 sections which were invited - 57 having the right to
vote and 9 advisory - 52 of the former sections and 6 of the latter are
represented. Of all the organisations having the right to vote are not
represented: Australia, Portugal, Korea, Egypt and Cuba. Of the organisa-
tions having advisory rights the following were not represented: Tanny-
Toova (?), Peru and Philippines.

The following countries, which were not represented at the 5th
Congress, sent their representatives to the present 6th Congress: Pa-
lestine, Columbia, Syria, Uruguay, Equador, Paraguay, Venezuela, New
Zealand and Chili.

30% of the Congressional delegates were former social democrats,
55% joined the party directly. The Congress unanimously approved the
report of the Mandatory Commission. Comrade Piatnitzky also submitted
a report regarding certain alterations to be introduced into the pre-
sent constitution of the Comintern. The Congress has approved all the
alterations proposed by the Commission.-

D. C. d.

共产国际第六次代表大会。
第36次会议。

在8月29日上午的会议上，皮亚特尼茨基同志提交了资格委员会的报告。

共有515名代表出席了第六次代表大会（比第五次代表大会多出40人），其中372名代表拥有表决权，143名为咨询代表。向66个支部发出了出席大会的邀请，这些支部共有4,024,159名成员（已缴纳1928年第一季度的党费）；其中1,798,859人为共产党员，2,225,300人为青年共产国际（KIM）成员。

在被邀请的66个支部中——57个拥有表决权，9个为咨询代表——前者中有52个、后者中有6个派代表出席。所有拥有表决权的组织中，未派代表出席的有：澳大利亚、葡萄牙、朝鲜、埃及和古巴。拥有咨询权的组织中，未派代表出席的有：Tanny-Toova (?)、秘鲁和菲律宾。

以下未参加第五次代表大会的国家派代表参加了本次第六次代表大会：巴勒斯坦、哥伦比亚、叙利亚、乌拉圭、厄瓜多尔、巴拉圭、委内瑞拉、新西兰和智利。

30%的大会代表是前社会民主党人，55%是直接加入党的。大会一致批准了资格委员会的报告。皮亚特尼茨基同志还提交了一份关于对现行共产国际章程进行某些修改的报告。大会批准了委员会提出的所有修改建议。-

Moscow, August 10, 1928.

6th CONGRESS OF THE COMMUNISTIC INTERNATIONAL.

At the morning sitting of Congress on August 9 which was
presided over by Comrade Telman, Comrade Bukharin read a report
on the program of the Communist International. The reading of the
report lasted four hours.

The debate on Bukharin's report commenced at the evening
sitting of the Congress. Speeches were delivered by Sicander(India),
Paredes(Ecuador), King(Poland), Reimann(Czecho-Slovakia). After
Comrade Reimann's address comrade Telman read the appeal on the
Polish-Lithuanian conflict addressed by Congress to the toiling
peoples throughout the world. The appeal was unanimously adopted.
Only the Programme Committee will work to-day and to morrow
morning. There will be no plenary session to-day.
A detailed account of the sitting of Congress on August 9
will be published in the next issue of this paper.

"I z v i e s t i a "
Moscow, August 16, 1928.

6th CONGRESS OF THE COMMUNISTIC INTERNATIONAL.
26th Session.

The morning and evening sittings of Congress on August 17, at which the debates on the reports of the revolutionary movement in the colonies were continued, was presided over by comrade Hitaroff. Speeches were delivered by comrades: Manavar(Indonesia), Fokin(KIM), Chu Hsu Lei (China), Ford(America), Lacerda (Brazil), Schuler (KIM), Paredes(Ecuador), Martynof(USSR), and Travin (USSR). There were also present at the evening sitting: An (Indo-China), Sultan-Zade(Persia), Aberdarane(Alger.), Vassilieff(IKKK), Gernanetto(Profintern), Cox (Britain), Lu Hai Cho(China), Martinez(Venezuela), Mustapha(Tunis).

Comrade Chu Hsu Mei (China) declared that after the Canton defeat the influence of the Communist Party has not decreased but, on the contrary, was becoming stronger. The new revolutionary wave has not yet come, but the communistic party should be prepared for it.
Comrade Ford(American delegate of the communistic fraction of the Profintern) declared that the colonial peoples and negroes will succeed in liberating themselves only by the leadership of the Comintern.
Comrade Vassilieff, who spoke at the evening sitting, advocated that the Comintern should devote the greatest attention in the immediate future to the communistic work in China, India, Egypt and the countries of Latin America. In colonial and semi-colonial countries China excluded, either the communistic parties are very small, or they do not exist at all. The main problem consists in strengthening the already existing parties and in creating new ones in those countries where they do not exist. The aid which could be rendered by the Comintern to the colonial and semi-colonial parties should consist of a theoretical work, which explains the aims of the party.
Comrade Vassilieff then described the characteristics of the communistic movement in each country. In India there is practically no communistic party, only separate communistic groups. However, instead of this there are many labour-peasant parties in India, among which the communists are working without creating communist fractions. These parties have the tendency to unite into one party. The main problem in India is to create a communistic party with communist fractions among all classes of workers and peasants organisations.
In Egypt we should struggle against the tendency of some of the communists to democratise WAFD (Party of the Egyptian nationalists), or even to create a left wing in the WAFD. The principal enemy of the liberation movement in Egypt is this WAFD party, the party which is obstructing the development of the revolutionary self-consciousness of the masses. The main problem in Egypt is to strengthen the communist party; organise the fractional work in the Trade unions and in other mass organisations and unmask the WAFD and liberate the labourers and peasants from its influence.
In Latin America there is strong tendency among the peasants and labourers towards communism which has not yet acquired a definite form, and sympathy towards USSR is increasing. For instance, the Conference of the Communist Party in Columbia expressed itself in

共产国际第六次代表大会。
第26次会议。

8月17日大会的上午和晚间会议由希塔罗夫（Hitaroff）同志主持，继续就关于殖民地革命运动的报告进行辩论。以下同志发了言：马纳瓦尔（Manavar，印度尼西亚）、福金（Fokin，青年共产国际）、朱旭雷（Chu Hsu Lei，中国）、福特（Ford，美国）、拉塞尔达（Lacerda，巴西）、舒勒（Schuler，青年共产国际）、帕雷德斯（Paredes，厄瓜多尔）、马尔蒂诺夫（Martynof，苏联）和特拉文（Travin，苏联）。出席晚间会议的还有：安（An，印度支那）、苏丹-扎德（Sultan-Zade，波斯）、阿伯达拉内（Aberdarane，阿尔及利亚）、瓦西里耶夫（Vassilieff，少共国际）、杰尔马内托（Gernanetto，赤色职工国际）、考克斯（Cox，英国）、陆海秋（Lu Hai Cho，中国）、马丁内斯（Martinez，委内瑞拉）、穆斯塔法（Mustapha，突尼斯）。

朱旭梅（Chu Hsu Mei，中国）同志宣称，广州起义失败后，共产党的影响力并未减弱，相反，正在增强。新的革命浪潮尚未到来，但共产党应为此做好准备。
福特同志（赤色职工国际共产主义党团美国代表）宣称，殖民地人民和黑人在共产国际的领导下才能成功实现解放。
在晚间会议上发言的瓦西里耶夫同志主张，共产国际在近期应最关注中国、印度、埃及和拉丁美洲国家的共产主义工作。在殖民地和半殖民地国家（中国除外），要么共产党非常弱小，要么根本不存在。主要问题在于加强已有的政党，并在那些不存在的国家建立新政党。共产国际可以向殖民地和半殖民地政党提供的援助应包括解释党的目标的理论工作。
随后，瓦西里耶夫同志描述了各国共产主义运动的特点。在印度，实际上没有共产党，只有单独的共产主义小组。然而，印度有许多工农党，共产党人在其中工作而不建立共产主义党团。这些政党有合并为一个政党的趋势。印度的主要问题是建立一个在所有工人和农民组织中都设有共产主义党团的共产党。
在埃及，我们应当同某些共产党人使华夫脱党（WAFD，埃及民族主义者政党）民主化，甚至在华夫脱党内建立左翼的倾向作斗争。埃及解放运动的主要敌人就是这个华夫脱党，该党阻碍了群众革命自觉意识的发展。埃及的主要问题是加强共产党；在工会和其他群众组织中开展党团工作，揭露华夫脱党，并将劳动者和农民从其影响下解放出来。
在拉丁美洲，农民和劳动者中存在强烈的共产主义倾向，尽管尚未形成确定的形式，且对苏联的同情日益增加。例如，哥伦比亚共产党会议表示支持

favour of the establishment of the dictatorship of the proletariat.
In Urugual one speaker, who bitterly denounced the Soviet Union, was
killed by the indignant listeners. Communism enjoys popularity
among the peasants and labourers. It is incomprehensible therefore
why some of the Latin American comrades should think it is neces-
sary to start simply an ordinary labour & peasant party or some-
thing like that. Our main problem in the Latin American countries
consists of strengthening the communist parties and creating them,
where they do not yet exist.
Comrade Germanetto pointed out that the communist parties
did not sufficiently and energetically defend the Chinese revolution
and that the sections of the Comintern should now devote more
attention to the Chinese revolution than was done previously.
Comrade Cox (Britain) declared that the thesis which repre-
sents India as being the Agrarian pocket of the British Empire is
not correct. A wrong explanation has also been given to the fact
that imperialism is the obstacle impeding industrial development
of the colonies. It would be more correct to say that the imperia-
list bourgeoisie are impeding the development of those branches
of industry, which are controlled by the Indian bourgeoisie.
Comrade Lu Mai Cho (China) pointed out that the thesis should
throw more light on the role played by the youths in the revolu-
tionary movement in the colonies and semi-colonies. The youth mo-
vement is of considerable importance for the revolutionary move-
ment in China.
The growing revolutionary activity of the labour class and
peasants in the Latin countries of America - Comrade Martinez de-
clared - stimulates the aggressiveness of U.S.A. imperialism in
Latin America. Last year the government of U.S.A. intervened in
a number of the Latin America countries. Simultaneously with the
penetration of U.S.A. imperialism into the countries of Latin
America, the methods of American reformism have been inculcated
into the labour movement. At the same time, the reformists of
U.S.A. - the leaders of the American Federation of Labour - are
striving to seize the labour movement in Latin America through
the medium of the Pan-American Labour Federation. Communist par-
ties in the countries of Latin America should incessantly unmask
this reformism. The communism is the only force which will conti-
nue to struggle against imperialism until labour-peasant soviet
republics have been established in the countries of Latin America.-

D. e. J.

在乌拉圭，一名猛烈抨击苏联的演讲者被愤怒的听众杀死。共产主义在农民和劳动者中享有声望。因此，令人费解的是，为什么一些拉丁美洲同志认为有必要仅仅建立一个普通的工农党或类似的东西。我们在拉丁美洲国家的主要问题是加强共产党，并在尚不存在的国家建立共产党。
杰尔马内托同志指出，各共产党未能充分且有力地保卫中国革命，共产国际各支部现在应比以往更多地关注中国革命。
考克斯同志（英国）宣称，将印度视为大英帝国农业附庸的论点是不正确的。对于帝国主义是阻碍殖民地工业发展的障碍这一事实，也给出了错误的解释。更准确的说法应该是，帝国主义资产阶级正在阻碍由印度资产阶级控制的那些工业部门的发展。
陆迈乔（Lu Mai Cho，中国）同志指出，纲领应更清楚地阐明青年在殖民地和半殖民地革命运动中所扮演的角色。青年运动对中国革命运动具有重要意义。
美洲拉丁语系国家工人阶级和农民日益增长的革命活动——马丁内斯同志宣称——刺激了美帝国主义在拉丁美洲的侵略性。去年，美国政府干预了多个拉丁美洲国家。随着美帝国主义渗透进拉丁美洲各国，美国改良主义的方法也被灌输到劳工运动中。同时，美国的改良主义者——美国劳工联合会领导人——正试图通过泛美劳工联合会掌控拉丁美洲的劳工运动。拉丁美洲各国的共产党应不断揭露这种改良主义。共产主义将是唯一持续反对帝国主义的力量，直到在拉丁美洲各国建立起工农苏维埃共和国。-

Moscow, August 21, 1923.

（印：91896 / 7.9.36）

6th CONGRESS OF THE COMMUNIST INTERNATIONAL.
(28)th Session.

The morning sitting on August 20.

Comrade Rebecca Bunting (South Africa) declared that she disagrees with the proposal of the Negro sub-commission, which proclaims the slogan to struggle for a native republic. In view of the existence of white proletarians and peasants in South Africa and the absence of native bourgeoisie, such a movement would present great danger. It would endanger class unity of oppressed whites and blacks, which is a far more effective force in a struggle for overthrowing capitalism than is native nationalism.

Comrade Rasa (India) said that it is quite admissible, for tactical purposes, to march together with the nationalist bourgeoisie. However, the danger is always present that the bourgeoisie will even use this temporary cooperation against the communist party. The main revolutionary force in the colonial countries is the proletariat and the impoverished peasants, similar to what exists in capitalistic countries.

D. C. I.

共产国际第六次代表大会。
第(28)次会议。

8月20日上午会议。

丽贝卡·邦廷（Rebecca Bunting，南非）同志宣称，她不同意黑人小组委员会提出的为建立土著共和国而斗争的口号。鉴于南非存在白人无产阶级和农民，且缺乏土著资产阶级，这样的运动将带来巨大危险。它将危及受压迫的白人和黑人的阶级团结，而在推翻资本主义的斗争中，这种团结比土著民族主义是更有效的力量。

拉萨（Rasa，印度）同志说，出于战术目的，与民族资产阶级并肩行动是完全允许的。然而，危险始终存在，即资产阶级甚至会利用这种暂时合作来对付共产党。殖民地国家的主要革命力量是无产阶级和贫困农民，这与资本主义国家的情况类似。

D. C. I.

"Izvestia"
Moscow, August 19, 1928.

6th CONGRESS OF THE COMMUNIST INTERNATIONAL.

26th Session.

At the morning and evening sittings of the Congress on August 18
debate on the colonial question continued. Addresses were delivered by:
Cc.Alymin(Indonesia), Losereille(France), Narayan(India), Griffin(New
Zealand), Johnes (U.S.A.), Cotreraz(Mexico), Pepper(America), Sala(Uruguay),
Fahry(Turkey), Murphy(Britain), Londock(Czecho-Slovakia), Lozovsky,
Neiman(Germany), Arnott(Britain), Dutt(India).

Comrade Narayan (India) pointed out that British Imperialism has
changed its pre-war tactics of impeding the development of industry in
India, because Britain cannot have India as its war base without
making concessions to the native bourgeoisie. In the opinion of comrade
Narayan the thesis overestimates the revolutionary forces of the Indian
bourgeoisie; with regard to the question of the labour-peasant parties
in the colonies it must be admitted that this form of organization is
the most suitable for the creation of an anti-imperialist front.
Comrade Johnes (U.S.A.) declared that little attention has hitherto
been paid to the Negro question. The American Communist party endorses
the slogan of self-determination for negroes to establish a Negro
Soviet Republic in U.S.A. The main problem to be solved is the
intensification of organisation work among negroes.
Comrade Peper (America) emphasized that the opinion, held by
Comrade Bennett, with regard to industrialization of India is not
correct, and comrade KUUsinen justly described the role played by India
as an agricultural auxiliary continent to the parent-State. In India
no heavy industry exists, which naturally prevents the agrarian country
being transformed into industrial one. The revolutionary situation in
India is the outcome of the clash between capitalism and imperialism
under against pre-war conditions. Is also not correct Comrade Bennett's
point of view that the Indian bourgeoisie have already joined the
imperialist camp, and that in India there are at present two camps:
British imperialism plus Indian bourgeoisie on the one hand and the
proletariat on the other.
Comrade Pepper further declared that the bourgeois-democratic
revolution is the main problem for all colonies and semi-colonies.
Continuing, Comrade Pepper stated that the theory, advanced by Comrade
Lominadze, of a permanent revolution in China, outstepped the epoch
of the bourgeois-democratic revolution and consequently bears the
Trozskist character. The definition of the bourgeois-democratic revolu-
tion in the colonies, described by Comrade Stalin, as an unified effort
against imperialism and feudalism, is the standard one and extends to
India, China and all colonies and semi-colonies. The assertion that the
bourgeois-democratic revolution in China is already spent signifies
a contemptuous disregard to the problems confronting us and, from
this point of view, is not a left, but a right position.-

D. C. I.

莫斯科，1928年8月19日。

共产国际第六次代表大会。

第26次会议。

在8月18日大会的上午和晚间会议上，继续就殖民地问题进行辩论。以下人员发表了讲话：阿里明（Alymin，印度尼西亚）、洛塞耶（Losereille，法国）、纳拉扬（Narayan，印度）、格里芬（Griffin，新西兰）、约翰斯（Johnes，美国）、科特雷拉斯（Cotreraz，墨西哥）、佩珀（Pepper，美国）、萨拉（Sala，乌拉圭）、法赫里（Fahry，土耳其）、墨菲（Murphy，英国）、隆多克（Londock，捷克斯洛伐克）、洛佐夫斯基、奈曼（Neiman，德国）、阿诺特（Arnott，英国）、杜特（Dutt，印度）。

纳拉扬同志（印度）指出，英国帝国主义已改变其战前阻碍印度工业发展的策略，因为如果不向土著资产阶级做出让步，英国就无法将印度作为其战争基地。在纳拉扬同志看来，纲领高估了印度资产阶级的革命力量；关于殖民地工农党的问题，必须承认这种组织形式最适合建立反帝统一战线。
约翰斯同志（美国）宣称，迄今为止对黑人问题关注甚少。美国共产党支持黑人自决以在美国建立黑人苏维埃共和国的口号。需要解决的主要问题是加强在黑人群体中的组织工作。
佩珀同志（美国）强调，贝内特同志关于印度工业化的观点是不正确的，而库西宁（KUUsinen）同志恰当地描述了印度作为母国农业辅助大陆所扮演的角色。印度不存在重工业，这自然阻碍了这个农业国转变为工业国。印度的革命局势是资本主义与帝国主义在战前条件下冲突的结果。贝内特同志认为印度资产阶级已经加入帝国主义阵营，且目前印度存在两个阵营：一方面是英国帝国主义加上印度资产阶级，另一方面是无产阶级，这一观点也是不正确的。
佩珀同志进一步宣称，资产阶级民主革命是所有殖民地和半殖民地的主要问题。接着，佩珀同志指出，洛米纳兹（Lominadze）同志提出的中国不断革命论超越了资产阶级民主革命的时代，因而具有托洛茨基主义特征。斯大林同志将殖民地的资产阶级民主革命定义为反对帝国主义和封建主义的统一努力，这是标准定义，适用于印度、中国以及所有殖民地和半殖民地。声称中国的资产阶级民主革命已经耗尽，意味着蔑视我们面临的问题，从这个角度来看，这不是左派立场，而是右派立场。-

D. C. I.

"I z v i e s t i a"
Moscow, August 18, 1928.

6th CONGRESS OF THE INTERNATIONAL COMMUNIST INTERNATIONAL.

25th Session.

On August 16, at the morning sitting, the debate on the colonial
question was continued. Speeches were delivered by Ember-Dro(IKKK),
Geller(Profintern), Carney(Ireland), Banderas (Crestintern), Vorovsky
(China), Haidar(Palestine) and Omura(Japan). At the evening sitting:
Katayama(Japan), Misiano, Darcey(KIL of America), Rew(South Africa),
Jacqmot(Belgia.), De-Visser(Holland), Gomez(U.S.A.). Bennett(Britain),
Miha-Tzhakaia(Georgia) and Rotstein (Britain).
Comrade Carney(Ireland) pointed out that the communist parties
in the parent States should actively participate in the direction
of the revolutionary movement in the colonies and not place the
responsibility on the colonial parties only. American and British
communist parties should carry out propaganda among the Irish workers
in Britain and America and thus render assistance to the Irish party.
Vorovsky(China) declared that in spite of the criticism by
opportunists, it must be admitted that the Canton rebellion was the
greatest event in the revolutionary struggle in the East. Mistakes
were committed during the insurrection and particularly the admini-
stration and and military preparations were inadequate. We should
oppose the "coup" tendencies in the Chinese Communist Party. The
main danger is the opportunists and their tendencies - against
which we must struggle most resolutely.
Comrade Katayama(Japan) said that the revolutionary movement
in Korea is now in a very painful condition owing to acute fractional
friction. We must adopt every measure in order to involve the best
intellectual elements in the party work, while simultaneously
creating and educating suitable groups of workers to direct the party.
I do not agree, said Comrade Bennett(Britain) with that part
of the thesis which refers to India. To-day when the class struggle
and powerful strikes are in the ascendant in India, one cannot consider
India to be a mere agrarian pocket of the parent-state. It does not
contain a correct reference to the role played by the Indian bour-
geoisie, some of whom are at present cooperating with British
imperialism.
The Indian bourgeoisie already know from the experience of the
Chinese revolution that the national revolution commences with the
agrarian revolution and the struggle of the labour and peasant mas-
ses for power. Therefore it would be grievous error to suppose that
this bourgeoisie will actively participate in the national revolu-
tion. The Savardj party - as a counter-revolutionary bourgeois
party which at a certain moment during the revolution will go over
to the camp of British Imperialism.-

D. C. J.

《消息报》
莫斯科，1928年8月18日。

共产国际第六次代表大会。

第二十五次会议。

8月16日上午的会议上，继续就殖民地问题进行辩论。恩贝尔-德罗（Ember-Dro，共产国际执行委员会）、盖勒（Geller，赤色职工国际）、卡尼（Carney，爱尔兰）、班德拉斯（Banderas，赤色农民国际）、沃罗夫斯基（Vorovsky，中国）、海达尔（Haidar，巴勒斯坦）和奥村（Omura，日本）发表了讲话。在晚上的会议上：片山（Katayama，日本）、米西亚诺（Misiano）、达西（Darcey，美国青年共产国际）、鲁（Rew，南非）、雅克莫特（Jacqmot，比利时）、德维瑟（De-Visser，荷兰）、戈麦斯（Gomez，美国）、贝内特（Bennett，英国）、米哈-茨哈卡亚（Miha-Tzhakaia，格鲁吉亚）和罗特斯坦（Rotstein，英国）发了言。
卡尼同志（爱尔兰）指出，宗主国的共产党应积极参与指导殖民地的革命运动，而不应将责任仅推给殖民地政党。美国和英国的共产党应在英国和美国的爱尔兰工人中进行宣传，从而援助爱尔兰党。
沃罗夫斯基（中国）宣称，尽管受到机会主义者的批评，但必须承认广州起义是东方革命斗争中最重大的事件。起义期间犯了错误，特别是行政和军事准备不足。我们应当反对中国共产党内的“暴动”倾向。主要的危险是机会主义者及其倾向——对此我们必须进行最坚决的斗争。
片山同志（日本）说，由于激烈的派系摩擦，朝鲜的革命运动目前处于非常痛苦的境地。我们必须采取一切措施，以便让最优秀的知识分子元素参与党的工作，同时创建并教育合适的工人群体来领导党。
贝内特同志（英国）说，我不同意纲领中涉及印度的那部分。当今阶级斗争和大规模罢工在印度占上风之际，不能将印度仅仅视为宗主国的一个农业角落。其中没有正确提及印度资产阶级所扮演的角色，他们中的一些人目前正与大英帝国主义合作。
印度资产阶级已经从中国革命的经验中得知，民族革命始于土地革命以及劳工和农民群众为争取权力而进行的斗争。因此，假设这个资产阶级会积极参与民族革命将是一个严重的错误。萨瓦吉党（Savardj party）作为一个反革命的资产阶级政党，在革命的某个时刻将会倒向大英帝国主义阵营。——

D. C. J.

"I z v i e s t i a"
Moscow, August 16, 1928.

6th CONGRESS OF THE COMMUNIST INTERNATIONAL.
(24th Session.)

At the morning sitting of Congress on 15 August which was
presided over by comrade Katayama, comrade Ercoli submitted a report
on the revolutionary movement in the colonies and semi-colonies. After
the reading of this report the representatives of various colonies and
tribes explained the situation existing in their respective countries.
Comrade Sicander criticises the theory, advanced by some of the
comrades, of the so-called "denationalisation" of India.
He said that by analysing the class elements of which Indian
society is composed, one can easily prove the absurdity of this theory.
The Indian population is composed of the following elements: the ari-
stocracy of land-owners having a touch of feudalism, a small but
highly developed bourgeoisie, petty bourgeois intellectuals, numerous
peasant masses and an industrial proletariat. The bourgeoisie and
petty bourgeoisie are bound together by strong economic bonds having
agrarian interests. British imperialism is marching hand in
hand with the land-owners' aristocracy and dictates to the industrial
bourgeoisie. Thus British imperialism strengthens the reactionary
forces, but not those of the industrial bourgeoisie, as is believed
be the partisans of the theory of "decolonisation".
Comrade Strakhoff (China) in his address, which lasted nearly
four hours analysed the history of the Chinese revolution during the
past few years, after which he made the following deductions.
The defeat of the Chinese revolution is the result of blunders
committed by opportunists of the Chinese Communist Party. The princi-
pal blunder was that the party did not understand the agrarian
feature of the Chinese revolution. On the other hand, it failed to
understand the necessity of paralysing the national-reformist tendency
of the Chinese bourgeoisie. The defeat can be explained by both
subjective and objective causes, among which the existence of numbers
of counter-revolutionary forces occupy the first place. After
the Wuhan split the party leaders then understood the mistakes
committed by the opportunists and started the struggle against them.
In the near future the general line of action of the Chinese
Communist Party will be to struggle for the direction of masses and
for the organisation of labour and peasant masses by making use of the
dissatisfaction of the masses with their land-owners, the bourgeoisie
and the Kuomintang and to struggle against the national-reformist petty
bourgeois illusions. On the other hand the communist party should
struggle against the "coup" tendencies of the "lumpen-proletariat".
The Chinese revolution has suffered a serious defeat but it has
not expired. It still exists. We should rally our forces in order
to prepare for the successful revolt when the next revolutionary wave
approaches.-

D. b. I.

《消息报》
莫斯科，1928年8月16日。

共产国际第六次代表大会。
（第二十四次会议。）

在8月15日由片山同志主持的大会上午会议上，埃尔科利（Ercoli）同志提交了关于殖民地和半殖民地革命运动的报告。宣读该报告后，各殖民地和部落的代表解释了各自国家存在的局势。
西坎德（Sicander）同志批评了一些同志提出的所谓印度“去民族化”理论。
他说，通过分析构成印度社会的阶级元素，可以轻易证明这一理论的荒谬性。印度人口由以下元素组成：带有封建色彩的贵族地主、小而高度发达的资产阶级、小资产阶级知识分子、众多的农民群众和工业无产阶级。资产阶级和小资产阶级通过具有农业利益的强大经济纽带联系在一起。大英帝国主义与贵族地主携手并进，并向工业资产阶级发号施令。因此，大英帝国主义加强的是反动势力，而不是像“去殖民化”理论支持者所认为的那样加强工业资产阶级的力量。
斯特拉霍夫（Strakhoff）同志（中国）在其持续近四个小时的讲话中，分析了过去几年中国革命的历史，随后得出了以下结论。
中国革命的失败是中国共产党机会主义者所犯错误的结果。主要错误在于党不理解中国革命的农业特征。另一方面，它未能理解遏制中国资产阶级民族改良主义倾向的必要性。失败可以由主观和客观原因来解释，其中大量反革命势力的存在占据首位。武汉分裂后，党的领导人当时理解了机会主义者所犯的错误，并开始与他们作斗争。
在不久的将来，中国共产党的总行动方针将是利用群众对地主、资产阶级和国民党的不满，争取对群众的领导权并组织劳工和农民群众，并与民族改良主义的小资产阶级幻想作斗争。另一方面，共产党应当与“流氓无产阶级”的“暴动”倾向作斗争。
中国革命遭受了严重挫折，但并未消亡。它仍然存在。我们应当集结力量，以便在下一次革命浪潮临近时准备成功的起义。——

D. b. I.

"I z v i e s t i a"
Moscow, August 11, 1928.

6th CONGRESS OF THE COMMUNISTIC INTERNATIONAL.
20th Session.

The work of drafting out the Programme of the 3rd International
is nearing completion after prolonged conversational debates.
Since the publication of the "Communist Manifesto" there has
never been a document in the history of the world labour movement
which will be of such great importance that the programme which is now
under consideration of the 6th Congress.
If comparison is made between the Manifesto and the Programme
from the literary point of view, clearness of thought, unity of ex-
pression, the Manifesto, without doubt, will still remain the
"Chef-d'oeuvre" of the Marxist dialectic style. The author of the
Manifesto, However, was Karl Marx himself, the incomparable genius.
The Manifesto was the fruit of his revolutionary thoughts and bound-
less devotion to revolution. The Programme of the 3rd International
represents the labours of collective works Therefore when compared
with the Manifesto it is somewhat inferior but at the same time it is
the direct successor to the manifesto, and, naturally, goes one step
farther than it. The events of 80 years, which have elapsed since
the publication of the Manifesto, have thrown new light on the deve-
lopment of capitalist society. The development of industry has clearly
disclosed through hidden hitherto from the human eye: class struggle
has reached its highest limit, the bourgeois democracy is dead and
has given place to the absolute dictatorship of capital.
The labour class in the course of its long struggle with irre-
concilable enemies has sometimes suffered failures, but has not
been defeated. It has learned how to fight for power. The Revolution
of 1848, the Paris Commune, the Soviet Republics in Hungary and Ba-
varia and lastly-the revolutionary events in China - have all taught the
proletariat how to fight for freedom.
The great proletarian victory in Russia, which was the conse-
quence of the October Revolution and gave birth to the first prole-
tarian state in history, the growth of the bourgeois power against
Russia's victorious proletariat etc. have all necessitated the
creation of the present Programme. Its necessity was felt long ago,
even the 4th Comintern Congress which was held in 1922, expressed this
desire. The 5th Congress finally decided that one of the main problems
of the 6th Congress should be to draw up the programme.
We can now state, that this desire has been fulfilled. The
Programme compares the past, so perfectly outlined in the Manifesto,
with the present which is one of decay of capitalism and of transition
into a period of social revolution. The programme analyses from the
angle of dialectic materialism the forces which are warring against
revolution. That is why special attention has been paid to the role
of social democracy. We are not dealing here with abstract notions,
because sections of the Communistic International in all countries
are facing practical problems, which require practical solutions.
Our programme does not underestimate the strength of our enemy and
gives no assurance to the proletariat that its final victory will be
gained cheaply. The correlation of the strength of the forces of the
agrarian and industrial elements has been clearly outlined. The

《消息报》
莫斯科，1928年8月11日。

共产国际第六次代表大会。
第二十次会议。

经过长时间的交谈式辩论，起草第三国际纲领的工作已接近尾声。
自《共产党宣言》发表以来，在世界劳工运动史上，从未有过像第六次代表大会正在审议的这份纲领如此重要的文件。
如果从文学角度、思想清晰度和表达统一性方面比较《宣言》和《纲领》，毫无疑问，《宣言》仍将保持马克思主义辩证风格的“杰作”地位。然而，《宣言》的作者是无与伦比的天才卡尔·马克思本人。《宣言》是他革命思想和对革命无限奉献的结晶。第三国际的纲领代表了集体工作的成果。因此，与《宣言》相比，它稍逊一筹，但同时也是《宣言》的直接继承者，并且自然地比它前进了一步。自《宣言》发表以来流逝的80年间的事件，为资本主义社会的发展提供了新的视角。工业的发展清晰地揭示了此前对人类眼睛隐藏的东西：阶级斗争已达到其最高限度，资产阶级民主已经死亡，并让位于资本的绝对独裁。
工人阶级在与不可调和的敌人的长期斗争过程中，有时遭受失败，但并未被击败。它学会了如何为权力而战。1848年革命、巴黎公社、匈牙利和巴伐利亚的苏维埃共和国，以及最后——中国的革命事件——都教导了无产阶级如何为自由而战。
俄国伟大的无产阶级胜利，这是十月革命的结果，并诞生了历史上第一个无产阶级国家，以及针对俄国胜利无产阶级的资产阶级权力的增长等，都使得制定当前纲领成为必要。这种必要性早已被感受到，甚至1922年召开的共产国际第四次代表大会也表达了这一愿望。第五次代表大会最终决定，第六次代表大会的主要问题之一是起草纲领。
我们现在可以说，这一愿望已经实现。《纲领》将《宣言》中完美勾勒的过去，与当前资本主义衰败和向社会革命时期过渡的现状进行了比较。纲领从辩证唯物主义的角度分析了与革命作战的力量。这就是为什么特别关注社会民主党的作用。我们这里处理的不是抽象概念，因为各国共产国际分部正面临需要实际解决的实际问题。我们的纲领没有低估敌人的力量，也没有向无产阶级保证其最终胜利会轻易获得。农业和工业元素力量之间的对比关系已得到清晰勾勒。

crisis of capitalism, the importance of colonial wars, the role of
so-called backward countries,- all these have been most carefully
analysed from the point of view of their importance to the world
revolution. The revolutionary forces as well as those forces of
the world's capitalism have been duly estimated.
Having calculated the exact correlation of forces of the strug-
gling proletariat and their capitalistic enemy, the programme pro-
ceeds to examine the proletarian strategy, namely, by which way
the enemy can be destroyed.
The Programme essentially differs from the Manifesto on this
point because every individual section of the Communist International
has its assigned special strategy, which is a part of the whole plan,
the final aim of which is the victory over capitalism.
The programme devotes special attention to the problem of colo-
nies and colonial proletariat. It carefully discusses the question
how to transform the peasants of the colonial countries into an
ally of the proletariat. Fascism, as a special form of capitalist
dictatorship, has been scientifically analysed. The methods employed
by social-democracy are exposed in detail, emphasis being placed on
the dangerous role played by the left wing of the social-democratic
movement.
Finally the programme indicates the role which is being played
by U.S.S.R. at a present moment. The problem of war menace to U.S.S.R.
is one of the main points of the programme. Practical instructions
are given with regard to measures which should be taken in order to
avoid war, as well as for the successful struggle against militarists.
Military communism and N.E.P. are also discussed in the pro-
gramme. The economic role played by them during the period immediate-
ly following the seizure of power by the communists is explained
in detail.
The appearance of the programme of the 3rd Communist Internatio-
nal presents no less an important event in the History of the world
labour movement than did the Marx' Manifesto.-

Debates on the Programme of the Comintern.

The principal object of the Programme of the Comintern - Comrade
Sicander(India) said - is not so much that we again proclaim the
organisation of the communist society, as it is that we explain
by which ways we can march towards the goal under circumstances exi-
sting in various countries. The preliminary seizure of power by the
proletariat is a necessary condition towards the establishment of
communism. In highly developed capitalistic countries the proletariat
is competent enough to be able to seize the power in their hands
under able leadership. A totally different situation exists in the
colonies and semi-colonies. Thus, for instance, in India, in addition
to a powerful proletarian movement, we also have a powerful nationa-
list movement. That is why we should employ the forces, which in
India, as in other oppressed countries are opposing British imperia-
lism, for the struggle against imperialism in order to establish
the communistic regime. With the help of strong discipline and by
relying upon the programme which has just been drawn up by us, the
Communist party of India will be able to solve this problem.-

D. C. J.

资本主义危机、殖民战争的重要性、所谓落后国家的作用——所有这些都从其对世界革命重要性的角度得到了最仔细的分析。革命力量以及世界资本主义的力量均已得到适当评估。
在精确计算了斗争中的无产阶级与其资本主义敌人的力量对比后，该纲领进而审视无产阶级战略，即通过何种途径消灭敌人。
在此点上，该纲领与《宣言》有着本质区别，因为共产国际的每一个分支都有其指定的特殊战略，这是整体计划的一部分，其最终目标是战胜资本主义。
该纲领特别关注殖民地及殖民地无产阶级问题。它仔细讨论了如何将殖民地国家的农民转变为无产阶级的盟友的问题。法西斯主义作为资本主义独裁的一种特殊形式，已得到科学分析。社会民主主义所采用的方法被详细揭露，重点强调了社会民主主义运动左翼所扮演的危险角色。
最后，纲领指出了苏联目前所扮演的角色。对苏联的战争威胁问题是纲领的主要要点之一。就为避免战争应采取的措施，以及为成功对抗军国主义者，均给出了实际指示。
军事共产主义和新经济政策（N.E.P.）也在纲领中进行了讨论。详细解释了它们在共产党夺取政权后的紧接时期内所发挥的经济作用。
第三国际纲领的出现，在世界劳工运动史上的重要性不亚于马克思的《宣言》。-

关于共产国际纲领的辩论。

共产国际纲领的主要目标——西坎德同志（印度）说——不在于我们要再次宣告共产主义社会的组织，而在于我们要解释在各种国家现存的情况下，我们可以通过哪些途径迈向目标。无产阶级预先夺取权力是建立共产主义的必要条件。在高度发达的资本主义国家，无产阶级在有能力的领导下，完全有能力将权力掌握在自己手中。殖民地和半殖民地的情况则完全不同。例如，在印度，除了强大的无产阶级运动外，我们还有强大的民族主义运动。这就是为什么我们应该利用在印度及其他受压迫国家中反对英帝国主义的力量，来进行反帝斗争，以建立共产主义政权。凭借严明的纪律，并依靠我们刚刚制定的纲领，印度共产党将能够解决这一问题。-

D. C. J.

“Izvestia”
Moscow, July 24, 1928.

SIXTH CONGRESS OF THE COMMUNISTIC INTERNATIONAL.

Fifth Session.

Report of the Executive Committee of the Comintern. General analysis
of modern capitalism and peculiar forms of capitalistic crisis (Extract
from Bukharin's report).

Dear Comrades ! We have witnessed many events pass since our last
Comintern Congress. For the purpose of arriving at a correct apprecia-
tion of past events and in order to give outlines of future work we
must analyse the past not by taking it separately, but by linking it
with preceding events. The whole after-war period may be divided
into three sections. First comes the period of acute revolutionary
crisis, especially in European countries, during which period revolution-
ary development attained its highest degree, when the powerful revo-
lutionary wave rose over all Europe and attained its culminative point
in 1920-21.

To this first period belong the February and October revolutions
in Russia, the labour revolution in Finland in March 1918; the "Rice"
uprisings in Japan in August 1918; the November revolution in Austria
and Germany in 1918; the proletarian revolution in Hungary; the
uprising in Korea in 1919; the establishment of the Soviet Power in
Bavaria in April 1919; the Turkish revolution in 1920 and the seizure
of all the factories in Italy by the workers in 1920; to this may
be added the Polish offensive by the Red Army against Warsaw and so-
called forward movement in Germany in 1921.

We see that this first period witnessed great revolutionary events
of considerable magnitude and great historic importance. These events
revealed the decay of European capitalism. The last chronological
date of this period was seen in the uprising in Bulgaria in 1923,
which ended in a complete defeat and a similar defeat was suffered
by the German proletariat at the end of the same year.

The defeat suffered by the proletariat of Western Europe
has served as the starting point of the development of the bourgeoi-
sie and also marks the beginning of the second period. This second
period is synonymous with the offensive launched by capital and
also of the defensive by the proletariat in general. It was the
period of strikes and establishing, to a certain degree, the stabi-
lity of capitalism. It must be pointed out that some of the defensi-
ve battles launched by the proletariat attained considerable dimen-
sions as, for example, the General Strike and Miners' strike in
England. The second period produced a state of "tranquility and or-
der" in European and world capitalism. The revolutionary events
have been recorded in the colonial and semi-colonial countries. In
1925 there was insurrection in Morocco; in August of 1925 a riot
took place in Syria; a severe struggle has begun also this year in
China. If the revolutionary situation was of a strictly European
character during the first period, the revolutionary wave has moved
in the present period into the eclipse of world capitalism. The
second period, from the second point of view, may be termed as the
regeneration period of productive forces of capitalism. This latter
basing itself on its political victories, strove to reach a certain
economic stability which marked the third period of capitalistic
reconstruction. The growth of the productive forces of capitalism
depended, on the one hand , on considerable technical progress,
and on the other - on the attempt to establish economic capitalist
connections. This technical reconstruction and economic reorganisa-
tion were accompanied with the growth of forces antagonistic to ca-
pitalism and with the development of internal contradictions.

The first place among these forces is occupied by U.S.A.
The reconstructive period of capitalism coincides with the same

《消息报》
莫斯科，1928年7月24日。

共产国际第六次代表大会。

第五次会议。

共产国际执行委员会报告。现代资本主义的一般分析及资本主义危机的特殊形式（布哈林报告摘录）。

亲爱的同志们！自上次共产国际代表大会以来，我们目睹了许多事件的发生。为了正确评价过去的事件，并为未来的工作勾勒轮廓，我们必须将过去与先前的事件联系起来进行分析，而不是孤立地看待它。整个战后时期可分为三个阶段。首先是尖锐的革命危机时期，特别是在欧洲各国，在此期间，革命发展达到了最高程度，强大的革命浪潮席卷整个欧洲，并在1920-21年达到顶点。

属于这一第一阶段的有：俄国的二月革命和十月革命；1918年3月芬兰的劳工革命；1918年8月日本的“米骚动”；1918年奥地利和德国的十一月革命；匈牙利的无产阶级革命；1919年朝鲜的起义；1919年4月巴伐利亚苏维埃政权的建立；1920年的土耳其革命以及1920年意大利工人占领所有工厂；此外还可加上红军对华沙的波兰攻势以及1921年德国的所谓“前进运动”。

我们看到，这第一阶段见证了规模巨大且具有重大历史意义的革命事件。这些事件揭示了欧洲资本主义的衰败。这一时期的最后一个时间标志是1923年保加利亚的起义，它以彻底失败告终，同年年底德国无产阶级也遭受了类似的失败。

西欧无产阶级遭受的失败已成为资产阶级发展的起点，同时也标志着第二阶段的开始。这第二阶段 synonymous with 资本发起的进攻，也是无产阶级总体上的防御时期。这是罢工频发、资本主义稳定性在一定程度上得以确立的时期。必须指出，无产阶级发起的一些防御性战斗规模相当大，例如英国的总罢工和矿工罢工。第二阶段使欧洲和世界资本主义进入了一种“平静与秩序”的状态。革命事件主要记录在殖民地和半殖民地国家。1925年摩洛哥发生起义；1925年8月叙利亚发生暴动；今年中国也开始了激烈的斗争。如果说第一阶段的革命局势具有严格的欧洲特征，那么当前的革命浪潮已转移到世界资本主义的衰落期。从另一个角度来看，第二阶段可称为资本主义生产力的复兴时期。后者基于其政治胜利，力求达到一定的经济稳定，这标志着资本主义重建的第三阶段。资本主义生产力的增长，一方面取决于显著的技术进步，另一方面取决于建立资本主义经济联系的尝试。这种技术重建和经济重组伴随着反资本主义力量的增长以及内部矛盾的发展。

在这些力量中，美国占据首位。资本主义的重建时期与美国
