"I z v i e s t i a "
Moscow, July 25. 1928.

6th CONGRESS of the COMMUNISTIC INTERNATION L.
7th Session.

Deliberations on comrade Bukharin's report.

Comrade D e n n (U.S/A.) who spoke at the evening sitting
on the Congress held on July 24, pointed out that the report made by
C.Bukhari must be supplemented particularly with reference to the
outline of the situation in the U.S.A. He emphasizes on the strained
internal frictions, the movement of the labour masses towards the left
are necessary and the line of the Central Committee of the Workers which
is deviating from their course to the left must be adjusted.

Comrade R o s a (India) talked of the necessity of passing a
resolution emphasizing the question of the agrarian policy of Bri -
tish imperialism in India. The Communist party in India should lead
the revolutionary movement at present in progress and avoid repeating
the blunders committed by the Chinese Communist party. The Indian
communists should unmercifully unmask the treachery of the nationalist
bourgeoisie.

Comrade C o l l a r o f f (Bulgaria) declared that the Bulga-
rian delegation unanimously approved Bukharin's report. It need only
be supplemented by the analysis of the universal agrarian situation.
The Communistic Parties should devote their attention to work amongst
the peasants. The Balkan communistic parties have passed through a
period of serious crisis. Internal dissensions in the Bulgarian
party have not yet been terminated. With the aid of the Communistic
International the crisis in the Greek party has been terminated.

Comrade P e p p e r, in the name of the American delegation,
unlike comrade D e n n who expressed his own personal opinion,
wholly approved the proposal made by Bukharin. After criticising
Denn's speech comrade Pepper pointed out that those comrades who
now accuse the central committee of the American Communist Party of
being opportunists, when they were the majority of the Central Commi-
ttee, defended the opportunist theory of "economic democracy". The
present Central Committee has now corrected this error .

Comrade B l e n k l e (German Commun.Youth) said that the pro-
blem of work among the communist youth had never been presented in
such an acute form as at present, when preparations are being made
for an imperialistic war. If we desire to transform our unions of
communist youth into mass organisations we should adjust our method
of work accordingly.
Comrade M a n n i n g t o n (British delegate) pointed out that
Comrade Bukharin had not completed his analysis on the problems of
unemployment, which are of the greatest importance. The British Com-
munistic Party has achieved great success in its work among the
unemployed.

D. C. J.

共产国际第六次代表大会。
第七次会议。

关于布哈林同志报告的审议。

登恩（Denn）同志（美国）在7月24日举行的代表大会晚会上发言时指出，C.布哈里（C.Bukhari）[原文如此]的报告必须予以补充，特别是关于美国局势概况的部分。他强调内部摩擦紧张，劳工群众向左翼运动是必要的，必须调整工人中央委员会偏离左翼路线的方针。

罗萨（Rosa）同志（印度）谈到有必要通过一项决议，强调英国帝国主义在印度的农业政策问题。印度共产党应当领导目前正在进行的革命运动，避免重犯中国共产党所犯的错误。印度共产党人应当无情地揭露民族资产阶级的背叛行径。

科拉罗夫（Collaroff）同志（保加利亚）宣布，保加利亚代表团一致批准布哈林的报告。只需补充对全球农业状况的分析即可。各共产党应当重视在农民中的工作。巴尔干地区的各共产党经历了一段严重的危机时期。保加利亚党内的内部分歧尚未结束。在共产国际的帮助下，希腊党的危机已经终结。

佩珀（Pepper）同志代表美国代表团发言，与表达个人意见的登恩同志不同，他完全赞成布哈林提出的建议。在批评了登恩的演讲后，佩珀同志指出，那些现在指责美国共产党中央委员会是机会主义者的同志，当他们占据中央委员会多数席位时，曾捍卫“经济民主”的机会主义理论。现任中央委员会现已纠正了这一错误。

布伦克勒（Blenkle）同志（德国共产主义青年团）表示，共产主义青年工作的问题从未像现在这样以如此尖锐的形式呈现出来，因为人们正在为帝国主义战争做准备。如果我们希望将我们的共产主义青年联盟转变为群众组织，我们就应相应地调整我们的工作方法。

曼宁顿（Mannington）同志（英国代表）指出，布哈林同志尚未完成对失业问题的分析，而这些问题至关重要。英国共产党在失业者工作中取得了巨大成功。

D. C. J.

"I z v i e s t i a "
Moscow, July 24, 1928.

THE 6th CONGRESS OF THE COMMUNISTIC INTERNATIONAL
( 6th day)

The British "subject's " DAY " .

Yesterday's sitting may justly be classified as the revolt of
the British "subjects". Representatives of dominions and colonies sub-
mitted to Congress their "Cahier de doléances" against their mother-
country. The British subjects have long been seeking justice in the
British parliament. The reason for this may be easily understood from the
report submitted by the Indian delegate, giving information on the
situation in the "Pearl of the Empire". It is a long description of
indescribable sufferings and the heroic battles. It is imbued with
the assurance that the 300 millions people of India will find delive-
rance under the banners of the Comintern.
South Africa, the youngest of the dominions of the British
Empire has also sent its delegation. All nations inhabiting the
South African Dominions are endeavouring to break down the fettering
chains and liberate themselves from the yoke of Albion. British oppres-
sion has accomplished the miracle of uniting the whites, blacks (ma-
jority of the population) and Indians into an enormous union, which
alone is able to wipe out the British parasites/
From the representative of the Canadian proletariat Congress
has obtained a clear insight as to how Canada, the oldest of the British
dominions, "gradually drops her connections with the mother country".
If however, on the other hand, Canada is liberating herself from the
clutch of British imperialism, it is being menaced, on the other hand,
by the only alternative of passing under the yoke of the U.S.A. The
Canadian workers now understand that only by cooperation of all the
peoples oppressed by the world's capitalists can they hope to obtain
freedom.
This remarkable sitting was presided over by a negro from North
America, one of the 12 millions negroes exploited by American capitalism.
All the eyes of the American negroes are turned to the 6th Congress.
It was remarkable day; a wonderful mobilisation of the downtrodden
nations, who have voiced their aspirations for freedom amidst the
fraternal society of the revolutionary delegates of the whole world.
The morning sitting was presided over by C.Carlton (negro delegate
from North America). The entire sitting was devoted to the discussion
of Bukharin's report. Speeches were delivered by Cc.Semar (France),
Wisser (Holland), Rogitch (Yougo-Slavia), Ford (from North American ne-
groes), Vassilieff (Crestintern), Tegersen (Dane), Sikander (India),
Bodeman (Swiss), Koplenig (Austria), Murphy (Britain), Macdonald (Canada)
Bunting (Communist party of South Africa), altogether 12 persons.

Comrade FORD, delegate of the North American negroes, pointed out
that the American Communist party, up to present, had paid very little
attention to the work amongst the negroes. Notwithstanding this, recent
events have proved the importance of the work performed amongst the
downtrodden peoples. "We have had a revolution in China. At present
there is trouble brewing in India. Now is the time for the negroes
of the United States to revolt" - concluded C.Ford accompanied by
applauses.
C.Sikander, the Indian delegate, was greeted with applauses
. He pointed out that the situation of the toiling masses, under the
yoke of British oppression and Indian capitalism, is becoming worse.
In addition to this the workers resistance based on the Comintern pro-
gramme has increased. It behoves us to transform the Indian Communist
party into a powerful mass organisation".
Comrade Murphy, who spoke in the name of the British delegation
emphasized the necessity of obtaining more complete information about
the role played by the League of Nations and the Kellog's pact intended
to screen preparations for the imperialistic war. Beside this, comrade
Bukharin has devoted little attention to the work in progress among

《消息报》
莫斯科，1928年7月24日。

共产国际第六次代表大会
（第六天）

英国“臣民”的“日子”。

昨天的会议可以恰当地被归类为英国“臣民”的反抗。自治领和殖民地的代表向大会提交了针对其母国的“怨情陈述书”（Cahier de doléances）。英国臣民长期以来一直在英国议会寻求正义。从印度代表提交的关于“帝国明珠”局势的报告中，很容易理解其原因。那是对难以言喻的苦难和英勇战斗的长篇描述。文中充满了一种信念，即印度的三亿人民将在共产国际的旗帜下获得解放。

南非作为大英帝国最年轻的自治领，也派遣了代表团。居住在南非自治领的所有民族都在努力打破束缚他们的锁链，从阿尔比恩（英国）的枷锁中解放自己。英国的压迫创造了一个奇迹，将白人、黑人（人口多数）和印度人联合成一个巨大的联盟，只有这个联盟才能清除英国的寄生虫。

从加拿大无产阶级的代表那里，大会清楚地了解到加拿大这个最古老的英国自治领是如何“逐渐切断与母国的联系”的。然而，另一方面，如果加拿大正在从英国帝国主义的魔爪中解放出来，它也面临着另一种威胁，即落入美利坚合众国的枷锁之下。加拿大工人现在明白，只有通过与受世界资本家压迫的所有人民合作，他们才有希望获得自由。

这次引人注目的会议由一位来自北美的黑人主持，他是被美国资本主义剥削的1200万黑人之一。所有美国黑人的目光都投向了第六次代表大会。这是非凡的一天；是被压迫民族的精彩动员，他们在来自全世界的革命代表的兄弟般社会中表达了他们对自由的渴望。

上午的会议由C.卡尔顿（Carlton）同志（来自北美的黑人代表）主持。整个会议致力于讨论布哈林的报告。发表演讲的有：塞马尔（Semar）同志（法国）、维瑟（Wisser）同志（荷兰）、罗吉奇（Rogitch）同志（南斯拉夫）、福特（Ford）同志（来自北美黑人）、瓦西里耶夫（Vassilieff）同志（赤色职工国际）、泰格森（Tegersen）同志（丹麦）、西坎德尔（Sikander）同志（印度）、博德曼（Bodeman）同志（瑞士）、科普莱尼格（Koplenig）同志（奥地利）、墨菲（Murphy）同志（英国）、麦克唐纳（Macdonald）同志（加拿大）、邦廷（Bunting）同志（南非共产党），共计12人。

福特同志，北美黑人代表，指出美国共产党迄今为止很少关注在黑人群体中的工作。尽管如此，最近的事件证明了在被压迫民族中进行的工作的重要性。“我们在中国发生了一场革命。目前印度正在酝酿动荡。现在是美国黑人起义的时候了”——福特同志在掌声中总结道。

印度代表西坎德尔同志受到掌声欢迎。他指出，在英国压迫和印度资本主义的枷锁下，劳动群众的处境正日益恶化。此外，基于共产国际纲领的工人抵抗运动有所增加。我们有责任将印度共产党转变为一个强大的群众组织。

墨菲同志代表英国代表团发言，强调有必要获取更完整的信息，了解国际联盟和旨在掩盖帝国主义战争准备的凯洛格公约（Kellog's pact）所扮演的角色。此外，布哈林同志对正在进行的工作关注甚少

" I z v i e s t i a "
Moscow, July 20, 1928 .

The largest section of the proletariat of the world is threatened
with extermination.

Comrades, the present question affects one of the vastest (second
to U.S.S.R.) countries, of the most populated country in a world, where
300.000 peasants and tens of millions of workers live under constant per-
secution, tortures and physical extermination.
One could suppose that the Chinese issue has now been settled by
the nationalist victory; yet in reality this is not so.. As has often
happened in the course of the world's history, what was considered to
be a Chinese revolution, has deviated from its course, slipped out of
the hands of its original initiators and has passed under the control
of the counter revolutionary oligarchy. The situation can only be sta-
bilized over the dead corpses of proletariat. But there is no stabili-
zation so far. A huge country, after experiencing a series of events,
to which the whole world has responded, is covered with blood and mud,
and finds itself in even more difficult situation than before. Loud
appeals for help are coming to us from the deceived and suppressed
Chinese labour masses.
The situation of the Chinese workers is awful. They are living and
working in undescribable conditions. From the moment of becoming emplo-
yed the worker is being exploited by agent who unmercifully takes from
him part of his wages, the second part of which goes as a "bail"(which
is never returned), and to cover numerous fines. He works from 12 to
16 hours, and, sometimes, in the silk mills in Shanghai he works 20
hours. In the mines each shift works sometimes the whole 24 hours
without interruption. 30 minute for dinner is being given only in some
enterprises, yet generally the workers eat while continuing their work.
As a general rule the worker has no right to leave his work more than
once a day (even to go to the lavatory). The hard labour exhausts wor-
kers to such extent that at the end of the working day they cannot
walk, so sleep in the street, near the factory. Besides the workers often
have no money to pay for lodgings. The women workers have to bring their
babies with them into the factory. The Chinese capitalists largely
employ Child labour. In Shanghai children under 12 years of age account
for 13% of the factory proletariat. In British enterprises there are
17%, French and Italian - 46%.
There are no laws of labour defence, no measures are taken against
accidents. If a worker during work happens to be a victim of some
unfortunate accident, the owner sometimes pays his family 20-30 dollars
compensation but is under no obligation to do this. If a worker is
mutilated, wounded, or falls sick, he is simply thrown out of the door.
70% of the Chinese workers do not have one day's rest during the year,
excepting a few days at New year, during which time he receives no
wages. Women workers sometimes are allowed two weeks leave when giving
birth. It often happens that women workers give birth when working at the
machine and she immediately resumes work after delivery. Children earn
from 3 to 5 dollars a month for a 16 hours working day. In small working
shops children do not receive wages at all, only food. The workers'
wages vary from 2 doll. 40 cts. to 26 dollars. Thus the average wages
are 11 dollars p.month. If we take a family of 4 (husband, wife and two
children) when the husband and his wife are both working ( a rare occa-
sion) their average wages is from 17 to 18 dollars. To make both ends
meet 21 dollars are required: therefore they are from 3 to 4 dollars
short.
The revolutionary Trade Unions united under the All China Federation
of Trade Unions which affiliated to the Profintern (RILU) composed on
April, 1927, 3.000.000 members. At that time the Trade Unions were at the
height of their power and development. The Shanghai Trade Union alone

《消息报》
莫斯科，1928年7月20日。

世界无产阶级的最大部分正面临被灭绝的威胁。

同志们，当前的问题关系到世界上人口最多的国家之一（仅次于苏联），在这个拥有30万农民和数千万工人的国家里，他们生活在持续的迫害、酷刑和肉体灭绝之下。
人们可能认为中国问题已通过民族主义的胜利得到解决；然而事实并非如此。正如世界历史进程中经常发生的那样，被视为中国革命的事情偏离了其轨道，脱离了其最初发起者的掌控，转而被反革命寡头集团所控制。局势只能在无产阶级的尸堆上才能稳定下来。但迄今为止并无稳定可言。这个巨大的国家在经历了一系列引起全世界反响的事件后，鲜血淋漓、泥泞不堪，处境甚至比以前更加艰难。受骗和被压迫的中国劳工群众向我们发出了大声的求助呼吁。
中国工人的处境糟透了。他们在难以形容的条件下生活和工作。从受雇的那一刻起，工人就受到代理人的剥削，代理人无情地拿走他部分工资，另一部分作为“保证金”（从不退还），并用于支付各种罚款。他工作12到16小时，有时在上海的丝厂里工作20小时。在矿井里，每班有时连续工作整整24小时不间断。只有少数企业给予30分钟的午餐时间，但通常工人在继续工作的同时进食。一般来说，工人每天无权离开工作岗位超过一次（甚至包括上厕所）。繁重的劳动使工人精疲力竭，以至于在工作日结束时他们无法行走，只能睡在工厂附近的街道上。此外，工人往往没有钱支付住宿费。女工不得不带着婴儿进工厂。中国资本家大量使用童工。在上海，12岁以下的儿童占工厂无产阶级的13%。在英国企业中这一比例为17%，法国和意大利企业为46%。
没有劳动保护法律，也没有针对事故采取措施。如果工人在工作中遭遇不幸事故，业主有时会向其家庭支付20-30美元的赔偿金，但这并非义务。如果工人致残、受伤或生病，他会被直接赶出门外。70%的中国工人在一年中没有一天的休息日，除了春节期间的几天，在此期间他没有工资。女工有时在分娩时被允许休假两周。经常发生女工在机器旁分娩，并在分娩后立即恢复工作的情况。儿童每天工作16小时，每月收入3至5美元。在小作坊里，儿童根本拿不到工资，只提供食物。工人的工资从2.40美元到26美元不等。因此平均工资为每月11美元。如果我们以一个四口之家（丈夫、妻子和两个孩子）为例，当丈夫和妻子都工作时（这种情况很少见），他们的平均工资为17至18美元。要维持收支平衡需要21美元：因此他们短缺3至4美元。
隶属于赤色职工国际（RILU）的中华全国总工会联合下的革命工会，在1927年4月拥有300万成员。当时工会处于权力和发展的顶峰。仅上海工会

unified about 500.000 workers. Leading the armed proletariat they
seized the city on March 21, 1927, and drove out the northerners.
There was a time when the All-China Federation of Trade Unions was
able to seize the British Concessions in Hankow and force the British
Government to legalize this seizure.
The Britishers execute Chinese workers. "Beheading is the best
remedy against the fever of strikes in China" writes the "Daily Mail"
the official representative of the Great Powers participate in this
butchery. British, American and French police are seizing communists
and handing them over to the Chinese executioner. Whenever the
workers and peasants seize the power in their hands, Japanese, British
American and French gunboats immediately arrive upon the scene and
help the Chinese reactionaries to squash the movement.
The labour movement is in danger. It has suffered such considerable
losses that it has now placed itself behind the peasants movement which, by its nature, cannot be exterminated. It is essential
for the future destiny of the world's proletarian movement that
both these movements should march together.
In this tragic situation the imperative duty of the world proletariat is to organise immediate resistance to this white terrorism.
Let the workers of the whole world express their wish, step out with
a protest, which would frighten the Asiatic reactionists, to unmask
the crimes of the bourgeois circles, militarists and of representatives of the "civilised" powers; demand the evacuation of foreign troops from China, collect contributions to aid Chinese workers -
these are the problems which should be explained to all the toiling
masses during the "Chinese self-denial fortnight" for the aid of the
Chinese labour movement.

(signed) Henry Barbusse.

D.C.J.

就统一了约50万名工人。他们领导武装无产阶级于1927年3月21日占领城市，驱逐了北方军阀。
曾有一段时间，中华全国总工会能够占领汉口的英租界，并迫使英国政府合法化这一占领。
英国人处决中国工人。“斩首是对付中国罢工热潮的最佳良药”，《每日邮报》写道，大国的官方代表参与了这场屠杀。英国、美国和法国警察逮捕共产党人并将他们移交给中国刽子手。每当工人和农民掌握权力时，日本、英国、美国和法国的炮舰立即赶到现场，帮助中国反动派镇压运动。
劳工运动处于危险之中。它遭受了如此重大的损失，以至于现在落后于农民运动，而农民运动按其性质是无法被灭绝的。这两场运动并肩前进对于世界无产阶级运动的未来命运至关重要。
在这种悲剧性的局势下，世界无产阶级的当务之急是组织对白色恐怖的即时抵抗。让全世界的工人表达他们的愿望，提出抗议，吓退亚洲反动派，揭露资产阶级圈子、军国主义者和“文明”强国代表的罪行；要求外国军队撤出中国，募集捐款援助中国工人——这些是在援助中国劳工运动的“中国自我牺牲 fortnight（两周）”期间应向所有劳动群众解释的问题。

（签名）亨利·巴比塞。

"Izviestia"
Moscow, July 14, 1925.

（印：CENSORSHIP No. 10 9199）

Foreign visitors in U.S.S.R.
Yesterday Louis Meyers, representative of the Federation of the Ukrainian Jews in America, left Moscow for Ukraina to study conditions of life of the Jewish population in that country and to find out whether there is a possibility for mass-emigration of the Jews from America into Ukraina.

Arrival of American educationalists.
Yesterday morning 32 prominent American educationalists headed by professor J.Lewis, the well known authority on education, arrived in Moscow. At the "October" station they were met by the representatives of the Commissariat of Education and others. At the Commissariat of Education they were received by Lunatcharsky, with whom they have conferred on some most important problems of the peoples education in U.S.S.R. According to a program worked out by the Commissar of Education the delegation will, within the next few days, visit a number of educational and scientific institutions.

（批：Copy to. H. W. M. General. / Colonel Hallam / Lieut Goldsmith / 13/8 A.B.）

昨天上午，由著名教育权威J.刘易斯教授率领的32位杰出美国教育家抵达莫斯科。他们在“十月”车站受到教育人民委员部代表及其他人士的迎接。在教育人民委员部，卢那察尔斯基接待了他们，并与他们就苏联国民教育的一些最重要问题进行了会谈。根据教育人民委员制定的计划，代表团将在未来几天内参观一些教育和科研机构。

"Red Banner".
Vladivostock, May 20, 1928.

Shanghai, 18 (Tass). Shanghai newspapers report that Chang
Tso Lin's son Chang Sueh Liang, who arrived in Peking to take
part in a military conference, has been found dead near the entrance
to the Legation Quarters. According to newspaper reports the body
of Chang Sueh Liang bore three bullet wounds.
Shanghai 18 (Tass). Details are now available about the murder
of Tso Kung Hsi, the representative of the Foreign Ministry in
Tsinanfu.
A Japanese detachment which happened to pass by the office of
the representative, found the dead bodies of two Japanese soldiers
near the building.
Japanese soldiers rushed into the office and arrested Tso Kung
Hsi and his 19 assistants. The Japanese soldiers demanded of Tso
Kung Hsi a statement that the Japanese soldiers had been killed by
the Nanking troops. Tso Kung Hsi refused and instantly he and all
the others arrested were cruelly murdered.
Shanghai, 18 (Tass). Rover, the representative of "Tass" in
China, has been arrested on board the steamer "Sakaki Maru" at
Dairen.
Long live pioneers! N. Akita and K. Nalmi, the Japanese delegates
who arrived here to participate in the celebration of the jubilee
of the Soviet revolution, have written about children in the
Soviet Union as follows:
All that we have seen in the soviet Union is of great service
to us, yet nothing has touched us so deeply and strongly as the
life of the pioneers. The pioneers whom we had a chance to see
in Moscow and other towns are not only well trained and disciplined
but have a healthy appearance and are cheerful. It is only liberty
that gives real joy. The cheerfulness on the faces of the soviet

上海，18日（塔斯社）。上海各报报道，张作霖之子张学良抵达北京参加军事会议后，其尸体在使馆区入口附近被发现。据报纸报道，张学良的遗体上有三处枪伤。
上海，18日（塔斯社）。现有关于外交部驻济南代表左公禧（Tso Kung Hsi，音译）被谋杀案的详情。
一支偶然路过该代表办事处的日本分遣队，在大楼附近发现了两名日本士兵的尸体。
日本士兵冲进办事处，逮捕了左公禧及其19名助手。日本士兵要求左公禧发表声明，称日本士兵是被南京军队杀害的。左公禧拒绝，随即他和所有其他被捕者均遭残酷杀害。
上海，18日（塔斯社）。塔斯社驻华代表罗佛（Rover）在大连的“榊丸”号（Sakaki Maru）轮船上被捕。

我们在苏联看到的一切对我们都大有裨益，但没有任何事情像先锋队员的生活那样深深且强烈地触动我们。我们在莫斯科和其他城镇有机会看到的先锋队员不仅训练有素、纪律严明，而且面色健康、情绪愉快。只有自由才能带来真正的快乐。苏联

援助印度铁路罢工工人。

伦敦，14日（塔斯社）。《泰晤士报》记者报道，印度利卢阿（Lillua）铁路罢工领导人发给赤色职工国际的电报呼吁，奉英国政府之命，未送达收件人。

（批注：另见 / 10.9608。）

莫斯科，14日（塔斯社）。赤色职工国际执行局向印度铁路罢工工人发出了以下电报：
“我们从英国报纸上读到了你们发给赤色职工国际请求援助的电报。我们要未收到此电报。作为我们团结一致的证明，我们向铁路罢工工人汇款7,000卢布。坚持到底，你们就会胜利。向你们致以兄弟般的祝愿。”

由于比金-维亚泽姆斯卡亚（Bikin-Viasemskaia）段电报线路中断，我们无法在今日的版面中刊登足够数量的来自苏联及国外的电报信息。

Shanghai, 13,(Tass). The All-China Labour Federation has addressed to the workers of all countries a letter pointing out the results of the white terrorism. The Chinese revolutionary masses lost over 23i.700 men. The number of families jailed, whish have lost their supporters, amounts to several hundred of thousands. The All-China Labour Federation requests material assistance for the Chinese workers and the families which had suffered under this terrorism.

S/S "Lozovsky" leave for Kamtchatka. Sebastopol,14(Rosta). The steamer "Lozovsky" left for Kamtchatka carrying on board the aeroplane "Soviet North" and the pilots Krassinsky, Kosheleff, Volynsky, Rodzievitch and Borisenko, the participants of the projected flight over the North Pole.

Day of international solidarity.The Russian and Korean pioneer detachments on May 26 will conjointly start collecting contributions. “洛佐夫斯基”号轮船驶往堪察加。塞瓦斯托波尔，14日（罗斯塔社）。“洛佐夫斯基”号轮船载着“苏维埃北方”号飞机以及飞行员克拉辛斯基（Krassinsky，音译）、科舍列夫（Kosheleff，音译）、沃伦斯基（Volynsky，音译）、罗德泽维奇（Rodzievitch，音译）和博里森科（Borisenko，音译）启程前往堪察加，他们是计划中的飞越北极飞行活动的参与者。

国际团结日。俄罗斯和朝鲜先锋支队将于5月26日联合开始募集捐款。在“国际戈比”日当天募集的资金将寄送给中国先锋队员。当晚将组织“援助中国先锋队员角落”。

" I z v i e s t i a ".
Moscow, May 5, 1928 .

Story about little Li Hwang.
It was a time when fighting was in progress in Shanghai between the workers in revolt and the world boirgeoisie. The troubled city, so far, was in the latter's hands. The guns of the Britisg gun-boats were ready at any moment to spit out burning shells. The huge city was practically cut off not only from the outside world but even from Chira. Agents of the world bourgeoisie were carefully guarding it to prevent foreign or even other city newspapers from coming in bringing the news that the whole region of China raised to come to its aid, that the nationalist army was moving ahead to give it as-sistance. Yet all attempts of the agents of the world bourgeoisie proved futile. Every morning the town was receiving a regular supply of information regarding the war situation or the movement of the Canton army. Every morning the house and street walls were adorned with bright posters playing the part of newspapers.
Details of foreign police were busy tearing off these posters. Yet the next morning they appeared again, even brighter than before, imbued with hatred towards the enemies of the Chinese toiling masses. Martial law was proclaimed in Shan, hai. In response th this the town, on the next morning, was flooded witn tracts calling on the people to struggle against the capitalists and stranglers of China.
This caused Minister Eivens, the Chief of the British Political Police, to be furious with rage. He ordered all his detectives to apprehend the "malefactors" who were posting bills and distributing tracts.
Early the next morning a small boy was apprehended by the detec-tives, caught in the act□□ of posting bills. He was brought to the British Political Police Office. Here the youngster was handcuf-□ fed and sent under strong escort to the headquarters of the Shantung
pages.zh:
《消息报》。
莫斯科，1928年5月5日。

小李黄的故事。
那是上海起义工人与世界资产阶级之间战斗正在进行的时候。这座动荡的城市当时仍掌握在后者手中。英国炮舰的大炮随时准备喷出燃烧的炮弹。这座大城市实际上不仅与外部世界隔绝，甚至与中国其他地区也隔绝。世界资产阶级的代理人严密看守着它，以防止外国甚至其他城市的报纸带入整个中国地区奋起支援、国民革命军前进提供援助的消息。然而，世界资产阶级代理人的所有企图均告失败。每天早晨，城里都能定期收到有关战况或广东军队动向的信息。每天早晨，房屋和街道的墙壁上都贴满了充当报纸角色的鲜艳海报。
外国警察的细节部队忙于撕下这些海报。然而第二天早晨，它们又出现了，甚至比以前更鲜艳，充满了对中国劳苦大众敌人的仇恨。上海宣布戒严。作为回应，第二天早晨，城里到处都是传单，号召人民与资本家和中国的扼杀者作斗争。
这使英国政治警察局长艾文斯（Eivens，音译）部长勃然大怒。他命令所有侦探逮捕张贴海报和分发传单的“罪犯”。
次日清晨，一名小男孩被侦探抓获，当时他正□□张贴海报。他被带到英国政治警察办公室。在这里，这名少年被戴上手铐□□，并在重兵押送下被送往山东

pages.en:
army.
His name was Li Hwang and he was not more than 10 years old. He
was a member of the Chinese pioneer union and was posting bills by
order of this organisation.
They tortured him to make him reveal the names of those who
had given him the posters. He did not cry out nor scream but
silently suffered the tortures without pronouncing a single word.
The 10 years old Li Hwang was executed but he carried with him
into his grave the names of those who have sent him to post the
bills.-
pages.zh:
军队总部。
他的名字叫李黄（Li Hwang，音译），年龄不超过10岁。
他是中国先锋工会的成员，是受该组织命令张贴海报的。
他们对他施以酷刑，逼他供出给他海报的人的名字。他没有哭喊也没有尖叫，而是默默地忍受酷刑，一言不发。
10岁的李黄被处决，但他将那些派他去张贴海报的人的名字带进了坟墓。-

The "Izvestia" of May 29th writes:-
Bolshevist journalists graduate.
53 students of journalism graduated from the State
Institute of Journalism and are being appointed to
various posts as editors and sub-editors, etc. for
the purpose of promoting communism by means of the
Press. They have important missions entrusted to them.
They must continue their military training so as to be
prepared to fill in the ranks of the Red Army when called
upon to do so by the Communist Party.

The "Izvestia" of May 30 and June 5th writes:-
Anti-Soviet provocation in China.

The anti-Soviet campaign in China has recently been
intensified by imperialistic activities against Soviet
Russia, such as inspiring the Chinese to attack Soviet
representatives, etc. Another factor to help in the
campaign is the resumption of Chinese civil war and here
again the imperialists are responsible for the Nanking's
attitude in attributing to Feng Yu Hsiang secret connections
with the U.S.S.R. For this purpose various false documents
have been published in the press to discredit Soviet Russia.
Some papers were not inclined to believe the information
and on one occasion the "Peking and Tientsin Times" even
said that the agreement between U.S.S.R. and Feng is
invented to serve as a weapon against Feng by his enemies.
In view of the U.S.S.R. recognizing the sovereignty
of China and her independence, she is avoiding every
interference in the affairs of the country, contrary to other
foreign powers, and does not support any of China's generals.
Neither the Soviet Government or any of its institutions
have any relations with either Feng, Yu Hsiang or other
generals, and do not provide these with funds, ammunition,
advisers or instructors, or enter into any secret agreements
with them.
The campaign is undoubtedly inspired by the foreign
sources of imperialism and particularly by the British.
The latter in view of the elections have invented a "Soviet
plot in the Far East" with an intention that such information
might have a beneficial influence on the elections for the
imperialists, foreseeing that otherwise there may be a great
change in the attitude towards the Soviet Government and
even resumption of relations with her.
The action of the Harbin Chinese Authorities with
regard to the Soviet Consular officials is one of the worst
known examples of the violation of elementary foundations
of international rights and international intercourse
and the Soviet Government is just to be indignant over this
fact, which is most unlawful.
Is there any harm in Soviet citizens visiting their
own Consulate for purposes of registration, etc. as has
been the case in this particular instance, when about 40
persons were found to be present on the consulate premises
and were arrested as though they were criminals? Moreover
this instance being used as a pretext for an anti-Soviet
campaign very crude false documents are manufactured to
represent "would-be" found ones at the time of the raid
and are published for the benefit of the public to show
that there was a Conference of the III International held
then, together with various allegations as to evidence found.

（右上角框内文字：C.I.D REC... 1.6.9.19.9 ... 8. 2. 29）

5月29日的《消息报》（Izvestia）写道：——
布尔什维克记者毕业。
国立新闻学院有53名新闻系学生毕业，并被任命为编辑、副编辑等各种职务，旨在通过报刊宣传共产主义。他们肩负着重要的使命。他们必须继续接受军事训练，以便在共产党号召时，能够随时补充红军的队伍。

5月30日和6月5日的《消息报》写道：——
中国的反苏挑衅。

近期，中国境内的反苏运动因针对苏维埃俄罗斯的帝国主义活动而加剧，例如煽动中国人攻击苏联代表等。促成这一运动的另一个因素是中国内战的重启，在此问题上，帝国主义者同样难辞其咎，南京方面将冯玉祥与苏联存在秘密联系归咎于他。为此，报刊上刊登了各种伪造文件，以抹黑苏维埃俄罗斯。有些报纸并不相信这些消息，《京津泰晤士报》（Peking and Tientsin Times）甚至曾指出，所谓苏联与冯玉祥之间的协定是其敌人为了打击冯玉祥而捏造的武器。鉴于苏联承认中国的主权及其独立，与其他列强相反，苏联避免干涉中国内部事务，也不支持任何中国将领。苏联政府及其任何机构均不与冯玉祥或其他将领发生任何关系，不向他们提供资金、弹药、顾问或教官，也不与他们签订任何秘密协定。
这场运动无疑是由帝国主义的外国势力，特别是英国所煽动。后者鉴于选举在即，捏造了“远东苏联阴谋”，意图使此类信息对帝国主义者的选举产生有利影响，因为他们预见到，否则人们对苏联政府的态度可能会发生重大转变，甚至可能恢复与苏联的关系。
哈尔滨中国当局对待苏联领事官员的行为，是违反国际权利和国际交往基本准则的最恶劣事例之一，苏联政府完全有理由对这一极其非法的事实感到愤慨。
苏联公民前往本国领事馆办理登记等手续有何害处？而在本次事件中，约40人出现在领事馆内并被当作罪犯逮捕。此外，以此为借口发动反苏运动，制造了极其粗糙的虚假文件，谎称是在突袭时“查获”的，并公之于众，以显示当时正在举行第三国际会议，同时还伴有各种关于查获证据的指控。

（右上角框内文字：C.I.D REC... 1.6.9.19.9 ... 8. 2. 29）

As to falsification of documents if these are
compared with similar ones manufactured in Europe, one
can easily detect the imperfection of such work in the past.
The one thing that gives away their falsification is
the old style orthography, which has been rejected by
the Soviet.
Another outrageous instance is the arrest of Comrade
Kuznetsoff, who was en route to Moscow on leave. This
is a step of the Chinese Authorities, which cannot be
considered permissible with regard to Soviet Consular
representatives. It is a well known fact that China is
endeavouring to abolish Consular jurisdiction and
establish herself on an equal footing with the other Powers
of the world. Whilst the imperialistic powers are
concerned in this matter and while their consent has not
been definitely obtained for equality with China, the latter
country finds nothing better than show herself negligent
in respect of the most elementary rules of international
rights towards the U. S. R. , which is the only country
which voluntarily gave up her privileges in favour of China
and has treated her on equal terms, The worst enemy of
China could not have thought of a better method to prove
that China is not as yet capable of governing herself
as an independent state and therefore cannot be treated
as an equal either.
Soviet Russia cannot allow gangs of Chinese policemen
rushing into her Consulates and seizing business correspondence
and detaining Soviet citizens who visit their own Consulate.
Soviet Government cannot tolerate this treatment any longer.

至于文件伪造，若将其与在欧洲制造的类似文件相比，人们可以轻易察觉此类过往拙劣作品的破绽。暴露其伪造性质的一个特征是使用了旧式拼写法，而苏联已摒弃此种拼写。
另一个令人发指的事例是库兹涅佐夫同志（Comrade Kuznetsoff）被捕，他当时正休假前往莫斯科。这是中国当局采取的行动，对于苏联领事代表而言，此举不能被视为允许。众所周知，中国正努力废除领事裁判权，并使自身处于与世界其他列强平等的地位。虽然帝国主义列强关注此事，且在中国获得平等待遇方面尚未明确取得它们的同意，但该国却表现出对国际权利最基本规则的漠视，尤其是针对苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟（U. S. R.），而苏联是唯一自愿放弃在华特权以利于中国、并平等对待中国的国家。即便是中国的死敌，也想不出更好的方法来证明中国尚不具备作为独立国家进行自治的能力，因此也不能被当作平等国家对待。
苏维埃俄罗斯不能容忍成群的中国警察冲入其领事馆，扣押公务信件，并拘留前往本国领事馆的苏联公民。苏联政府再也不能容忍这种待遇。
